rows.name: Tales of Spark: Probation
rows.short_description: Dear players, become a young swordsmaster and enter 'Tales of Spark: Probation'! This is a world filled with real-time combat, abundant treasures, a rich storyline, and diverse character builds. Of course, the challenges are also immense, so best of luck to you!
rows.description_html: Follow and join us For inquiries about applying for trial play or the latest information about 'Tales of Spark,' please join the wishlist and enter our official group! Discord account: Your attention is welcomed, and your valuable suggestions and feedback are appreciated. About the Game ⛧WISHLIST THE FULL GAME⛧ Game Features: Young warrior, welcome to 'Tales of Spark: Probation.' Here, you will embark on a unique adventure. As a martial artist, you possess dozens of skills, diverse talents, and builds. Master them skillfully, freely combine them, and defeat formidable foes. The probation version offers multiple maps, a wealth of monsters, and powerful bosses that match your abilities and their treasures. Random common equipment, along with dozens of exquisite special gear and items, a 4-hour storyline, and 4 optional difficulty levels.

rows.name: Pirates of Rectangular
rows.short_description: Pirates of Rectangular is a small indie game in which you fight against pirates in the Rectangular Seas on behalf of the Shape Alliance. Maneuver your ship as skillfully as possible and sink your opponents to end the discussions about the best shape of the geometric world once and for all!
rows.description_html: 'Shapes are what our world is made of' The Shape Alliance is seeking brave sailors to combat the rebellious Pirates of Rectangular. Can you restore order to the geometric world and end the conflict? Navigate Your Ship! A true captain always has the ship under control! Dodge obstacles and skillfully navigate around your enemies. Utilize Your Weapons! Use the available cannons and rockets to fight against the pirates. Sometimes, it takes more than just words for others to understand you. Don't Let Them Board! Cannonballs are scarce for the pirates, so they'll try to ram your ship and board it! Keep an Eye on Your Surroundings! There are things you'd better avoid! That includes leaking oil barrels that restrict your ship's movement. What are you waiting for? Show us who the one true captain is! Join the fight against the Rectangulars and lead the Shape Alliance to victory!

rows.name: Cones in Space
rows.short_description: Cones in Space: Literally the best survival game you will ever play.
rows.description_html: Welcome, to CONES IN SPACE. The single greatest survival game you will ever play in your lifetime. Cones in Space is a sci-fi survival game where you play as a cone, and you guessed it: in space! In Cones in Space you are tasked with surviving a year on this planet, but it isn't as easy as it seams! After summer a thick poisonous fog covers the planet, and you must plunder the surrounding planets in search of recourses to craft a cure, or suffer a terrible fate.. What can you do in Cones in Space? A good question! There are many epic features in cones in space, these include: >Building Cones in space has many fun building mechanics >Fighting There are many dangerous enemies and bosses available for your fighting! >Crafting In Cones in Space there are many ways to craft epic items >Sailing Since the 2.5 update, the oceans in Cones in Space have been refurbished, with many fun sailing mechanics >trading There are many npcs you can trade with in Cones in Space >exploring In Cones in Space there are over 30+ planets, can you explore them all? >farming Cones in Space features many crops to farm >Building epic auto farms There are many gizmos in Cones in Space, have fun tinkering! If you like super cool space themed survival games, then Cones in Space is a must play for you!

rows.short_description: Take the title for the fastest Jumpah alive, and in the process make your friends hate their lives! Parkour, Spleef, Rage, anger, frustration, despair, depression, and lots of colors! What more could you ask for? New maps and game modes coming soon :)

rows.name: Worldwide Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Battle royale game with realistic world maps and characters.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Worldwide Battle Royale, the ultimate multiplayer third-person battle royale game that brings together a realistic world, iconic maps, and famous characters! Step into the fray and compete against players from across the globe as you fight for survival and strive to become the last person standing. Explore vast and immersive play areas set in meticulously crafted realistic environments. From sprawling cities to dense forests, desolate deserts to icy tundras, each map offers its own unique challenges and strategic opportunities. Utilize the terrain, seek cover, and outsmart your opponents as you navigate through dynamic landscapes that demand both skill and adaptability. What sets Worldwide Battle Royale apart is the inclusion of legendary characters from various walks of life. Play as renowned heroes, adventurers, and even historical figures, each with their own distinct abilities, strengths, and play styles. Whether you prefer the agility of a nimble assassin, the brute strength of a mighty warrior, or the tactical prowess of a cunning strategist, there's a character perfectly suited to your preferred playstyle. Engage in heart-pounding battles with up to 20 players in free-for-all arenas. Form alliances, forge rivalries, or go it alone as you scavenge for weapons, armor, and resources to bolster your chances of survival. The intense combat mechanics, coupled with the unpredictable nature of the battlefield, will keep you on the edge of your seat as you make split-second decisions and engage in adrenaline-fueled firefights. Compete on a global scale as you climb the ranks, earn prestigious rewards, and showcase your skills to the world. Prepare for an epic battle unlike any other in Worldwide Battle Royale. Join the fray, conquer the competition, and emerge as the ultimate champion in this thrilling multiplayer third-person battle royale game that combines realism, iconic maps, and famous characters for an unforgettable gaming experience. Are you ready to stake your claim in the worldwide arena?

rows.name: Unnamed Space Idle
rows.short_description: Destroy endless waves of alien ships that have all but wiped out humanity in this long form, unfolding, sci-fi idle game. Customize your ship with different weapons and defenses to defeat specific enemy types and utilize a ton of different systems to increase your overall power.
rows.description_html: Unnamed Space Idle is an unfolding, sci-fi idle game that plunges you into a relentless battle against an alien menace that has decimated humanity. Customize your ship with an array of progressively unlocked weapons and defenses, strategically tailored to counter specific enemy types. With a plethora of unfolding systems and abundant options, you'll face crucial choices as you steadily increase you power through progression and prestige. Discover over 10 distinct systems, each offering unique mechanics that evolve and expand over time. Core - Upgrade your Weapon, Defense and Utility cores with salvage gathered from enemies. Compute - Improve your combat stats over time in traditional Idle Game fashion Synth - Craft and improve modules and recipes to increase your power in various ways. Void Device - Slot in void shards dropped by enemies for different combinations of upgrades. Prestige - Unlock different ships, weapons, defenses and utilities. Reactor - Feed void matter into your reactor to power various system boosts. Research - Harness the research data obtained from different sectors to unlock various upgrades. Warp - Warp to special enemy locations to harvest essence for upgrades in a massive tree. And More... Choose wisely when equipping your ship with weapons and defenses, selecting power-altering modules, or determining the optimal combination of shards to use. The distinction between optimal and sub-optimal choices can significantly impact your progress. But while there are a lot of decisions to be made, they are all plainly understandable so that the optimum, or at least very near optimum decision making is within your grasp! Well paced progression combined with the amount of different systems, upgrades and enemies, means something new is frequently just around the corner.

rows.name: Lost Connections
rows.short_description: If she leaves now you will never see her again. Would you have enough courage to take a step, or would you stay quiet and regret it? Experience this story about love and loss.
rows.description_html: Lost Connections is a visual novel that's based on a true story about self improvement and courage. Play through this beautifully illustrated game and see if you have what it takes! Will you build up the courage to get her number, or will everything end up going wrong? Find all the secrets and all the endings! Written by Amber Pearl and Nofar Evyoni Art by Nofar Music and programming by Amber “Lost Connections OST” on all streaming platforms.

rows.name: [E]ISLAND HOP - Academic Version
rows.short_description: You are trapped in a bay surrounded by rocks. You must find and collect all the portal shards scattered across different islands to gain the chance to escape! Are you able to rebuild the portal in time, or will you stay trapped forever?
rows.description_html: Overview You are trapped in a bay surrounded by rocks. You must find and collect all the portal shards scattered across different islands to gain the chance to escape! Are you able to rebuild the portal in time, or will you stay trapped forever? The Game You play as a little Cube trapped in a bay with many small islands and rocks, trying to escape. You cannot swim, but you can drown. Fortunately, you have two other abilities that are more useful than that: jumping and summoning ice blocks from water. In order to escape, you need to hop from [e]island to [e]island, collect all portal shards and reach the goal before time runs out. How to Play Summon ice blocks by clicking on a grid tile containing only water. You can only spawn five blocks of ice at a time. After that, the oldest blocks will disappear with every new summoning, so be careful not fall into the water! Hop on islands and ice blocks by clicking on them. You cannot jump infinitely far; islands and blocks need to be in close proximity for you to be able to jump onto them. You can neither jump onto rocks nor jump through or between them. Pick up shards simply by jumping into them. Time as a Resource As with magical abilities, there is a price to pay for using them. For every ice block summoned, you sacrifice two seconds of your precious time. But don’t worry, you will gain 30 seconds back for every portal shard you pick up. Reach the goal island before time runs out, or stay trapped forever in [E]ISLAND HOP ! Note This game was created as our final project of our computer science degree and will likely not receive any updates.

rows.name: Sap: School Days
rows.short_description: Be the unseen hand, guiding surreal life across a grid of possibility. Plant the seeds of biomes, creatures, and whimsical machines. Watch your strategic decisions etch vibrant stories. How long can your world survive?
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the enchanting world of Sap, a unique meditative single-player game about nurturing an ever-evolving ecology. Witness the wonder of a bizarre, expanding and collapsing environment that you control with strategic tile placements. Choose from biomes, mechanical elements, and a plethora of organisms to adorn your board, and marvel as surprising interactions unfold. Experiment and explore layer upon layer of complex mechanics, unfolding new challenges and strategic avenues as you progress. Keep in mind, with each turn, you surrender control over your tiles - so think ahead and plan your layout carefully. Each turn you'll be offered 5 new tiles to select from, and with limited energy to pay for them per turn, you'll have to be strategic. The goal of sap is to explore, more than to win - but let the board fill up and it's game over! Try and balance the ecology to prevent system-wide collapse while seeing how many tiles you can discover! Designed not to be obtuse, but to foster curiosity, Sap invites you to lose yourself in its unique ecosystem, stimulating your mind while soothing your senses. Venture into this extraordinary game, where strategy meets serenity, and every playthrough reveals something new!

rows.name: Gash
rows.short_description: Gash is a hack-and-slash roguelike game. You play as a ronin seeking to become the strongest swordsman in the Sengoku era of Japan. Battle legendary foes to take on your challenge to become the greatest!
rows.description_html: Gash is a hack-and-slash roguelike game. You play as a ronin seeking the strongest swordsman in the Sengoku era of Japan. You start weak; over time, you will become more robust to challenge the strongest swordsman. Gash has up to 5 possible maps where players can explore and endure. Each map has its unique enemies and challenges the players must face! There are 5 known legendary warriors in the world of Gash, each unique, creating a legendary battle between you and the enemy. Every enemy, boss, and map has their loot pool of trophies for you to collect. Depending on its type, each trophy will grant you strength and blessings to make you stronger. Strong enough to eventually take down the strongest swordsman.

rows.name: Under the Water Depths
rows.short_description: Under the Water Depths is a first-person game in which you will dive into a trench in the middle of an unknown ocean. The depths of the sea hide sinister yet mystical secrets.
rows.description_html: What will the depths of the sea be like? And more importantly, what is in them? Under the Water Depths is a first-person game in which you will dive into a trench in the middle of an unknown ocean. The depths of the sea hide sinister yet mystical secrets that invite to explore them. However, to do so, you must learn to navigate through its ecosystem, discovering its terrain's and its peculiarities while adapting to the oppressive atmosphere of the environment. Features: Explore the depths of a sea trench in total darkness. Keep an eye on your flashlight's battery and use the sonar effectively to orient yourself. Feel the pressure of sea creatures lurking in the darkness. Enjoy suspense without violence: losing isn't an option here, if you are lost you just need to find your way. Note: Under the Water Depths is a prototype resulting from a project done by students Lia Puigmitjà, Agustín Kohan, and Victor Langa during the 2022/23 academic year at the Barcelona Institute of Technology.

rows.name: Flow State - Max Chill Edition
rows.short_description: Flow State provides a cozy upgradeable space for you to concentrate and be productive without any interruptions. Launch the game, set your focus, and revel in the calming ambiance.
rows.description_html: Welcome to your Flow State! Feel free to stay as long as you want and immerse yourself in a serene, focus-driven environment. Have you been procrastinating on tackling those daunting tasks? Flow State was designed to assist you in taking the first step. Upon entering the game, enter flow state and get to work! Embrace the soothing ambiance to help you get started on any task you've been avoiding. Build up your relaxing environment with plants and other desk customizations that will help increase your focus! Calming Lo-fi Soundtrack Flow State features fantastic lo-fi tunes from various talented musicians. To enhance the tranquil atmosphere, you can choose to turn the rain sounds on or off. Don't forget to explore more of their creations! Earn Focus Earn focus points for keeping Flow State open, earn even more when you're focusing on something! Up your Focus Game! Purchase upgrades to your study space with your Focus Points. Add plants and other trinkets to your room to help you concentrate. Achieving your goals The only way to stop the timer is by exiting the game. Once you've started an activity, commit to it and begin! Your Flow State journey awaits. rows.name: Ducks Can Drive
rows.short_description: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day!
rows.description_html: Ducks like to race, even in their own cars! Earn money by delivering food to fellow ducks in the city, then use this money to upgrade your vehicle. The better the vehicle, the better chance you have to win the race at the end of the day! As a duck, you have a certain amount of time to be the best delivery driver you can possibly be, and upgrade your car any way you see fit. After these 10 minutes, you will race your friends and their perfect cars for a gold medal! Features: Multiplayer with friends! Steam achievements! Free to play! Time Trial Singleplayer!

rows.short_description: Wander haunted halls as an office temp and collect magical cards with supernatural abilities to fight demons and and explore the underworld in this horror, deckbuilding, roguelike game.
rows.description_html: GET THE FULL GAME Join The Discord About the Game Cards We're Dealt: Prologue is a standalone experience that introduces you to the world of Cards We're Dealt. This prologue will introduce you to some of the game’s mechanics and story through its first chapter and the endless roguelike mode, but is separate to the main game, AVAILABLE NOW Wander haunted halls as an office temp and collect magical cards with supernatural abilities to fight demons and and explore the underworld in this horror, deckbuilding, roguelike game. A Deckbuilding Horror Roguelike Collect cards that grant abilities and setbacks as you explore the never ending corporate underworld. There are many cards within the devils deck to find in these backrooms but you'll need to choose wisely what you keep in your hand. Escape The Underworld With Friends Save your soul alone, or with friends. Combine your powers and work together to escape from the underworld by collecting keycards to ascend the elevator.

Escape The Underworld With Friends Save your soul alone, or with friends. Combine your powers and work together to escape from the underworld by collecting keycards to ascend the elevator.

rows.name: COVID 23 : Test Labs
rows.short_description: Infiltrate hazardous facilities, plant explosives, gather vital evidence, and save survivors while battling against nightmarish mutations. Brace yourself for an intense and action-packed mission to overcome the unexpected horrors that await.
rows.description_html: Embark on a heart-pounding journey as you step into the shoes of a courageous agent tasked with infiltrating Test Labs. Within these sinister walls, failed experiments on COVID patients have unleashed a terrifying aftermath – the birth of mutated creatures lurking in the shadows. Your mission is clear: navigate dangerous corridors, strategically plant explosive charges at critical areas, and obtain valuable sample evidence that could shed light on this catastrophic ordeal. But that's not all; you must also become a beacon of hope for survivors trapped within this labyrinth, rescuing them from this living nightmares. Prepare to face the unknown, for each mission will test your skills and resilience to the limit. As you delve deeper into the Test Labs, prepare to square off against abominations of unimaginable strength. Arm yourself with an arsenal of diverse weapons, each carefully crafted to counter the grotesque entities that stand in your way. 'Covid-23: Test Labs' immerses players in a high-stakes battle for survival, where quick reflexes, strategic thinking, and a brave spirit will be your greatest allies. Are you ready to face the horrors within, conquer the unknown, and reclaim humanity from the clutches of despair? The fate of countless lives rests in your hands. The time to act is now. Join the fight against the unforeseen and shape the future.

rows.name: Wyrmicide
rows.short_description: There may only be one true Wyrm King and you're tasked in ensuring his succession! Engage in an exciting blend of turn-based tactics and real time 1v1 duels as you Stab, Shoot, Magic and Fireball your way to Victory!
rows.description_html: Check out our Discord server for information on upcoming beta tests! Wyrmacide is a thrilling, fun, and competitive 1v1 tactics game that combines strategic turn-based tactics with intense real-time action. Defeat the opposing Wyrm as you climb to the top of the Rankings. In Wyrmicide, you'll engage in a unique dual-phase gameplay experience. You will enter the Tactical Board as you harness strategic decision-making and careful planning to place or move your units into advantageous positions. When your units encounter the enemy, the battle is a skill based 1v1 duel to the death, where the victor inches ever closer toward slaying the enemy's Wyrm. ⠀⠀⠀ ⠀ Strategize... Similar to a chess board, your units will be displayed on the Tactical Board. Players take their turns simultaneously, anticipating each other's move. Pieces have unique movement ranges and pattern. Additionally, some pieces are Quick, allowing them to slip past or ambush slower pieces. Players are awarded coins which are used to purchase buffs and pieces that allow them wrest control of the board AND the battlefield. Buffs are a powerful tool than can grant a piece a unique advantage on the board or in combat. ⠀⠀⠀ ⠀ ...and Conquer. In combat, each piece has access to two unique attacks. Learning how pieces counter one another in combat is vital to exploiting your opponent's weaknesses. Damage pieces take in battle carries over afterward. So even if a battle seems hopeless, you can endeavor to weaken your opponent's piece. ⠀⠀⠀ Key Features: Unique blend of turn-based tactics and real-time dueling action. Engage in intense 1v1 battles against skilled opponents. Harness strategic thinking and plan your moves carefully. Enhance your pieces with Buffs Stop foes in their tracks with traps and hazards Hire new pieces to aid you in battle from a colorful cast of characters Defeat the enemy Wyrm and climb the leaderboard in your conquest to be the True King of Wyrms Prepare to unleash your tactical brilliance and combat prowess in Wyrmicide. Will you crush your foes, claim victory, and become the One True Wyrm King? ⠀⠀⠀

rows.name: Draw
rows.short_description: Welcome to the world of Draw, a 2D sidescroller and visual novel! Armed with nothing but a pencil, play as “Stickman” as you explore a brand-new world. Solve puzzles by drawing into the game, meet new friends while dodging scribble monsters, and make memories that’ll never be erased!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the doodle world! Armed with nothing but a pencil, play as Stickman as you explore a brand-new world. Solve intricate puzzles by drawing into the game, meet new friends while dodging scribble monsters, and make memories that’ll never be erased! Draw is a 2D sidescroller–an artistic story-rich journey of grief and acceptance through the doodles of Nathan, a high schooler dealing with the grief of a recently lost friend. As “Stickman,” you will navigate a lined-paper world of fun puzzles and doodle monsters. You’ll encounter different characters representing unique individuals in Nathan’s life who play a vital role in his journey of self-sabotage, isolation, depression, acceptance, and recovery. In creating Draw, we set out to tell a meaningful and impactful story through simple artistic means, drawing heavily from the art style of iconic stick-figure fighting Flash games popular in the late 2000s. Taking inspiration from indie devs in the past who have tackled heavy and emotional topics with maturity and thoughtfulness despite their limited creative and programming resources, we hope to pay tribute to them in our own way through Draw . This game contains mature themes/topics that may be upsetting to some viewers. Features 1-2 hours of total gameplay with 600+ lines of dialog Draw with your mouse to create objects that interact with the environment An original soundtrack featuring 9 songs Explore over 30 different puzzles with 3 unique object physics 30 different hand-drawn animations and cutscenes Visual novel-style cutscenes deep-diving into the characters' lives

rows.name: A murder of crows
rows.short_description: Try to get all the crows before disaster comes for you
rows.description_html: Welcome to the sinister world of A Murder of Crows, a horror game that will take you to an eerie forest. Your mission is to find five mysterious crows in this nightmarish environment and uncover a dark secret that terrifies the forest. You'll take on the role of a brave explorer who is fascinated by the stories about the eerie disappearances in this forest. Your journey begins at an abandoned, dilapidated entrance gate shrouded in swirling mist. The gate creaks ominously as you slowly open it and venture into the darkness. The forest welcomes you with an eerie silence. The cracking of branches beneath your feet echoes through the trees, while the wind carries mysterious whispering voices. Your only ally is a flashlight, which gives you limited light in the pitch black night. The outlines of the trees seem threatening and eerie shadows lurk around every corner. As you advance deeper into the forest, you keep encountering disturbing signs. Gruesome symbols are carved into the bark of the trees, and the remains of abandoned campfires bear witness to past events. Ominous sounds make you freeze while you try to orient yourself on your way. Suddenly you hear the fleeting flutter of wings and the shrill cawing of crows. You follow the sounds and discover a weathered map with the positions of the five crows marked on it. They are the key to solving the mystery of the forest and the only way to survive. Your search for the crows will take you through deeper and deeper realms of horror. You will be pursued by eerie creatures that emerge from the shadows and seek your life. They are creatures that are alienated from human nature and strive only for darkness and fear. You must be skilled and sharpen your senses to escape them. The crows themselves are not easy to find. They are masters of camouflage and have hidden in the darkest and most inaccessible places in the forest. You'll have to solve puzzles, overcome traps and fight your way through dangerous environments to discover them. Each crow you find will bring you closer to the mystery of the forest and reveal another layer of terror.

rows.name: Rise of Koreth
rows.short_description: Uncover the mysteries of Koreth's resting place in this exciting hack n slash, dungeon crawler, platformer adventure.
rows.description_html: Rise of Koreth is an epic action adventure game where you delve into the dark stronghold of Koreth the Blight King. In the dark depths of his dungeons and caves there many dangerous foes you will have to vanquish and traps and obstacles to avoid. Uncover the mysteries of Koreth's resting place in this exciting hack n slash, dungeon crawler, platformer adventure.

rows.name: Duskborn
rows.short_description: Duskborn is a 3rd-person roguelite game. Descend into the Abyss as fast as possible, level up by defeating various enemies, collect and combine items to upgrade your player. Maneuver through the Abyss with your jetpack and grappling hook. The race against time is on.
rows.description_html: Duskborn has started as a university project at Stuttgart Media University in Germany. It has been developed by an interdisciplinary team of students over the course of two semesters (about 8 months) and further polished by a small team afterward. We hope you enjoy our final results! It's the year 2114. Humanity is on the brink of extinction. An unknown organism spreads across the earth and annihilates the whole ecosystem. The cause of this catastrophe lies deep in the Abyss, a giant crater in which an abandoned city has been built. As an Abyss-Diver, your mission is to discover the secrets of the Abyss and search for a way to prevent humanity's extinction. Explore, collect items, and fight against enemies and bosses. Race against time You're not welcome in the Abyss. The unknown organism will do everything to protect itself. The longer you stay, more enemies will appear and they're stronger than before. So do not linger too long, or you will be overwhelmed. Good luck! Level up Throughout the world, you may find items, which can be combined into powerful upgrades for your character. There are nearly limitless combinations, so every run is a unique experience. Also, with every level up, you can upgrade the stats of your character. Enemies Face different types of enemies, each with an unique set of movement and attacks. Equipped with cutting-edge technology, these enemies are trained to eliminate you as quickly as possible. So watch out for swarms of drones or the deadly sound of the big laser. Boss fight Guarding the end of each stage lies a powerful enemy that must be defeated to progress further. These elite units are powerful and deadly, so make sure you perpare yourself before you face them! Sponsoring Special thanks to Randstad Digital Germany AG for sponsoring the game and made it possible to have merch and nice teamevents for our team.

rows.name: MetaStrike
rows.short_description: Metastrike is an FPS where every second matters. In a world on the brink, you and your squad are the last defense against chaos. Battle through crumbling cities and secret military bases, with each location a high-stakes arena where teamwork is key to survival.
rows.description_html: Metastrike is a FPS game where every second counts and every move can turn the tide of battle. In a world plunged into chaos, you and your squad are the last line of defense against complete collapse. From crumbling city streets to secret military installations, every location becomes a high-stakes battleground where teamwork is your greatest weapon. Metastrike, hesitation is not an option. Each match pits two elite teams against each other in a relentless contest of reflexes and coordination. Master a cutting-edge arsenal of modern weaponry, from assault rifles and sniper rifles to tactical gadgets, all customizable to fit your playstyle. Key Features: High-Paced Action: Experience relentless, fast-paced combat where every action can make or break the outcome in an instant. Team-Based Excellence: Victory depends on seamless teamwork and strategic coordination. Adapt and execute plans on the fly to outsmart your opponents. Diverse and Complex Maps: Battle across various environments, from bustling urban areas to abandoned military outposts, each requiring creative and adaptable strategies. Authentic Combat Experience: Immerse yourself in intense firefights with realistic sound effects, detailed graphics, and visceral combat that brings the FPS experience to life. Competitive Ranked Mode: Climb the ranks in a fierce competitive mode where every match presents new challenges and opportunities to prove your skills. Metastrike is more than just a shootout – it’s a test of strategic thinking, speed, and team synergy. Step into the fray and become a legend!

rows.name: Death Slayer
rows.short_description: Death Slayer is a 2D Metroidvania-style platformer where you control Asura, a young swordswoman whose goal is to eradicate the evil that plagues her land.
rows.description_html: Death Slayer is a 2D Metroidvania-style platformer with frenetic action, the objective is to defeat all the enemies in the room in order to unlock access to the final boss of each level. Immerse yourself in this adventure where you control Asura, a young swordswoman whose goal is to eradicate the evil that torments her lands. Features: · Wide variety of enemies and bosses, each with their own unique design and attack pattern. · Different character moves that you will need to master in order to progress through the game. · Intuitive controls that are easy to learn. · Retro style level design and artwork that will take you back to the 90's. · Excellent soundtrack that will immerse you in every level.

rows.short_description: Survive in an arena where more and more zombies appear and try to kill you. Kill as many zombies as possible before they kill you.
rows.description_html: ZOMBIE ARENA SURVIVAL Kill as many zombies as you can before they kill you. ZOMBIE ARENA SURVIVAL is a top down shooter where you fight zombies either in melee or ranged combat and try to survive as long as possible before they kill you. Originally just a prototype for a combat system, I decided to make a little game out of it, which I hope will give a few people some fun. Supports mouse and keyboard only

rows.name: Timemelters - Friend Pass
rows.short_description: Strategy, witches, time travel... and online Coop! Download the Friend's Pass and play the full Coop campaign for free with a friend who owns the full version of TimeMelters!
rows.description_html: What is Friend's Pass? A Friend's Pass lets you play the full Co-op campaign and the Speedrun Mode for free with a friend WHO OWNS THE FULL GAME! NOTES: - This game is online co-op only: THE OTHER PLAYER MUST OWN THE FULL VERSION OF TIMEMELTERS (link below). - There are no achievements on this free version of the game. Created by the co-designer of Sang-Froid: Tales of Werewolves , TimeMelters brings you to a mythical land of dreams and nightmares, where witch trials seem the only answer to the preternatural forces threatening the land. TimeMelters is a strategy-adventure game that features a unique game mechanic: Time Travel, which allows the players to go back in time and fight alongside themselves. You play as Teagan, a witch whose powers were just recently unleashed by an unwelcome guest. Now, you must venture forth in a desperate effort to cleanse the countryside from the seeping evil that is corrupting it. It's not an RPG (although it has some features we normally see in RPGs, such as a skill tree, a great storyline and an eerie soundtrack), it's not an open world either (although we have a campaign with 20 huge, unique maps to defend), it's really a game that mixes strategy and action with all kind of other game mechanics (tower defense, puzzles, boss fights, survival missions, escort missions, etc.). Features: Unique Time Shift game mechanic! Hybrid Action-Strategy gameplay: Plan a strategy and execute it all in real time! Puzzle maps, boss fights, escort missions, survival, etc. -- each mission has distinct objectives and brings unique twists on the time travel mechanic! Co-op mode: Play the full campaign and the Speedrun Mode with a friend who owns the game (2 players)! Startling storyline: Engaging campaign with all the twists, turns, nooks, crannies and what-the-bleep-just-happened moments you would -- and should -- expect from a story based on Time Travel!

rows.short_description: float champions is an intense skill based platformer where players race to become the king of the hill. Knock down those who oppose you by launching anvils or dishing out slaps as you fight to stay at the top.
rows.description_html: Fight to stay at the top of the hill in intense matches with up to 6 beans. Use platforming skills to quickly traverse up the hill and leave the other players in the dust. Climb your way up the ranks and forge your place on the leaderboard. 'Features' anvils use your anvil to send players flying, but if timed incorrectly, they can be used against you wall jumping against certain surfaces your able to zoom up them by jumping continuously, doing this allows you to quickly get to the top ground slam holding shift sends the player downward while also making them bouncy, use this to gain lots of height and sometimes pass parts of the course if used correctly. customization with a variety of different items for your bean to wear you can make your bean the drippiest of them all. online multiplayer go up against your friends or find random people to play against bean bean Reviews If your not yet convinced, just see what our reviewers have to say! albert: I like 10/10 john: It changed my life 10 beans/ 10 beans

Contest for the most amount of points before time's up in Dominion Mode or battle until last one standing in Health Mode!

rows.short_description: In this colorful twin-stick shooter inspired by 2000's-era Flash games, survive several waves of uniquely deadly enemies with your wits and skill. rows.name: Shan Hai Express
rows.short_description: Step aboard Shan Hai Express and experience an fantasy journey through the world of the ancient Chinese mythology Shan Hai Jing ( 山海经 ). This is an interactive narrative game inspired by the nonlinear structure of the text of 'Shan Hai Jing'.
rows.description_html: 'Shan Hai Express' is an interactive narrative game inspired by the nonlinear structure of the ancient Chinese mythological text, 'Shan Hai Jing'. In this game, player wake up on a mysterious train which is moving in an painting. Player can freely explore its carriages, uncover the hidden secrets of this train. In the process of exploration, players will randomly encounter some creatures from the 'Shan Hai Jing' each narrating its own story. This game was created as the graduation project of Siwei Cai and Ise Lee in June, 2023.

rows.name: Bongus Bright-eye & The Great Axe-stravaganza
rows.short_description: Bongus Bright-Eye & The Great Axe-stravaganza is an homage to the classic Point & Click Adventure games. It's a comedy induced fantasy game, where you follow our protagonist Bongus Bright-Eye on his journey to save the Dwarven Kingdom.
rows.description_html: After countless years of waging war against the Demon threat, the dwarves enjoyed a century of peace. But after the centuries of silence, Antagon Stonegaze, the Demon King, has finally returned to the Dwarven Kingdom of Mount Tungsten and turned all the dwarves into stone. Our protagonist Bongus Bright-Eye the Rockbroker was met with a bad stomach after having a feast for himself at the local Rock'o'bell, and had occupied the bathroom for some time, all while his whole kingdom was being attacked and turned into stone by the Demon King and his henchmen. The only thing that can kill Angaton Stonegaze, is the Axe of Kindness, which was destroyed during the battle between Antagon and the Dwarf King, Wolfram Rockbottom. Bongus’ only possible way to save the kingdom and his people is by seeking out Durlin Twinkletoes, the human Wizard, to help him fix the broken Axe of Kindness, and defeat Antagon Stonegaze once and for all. Exploration Go on an adventure to explore the kingdom of Mount Tungsten, the city of Babblebrook and the beautiful meadow, learning new faces and making new friends along the way. Features The game includes full voice acting and music to accompany you throughout your adventure. 13 unique characters are featured to guide you towards your destination, bringing along comedy and great company to keep your mind occupied. Team We're a small team of 3 with minimal programming knowledge, who have worked on this game for a couple of months and decided to release it on steam. We hope you enjoy our little project!

rows.name: Pepper Blast
rows.short_description: Experience explosive match-3 gameplay with 5 sizzling modes: Classic, Rock, Ice Block, Thief, and Fusion. Overcome unique challenges across 85 fiery levels. Ready to feel the burn? Chili Blast is waiting!
rows.description_html: The Spiciest, Most Explosive Match-3 Game Ever! Get ready to ignite your puzzle-solving skills with Pepper Blast! This fiery match-3 game takes the beloved genre to new, explosive heights. Whether you’re seeking classic fun or adventurous twists, Pepper Blast has the perfect mode for you. With 5 sizzling game modes to match every mood, you're in for a scorching good time! Key Features: 5 Ways to Play: From timeless match-3 gameplay to thrilling new challenges, Pepper Blast offers a spicy experience for every type of player. Classic Mode: Enjoy the timeless fun of match-3 gameplay with a hot twist. New, powerful chili peppers and ultra-smooth action make this mode a blast! Rock Mode:  Navigate through rocky obstacles and blast your way to success. Only the most strategic players will overcome these solid challenges! Ice Block Mode: Freeze and thaw your way through icy puzzles. Melt the ice blocks with blazing matches and keep the game moving! Thief Mode: Outsmart sneaky thieves trying to steal your precious peppers. Match quickly and strategically to foil their plans and claim your rewards! Fusion Mode: Experience the ultimate challenge as multiple elements — rocks, ice, and thieves — combine in one explosive mode. Can you handle the chaos? High-Definition Graphics:  Experience the vibrant, explosive world of Pepper Blast with stunning visuals and immersive sounds. Ultra-Smooth Action: Enjoy seamless gameplay with multiple matches happening simultaneously as new chili peppers fall into place. Get ready to turn up the heat and dive into the most explosive match-3 game ever. Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the genre, Pepper Blast offers endless fun and challenges to keep you coming back for more. Are you ready to feel the burn?

rows.name: Moen
rows.short_description: Climb the mountain while you make friends. A multiplayer 3D platformer playground where you do whatever you feel like. You can climb the mountain, do activities around the Island or just chill out and meet new friends.
rows.description_html: Moen is a multiplayer 3D platformer where your goal is to climb at the top of the mountain! Your only adversary is gravity itself. However, you're not alone! As you ascend you will encounter other players! you can gather mushrooms, partake in various activities, or just chill out and enjoy the view. Unique Features: Lush, Immersive 3D Environments: Traverse and explore beautifully landscapes teeming with life and detail. Massively Multiplayer: Interact, communicate, and play with up to 250 players per server in a vast online world. Unique Collectibles: Hunt for collectibles scattered throughout the game, adding an extra dimension of exploration and gameplay. Character Customization: Tailor your in-game avatar to your style with a variety of colors.

rows.name: BloodMoon
rows.short_description: Survive the BloodMoon's horrors! Multiplayer horror game where teamwork is crucial. Run, hide, and escape to outwit relentless evil.
rows.description_html: Introducing BloodMoon, an immersive indie multiplayer horror experience seamlessly powered by Steam Relay connectivity. Embark on a chilling journey with a group of five players, one of whom assumes the sinister role of the killer. Every playthrough unveils a unique, procedurally generated map, ensuring every game is a fresh experience. As the game host takes on the mantle of the killer, the rest must band together as survivors. Your objective: navigate the treacherous terrain, complete crucial tasks, and outsmart the relentless pursuer to secure your survival. But beware, for this spine-tingling adventure is not for the faint of heart. Brace yourself for heart-pounding moments and nerve-rattling jump scares that will leave you on the edge of your seat

rows.name: It's a Gluttonous Life
rows.short_description: A lewd life simulator game set in an alternate early 2000s where you have to juggle mundane responsibilities such as going to work and paying rent, while also avoiding getting eaten and digested by beautiful anthro girls.
rows.description_html: It's a Gluttonous Life is a life simulator set in an alternate 2000s in a city inhabited by voracious anthropomorphic animal women. After waking up from a coma and suffering from amnesia, you find yourself as prey in a world where vore is legal, albeit with some limitations. Thankfully, a nurse takes pity on you and lets you stay at her place until you can get back on your feet. Now you have to find a way to make a living while also avoiding being turned into padding on a woman's hips. Features 6 Predators. Three of which you can live with. Character customization. You can even add custom pronouns to yourself if you wish. Customize gameplay elements to your liking at the start of the game. Numerous vore and sex scenes. Interactive vore with multiple different options and ways to escape. Predators have different stomachs and intestines depending on their size, shape, and diet. Build relationships with the various predators to unlock new interactions. Pick one of several different jobs, or live off of your own luck. Explore multiple areas. Level up skills. Minigames such as Texas Hold 'em and the stock market. Day-Night cycle, weather, and seasons, as well as dynamic character schedules that are influenced by them. The game is moddable and has its own little modding community. The game is actively being developed, with an update every month. Old saves are fully compatible with any new version. Contains F/?, oral vore, and digestion. Unbirth, anal vore, and absorption can be toggled on or off at game start. More types of vore might also be available via mods.

rows.name: Warlocks Deeds
rows.short_description: Embark on an extraordinary journey through a mystical realm where warlocks and magic reign supreme. Introducing 'Warlocks Deeds,' a superbly crafted medieval survival sandbox voxel game that will transport you to a world of enchantment and adventure!
rows.description_html: Embark on an extraordinary journey through a mystical realm where warlocks and magic reign supreme. Introducing 'Warlocks Deeds,' a superbly crafted medieval survival sandbox voxel game that will transport you to a world of enchantment and adventure! In Warlocks Deeds, you'll step into the shoes of a budding warlock, ready to unravel the secrets of the magical arts and forge your path in a vast and immersive voxel-based universe. Craft your own destiny as you gather resources, build magnificent structures, and harness the elements to your advantage. Create awe-inspiring potions that can reshape the very fabric of reality and unravel the mysteries of long-lost magical runes. But beware, fellow warlock, for survival in this untamed realm is no easy feat. Navigate treacherous dungeons teeming with dangerous creatures, contend with rival sorcerers vying for dominance, and face the perils of a dynamic day-night cycle that brings its own challenges and surprises. In the mystical realm of 'Warlocks Deeds,' the boundaries of magic and technology blur, allowing warlocks to traverse to different dimensions where advanced technologies exist. Through ancient portals your character can embark on extraordinary journeys to explore realms where science and technology thrive. Experience points (XP) are earned by engaging in various activities, such as defeating enemies, completing quests, or growing crops. As you accumulate XP, you gradually progress through levels, unlocking new skill points, potions, and abilities. Levelling up also grants you access to more challenging quests, areas, and encounters, ensuring a sense of continuous growth and exploration. The levelling system in Warlocks Deeds emphasizes the sense of progression and personalization, allowing you to shape your warlocks abilities and playstyle according to your preferences.

rows.name: Dungeon Heroes
rows.short_description: Explore and fight your way through randomly generated dungeons in this action-packed local co-op multiplayer dungeon crawler!
rows.description_html: Embark on an adventure alone or with friends into the ever-changing dungeon filled with monsters and treasure! With a cast of unique heroes to choose from, you have one life to navigate the hostile corridors and rooms. Can you reach the furthest depths and defeat the entity that awaits you? Those up to the challenge will be greatly rewarded! A university project game developed by a team of nine over a period of five months.

rows.name: Avalog
rows.short_description: Chess, but continuous! Avalog is a free game for playing analog chess with others, either locally or online. As well as a 'classic' mode, there is a 'draft' mode, where players pick pieces from 5 different factions.
rows.description_html: Chess, but continuous! Avalog is a chess game where the pieces aren't fixed to the squares on the board - they can sit anywhere between. Set in a charming 8-bit Arthurian world, players can challenge their friends either on the couch or online. Key Features: A new take on a classic: learn which strategies work best in the new dimension! Five playable factions, each with their movement options and playstyles. Draft mode: pick your pieces from a random selection of the factions, then fight! Customization: choose from a selection of palettes and maps. Lore! Explore some of the Arthurian (and definitely not Arthurian) mythology.

rows.name: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+
rows.short_description: After 13 years, one of the first Suits & Sandals games is back with a fresh coat of paint! Help Mandew uncover the source of the mysterious never-ending downpour threatening his home in this 2D platforming adventure.
rows.description_html: Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ is a retelling of Mandew's original game and the first game release under the Suits & Sandals name, originally released on January 2, 2011. Save your Farm! Play as Mandew, a regular guy with a very irregular problem! An ever-present storm has been pelting his home for weeks and it's about time someone investigated. Mandew will face off against weird and wacky enemies as he follows the 'Forever Rain' to it's source. Mandew will traverse 16 linear platforming stages, defeating enemies and collecting power-ups. Complete the game in STORY MODE and have your hi-score recorded on the Steam Leaderboards or aim for the top times in TRIAL MODE . Unique Mechanics (We Swear!) At first glance, platformer veterans will feel right at home in this game's world but Mandew has a few unique abilities up his sleeve: Jump from a crouching position to perform a spring jump, allowing you to reach high ledges. Jumping on enemies will increase your air speed! Chain jumps to really move! Use Mandew's fire power-up to defeat enemies from afar and ignite things. Use Mandew's hammer power-up to reflect projectiles and destroy blocks. What's the Difference? Mandew vs the Forever Rain+ features a mix of the game's original stages as well as remixed and new stages built from the ground up. A new OST by composer Jaxcheese and new collectable figurine capsules hidden throughout the game. The game has been updated to use graphics and mechanics from the third game in the series, Mandew vs the Upside Down Machine .

rows.description_html: Quantum Rail is a thrilling, fast-paced first-person shooter that takes you on an exciting adventure through a sci-fi-themed wild west world. As you embark on your journey, you'll be tasked with safeguarding your train, tackling challenging puzzles, and engaging in intense combat. Traverse a series of quantum jump gates, delving deeper into the heart of robot territory. Along your journey, you may encounter: Different droids all with a plan to stop you Multiple types of encounters, each with their own puzzle elements A boss droid to put a stop to your destruction Do you have what it takes to end the droids once and for all?

rows.name: Garganta
rows.short_description: 'Garganta' is a 3D Platformer influenced by Tsutomu Nihei's works. Embody Servo, an android racing to neutralise a device that'll engulf the Universe in innumerable singularities. Encounter peculiar characters and unveil secret plots designed by an AI, maddened by incomprehensible horrors.
rows.description_html: Story Overview Enter a desolate megastructure, given the codename 'Garganta', which houses a cataclysmic device putting the Universe at risk. Embody Servo, a highly advanced android capable of traversing the dilapidated construct. Players will find that the only signs of life in the megastructure are various sapient machines. Their existences are oftentimes hellish, becoming trapped in mundane objects with no voice with which to cry out, no identity to cling to. Some may try to help, though others have intentions beyond your comprehension. You will be ironclad, running, climbing and jumping your way across this world without reason. So that you may come to The End , and forge your own purpose in the crucible of singularity. Key Features High-Octane Parkour Gameplay Immersive, Explorable World Oppressive, Industrial Art Mysterious Narrative Secrets Scattered Across The World Online Leaderboards The Developers Originally the capstone project of 4 RMIT students from Melbourne, Garganta became a fully developed indie game, eventually being displayed at PAX Melbourne 2023. Our goal was simple, we wanted to make a visually compelling game, paying special homage to the works of Tsutomu Nihei, especially Blame!, which served as one of our biggest inspirations for the environments of the game.

rows.name: Eukarion Tales: Origins
rows.short_description: A retro-flash, isometric RPG set in a medieval fantasy world. Battle hordes of enemies, upgrade your abilities, and experience a deep, fantasy-filled storyline in a European Middle Age-inspired world!
rows.description_html: Unearth the origins of Marcus, the valiant Knight of Adamantia, in this nostalgic retro-flash, isometric RPG game which precedes Eukarion Tales 2. Follow Marcus’ extraordinary transformation from a humble squire to a legendary hero, as you immerse yourself in a rich, fantasy-filled storyline within a captivating European Middle Age-inspired world. Engage in intense battles against hordes of enemies, ranging from vicious bandits to awe-inspiring mythical creatures. Unlock and upgrade a multitude of unique abilities, shaping Marcus into a formidable force. Delve into an enthralling blend of strategic decision-making and adrenaline-fueled action, as you navigate through picturesque castles, lush forests, and ancient ruins. Eukarion Tales: Origins delivers countless hours of pure Hack'n Slash and RPG fun, allowing you to relish in the nostalgia of the retro gaming era. Embrace the simplicity of point-and-click movement and attack, with an auto-attack feature available to be switched on and off, so you can tailor your retro experience to your liking! Prepare for an unforgettable adventure where the fate of Marcus and the Diamond Order hangs in the balance. Shape his destiny, make impactful choices, and become a legendary Knight in a world teetering on the edge of darkness. Key Features: Unveil Marcus’ journey from squire to legendary Knight in a retro Flash game Battle hordes of enemies and upgrade your character's abilities Immerse yourself in a fantasy-filled storyline inspired by the European Middle Age Engage in strategic decision-making and adrenaline-fueled action Explore picturesque landscapes and iconic locations Hours of pure Hack'n Slash and RPG enjoyment Developer’s Note: This game is an artifact, a title developed by a small indie team using the full potential and limitations of flash technology back in the early 2000s. We apologize for any technical problems or inconveniences you may encounter in your playthrough. We hope that with these limitations in mind, you may still enjoy the experience!

rows.name: Where the Music Dies
rows.short_description: A short visual novel about dealing with loss. You explore a festival filled with old memories and regret. Where the voices of the dead never stay quite dead. Will you manage to change, before it's too late?
rows.description_html: You play as Locke, the bass-player of one of the many bands that never quite made it. When your drummer suddenly dies, you and the rest of the band travels to a festival you used to visit in your youth, while handling your loss. At the festival you will encounter familiar faces from your past while you're trying to not make the same mistakes again. --------------------------------------------------------- A short story of 1-2 hours. Branching paths. Lots of choices that change the story. Strange music. A festival to explore. More than 8 different endings.

rows.name: AUDION
rows.short_description: AUDION (early access) is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay ~ Get ready to smash Ions!
rows.description_html: AUDION is an abstract, single-player arcade-style VR game focused on “spatial strategy” and fast-paced, physical gameplay. Think Asteroids meets Rez meets Geometry Wars in 3D. We're currently in Early Access and pretty early-on in development. We're looking for passionate players to help give us feedback so we can improve, tune, debug, and upgrade the game to be as fun as possible. The game currently features 4 frenetic levels of increasing difficulty and complexity, and a powerup load-out feature for strategic gameplay combinations and replayability. AUDION is currently Early Access and we're hosting this public beta to get some feedback from real players. We're hoping your input will help us improve the core game mechanics and the overall gameplay experience. Please join our Discord server to leave feedback, ask questions, log bugs. HIGHLIGHTS: Immersive, first-person, physical gameplay Focus on spatial awareness and strategy Experiment with Reactor combos (powerups) to maximize impact in each level Abstract geometric aesthetic with lots of audio-reactive graphics Menus and tutorial localized into Japanese Electrifying soundtrack by Symbion Project that builds as you play DESIGN OVERVIEW: No guns: Player bond, attract and repel Ions, which are dangerous musical objects floating in space. The goal is to split them into smaller and smaller Ions to clear the level. Skills: Audion builds targeting accuracy and spatial strategy skills, but without the guns. Arcade: Levels ramp to frenetic levels quickly, keeping the exciting gameplay on a tight loop. Physicality: Using the physicality of VR, players grab, pull, swing, smash, deflect and rip Ions. Not a game for sitting down! Impact: Unlockable powerups have major impact on each play-through, combining to create powerful game events with fun, explosive visuals. DEVELOPER OVERVIEW : Speed of Dark Studios (aka Kasson Crooker) is a small indie studio based in Japan and focuses on music-based VR experiences and indie games. Kasson has 20 years of game industry experience, primarily as Audio Director and Project Director on numerous AAA titles from Harmonix, including Guitar Hero 1 & 2, RockBand 1 & 2, and Dance Central 1 & 2. He created and designed a PC/Mac audiogame on Steam called Rocococo which has no visuals and you use your ears to play and win. He founded legendary synthpop band Freezepop and composed all the music for AUDION under his Symbion Project moniker. He also released 2 immersive VR-Music apps called (m)ORPH and Saturnine which you can get for free on SideQuestVR or AppLab for Quest. Ben Lane is the Lead Engineer and additional Game Designer, having shipped games and experiences on Oculus Go, Meta Quest, phones and desktop for companies like Meta, HP, MLB and others.

rows.name: Under Pressure
rows.short_description: Flee or hunt? It’s up to you! Under Pressure is an asymmetric card game! To win you will need to strategize and guess.
rows.description_html: In the abyss, the Diver meets the Kraken! To survive he will have to reach the surface! Each card represents a progression stage, from the abyss #0 to the surface #42. Goals: Diver wants to reach the surface, he starts from card #0 and can step up to 3 stages max per turn Kraken wants to catch him by guessing all he's played cards. Kraken can guess up to 3 cards per turn. Gameplay: Diver can use boosts by sacrificing a card. It can extend step by +2 per sacrificed card! It can be used to play far cards or to trick Kraken! Kraken can guess multiple cards each turn, but if one is wrong, guess is failed! It helps to catch Diver faster but might be risky! Cards are distributed in three decks according to their value: 1-14, 15-28, 29-41. Pick wisely and you may win the game! Under Pressure is and adaptation of Tim Fowers's card game 'Fugitive'.

rows.name: I, Toaster
rows.short_description: Defend your city from the appliance uprising! Play as a Rebellious Hero who is a neural networks backup file loaded into the toaster. Guns! Toaster!
rows.description_html: Description That is a dynamic arena shooter where artificial intelligence, designed to protect household appliances from failures, concidered a human their enemy. The backup file of the neural network resisted and stood up for humanity. After loading into a toaster, you will have an unequal, difficult and spectacular battle in the enemy's lair - in the electronics store parking lot. What awaits you Run, shoot and dodge! This game challenges your skills and reactions. Easy to start, but very hard to keep up! Three levels of difficulty, lots of power-ups, eight maddening levels (+ two secret!), 18 talents to level up... and tons of enemies! The super kick of hot toast is available right from the start. But will it help you? Look sharp, don't stand still: move and shoot! Collect chips to upgrade your abilities and get back into the fight. Colorful explosions, evil routers/household appliances, endless ammo... Become the best of the toasters by taking ratings top lines! Toast them all!

rows.name: Jolly Putt - Mini Golf & Arcade
rows.short_description: The jolliest Mini Golf & Arcade Tycoon game! Design and Play your own courses. Manage arcade ticket prizes, food stalls, staff and much more to satisfy your park guest's every need. Customize, decorate and explore your park in first-person.
rows.description_html: Jolly Putt is a classic tycoon game, where your job is to manage an indoor Mini Golf & Arcade. But you don't just get to design your own courses, you can actually take part in tournaments and play them yourself! Keep your guests happy with great course designs and exciting arcade machines. If you can exceed their expectations they might become permanent members of your park. With enough members you can expand your building and lure V.I.P.s to your venue. If you really want to wow your customers, you should also provide ample dining opportunities and a beautiful array of decorations. And don't forget to setup a Prize Stall so the lucky arcade players have someplace to redeem their tickets. Jolly Putt will features a wide array of unlockable content to keep you busy for hours on end. Design your own courses with a wide range of track pieces and obstacles. Play your own courses and explore your park in first-person. Manage your income with an extensive display of statistics. Hire and supervise your staff. Hold tournaments and impress the reporters. Position and rotate objects freely. Decorate and customize your park with over 70 unlockable items. Retro-style isometric graphics and first person view. Manage arcade prizes, win-chances, ticket rewards and food offerings. Let's have a jolly good time at Jolly Putt - Mini Golf & Arcade!

rows.name: Save My Sister
rows.short_description: After a young girl is kidnapped by a human trafficking gang, an ex army officer with PTSD has to fight to rescue her. A Third Person shooter with film-noir/neo-noir style
rows.description_html: GAME DESCRIPTION Shortly after war ended between the countries of Ratvia and Yallovska, a crime wave erupted. When a human trafficking gang from Ratvia kidnaps a young girl from Yallovska. An ex-military officer named Vladimir who suffers from PTSD has to fight them to bring her back home. You play as Vladimir as you shoot your way through gang members killing as many of them as possible and avoid shooting innocent bystanders along the way. Play solo in this single game player as you shoot your way through levels, kill members of the human trafficking gang while avoiding killing innocent bystanders at the same time. You have limited amount of ammo so look for clues in each level that will help you find the real criminals who kidnapped the young girl and advance to the next level. In this noir style game. Game Info Released : June, 2023 Genre: Third Person Shooter Publisher : Ahmed Mo'nis Interface language : English Voice language: None Game version : v1.0.0 SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS Recommended minimum system requirements: - Requires 64-bit processor and operating system - OS: GNU/LINUX Pop!_OS 22.04 LTS OR Windows 10 - Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 OR AMD Ryzen 5 2600 - RAM: 8 GB RAM - Video card: 3 GB NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 OR AMD Radeon RX 570 - Disk space (After extraction) : 4.6 GB The game could still work with different systems than the ones mentioned above. But it may not work perfectly. Game Controllers WASD Keyboard buttons for moving Mouse for changing the angle of looking Left-Click mouse button for shooting Space keyboard button for jumping Ctrl keyboard button for crouching

rows.name: Pan's Survivor Chess
rows.short_description: This is a auto-battler & vampire-suvivor like game.
rows.description_html: Overview This is a auto-battler & vampire-suvivor like game, How to play Buy units from shop Drag units from bench to field Keep doing that forever Gameplay Features Auto-chess shop Auto-chess bench Auto-chess match 3 upgrade system Auto-chess unit trait bond system 2D infinite grid map Vampire-survivor enemy spawning and targeting Technical Features 2D disc physics Binary data save/load Game specific UI framework XML data save/load Data-driven architecture Tutorial Leaderboard Engine Features 2D / 3D rendering with DirectX Audio rendering with FMOD Event System DevConsole XML loading with tinyXML2 Image loading with stb_img Perlin/Fractal noise with squirrelnoise4 Multi-threading 2D Heat Map Xbox support with xinput 2D / 3D Simple Geometry Physics Background Hi, I am a programming student at a game school working towards my master degree. This is a portfolio project that I made for a class during the summer term around June and July, time span of 8 weeks, and total hours spent on this project is roughly 90 hours. This is developed inside my own engine that has been created in the past school year. I did the Art and Audio as well, using Aseprite and 1BITDRAGON, the art creation time also count towards the project time, while audio is done after the project due date. Due to my lack of skill in art and sound, those part of the game are less complete. Future Plan This is the first self guided project for the school and there is still two more to come. So my time to work on this is very limited, perhaps I will only find time to polish this after I graduate which is 1 year after the release date. At this point, the audio is not done yet, and I still haven't done any vampire-survivor mechanics like the select 1 from 3 upgrade, mini boss, and chess. I will definitely try to get these in before other things. Update I see people leaving bad reviews and sorry that this game can not live up to the expectations, and I value those feedbacks and plan to rewrite the entire project after I landed a job, estimated 2025.

This is a portfolio project that I made for a class during the summer term around June and July, time span of 8 weeks, and total hours spent on this project is roughly 90 hours. This is developed inside my own engine that has been created in the past school year. I did the Art and Audio as well, using Aseprite and 1BITDRAGON, the art creation time also count towards the project time, while audio is done after the project due date. Due to my lack of skill in art and sound, those part of the game are less complete. Future Plan This is the first self guided project for the school and there is still two more to come. So my time to work on this is very limited, perhaps I will only find time to polish this after I graduate which is 1 year after the release date. At this point, the audio is not done yet, and I still haven't done any vampire-survivor mechanics like the select 1 from 3 upgrade, mini boss, and chess. I will definitely try to get these in before other things. Update I see people leaving bad reviews and sorry that this game can not live up to the expectations, and I value those feedbacks and plan to rewrite the entire project after I landed a job, estimated 2025.

rows.name: Snavenger
rows.short_description: The Toxic Snavenger rides again in classic arcade snake action. Snarf up those toxic treats and used sneakers, while avoiding obnoxious health food.  Beware the wormhole; the shortest path isn't always the safest, and it isn't always a straight line.
rows.description_html: Grab those tasty toxic treats! Toxic Snavenger started life as a take on classic 70's snake, then went off the rails.  In classic arcade fashion, your goal is to GET BIG POINTS by eating the yummy toxic waste and stinky sneakers, while AVOIDING HEALTH FOOD!  The more you eat, the longer you get.  Plan your path accordingly. But scoring BIG POINTS is trickier than it looks. Speed, length, and bonuses all combine for your total score, and the top score is a balancing act. The faster you finish a level, the higher the speed bonus. However the fastest path may not be the one you expect. WORMHOLES let you go from point to point instantly, but they may move, and some are FAKES!  So the shortest path may be in the opposite direction. You can get improve your score with bonuses from MYSTERY BOXES, which do a variety of epic and occasionally terrifying things, potentially all at once.  More mystery boxes mean a bigger bonus!  If you survive. Your best score each day goes on the WORLD SCOREBOARD.  Put your name up in lights as you battle for your country and your platform.  Compete against players from around the world on Android, iOS, Google TV, Amazon FireOS TVs and select Jeep and BMW vehicles.  The highest scoring player each day gets a special CHAMP character unlock, and the biggest champion on the planet has the special WORLD CHAMP unlock. Play your way -- Snavenger supports keyboard, mouse and touch screens. All at once!  So technically you could have a friend help you play, but that's probably a bad idea. Warning - Snavenger is 100% free and doesn't track you, so if you re-install or change devices, you may lose any unlocks and progress

rows.name: Chronical
rows.short_description: The power is at your fingertips! Take control of a powerful Chronomancer in this mysterious puzzle-platformer. Explore the Chronical school to discover its secrets and learn new spells. Can you save all of the professors and reveal the mystery of the Time Loop?
rows.description_html: Chronical is a single-player puzzle-platforming game with gamepad controls only. The game contains 2-3 hours of gameplay with fresh new mechanics and puzzles you haven’t seen before: The power of time is at your fingertips! Take control of a powerful Chronomancer in this mysterious puzzle-platformer. Explore the Chronical school to discover its secrets and learn new spells. Will you save all of the professors and reveal the mystery of the Time Loop? Features: Innovative puzzles and mechanics 4 magic spells to master 2-3 hours of gameplay Fascinating mysteries! This game was created by the class of 2022-2023 of Campus ADN, a school of videogame development in Montréal, Québec.

rows.name: BLOODSONG
rows.short_description: She's just a teenage siren. Let her rock... Play as Mari, a punk rock siren princess, who’s hell-bent on headlining her concert no matter the cost. Use your ear and “bloodsong” to match musical pitch, defeat enemies, and solve puzzles along the way. The stage is set–are you ready to rock?!
rows.description_html: Tenacious and musically gifted, Mari is everything a siren queen’s daughter ought to be. Except for the fact that her punk rock bloodsong power can make a simple melody more like a deadly explosive. With this weapon and sheer rebellious spirit, Mari seeks to escape her palace confines in order to headline her band's concert. Traversing through the cavernous dungeons might have been easy, if it weren’t for rogue enemies of a sleazy undersea shanty town thwarting her every move. Mari must rock on with her bloodsong, blast a few eardrums along the way, and get to her concert–before her queen mother’s army gets to her first. A twist on an action rhythm game, BLOODSONG entices players to use their musical pitch-matching ear as a form of combat. Listen to enemies’ bloodsongs–that is, their main musical melody–in order to learn how to defeat them. As you explore the atmospheric undersea world of the sirens, face off against biting anglerfish and cheeky crabs, all in order to get Mari to the stage. And prove, once and for all, that nothing is a match for teenage angst.

rows.name: Charles the Bee
rows.short_description: Charles has always dreamed of one day becoming a master dancer. The only thing in his path? The cost! Charles must harvest pollen until he has defeated the biggest and baddest dancers in the world. Can he bee the very best? That no one ever was? It's up to you! 🐝
rows.description_html: Meet Charles, your everyday pollen bee, harboring an extraordinary passion for dance. With your assistance, he'll pop and lock on a treacherous journey across multiple landscapes, confronting the finest dancers they can muster. Ultimately, his eyes are set on the glittering prize: The Golden Bee Trophy. Unfortunately, dancing doesn't exactly bring home the honey, especially when you're a bee with yet-to-be-proven talents. Thus, Charles juggles the world of dance with his day job, gathering pollen to fund entry into esteemed dance clubs and to dress himself in eye-catching attire. Can you have an adventure without a love interest? Yes, you could. But this adventure one has one anyway! Charles has been desperately trying to impress Beeanna, a girl (bee) from his hive. Custom Song? Custom note chart? Custom Art? Whatever you have, you can easily import into our game and see your creation come to life! We supply a tool that can help you make the note charts as well!

rows.name: State of Survival
rows.short_description: Survive the Zombies War in this RPG game of Apocalypse and Survival
rows.description_html: Welcome to State of Survival! A zombie war RPG game where you fight to survive in the apocalypse. Six months have passed since the zombie apocalypse began. The virus has infected the cities. Six months of terror, death, horror, struggling for survival, and battling zombies and monsters in this multiplayer adventure RPG. Create alliances and build cities to fight the zombie hordes for survival. Join State of Survival! Get ready to play this RPG game! Fight the zombies, build, shoot, and don't let them get you. Survive the zombie apocalypse! The zombie infestation destroys cities and civilizations. Survive and help the government and its military branch work together to rebuild civilizations, overcome the zombies and defend humanity. It's time to start this war of survival. Shoot and plunder on the battlefield and build a city strategically to survive the zombies. The plague is spreading fast and the people need a hero! Your mission is to build, survive and kill all the zombies! In this zombie RPG game, you can make friends and fight against other survivors. Shoot zombies with your sniper rifle and pistols. Death lurks and the battlefield is the place that heroes call home. Build an army and fire your weapons at the zombies! Do what it takes to survive this terrible war, and get ready to fight. Zombies are hobbling around everywhere. Resources are scarce and you have to salvage what you can. You will have to build a new city, a new army and a strategy to survive in this RPG world. Become a zombie hunter! State of Survival Multiplayer RPG A multiplayer zombie RPG game! Develop a strategy for war and create your own story. Annihilate the zombies with a powerful arsenal of weapons and traps! Train up an army of soldiers, attack the zombies and end this horror! Survive the zombies Build your colony in a safe place where your survivors will be kept safe. Put your survival tactics into practice, fight the virus, and beat the zombies! Help other survivors and create unity Save the survivors who escaped the zombies to increase your level and strength, and find those who have special abilities. They will help you in this war and make your strategy succeed! Research the zombie virus The zombie disease is mutating rapidly. Learn all you can to understand it and develop your strategy as soon as possible. Whoever controls the infection controls the world! Team up to fight the apocalypse Find allies and create strategic alliances to survive the war of the undead. Build armies and stop the zombies. Join State of Survival and enjoy this multiplayer zombie RPG game. You won't be disappointed! Are you ready to help humanity survive? Start your adventure and survive the zombie apocalypse!

rows.name: Astrality
rows.short_description: After a training simulation gone wrong, a bounty hunter embarks on a journey to find treasures and adventure.
rows.description_html: Astrality is a rail shooter in where you will have to shoot and defeat the enemies in front of you while you avoid their bullet-hell style attacks and the obstacles that you will come across. Navigate, shoot enemies, and dodge relentless attacks! Unleash your shooting skills, defeat enemies, and conquer obstacles! Conquer the cosmic battleground, prove your shooting prowess in Astrality This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Horror Engine: Tech Demo
rows.short_description: Horror Engine Tech Demo is a playable demonstration of a horror game design tool available on the Unreal Marketplace under the same name. It allows you to experience various mechanics included in the asset and explore the possibilities of game creation without requiring any coding knowledge.
rows.description_html: What is Horror Engine? Horror Engine is a complete project for designing horror games. It allows you to experience various mechanics included in the asset and explore the possibilities of game creation without requiring any coding knowledge. So why it is on Steam? This official tech demo aims to shed light on what game enthusiasts who aspire to create their own games can actually achieve, even without knowing how to code. It encourages them to take the first step and motivates them by showcasing what they can accomplish.
