rows.name: Seekers: Enlightenment
rows.short_description: In this 2D Action Platformer, embark on this journey with Ivy and Lara to seek out the real truth behind this world and perhaps the world beyond filled with gods, strange creatures, different enemies as you discover new environments.
rows.description_html: After Lara and her friends failed to defeat and seal away the formidable primordial God of Chaos, they're given a second chance when Lara's Sister Ivy comes out of a portal without any memory of who she is and where she was during the 5 years she was missing. After a hasty reunion Lara and Ivy uses the one and only chance they have to take back everything they lost to the Primordial God of Chaos! In this 2D Action Platformer you play as Ivy and Lara and they have 2 completely different skill sets while also having all the basic controls every other platformer has! Ivy can dash, shoot projectiles out of her hands, and summon clones of herself to fend off her foes! Lara can shoot Arrows, summon her own bubble shield, and heal herself in dire situations! In this game you can expect twist and turns with the story mode, secrets that can unlock harder challenges, while also unlocking extra games modes such as Time Attack, Boss Rush, and the Chaos Trials! Can you survive the journey that awaits you?

rows.name: Lil Johnny Goes Home
rows.short_description: Welcome to the world of Lil Johnny, a thrilling 3D platformer adventure designed by our high school class! Get ready to embark on an extraordinary journey alongside our courageous protagonist, Lil Johnny, as he finds himself in an unknown realm after falling through a mysterious portal.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of Lil Johnny, a thrilling 3D platformer adventure designed by the creative minds of our high school class! Get ready to embark on an extraordinary journey alongside our courageous protagonist, Lil Johnny, as he finds himself in an unknown realm after falling through a mysterious portal. In this captivating tale, Lil Johnny must traverse through 13 mesmerizing levels filled with challenges, puzzles, and formidable enemies. His ultimate goal? To defeat an ancient and malevolent dragon, reclaim his lost path, and return to the familiar comforts of his home. Our team of talented young game developers poured their passion and dedication into crafting a captivating gameplay experience. Every detail, from the meticulously designed levels to the intuitive controls, has been carefully implemented to immerse you in Lil Johnny's extraordinary adventure. As you guide Lil Johnny through the various levels, you'll encounter mesmerizing landscapes, each with its own unique theme and art style. From enchanting forests to treacherous mountains and mystical ruins, the world of Lil Johnny is a visual feast for your eyes. But the journey won't be an easy one. Along the way, Lil Johnny will face numerous challenges that will test his agility, problem-solving skills, and courage. Be prepared to overcome treacherous platforming sections, ingenious puzzles, and epic boss battles that will push your gaming abilities to the limit. Our high school class has worked tirelessly to create a game that not only entertains but also sparks your imagination and inspires you to believe in the power of teamwork and perseverance. Lil Johnny's adventure serves as a reminder that even the most ordinary individuals can achieve extraordinary feats when faced with adversity. Join us as we invite you to experience the captivating world of Lil Johnny, where determination and bravery are the keys to success. Are you ready to help Lil Johnny on his quest to defeat the evil dragon and find his way back home? Get ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure that will keep you hooked from start to finish.

rows.name: Beecarbonize
rows.short_description: Do you have what it takes to save the planet? Beecarbonize is an environmental card strategy game with climate change as your opponent.
rows.description_html: Your enemy: carbon emissions. Research cutting-edge technologies, enact policies, protect ecosystems, and modernize industry to avert climate catastrophe. Create your own path to victory, manage your resources well, and you might survive! Will you favor industrial reforms, nature conservation or people initiatives? There are many ways to solve climate change and reduce pollution. But saving the planet is not an easy task. The more carbon emissions you produce the more extreme events you will have to deal with. You have to balance the power-generating industry, social reforms, ecological policies and scientific endeavors. Will you transition from fossil fuels as fast as possible? Or will you focus on carbon capture technologies first? Experiment with new strategies and don’t be afraid to start again. Game cards represent inventions, laws, social advancements, or industries – each designed on the basis of real-world climate science. In addition, partially randomized world events occur, forcing you to adapt your strategy. Gradually unlock new cards in the game encyclopedia and chart your path towards a new future. The world of Beecarbonize reacts to your actions. More emissions mean more floods or heatwaves, investing in nuclear power raises the risk of a nuclear incident, and so on. Learn more with each run and you might overcome environmental catastrophes, social unrest, and even avert the end of life on earth. We are introducing Hardcore mode, the ultimate challenge in Beecarbonize for experienced players. In Hardcore mode you will face the harsh reality of climate change. Can you defy the odds and save the planet even in this extreme scenario? Beecarbonize is a strategic challenge that lets you experience phenomena shaping our everyday lives hands-on. Just how many seasons can you last?

rows.name: Team Rise
rows.short_description: Discover the fun of team climbing! Explore all the secrets, shortcuts and traps! Share this adventure as a team, or do it alone.
rows.description_html: Team Rise is a free game that lets you discover the joys of a challenging multiplayer game. You can attempt to overcome the various difficulties with others, or alone. Be prepared to fall down a lot and go crazy! Share with your friends your climbing records, your achievements, the secrets you've found and explore all the maps with them! If you fall a lot, don't give up and get your friends to help you. Team Rise offers several maps to test your player control skills. You'll also have several movement modes to help you finish the maps in single-player, but in multiplayer, you'll have the most complex movement mode so that you're all on an equal footing, don't hesitate to finish the maps with the hardest difficulty level.

rows.name: Dark Riddle
rows.short_description: Find out the scary secrets of the neighbor.
rows.description_html: Neighbors can sometimes create problems more serious than noise at the wrong time of the day. In this game you have to face an unusual neighbor, whose home is full of chilling secrets. Get into his house unnoticed, bypassing all the traps and video cameras, and get to the truth that can shock you! The main character in this interactive thriller is yourself, thanks to a realistic camera from the first person perspective. Moving to a new home, you discover some oddities in the behavior of your unsociable neighbor from the house across the street. He never leaves his home, from which strange and unsettling sounds can be heard, like cries. And one dark night a neighbor drags out of his house a bag with something that resembles a human body. It becomes clear that something suspicious is going on. You can not stay away - you need to get into the neighbor's house and find out what's happening inside! However, this will not be so easy to do! Each corner of his yard is adorned with a movable video camera, and all doors and windows are securely locked. And the neighbor himself is a rather dangerous person who will stop at nothing, just to hide all his dark deeds. If he discovers you, you are unlikely to be able to leave his house alive! Stay unnoticed, use your own ingenuity and uncover a terrible secret! Features: Advanced camera system from the first person perspective, allowing you to move around freely and look without any delay! Finding and using useful items. Find a flashlight, pimples, keys, gas cans and much more - all this will come in handy in the neighbor's house! Characters & Quests A living and detailed world with characters and quests! Skins A large number of skins for neighbor and houses! Traps & Weapons A variety of traps and weapons - all this will help you in the game against your neighbor. Use them wisely! Locations Various locations that immerse you in the atmosphere of the game! In a critical situation, you can try to escape and take shelter in your own home - the horrendous neighbor will not be able to get through to catch you! Your goal is the basement of the neighbor’s house. The key to unraveling all the terrible secrets is somewhere there! A stunning soundtrack, the sinister melodies - all of it perfectly convey the atmosphere of a mystical thriller! Will you be able to get to the bottom of the truth, or will you become another victim of an ominous neighbor?
rows.about_html: Neighbors can sometimes create problems more serious than noise at the wrong time of the day. In this game you have to face an unusual neighbor, whose home is full of chilling secrets. Get into his house unnoticed, bypassing all the traps and video cameras, and get to the truth that can shock you! The main character in this interactive thriller is yourself, thanks to a realistic camera from the first person perspective. Moving to a new home, you discover some oddities in the behavior of your unsociable neighbor from the house across the street. He never leaves his home, from which strange and unsettling sounds can be heard, like cries. And one dark night a neighbor drags out of his house a bag with something that resembles a human body. It becomes clear that something suspicious is going on. You can not stay away - you need to get into the neighbor's house and find out what's happening inside! However, this will not be so easy to do! Each corner of his yard is adorned with a movable video camera, and all doors and windows are securely locked. And the neighbor himself is a rather dangerous person who will stop at nothing, just to hide all his dark deeds. If he discovers you, you are unlikely to be able to leave his house alive! Stay unnoticed, use your own ingenuity and uncover a terrible secret! Features: Advanced camera system from the first person perspective, allowing you to move around freely and look without any delay! Finding and using useful items. Find a flashlight, pimples, keys, gas cans and much more - all this will come in handy in the neighbor's house! Characters & Quests A living and detailed world with characters and quests! rows.name: Bellus Battle
rows.short_description: Enter the world of Bellus, a world where cute animals run wild in a epic battle for glory. Blast your friends with Shotguns, Rail guns, Zeus lightning bolts, Bombs, Portal Guns, and much more. This is BELLUS BATTLE. Be the last one standing!
rows.description_html: Bellus Battle is a fast-paced couch free for all game that takes place in an arena, the aim is to be the last one standing. Players are able to pick up weapons with different attributes. The game has a round based scoring system. The last player standing wins the round, after this you will move on to the next map and this cycle continues until someone has accumulated enough points to win the game! Find a variety of weapons on different levels to eliminate your friends from the battlefield! There are plenty of hats available that you and your friends can choose from to show off your style. Everything from knights to hamburgers!

rows.name: Yubu: The Shoeventure
rows.short_description: 'Yubu: The Shoeventure' is a 3D platformer with a twist - It let's you build your own playstyle with equipable movesets!
rows.description_html: 'Yubu: The Shoeventure' is a 3D platformer with a twist - It let's you build your own playstyle with equipable movesets! Yubu, a brave young Footarian, embarks on a mission to dismantle the Reseller's dominion over the Maibli Isles, using an unexpected weapon: shoes! In this epic quest, your mission is clear aid Yubu in his battle against the Reseller, a foe seeking to disrupt harmony in the shoeless society of Footaria. With your help, Yubu will navigate challenging platforms, uncover hidden secrets, and unleash his extraordinary shoe-based abilities. Make Yubu's journey your own with customizable movesets and special moves. Equip different shoe enhancements to alter his abilities. Whether you prefer enhancing agility, boosting jumping power, or a balanced approach, the choice is in your hands. Mix and match these abilities to overcome obstacles and enemies in creative ways. With each decision, Yubu's skills adapt to your playstyle, making every run through the game unique. Your strategy will determine the outcome of each challenge. Special Moves for Special Moments Boost Yubu's agility and power with special move shoe parts. Propel upwards with a burst of water, soar through the skies, or perform high-speed slides into enhanced jumps. Control the way your shoe hit Discover shoe parts that do more than complement footwear. Some parts scattered around Maibli Isles can cause explosions upon impact, trap enemies in ice, or release devastating lightning strikes. Tactical Throwing Mechanics Master the art of the throw with shoe parts that offer unique throwing patterns. Whether targeting the nearest enemy, a circle pattern, or bouncing off enemies. Innovative Movement Options Personalize Yubu with different shoe parts that affect Yubu's basic movements! Customize your shoe, combine four different attributes and find what suits you!

rows.name: Anonymous Hacker Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Step into the shoes of a skilled Anonymous hacker and embark on a mission to unveil the truth hidden behind a sinister organization's plans to monitor civilian data and enforce mass surveillance.
rows.description_html: Another great hack typing game About the Game The Prologue serves as the opening chapter of the complete version, you will be able to play the first gigs in chapter 1 of the game. Immerse yourself in a captivating digital world where every keystroke holds the power to unravel the deepest secrets. Begin your journey in the safety of your hidden apartment, equipped with an arsenal of realistic streamlined commands such as Nmap, Harvester, Airocrack, Hping, Burp and more. As you delve deeper into the game, navigate through an intricate web of intrigue, discovering hidden truths and unraveling a conspiracy that spans the country. Stay one step ahead of your adversaries as you exploit vulnerabilities, troll online pages, and manipulate the Internet. Streamlined Realistic Hacking Experience streamlined gameplay with realistic commands and hacking tools, providing an immersive hacking simulation. Uncover the Truth Engage in a compelling narrative-driven experience, tracking down leads, and exposing a secret organization's dark intentions. Target Manipulation Hack and troll public figures on social media, disrupting their online presence and revealing their secrets. Progression and Unlockables Earn money and increase your rank within the hacking community to unlock new software, tools, and hacking methods. Dynamic Gameplay Adapt your strategies as you face evolving challenges, race against time, and outsmart advanced security systems. Player Agency Choose your path and decide the fate of the information you discover, shaping the outcome of the game's gripping storyline.

rows.name: Burger Kombat
rows.short_description: Assemble your most expensive burger from whatever you can find in the kitchen.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Burger Kombat Kitchen! In this virtual kitchen, there is no logic – ingredients randomly appear on your table every couple hours . All you can do is hope that your culinary skills will be enough to figure out what can be prepared from them! Combine various ingredients to create new burgers and amaze everyone with your mastery of cooking from the most absurd and incompatible products. The rarer the product, the cooler the burger. Collect the rarest ingredients to make the most expensive burgers out of them. In the Burger Kombat's kitchen, the main indicator of a chef's mastery is the ability to make burgers that people would want to pay any amount of money for! And remember the main thing – this game will not teach you how to cook delicious burgers, it will teach you how to cook EXPENSIVE burgers .

rows.name: Mannequin
rows.short_description: Play as a clothing store worker who is just finishing up her shift and preparing to go home. However, as you make your way towards the exit, the power suddenly goes out, leaving you trapped inside the store.
rows.description_html: Mannequin is a short first person horror game where you navigate through a store filled with suspicious dolls as you step into the shoes of a clothing store worker. However, as you make your way towards the exit, a flickering of lights precedes a complete power outage, plunging the store into darkness and leaving you trapped inside. Try to survive while you make your way through the store and try to find a way out. As you cautiously tread through the store's eerily quiet aisles you'll need to watch your back because each time you avert your gaze, they inch closer, their cold plastic hands reaching out to grasp you. Features: Using your phone as flashlight Murderous dolls are chasing you Chilling Atmosphere A short thrilling experience Nerve-wracking sounds Surprise twist Unexpected environment Controls: WASD to move Mouse to Look F to use flashlight E to interact Shift to sprint ESC to Pause/UnPause

rows.name: Asteroidc
rows.short_description: You're in control of a spaceship and your mission is to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Compete for the highest place on the Leaderboard.
rows.description_html: A sci-fi spaceship asteroid game. You are sent by the asteroid haters to destroy as many asteroids as you can. Don't worry if you die, they'll send another one in your place. But, the asteroids are a group organism, the more you destroy the more they will send and the bigger and faster they'll be. Whoever destroys the most will earn it's place on top of the Leaderboard.

rows.name: DAYS END
rows.short_description: Fight for survival in the horror FPS 'Days End' amid the Xonobia Virus outbreak. Confront terrifying zombies, find weapons, and uncover chilling secrets. Thrills await!
rows.description_html: STORY: Embark on a Heart-Pounding Journey of Survival and Redemption in 'Days End' - a Gripping Horror FPS Experience on Steam! As the deadly Xonobia Virus engulfs the country, leaving behind a trail of infected zombies and death, follow the harrowing tale of Chad, one of the few survivors determined to escape the nightmarish chaos. Joining forces with the ruthless gang, 'Blackbirds,' Chad must navigate through a foggy, horror-filled environment, battling terrifying monsters and challenging zombies with limited ammo at his disposal. Engage in intense action and thrilling gameplay as you explore each abandoned house, uncovering secrets and easter eggs along the way. Utilize an intricate inventory system and crafting mechanics to craft essential items and weapons, enhancing your chances of survival. Will Chad be able to find his lost brother and make a daring escape from the country, or will the darkness consume him? Play 'Days End' now, if you dare, and experience a chilling, adrenaline-fueled adventure that will keep you on the edge of your seat! CONTROLS: ⦁ W,A,S,D To Move ⦁ Space To Jump ⦁ Shift To Run ⦁ E To Interact ⦁ Q To Put Away Objects ⦁ 1,2,3 Or Scroll To Switch Between Weapons ⦁ Esc To Pause The Game ⦁ Right Click To Aim, Left Click To Shoot ⦁ Tab To Open Inventory Key Features: Investigate Each House Scary Horror Foggy Environment Inventory System & Crafting Monster Boss Fight Partial Controller Support Challenging Zombies Shooting Secret Easter Eggs

rows.name: Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets PROLOGUE
rows.short_description: In this prologue you will step into the shoes of little Eddie, a 12 year old boy who goes to the amusement park with his parents until what would be a fun day out turns into a nightmare. Experience the terrifying atmosphere of what awaits you in Jack Holmes: Master of Puppets!
rows.description_html: ADD TO WISHLIST! About the Game Jack Holmes : Master of Puppets PROLOGUE is a short game that serves as an introduction to the story that takes place in the main game. Eddie has been waiting for weeks for the day when he finally goes to the amusement park with his parents. But at one attraction something unexpected will happen... Join Eddie on an adventure and immerse yourself in the terrifying atmosphere that awaits you in this fair of horrors. Survive the traps that have been prepared exclusively for you in this crazy experiment. If you make it to the end, get ready to meet someone very special...

rows.name: Elewar: Fused Survivors
rows.short_description: Use your elemental powers to defeat terrifying monsters, while slowly becoming a godlike magician. Packed with challenging events, deep ARPG-like systems and a hardcore difficulty! 18+ classes, 25+ spells, 300+ unlocks, 140+ upgrades, over 50 random events and much more!
rows.description_html: Upgrade your spells from basic functionality to a devastating power! Complete over 300 challenges to gain the advantage of over 300 interesting unlocks , with quite a lot of new additions to the game! Choose from over 30 different events which may trigger throughout a run for even more variety and build customizing! Play through multiple realms , each one providing a different type of playstyle to all of the character classes! Craft your own weapon to take with you and overcome the 5 trials of each realm! Will you become the archmage of Elewar or will you be brought down by your opponents? Bulletheaven might quickly become a bullethell if you aren't strong enouph! Every enemy has at least 1 special attack... which you can dodge! There is no simple contact damage, which makes the game very challenging Feature list: 5 elements, 20 different offensive spells and 8 utility spells. Every spell may be upgraded in its rarity separately, which enables a diverse and powerful spell progression in a run. Prophecy Whirls, which give you a choice of a random event, may challenge and reward you depending on the chosen difficulty. 18 character classes with wildly different playstyles, combined with a dual class system. over 300 unlocks with corresponding rewards. Over 140 upgrades. Choose an unlocked blessing before you start a run, making cool combinations out of classes, blessings and starting spells possible! At least 5 realms with different enemies, rules and trials. Crafting system to make your own items, which give you an additional edge in the Trials of Elewar. There are 5 different equipment slots with varying crafting. Several hidden secrets to discover. A roguelike gamemode with a highly different gameplay. And much much more!

rows.name: Escape From Castle Matsumoto
rows.short_description: Two shinobis race against each other to recover stolen items and escape a Japanese castle, using their wits and tricks to outsmart the opponent. Retro split-screen duel arcade game using pixel art in 3D.
rows.description_html: Medieval Japan. An evil daimyo lord has stolen the treasures of Imperial family and hidden them in his castle in an attempt to seize power. As a young Shinobi apprentice, you have decided to sneak into the castle, recover the treasures and return them to their rightful owners to bring prominence to your clan. However, a member of a competing clan has also discovered daimyo's scheme and is on the same mission as you. Do whatever it takes to be the first to recover stolen items and bring honour to your clan. Please check out the game manual in the sidebar for full explanation of all game mechanics! Gameplay You control one of two shinobis competing to recover stolen treasures and escape the castle. You will need to: thoroughly search the castle to locate and collect all items hinder your opponent's efforts by setting up tricks and obstacles if necessary, challenge your opponent in a direct fight Use all of your shinobi training to accomplish the mission: ninja's tools: locks and smoke bombs powerful spirits you can summon to guard items and passages defensive countermeasures to break tricks set up by your opponent martial arts if a direct confrontation becomes inevitable Play against the CPU or another player, over split-screen or network.

rows.name: Blitz Runner
rows.short_description: In Blitz Runner, you'll dash through colorful landscapes, collecting dazzling gems that not only increase your score but also your speed! The more gems you collect, the faster you run, making every game a unique and exhilarating journey.
rows.description_html: Step into the vibrant world of Blitz Runner, a thrilling, fast-paced game where your speed is your greatest asset. As the newest addition to our collection, Blitz Runner combines the excitement of endless running with the thrill of competition. In Blitz Runner, you'll dash through colorful landscapes, collecting dazzling gems that not only increase your score but also your speed! The more gems you collect, the faster you run, making every game a unique and exhilarating journey. As you level up, you'll have the chance to race against other players on a variety of distinctive tracks. Showcase your speed, skill, and strategy to outpace your rivals and claim victory. Uncover new pets, unlock faster speeds, and ascend the leaderboards. The road to becoming a speed legend starts here. Are you ready to take on the challenge and secure your place amongst the fastest runners in the game?

rows.name: Parasite in Love
rows.short_description: Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Can you convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late?
rows.description_html: STORY A biological romance horror visual novel Infected with the parasite commonly known as the “brain eating amoeba”, you have 10 days left before your death. One of the symptoms is hallucinations. And through that, “he” starts to talk and confesses his love to you. Will you be able to convince the parasite to leave your body before it’s too late? Or will his love consume you “until death do us part”? This game was made for the Spooktober VN Jam 2022. CONTENT WARNINGS Body Horror and Tokophobia (Fear of Pregnancy). Player discretion is advised. This game also contains flashing lights, animated effects, and vivid colors which may not be suitable for some players. There is a 'Reduce Motion' option in the game settings should you wish to turn off the animation and transition effects. FEATURES 8.5k words 4 endings 8 CGs atmospheric music hauntingly beautiful art partial voice acting, fully voice acted endings plot-consistent UI changes CREDITS Direction, Art, Writing by NiAsobu Marlowe voiced by Coda Niall voiced by Trickle Background Art by Baguetti Programming by Ooyu Editing by Allie Vera Music, Sound Effects, and Voice Edits by Amidst Voice Direction by MAHO! Cody Casting Direction and Marketing by Elm Logo, UI and Trailer by ingthing

rows.name: All We Need
rows.short_description: All We Need is a first-person horror exploration. Uncover supernatural mysteries, face chilling encounters, and navigate haunting landscapes. Unravel the consequences of Jack's fateful decision. Survive the psychological challenges that await. Can you escape the horrors?
rows.description_html: In All We Need, players immerse themselves in a world of horror and suspense. Influenced by North American mythology, the game takes players on a harrowing journey as they follow the protagonist, Jack, who is drawn away from his family by mysterious supernatural forces. As players navigate the haunting landscapes and eerie environments of North American woods, they will encounter psychological challenges, terrifying encounters, and dark secrets rooted in ancient lore.

rows.name: Ovine Replica
rows.short_description: A fantasy visual novel featuring action, horror, and multiple endings to a tale of suspense, intrigue, desperation, and desire. Part I of The Enonoia Saga.
rows.description_html: Once an impoverished boy, Ecout Kanovos lands a job as a recruit for the authoritative force of the city of Enonoia: the Master Order Trained Hire. However, Ecout soon realizes that this work exceeds his expectations of delivering any sort of justice. Amidst the chaos of sudden abductions and riots, an otherworldly atmosphere looms just beyond the recesses of the city's society. From a dubious state prison, Ecout frees Otis: a peculiar young man with a beastly visage who promises to return the favor with an ability to grant any wish. Could this power repair Ecout's life before it crumbles along with the city, or will the events that follow mark his undoing? What awaits you in the end is yet to be found. FEATURES An adventure-style visual novel. Multiple endings to a tale of suspense and intrigue shed new light on what could be and what could have been. Choices made will lead to different outcomes in unexpected ways as your true intentions become evident. In an already foreign world, the true mysteries have yet to be solved, and the biggest surprises have yet to be discovered. The precursor to Amorous Ursidae's Ursine Science .

rows.name: AMBUSH tactics Advanced
rows.short_description: A simple modern medieval tactics RPG.
rows.description_html: The finished epic tactics RPG is finally here! Deep below Legacio is the land known as Centralia. Within lies three city-kingdoms which include Gala, where our story begins. Ruby Pyre is a thief who gets caught, but is given an opportunity by the King's nephew to become a General of Gala's Woman Army. Red Cloud, a shadow, failed to save Ruby and vows to stop the royal family. Gala, using its male and female armies, are set off to find an ancient treasure said to contain some strange power. So begins the war of the sexes in a bid to find the 'cores' in this Core War. Elle (pronounced Ellie) Clare, Iris Green, Mike Cullen, and many others will join this story in a quest to bring Centralia back to some peace. Enjoy a thrilling tactics RPG where each decision may end the battle itself! Credit to Victor Sant & GubiD for Engine.

rows.name: Scratch Man
rows.short_description: In this 2.5D obstacle dodging game Scratch Man is on a train home when he encounters his old enemy the Evil Squirrel, who has recently escaped from prison.
rows.description_html: In this 2.5D obstacle dodging game you play as Scratch Man. He is a cat super hero who is on a train home when he encounters his old enemy the Evil Squirrel, who has recently escaped from prison. It is up to you to foil his evil plan and save the (honestly kind of weird) passengers. At one point you will be knocked off the train and must catch up to it. Scratch Man will start automatically flying towards the train and his progress will be represented by a graphic on screen. During this time you must move him up and down to avoid obstacles being thrown. These obstacles spawn either in the middle, top, or bottom of the right side of the screen. If you are hit too many times it is Game Over and you can try again. Features: The passengers of the train have some bizarre things to say, it's worth talking to them. Dramatic action cutscenes featuring Scratch Man and the Evil Squirrel. Fully voice acted. Do dogs get offended if they see you using a lint roller? Created by a group of friends, bursting at the seams with personality. Hard mode has faster obstacles, alternate passenger dialogue, and a secret ending.

rows.name: Shroom & Doom
rows.short_description: A top-down tower-defense game where you play as a little robot that has crash landed on an alien planet. Defend yourself against waves of bug-like enemies using towers made from the local mushrooms. Find a way to repair your ship and escape the planet!
rows.description_html: Shroom & Doom is a top-down tower-defense game where you play as a little robot that has crash landed on an alien planet. You must defeat waves of bug-like enemies and use the biomass they drop to build towers made from the local mushrooms. These towers are your only hope at defending yourself from the ever increasing onslaught of vicious enemies Defend yourself against waves of increasing intensity Face off against three unique enemies Use biomass obtained from the local fauna to grow your own defensive towers Play again and again to get farther and beat your highscore This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Asurya's Embers
rows.short_description: Asurya’s Embers is a 1st-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow shooter set in an ancient Himalayan village plagued by an environmental disaster. Find safety in the shadows from the blazing heat waves as Dawa, a bow-wielding hero who protects her village from the vengeful sun god, Asurya.
rows.description_html: Overview Immerse yourself in the spectacular environment of the Himalayan regions as Dawa, the bow-wielding village protector. Asurya’s Embers is a first-person, single-player, bow-and-arrow adventure game where you embark on a journey to save your home from the wrath of a vengeful god. In Asurya’s Embers , explore the Himalayan landscape and mountains, navigating your way while avoiding the intense sunlight and seeking safety in the shadows. Wield the Protector’s Bow and unleash mythical powers passed down through generations to protect your people by slaying mutated, demonic animals. Story A long time ago, this beautiful region was plagued by warfare. In order to protect the people from danger, the village initiated a tradition of electing a village protector. In the game, the player assumes the role of Dawa, the newly appointed protector. The story begins following Dawa’s completion of her meditation training in isolation. As Dawa embarks on her first day in the role, she learns that the natural balance of her world has been upturned by scorching skies and the arrival of mutated animals. Upon consulting with the village elders, she realizes that there is a more significant problem at hand... Features Immerse in a world of historical fantasy in the Himalaya regions, with these exciting game features: Immersive and Gorgeous Himalayan Landscape Embark on a journey in the Himalayan region, featuring beautiful mountain ranges and realistic architecture inspired by South Asian culture. Enjoy the grace and serenity of the in-game landscape. Powerful Bow Play Wield the power of the Protector’s Bow, passed down through generations, equipped with multiple special abilities to aid you in your journey of defeating demonic enemies. Unconventional Light and Shadow Mechanic Experience our unconventional light and shadow mechanic, where you must seek safety in the shadows and risk damage in the sunlight.

rows.name: Kneedle Knight
rows.short_description: Kneedle Knight is a 3rd-person puzzle platformer game. Conjure fabric with a magic needle as Sir Lukoss the Small and merge in and out of fabric. Solve puzzles, platform across magical objects, and defeat cursed candle minions to return Sir Lukoss to normal and defeat the Witch of Fabric!
rows.description_html: Kneedle Knight is a third-person, puzzle platformer game developed by students at SMU Guildhall Cohort 32. In Kneedle Knight , the player controls a mouse knight that uses his magical needle to sew fabric which he can merge into, moving back and forth between 3D and 2D. Sir Lukoss the Small was a noble knight sent on a quest to defeat the evil Witch of Fabric. The Witch, using her enchanted fabric, imprisoned and transformed many citizens and knights into malicious fabrications. Sir Lukoss climbed up through her fortress to put an end to her tyranny, only to be hexed by her magic and transformed into a mouse. In the dark dungeon of the Witch’s lair, the mouse finds a magic needle, granting him special powers to sew fabric of his own and merge in and out of the enchanted threadwork. Now Sir Lukoss must use his newfound weapon to sew his path forward and up through the evil stronghold. The mouse knight can use his needle to solve puzzles, overcome challenging obstacles, and defeat the animated candle minions of the Witch. All with the hopes of returning to face the Witch of Fabric yet again to finish his noble quest. Features: Single-player, puzzle platformer game Playtime (main story): 1-2 hours Playtime (100% achievements): 2 hours Steam leaderboard support for level speed running Made in Unreal Engine 5 Original soundtrack

rows.name: Taking Root - Academic Version
rows.short_description: Join a stone creature and its loyal plant companion in an emotional journey to escape their once-pristine home, now suffocated by a concrete metropolis. Solve mind-bending puzzles by shifting perspectives as they flee together and find a new sanctuary to forever take root!
rows.description_html: An emotional Odyssey Embark on a heartfelt journey in “ Taking Root ”, a game which depicts the emotional experience of escape on an abstract level. Its purpose is to encourage players to empathize with people having experienced such a journey in their lifes. Intervined Fates In this unique experience, you'll step into the shoes of a stone creature and its devoted plant companion. Sharing a deep, symbiotic friendship from birth, they choose to navigate the challenges of finding a new home after their once-pristine homeland transformed into a concrete-laden metropolis. Think outside the Garden As the player, you'll keep watch over this extraordinary pair and guide them on their arduous escape. You'll encounter a multitude of perspective-based puzzles along the way, requiring you to perceive the world differently and think outside the box. These puzzles will test your creativity and problem-solving skills. Immerse Yourself The colors and soundscapes used in each area reflect the emotional state of our endearing protagonists to provide an immersive experience. Will you be able to lead this inseperable duo to a new sanctuary where they can Take Root ? Root for us! This game was created during our studies at the University of Applied Sciences Salzburg as our bachelor's project. Game Design / Art Pascal Patrice Vincent Betsche Sarah Hagleitner Vivienne Estella Depauli Game Design / Programming Benjamin Kunz Cedric Elias Ferstl Helen Hinrichs Music Michael Paul Thelonious Hamel Logo / UI Sophie Marie Hennerbichler

rows.name: Le Bonk - Academic Version
rows.short_description: Imagine, you are a mole armed with a hammer, battling creatures coming out of holes by throwing your hammer to knock them off the stage. Dig into the environment to avoid hammers and use speed to dash into opponents for a powerful knockback. Be the last one standing and BONK!
rows.description_html: Notice: This game requires at least 2 players with controllers to be playable! Keyboard is not supported. Le Bonk is an action-packed game where you assume the role of a mole armed with a hammer and compete against other moles in the Moleanship. Your goal is to knock your opponents off the stage while remaining the last one standing. Immerse yourself in an exciting world that requires quick reflexes and strategic thinking. Throw your hammer at your opponents to unbalance them with a powerful strike. However, be careful not to be pushed to the edge of doom yourself! Use the environment to your advantage by burrowing into the ground to avoid incoming hammers. With your speed, you can swiftly move towards your opponents and deliver a mighty blow. The game features an appealing design that perfectly reflects the gameplay. Each level introduces unique third-party events, making the game even more captivating. Get ready for an thrilling adventure filled with action and tactical challenges. Become the master of Le Bonk and defeat your opponents to stand as the last mole on the hill.

rows.name: Labyrinth of Rage
rows.short_description: Enter the Labyrinth... at your own demise.
rows.description_html: A Souls-Like game like nothing seen before Trapped inside a Labyrinth constructed inside a demonic realm , our hero must face the deepest and darkest depths inside these twisted walls. Imbued with the power of magic, combat, and archery. Will you escape the Labyrinth? Fight your way against hordes of monsters while traversing through the twisted hallways. Various Combat Styles Use different styles of combat like one-handed sword & shield, bow & arrows, and magic! With many more combat styles on the way. Level up through Gear! Become stronger by wandering through the labyrinth and acquiring new weapons and armor. Many updates on the way (Early Access) This game is still in it's infancy and will continue to grow, for the time being it is in Early Access right now.

rows.name: Rampage Agents
rows.short_description: Rampage Agents is a VR game that fuses battle royale with multi-player action adventure games. Obtain powerful agents with unique powers and team up with your friends now!
rows.description_html: Rampage Agents is a VR game that includes hero shooting battle royale and multiplayer cooperative adventure gameplay. Players will take control of increasingly diverse and powerful superhuman agents, form tactical squads with friends, and fight together! 🎮 Battle Royale Mode: Create your tactic squad and utilize your hero skill, weapon and items to ensure your survival. Become the last one standing in the massive map. - KEY FEATURES: 🔥Diverse Tactical Skills. Not just for expert shooters! 🔥Over 100 different items and various weapons. Each weapon has its own unique ability. 🎮 Adventure Mode:(Over 12 hours of content, multiplayer mode requires the purchase of the Multiplayer Adventure Expansion Pack) Fused with Roguelite elements and dynamic tactical options, you can play as different agents with different skill sets in procedurally-generated stages with random loots. Find the right weapon & chip combo and level up the skills to create a unique build among tens of thousands of possible combinations. - KEY FEATURES: 🔥FPS+Roguelite+RPG combined gameplay, construct diverse Build through death cycle for different experience 🔥Many heroes and multiple game plus with different game mechanisms 🔥Dozens of personalized dyes available to customize your skin

rows.name: SpaceMine
rows.short_description: SpaceMine is a third-person tower defence game where your mission is to defend your mining operation by building towers and barriers to hold off waves of local fauna and collect enough resources to meet the company's quota.
rows.description_html: SpaceMine is a thrilling third-person tower defence game that puts you in charge of a mining operation on a distant asteroid! You'll be tasked with delivering minerals to your corporate overlords and fending off waves of local fauna before they can disrupt your mining operation. To do this, you can choose from a variety of structures with different strengths and weaknesses to build and upgrade. Of course, this all depends on the difficulty setting you choose, as this will affect the range of systems available to you to complete your mission. Be aware, however, that building, upgrading and repairing structures is not a company expense and must be paid for out of your own pocket! So choose wisely what you build, upgrade or repair and when you pay for it.  Brakken Industries would love to welcome a new Mining Operations Manager, with new positions becoming available every minute, there is always a place in our family.

rows.name: Mutus Meteora
rows.short_description: Mutus Meteora is a Ground-breaking fusion of art and gaming, offering an innovative experience where you explore an art gallery as though immersed in Top Down perspective. Experiencing a digital exhibition slightly different from the usual approach.
rows.description_html: MUTUS METEORA Welcome to the virtual gallery where you can explore the highlands, its architecture, discover works of art, collectibles, interact with a third-person character, and adjust the time of day. This project is an exploration on Secondary Bounce journey, and we are excited to have Shir Pakman as our special guest visual artist and immersed in the music of Javier Jaime. Deeply entwined with the exploration of the subconscious and the unleashing of imagination through provocative imagery. The artworks evoke a dream-like ambiance, showcasing mystical scenes and imaginary landscapes that explore themes like personal transformation, alchemy, and esoteric knowledge seeking. The art encapsulates philosophical and spiritual ideas, striving to create a bridge between art and nature. The sculptures on display, with their organic and abstract shapes, mirror a deep fascination with natural beauty and the allure of various materials. Employing stone, metal, and wood, the creator’s vision is vividly brought to life. We invite you to submerge yourself in this unique experience, where art and technology come together to create a captivating virtual world. Come and discover the lights and shadows of Mutus Meteora. Mutus Meteora is a Ground-breaking fusion of art and gaming, offering an innovative experience where you explore an art gallery as though immersed in Top Down perspective. This project aims to bridge the perceived gap between these two domains, introducing Artists as creators and gamers as users to the world of fine digital art galleries with an engaging, playful twist. Experiencing a digital exhibition slightly different from the usual approach.

rows.name: Heros and Monsters: Idle Incremental
rows.short_description: Auto Battler, Incremental, Idle Game
rows.description_html: Rated higher in steam than HellDivers 2! Ethically free Idle game! (No Ads/Micro Transactions or options to buy anything) In the once-prosperous kingdom, a land shrouded in mystic enchantments and ancient prophecies, a dire threat looms. The malevolent Mordek, a dark sorcerer of unparalleled power, has unleashed his horde of abominations upon the land, plunging it into chaos and despair. As the darkness encroaches, a glimmer of hope emerges from the towering spires of the royal castle. It is here, amidst the swirling mists of uncertainty, that brave adventurers gather, their hearts ablaze with the fire of determination. They stand ready to embark on a perilous quest that will lead them from the fortress's battlements deep into the heart of the enchanted forest, where Mordek's sinister lair lies hidden within the depths of a cavern veiled in shadows. Yet, this is not merely a battle of steel and magic, but a test of courage and resilience. For in this mystical realm, the laws of nature bend to the will of those who dare to challenge fate. It is a realm where heroes craft their own destiny, forging mighty weapons and armor, and honing their skills to perfection through tireless dedication. In the crucible of adventure, every action taken echoes through the fabric of reality, shaping the very course of destiny. Will you charge headlong into the fray, confronting the minions of darkness with unwavering resolve? Or will you harness the power of patience and strategy, allowing your strength to grow with each passing moment, until you stand as a beacon of hope amidst the encroaching shadows? So gather your courage, brave adventurer, and let your legend be written in the annals of history. For the fate of the Kingdom hangs in the balance, and only by vanquishing Mordek and rebuilding the kingdom can true peace be restored to this mystical land. Ascending is not merely a journey of progression; it is a leap into the unknown, where the very essence of existence bends to the will of the chosen few. Through the veils of time and space, adventurers ascend to new heights of power, gaining access to mystical multipliers that amplify their prowess in ways unfathomable to the uninitiated. With each ascent, the boundaries of possibility are stretched ever further, as heroes harness the boundless energies of the cosmos to fuel their endeavors. Multipliers cascade like streams of stardust, imbuing every action with the potential for greatness, allowing resources to flow like rivers of liquid gold. And in this mystical realm, where honor and valor reign supreme, there are no shortcuts to greatness. There are no hidden costs, no treacherous schemes, no super premium currencies to cloud the purity of the hero's journey. Only through courage, perseverance, and the indomitable spirit of adventure can heroes rise to claim their rightful place among the legends of the Kingdom. They stand ready to embark on a perilous quest that will lead them from the fortress's battlements deep into the heart of the enchanted forest, where Mordek's sinister lair lies hidden within the depths of a cavern veiled in shadows. Yet, this is not merely a battle of steel and magic, but a test of courage and resilience. For in this mystical realm, the laws of nature bend to the will of those who dare to challenge fate. It is a realm where heroes craft their own destiny, forging mighty weapons and armor, and honing their skills to perfection through tireless dedication. In the crucible of adventure, every action taken echoes through the fabric of reality, shaping the very course of destiny. Will you charge headlong into the fray, confronting the minions of darkness with unwavering resolve? Or will you harness the power of patience and strategy, allowing your strength to grow with each passing moment, until you stand as a beacon of hope amidst the encroaching shadows? So gather your courage, brave adventurer, and let your legend be written in the annals of history. For the fate of the Kingdom hangs in the balance, and only by vanquishing Mordek and rebuilding the kingdom can true peace be restored to this mystical land. Ascending is not merely a journey of progression; it is a leap into the unknown, where the very essence of existence bends to the will of the chosen few. Through the veils of time and space, adventurers ascend to new heights of power, gaining access to mystical multipliers that amplify their prowess in ways unfathomable to the uninitiated. With each ascent, the boundaries of possibility are stretched ever further, as heroes harness the boundless energies of the cosmos to fuel their endeavors. Multipliers cascade like streams of stardust, imbuing every action with the potential for greatness, allowing resources to flow like rivers of liquid gold. And in this mystical realm, where honor and valor reign supreme, there are no shortcuts to greatness. There are no hidden costs, no treacherous schemes, no super premium currencies to cloud the purity of the hero's journey. Only through courage, perseverance, and the indomitable spirit of adventure can heroes rise to claim their rightful place among the legends of the Kingdom. rows.name: Stories One
rows.short_description: Welcome to Stories One: an exciting pre-alpha game blending FPS and MOBA genres. Embark on thrilling 5v5 battles in a 90's retro-futuristic city. Strategically build your deck, level up, and conquer your foes. Join the Stories One arena today!
rows.description_html: Unique Fusion of FPS and MOBA (Pre-Alpha) Join us in the creation of Stories One, where the frenetic action of an FPS meets the strategic depth of a MOBA. In this pre-alpha stage, we invite you to experience and help shape this 5v5 PvP arena. Your aim, your strategy, and your feedback are pivotal to the game's development. Cooperative Team Play Teamwork is the essence of Stories One. Assemble your squad, plan your attack on the two lanes leading to the enemy base, and work together to dismantle their defenses while protecting your own. Arsenal and Special Powers Choose from five unique weapons and special powers to create the perfect loadout for your playstyle. Coordinate with your team, strategize, and use your arsenal effectively to lay waste to enemy defenses and seize victory. Strategic Deck Building and Leveling Up Harness the power of a well-built deck to enhance your character's stats and abilities. Gain levels by destroying enemy turrets, eliminating rival players or their robotic minions, and choose cards from your deck to get the upper hand. The better you perform, the more powerful you become. Reward System and In-Game Shop Every victory brings you points to spend in our in-game shop. Purchase new cards, customize your deck (up to 15 cards), and come up with fresh strategies for each game. Personalized Avatar Customization Dive deeper into the world of Stories One with extensive avatar customization options. Craft a unique identity for your university student as they navigate the challenges of the battlefield. From clothing and accessories to distinct facial features, make your mark and stand out in every match. Your style, your statement. Join us on this exciting journey to build a game that transcends traditional genres, blending strategy, team play, and fast-paced shooter action. Stories One is in its early stages and we're looking for players like you to help shape its future. Together, we can craft a truly remarkable gaming experience. Your story starts here.

rows.short_description: A personal, short and silly handwritten game about a little man feeling a little 'eh'.
rows.description_html: Little Man woke up and doesn't know what to do with his day. rows.name: Dot to Dot Sweep
rows.short_description: Go for the high score in this arcade-style color matching action game. Maneuver your character through fields of colored dots collecting those that match your color.
rows.description_html: Dot to Dot Sweep is an arcade-style color matching game. Collect dots that match your color while avoiding all other dots. The game is inspired by classic arcade games and takes cues from modern games. The simple gameplay mechanics coupled with increasingly difficult levels allows players of all skill levels to enjoy playing. Try to beat your personal best score or, optionally, compete for the top spot on the worldwide leaderboard.

rows.name: Connected! 2
rows.short_description: Minimalistic puzzle game. Connect the opposite sides of the same color by rotating the tiles. Each level is randomly generated, but guaranteed to be solvable!
rows.description_html: Minimalistic puzzle game. Connect the opposite sides of the same color by rotating the tiles. Each level is randomly generated, but guaranteed to be solvable. How to play You are challenged to bring order into the jumbled mix of lines and curves by connecting the opposite sides of the same color. Clicking a tile in the grid rotates the lines and curves in it. Colors will follow the lines. You may need to find spots to cross the lines or build loops. It's random! Each level is randomly generated, so solving even a small grid can vary wildly between being quite straight-forward to being a real challenge! Only one thing is for sure: there is at least one solution for ALL of the shown levels. That's a promise! Features Multiple grid sizes and numbers of lines to connect Share levels solved or as a challenge with your friends Endless random levels await being solved

rows.name: Chasemaster
rows.short_description: A perfect blend of adventure, racing, strategy and speed. Chasemaster is all about completing your mission and escaping the city to your agency safely. Make quick decisions, outplay the police and get back safely!
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO CHASEMASTER ! Chasemaster is an urban driving game where you embark on a mission assigned by your agency. Your objective is to swiftly locate and retrieve all seven hidden Data Cards scattered throughout the city, while carefully maneuvering your car to avoid any collisions that could end the exhilarating police pursuit. Utilize a sophisticated strategy and make timely decisions to outwit the pursuing police unit and safely return to your city. Ensure the preservation of your car as you transport the cards back to your agency headquarters. Strive to achieve quick completion times, establish personal records, and share your scores with both us and your friends. Immerse yourself in the immersive world of a comprehensive driving, racing, and chase game presented by Duelator Games.

rows.description_html: ·Run and Shoot automatically This is an endless auto runner where the player only needs to go left or right. You can complete the game by defeating the boss or continue to beat your highest score. ·Lots Of Power-ups Choose your power-ups wisely for different builds. ·Additional Helpers You have pets and flying swords that help you fight the enemies. ·Permanent Upgrades Purchase permanent upgrades to improve yourself. Music by Ben Esdor

rows.name: Rebel!
rows.short_description: Imagine yourself living under your favourite oppressive regime. Rebel! Fight waves of SWAT teams. Loot their weapons and money. Buy upgrades. Enlist allies. Face off with the corrupt government bosses. Casual top down/ dual stick shooter with short, intense gameplay and a clever AI.
rows.description_html: Public Announcement The Ministry of Propaganda has seized control of this publication. We strongly advice you against buying this game. The gameplay mechanics are spot on for a quick, intense and wildly addictive top-down, dual stick shooter experience that kept our troll army playing it for hours on end. But the overarching theme of the game is morally corrupt and has absolutely no anchor in reality. There is no dissatisfaction with The Regime. All subjects are happy. The developer is being detained in our Special Persuasion Facility and expected to make a public appearance confirming this very soon. We suggest you go back to your daily chores and forget you ever came upon this page. We trust you to not buy this game - but if you do, we will find you. Have a nice day. ======================================================= RESIST AUTHORITY A merciless regime has come to power and abuses the citizenry relentlessly. Enough is enough, fight this oppressive government and show them you mean business! FACES OF THE REVOLUTION Every game starts with a random citizen to kick off your rebellion, your allies come from all walks of life as you work together to topple the government. TOOLS OF DESTRUCTION Fight back with your fists, bricks, and bats or loot the weapons off the government goons you whack. Get everything from pistols, shotguns, and machine guns to sniper rifles and high explosives. Don''t forget to spend the cash you acquire on upgrades to unlock allies, grow stronger, and survive longer.

rows.name: Tatari: The Arrival
rows.short_description: Take the role of a detective from Tokyo who tries to solve the mysterious case of the disappearance of a young camper. You will try to follow the trail of evidence to guide you through an enigmatic and paranormal case connected with a Japanese urban legend. Can you help until the end?
rows.description_html: Note: This is a free prologue for the 'Tatari' game and it's limited to the first three areas. Tatari is a first-person adventure game where you take the role of a detective assigned to a disappearance case. As a police detective, you are sent to investigate from the last place the person of interest was seen. From there, you will find yourself experiencing some paranormal behavior that your logical mind can’t seem to get hold of. You will follow the evidence to a village that has been abandoned for many years and holds many of the secrets and details for your case. All the available places are filled with puzzles and locks that your goal is to open and get access to forgotten and hidden information that will bring you closer to finding an end to this case. Be careful, though. Some of the puzzles are more cunning than they seem and may cost you your life. Proceed with caution. Tatari is based upon a traditional Japanese urban legend which you will experience to some extent.

rows.name: Idle Weaponshop
rows.short_description: In Idle Weaponshop, you are handed your very own weapon shop to manage. Design and sell weapons, build up your local community, hire employees, and send adventurers off into danger for fun and profit... all before prestiging to earn powerful bonuses, all so you can do it all over again.
rows.description_html: In Idle Weaponshop, you are handed your very own weapon shop to manage. Design and sell weapons, build up your local community, hire employees, and send adventurers off into danger for fun and profit... all before prestiging to earn powerful bonuses, all so you can do it all over again. Features: Design items by choosing blueprints and materials, and then produce and sell those items Unlock additional crafting options, such as enchanting and additional modifications to the item design Unlock additional buildings in your town and craft tools to increase that building's inherent bonus Hire randomly generated employees who provide bonuses to your enterprise. Upgrade them and move them around as you need. Send adventuring parties off to adventure, unlocking relics that provide permanent bonuses. Retire from your store and earn knowledge points, which provide a gold multiplier and can be spent to unlock passives from the sprawling prestige tree. Steam Leaderboards, so you can see how you stack up to all of the other guild members from around the world

rows.name: R & P: Prologue
rows.short_description: Build and survive in Prologue to Revive & Prosper, a voxel base-building strategy. Cultivate food, gather resources, and control mutants. Remodel the terrain, and flow of water, build automated factories. Unlock the entire build menu by completing the map goal! Wishlist FULL Revive & Prosper game.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic journey in Revive & Prosper Prologue, a captivating single-player factory builder! It is a one-map gateway to the world of Revive & Prosper. IF YOU LIKE THE PROLOGUE, PLEASE ADD THE FULL GAME TO YOUR CART Features: Unleash your creativity as you construct a thriving base amidst landscapes you have revived with the mighty power of water. Put an end to manual excavation. Eliminate the reliance on resource deposits. Employ the Digging Wheel to excavate soil and transfer it to the Sedimentation Machine, which will efficiently sort the soil into all the necessary resources you require. Craft your industrial world from the ground up in this third-person base-building adventure with the help of delivering Catapults! Golems work tirelessly using bonuses for faster constructing, digging, planting and cooking. However, they will decompose eventually, beckoning you to craft new companions. Extend their existence by generating Biomass in Biopress and supplying it to the golem factory, which they will utilize to rejuvenate their lifespan. Be ready for changing weather that can impact your base. Rain can raise river levels, potentially causing floods if floodgates aren't opened promptly. Sandstorms provide wind for Windmills but can also lead to mild drought. Prepare for heat waves by storing water. Immerse yourself in a world teeming with possibilities, where building, producing, and harvesting blend harmoniously with a living ecosystem.

rows.name: Viking Hiking
rows.short_description: Viking Hiking is a cheerful 3D Platformer. Join Bøf on his adventure to reach Valhalla. Jump, dash and use the horn as you explore a lush but challenging island! Viking Hiking is a FREE game made by second year students from Breda University.
rows.description_html: Student Project Viking Hiking is a student project made by a passionate team from Breda University of Applied Sciences. We worked on this project for about four months. It would not have been the same if we had not had your support during development. We are very curious to get your opinions and feedback so join our Discord and become part of our Community! About the Game Viking Hiking is a 3D Platformer featuring a buff viking called 'Bøf, son of Tøf', on a quest to reach Valhalla. Bøf carries a magic horn that he uses in an 'unconventional' way. Jump, dash and vault with the horn to overcome obstacles and explore the environment. Are you ready to prove yourself worthy in the eyes of the gods? Bøf can freely explore an entire island. It is up to you to decide which path to take to collect the necessary runes. Confront numerous platforming trials and devise your own way to conquer them. Let yourself be carried away by the beauty of this lush but challenging island! An epic journey awaits you adventurer

rows.short_description: This is a idle game modeled on industrial building gameplay. It will be three-dimensional, complex industrial assembly line, easy, simple plane conveyor belt. At the same time to join the battleship assembly, space campaign, character development, giant construction, trade orders and other gameplay!
rows.description_html: This introduction is a software translation, Automatic production, easy placement This is a different star factory, Dyson ball and other industrial construction game as the blueprint for the placement of the hang-up game. It will be three-dimensional, complex industrial assembly line, easy, simple plane conveyor belt. Mineral, smelting, power generation, storage, scientific research, manufacturing, all the elements of the game, can be achieved by simple click, easy placement! Space warships, Planet Raiding In addition to traditional manufacturing elements, various types of space warships can also be assembled by production lines. Build a massive starfleet to attack the rest of the universe. Whether to plunder the planet's resources for their own development, or occupy the planet to increase the empire territory, or ruthlessly destroy the instantaneous destruction of hundreds of millions of lives, are up to your own choice! Character development, multiple careers No need for krypton! Recruit the leader! 8 military skills, 8 production skills, 31 different career transitions! Let the role become a production management expert, or the commander of the aircraft carrier fleet, all-round free training! Science and technology research and development, giant construction Huge technology tree, as of the current version has 158 different technologies! In addition to the basic technology tree, there are complex technology tree such as fleet strengthening technology, military technology and advanced technology. In addition, space giant structures can also be built, which will cost a lot, but when completed will bring permanent benefits to the empire! Simple operation, rich content The game simply simplifies the complex building gameplay, but the content, the gameplay is much richer! More than 110 kinds of various resource items, more than 40 kinds of production buildings, make the game more hardcore! In addition, trade order system, production capacity control system, power management system, make the gameplay more convenient and free! full game, game sincerity The game is now fully completed! I didn't go online right away because I needed to accumulate some wish lists! Please feel free to buy after sale, there is no unfinished running situation! Of course, new content and gameplay will be added later based on feedback! Any creative ideas and suggestions for improvement are welcome. QQ group has not been established, please look forward to it

rows.short_description: Rhythm in rains. Realization in dreams. 'All the words, belong to a melody of rain. Resonating within ripples, dreams of human remain. Wading through unknown dreams, our understanding shall be gained...'
rows.description_html: ♪ Clean and simple UI design The UI complements the theme of 'rain', immersing players in the charming world of rain. ♪ Unique and enjoyable game modifiers The modifiers enhance the game's challenge and fun. If you're frustrated with missing notes, you can choose 'Wonderful Trial' to automatically restart on a miss or bad. rows.name: Technofumer
rows.short_description: FPS Action Arcade Game.
rows.description_html: Step into the exhilarating world of TechnoFumer, the premier third-person shooter that immerses you in the role of a daring digital hunter! This thrilling, action-packed game tasks you with the mission of tracking down and neutralizing rogue YouTube influencers. Prepare for a heart-racing adventure as you navigate through intricately designed levels, sharpening your skills to achieve the highest scores and secure extraordinary rewards. Access all game statistics, including the Hall of Fame, daily leaderboards, total playtime, player engagement, and much more, at: 🎯 Game Objectives: In TechnoFumer, your objective is clear: secure the highest score within a month to claim spectacular prizes. Explore the digital realms to locate the elusive influencers, now controlled by a mysterious digital virus, and halt their disruptive spree! As the game was initially conceived as a competition, there are no checkpoints; a single death means restarting from the beginning. It requires nerves of steel to complete the game. 💣 Gameplay: Hunt the Infected: Traverse expertly crafted levels, from urban jungles to futuristic cities, in search of the infected influencers. Face a multitude of challenges, including advanced enemy AI and strategic boss encounters. Strategize to Win: Each influencer presents a unique challenge and demands a tailored strategy to overcome. Adjust your tactics dynamically and demonstrate your prowess as a marksman. 🌐 Global Community: Become part of a vibrant community of players. Share tips and experiences across social media platforms, engage in friendly rivalry, forge alliances, and exchange strategies to ascend as the ultimate TechnoFumer champion. Are you prepared to embark on this thrilling journey and showcase your marksmanship against renowned YouTube influencers? Arm yourself, take precise aim, and conquer the TechnoFumer leaderboard today!

rows.short_description: This is an immersive cinematic storytelling experience based on Scottish folklore. Become a part of the lighthouse keeper's story, and take a journey with him on the Scottish Isles. This is an exploratory application.
rows.description_html: This is an immersive cinematic VR storytelling experience based on Scottish folklore. Become a part of the lighthouse keeper's story, and take a journey with him on the Scottish Isles. This is an exploratory application and is best experienced standing with the ability to walk around. The experience is interactive, however it is up to the user to discover what they are able to interact with. This application has been translated into Scots and Scottish Gaelic with the support of the Scottish Government. Special thanks to the Glasgow School of Art *Please note that this application is only officially supported by Oculus/Meta devices. Support for additional headsets will be provided in future updates*

rows.name: The Last Exodus
rows.short_description: Turn-based tactical strategy with massive capital ships, frigates, gunships and fighter squads. Gather resources, research technologies, design and expand your fleet. Destroy your enemies. Single player and multi player mode, hot seat mod also available.
rows.description_html: The Last Exodus is a fast paced turn based strategy made as a sandbox experience. Game has multiple single player story-driven campaigns and a fast paced multiplayer mode where you can play cooperatively with your friends or competitively against your foes. The Last Exodus will have multiple campaigns with persistent fleet where your units and tech from previous missions will be available to you in future ones. As you complete missions your technology will advance and your fleet will grow until you became the unstoppable force in the galaxy. Single Scenario mode will also include a hot seat mode where you can play with your friends on a single device. Every player controls the fleet and the heart of that fleet is your mothership. Mothership is a massive capital ship on which you can build various subsystems which have different functions. Building subsystems on you capital ship you will be able to research new technologies, gather resources and produce various ships to strengthen your fleet. Technology is a very important aspect of the game. Not only will it increase strength of you ships and weapon systems but also unlock new options for designing a new blueprints of ships that can be deployed into battle. Instead of being limited to a number of ship types in you roster, your fleet can adapt to new circumstances during the battle. So you will be able to customize your ship blueprints to better counter enemy fleet. Once you research new chassis and weapon systems, plating and engines, you will be able to combine them into a new killing machine.

rows.name: Haunting Hijinx
rows.short_description: Outwit your friends as the ghost or cooperate to catch it in this spooky minigame for 2-5 players.
rows.description_html: Haunting Hijinx is a spiritual successor to a classic minigame where one player is a ghost and up to four players are ghost hunters. Haunt a Spooky Mansion Concealed by shadow, you will seek to outwit the ghost hunters and make them faint. A single touch is all it takes, but beware their searing lights! You must be clever if you are to catch the fiends off guard. Your goal is to make all the hunters faint by grabbing them. You are invisible by default. Sprint to gain a helpful speed boost at the expense of being visible. Charge your summon meter to summon a drain area under each hunter. Any hunter that doesn't quickly get away will be defenseless as their battery gets drained. The hunters' flashlight beams will briefly stun you, make you visible, and deal significant damage. Join Forces to Corner the Ghost Each armed with a flashlight, you and your friends will delve into the darkness to hunt down the ghost. Even though you can't see the ghost in the dark, you can sense when it draws near. Stay together; you will not survive alone for long. Your goal is to destroy the ghost by shining your flashlight on it. Your flashlight has limited battery life. You will need to pick up new batteries over time to keep the ghost at bay. You will be alerted when the ghost is nearby, though you should be wary of any tricks it may play to keep you on edge. Teamwork is essential. The ghost can easily outmaneuver a lone hunter but will struggle against a coordinated group. You will faint if the ghost touches you. Shine your flashlight on a downed hunter for a few moments to revive them. In the meantime, take care that you aren't vulnerable to being grabbed yourself!

rows.name: Last Bloody Snack
rows.short_description: Cody, haunted by psychological demons, envisions a monstrous threat eliminating all he hates.
rows.description_html: Last Bloody Snack: A 2D Horror Experience Last Bloody Snack invites players into the disturbed mind of Cody, immersing them in his distressing narrative. Tormented by psychological demons, Cody's journey unfolds in a dark and atmospheric adventure where players must guide him through the dangerous corridors of his haunted home. The game's intense narrative delves into the psychological horror genre as Cody confronts a monstrous entity fueled by an insatiable hunger for revenge. Solve Puzzles, Confront Demons As players step into Cody's shoes, they find themselves in a race against time to escape the clutches of the relentless monster. The game environment, once a place Cody called home, transforms into a treacherous labyrinth full of intricate puzzles and hidden passages. To survive, players must help Cody uncover the secrets binding him to this nightmare reality. Atmospheric tension builds with every step, creating an immersive experience where fear, survival, and self-discovery intertwine.

rows.name: King Island 3
rows.short_description: Embark on the final chapter of the King Island Franchise and venture into new depths, discover the Lost City and encounter Lola the Enchantress, you are no longer alone, Kaptivo!
rows.description_html: Prepare to confront fresh challenges and forge unexpected alliances in a world teeming with new enemies, allies, and enigmatic powers. Delve into the mysteries of an Ancient Dungeon-City, crafted by minds consumed with magic and madness. Navigate labyrinthine passages, battle fearsome foes, and unravel the secrets hidden within its walls. Join forces with a fearless warrior companion as you embark on an odyssey filled with peril and discovery. Arm yourself with newfound weapons and abilities, honing your skills to overcome the formidable adversaries that stand between you and the exit of this mystical labyrinth. Will you emerge triumphant, or will the city's arcane secrets consume you? Developer Note: This game is a 2008 artifact developed by a small indie team using the full potential and limitations of flash technology. We apologize for any technical problems or inconveniences you may encounter in your playthrough, or issues with the German and Spanish translations. We hope that with these limitations in mind, you may still enjoy the experience!

rows.name: Bullet Hell Monday: Finale
rows.short_description: 'Bullet Hell Monday: Finale' is a beginner-friendly bullet hell shooter. Upgrade your craft, clear the Chapter Mode, defeat bosses, and enhance your abilities to conquer stages.
rows.description_html: Dive into the thrilling world of bullet hell shooters with 'Bullet Hell Monday: Finale'! Even beginners can enjoy this intense action-packed game, featuring a gentle introduction to the bullet hell genre. Get ready for an authentic bullet hell experience! In 'Bullet Hell Monday: Finale,' players will navigate through a barrage of bullets while taking down enemies. Upgrade your craft and aim to conquer the challenging Chapter Mode. Chapter Mode Embark on various missions in each stage, ranging from simple to challenging. By completing missions like 'Defeat 30 enemies!' you'll unlock boss stages. Defeat the bosses to progress to the next chapter. Craft Upgrades Enhance your craft through a variety of level-up options, including shot power, shot speed, bomb duration, and more. Upgrade your craft and blast through the stages with devastating firepower. Beginner-Friendly The stages start off easy and gradually ramp up in intensity. You are not obligated to clear the difficult missions, so if you find yourself struggling, feel free to try your hand at another mission. Easy Mode In Chapter Mode, you can choose the difficulty level before starting a stage. Opting for Easy mode reduces enemy attacks, making it more manageable to complete the stage. If you find yourself stuck, consider selecting Easy mode for a smoother experience. Other Features The game supports various controls, including controllers, mouse and keyboard, and keyboard-only setups, allowing players to choose according to their preferences. It also offers support for vertical screen gameplay, providing an immersive experience. *The screen aspect ratios '16:9' and '16:10' are supported. For other aspect ratios and vertical screen gameplay, some menus will be displayed in a simplified format.
