rows.name: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai
rows.short_description: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and big village-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, monthly events and your dumb ways to die not harming your fun level.
rows.description_html: Daisho: Survival of a Samurai is an Action RPG with casual survival game mechanics and big village-building possibilities. You'll experience a new type of survival game with quests, continuous open world progression, monthly events and your dumb ways to die not harming your fun level. 🏹 Survival Games, casualized Chop every tree, hunt rabbits and deer, stone and copper mining - resource management are a staple of every survival game, and Daisho is no different. However, we threw away the hunger games in favor of a replenishing stamina pool so you can start every game session on exploration instead of just preventing yourself from dying. 🏛️ Build your own Japanese village estate From setting up your first camp to building an entire Japanese village, you'll be pretty busy making a home for yourself and all the rescued souls that turn up to settle as workers. Manage their resource refining jobs, build houses and beautify the city with fountains and other decor. ⚔️ Carry a big stick (mind the pointy end) Craft your weaponry from a selection of clubs, katanas, bows, spears and more. Upgrade them to make pointy ends even more pointy, embellish your craft with gems and their attributes, and poke around at the Shogun armies, bandit bosses and other generally unfriendly folk. 🗺️ Explore Japan and its dungeons Dive into dark medieval history and unravel the story of Oda Nobunaga, known as the great Japanese unifier; lead the siege to the stronghold of Kyoto, or rebuild the ancient estates and temples around Mount Fuji. Learning about history has never been more fun! 📅 Enjoy Seasonal Events Keep coming back for freshly designed seasonal events as they happen. Missed one? Don't worry, we've put them into your game progression and keep them fresh every year. 📱 Put Japan in your pocket Not at home? Experience Daisho: Survival of a Samurai on your phone or Steam Deck, fully optimized for the mobile gaming experience. And we're working to make your savegame available fully cross-platform. And many more features to come: Events ⭐ Quests ⭐ Talent Trees ⭐ Coop Building⭐ Mini Games ⭐ Achievements ⭐ Dojo PVP Leaderboards ⭐ Guilds & Chat As developers of Daisho: Survival of a Samurai, we hope you enjoy our casual approach to the Survival RPG genre. We are always happy to get in touch directly with our players and gather feedback - hop onto our Discord: 💬 Thanks and have fun surviving!

rows.name: Wolvesville
rows.short_description: Wolvesville is a multiplayer game for up to 16 players. Each game has different teams such as villagers or werewolves all fighting to be the last team standing. Use special abilities to uncover the roles of other players and convince your fellow players to work with you.
rows.description_html: Defend your village from the forces of evil or become a werewolf and hunt your friends! Join the mystery game, fight for your team and find the liars among your ranks. Wolvesville is a multiplayer game for up to 16 players. Each game has different teams such as villagers or werewolves all fighting to be the last team standing. Use special abilities to uncover the roles of other players and convince your fellow players to work with you. Features: - Play online with your friends - Join games with players from all around the globe - Create and customize your own avatar - Send roses to your beloved ones - Join ranked games for serious competition - Unlock unique and limited items and shine in the game! - Discover a thriving Discord community with special events, extra loot and more! The ultimate game of lies and deception! Got any problems or suggestions? Talk to us on Discord at . We love feedback! Happy hunting!

rows.name: Only Fortress
rows.short_description: Become the hero of your own fortress! Defend, customize, and explore in this PvP & PvM strategy game. Unleash your skills, lead your troops, and dominate in the battles. Build, fight, and conquer on the open world cross-platform online game!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Only Fortress, the ultimate fortress-building experience where you are the hero! Dive into a world of strategic PvP and PvM challenges, where your skills and tactical prowess shape your destiny. Customize every aspect of your fortress, from the grounds to the walls, and construct buildings instantly without the hassle of waiting. Embark on epic explorations with your troops, mastering powerful spells and engaging in cross-platform battles with players from all around the world. Unleash your creativity and design a fortress that reflects your style and strategic vision. No detail is too small in your quest for dominance. Take control of your hero, a formidable force in combat, alongside a carefully chosen team of special hero-troops. Engage in intense battles, leveraging your character's unique abilities and unleashing devastating spells. Your hero is the key to victory!

rows.name: Coast Defender
rows.short_description: Dive deep into the exhilarating world of high-stakes battles. Lead your army against a relentless onslaught of enemy machinery, spanning from the iconic tanks of WW2 to the modern-day helicopters.
rows.description_html: Engage in fierce confrontations across air, sea, and land. Each skirmish stands as a testament to your tactical prowess. Do you have what it takes to ascend the ranks and be hailed as a legendary defender in this ceaseless war? Fluid Gameplay Mechanics Command the battlefield with intuitive controls. Obliterate enemy air forces, decimate naval fleets, and reign supreme in intense tank duels. Master each level, reap your rewards, and sharpen your abilities for even greater challenges ahead. Ever-Changing Battlefronts Every chapter thrusts you into a unique warzone. From storm-lashed seas to wind-swept deserts, the theatre of warfare constantly evolves. Conquer each terrain and progress through a captivating saga of defense. Evolve and Enhance Accumulate accolades and strategically bolster your strengths. Prioritize health for resilience, elevate damage to amplify firepower, boost agility with speed, or refine your shooting accuracy. Consider equipping an additional gun to further enhance your offensive prowess. Radar Precision Harness the power of advanced radar technology. Track enemy maneuvers, devise potent strategies, and execute flawless strikes. Perfect your aim to vanquish foes with singular, lethal shots. A Spectrum of War Machines Square off against a diverse array of enemy units. From nimble military helicopters to formidable twin-fuselage aircraft and state-of-the-art naval vessels, each confrontation offers the raw adrenaline of authentic combat.

rows.short_description: Stormstriker is a hyperactive 5v5 PvP third-person shooter with colorful hero characters, action-packed gameplay, and an emphasis on teamplay! Join the battlefield by choosing a hero that’s right for your playstyle!
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game Engage in 5v5 team battles with action-packed combat involving swords and magic! Experience a thrilling action PvP game with diverse combat styles, ranging from long-range warfare to close-quarters brawling. Choose from a wide array of characters, each with their own unique combat styles. Whether you prefer combo-centric characters, psychological warfare specialists, strategic thinkers, or precise aim-dependent combatants, there's a character to match your preferences. The roster of distinctive characters continues to expand. Become a master of your favorite character! Each character comes with a set of skills that can be swapped out. Customize your character's combat style to suit your tastes or adapt to the situation and strategy. Become the master of the characters you love and want to play. This game is being crafted by individuals who have diligently explored the realm of action gaming, and they are eager to join you, our users, in the pursuit of thrilling action gameplay. We are relentless in our pursuit of fun and believe that a game should never stop being enjoyable. With your continuous feedback and collaboration, we aim to create the best action game recognized by action gamers worldwide. Join us on this journey to craft the world's greatest action game together, starting small but aiming high!

rows.name: Indigo Park: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Explore the abandoned childhood wonder of Indigo Park! Guided by Rambley the Raccoon, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you run from the reason it shut down.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Indigo Park Indigo Park is an immersive first-person exploration game that takes you on a thrilling journey through the eerie remnants of an abandoned amusement park. As the protagonist, you will step into the shoes of an adventurous soul eager to uncover the mysteries hidden within this once vibrant and lively attraction. Explore a desolate world where time has stood still, and nature has reclaimed its territory. The amusement park, once filled with joyous laughter and cheerful music, now echoes with haunting silence and faded memories. Guided by an A.I. assistant*, help restore power to the destroyed amusement park while you avoid the reason it shut down. Once one of the most renowned theme parks of the world, Indigo Park was suddenly shut down after a mysterious, horrific incident. Years later, in a search for nostalgia, you break into the park to explore the abandoned attractions. You may remember this place, but you'll need some help from a special A.I. friend*. Meet Rambley! Previously the park's A.I.-driven* tour guide, Rambley the Raccoon will take over screens and other aspects of the park to communicate with you! Explore the park as you find collectables, secrets, and discover why the park was shut down, all while being guided by Rambley! Find items, solve puzzles, and restore power to the park as you run from the reason it shut down. *Rambley, the AI character is a work of fiction, and is not utilizing actual 'AI', rather stunning 2D animation and voice acting to communicate with the player. Explore! In this first person horror experience, you'll explore the abandoned environment. Follow Rambley's guidance as you uncover secrets hidden inside these ruined walls. Featuring an exciting collectables system, thrilling encounters with the park's residents, and more!

rows.name: Ur
rows.short_description: The Royal Game of Ur, also called Twenty Squares, has a history stretching over five millennia with examples found across the Mediterranean! This is a 3D gameplay experience taking you into the ancient world! The game board set is a 3D reconstruction of an ancient example from a museum.
rows.description_html: The Royal Game of Ur, also known as Twenty Squares, has a history that stretches over five millennia! Its earliest boards date back to 2500 BCE and examples have been found across the Mediterranean. This game is a 3D computer gameplay experience that takes you into the ancient world. The game board, pieces, and dice are 3D reconstructions of actual ancient examples from museums. This historical game is harder than it looks! This is a race game: speed is of the essence! It brings to a board game the ultimate skill for the merchants, traders, bandits and pirates who drove their fleets and caravans around the ancient world. The goal is to get your counters from start to finish around the board, before your opponent does. Prove your strategic skill! How will you play out your strategies: do you want to put all of your pieces on the board at once, or focus on moving a single piece along? With a good throw of the dice, would you rather move your own counter ahead, or take one of your competitor’s off the board? Watch out, this game was used for ancient divination: you may see a glimpse of your future as you play! Game Features: Desktop or Laptop gameplay via keyboard. Roll virtual dice on each turn and move your pieces around the board. Land on a rosette for an extra turn or land on an AI opponent's piece to trap it. Three different levels of gameplay difficulty through different AI opponents. Three different avatars for gameplay. Built in tutorial. Track your high scores in game. Control your resolution and background music. Educational! Learn about the Royal Game of Ur, a real historical game played around the Mediterranean for thousands of years. Read ancient phrases between players as you play. Free! Use for classes. Project Team: Kylie Gilde - Lead Programmer, Freelance Programmer Dr. Sandra Blakely – Project Director, Emory University, Department of Classics Dr. Joanna C. Mundy – Project Manager, Digital Projects Specialist, Emory Center for Digital Scholarship Kevin Dressel - Technical Architect, Shiny Dolphin Games LLC Dr. Joy Li – Game Development Collaborator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Computer Game Design and Development Craig Brasco – Visual Interface Collaborator and Illustrator, Kennesaw State University, Assistant Professor of Art | Graphic Communications Evie Wang Edmundson - Freelance Composer and Producer David Herrod - Student Game Design and Programmer, Kennesaw State University (2020) Josh Winston - Trailer, Digital Scholarship Associate, Emory Center for Digital Scholarship

rows.name: M.E.A.T. Veterans
rows.short_description: Check out a free-to-play online action game! Test your shooting abilities in individual and team battles against your opponent. Stand out by creating your own strategy and distinctive style with unique skins and items, and especially - by taking the top place in the global ranking.
rows.description_html: DEVELOPMENT PLAN - HIGHLIGHTS Currently, M.E.A.T. Veterans is an early access game, which means that work on it is not yet complete. A lot can still change until the full release and launch. Just one month after the title becomes available, the first update will be released with fixes made based on community feedback. We plan to keep up the pace of monthly updates until the release itself*. We will strive to significantly expand M.E.A.T. Veterans and in addition to a number of technical improvements, we also plan to create new maps, the first arena or an increase in the selection of models and weapons, as well as several special features, including additional game modes and further social features.. The official M.E.A.T. Veterans server will be announced after the first update. *Critical issues, however, will be fixed as soon as possible, regardless of the assumed update schedule. About the Game After M.E.A.T. RPG and the announcement of its sequel in the form of M.E.A.T. II Absolute Zero (whose free demo is already available!), the time has come for another title. M.E.A.T. Veterans is a fully free-to-play online action game that will take you back to the fantastic world explored through the pixel art RPG from the M.E.A.T. universe. Get ready for a lot of new features! This time you won't be hiding behind the back of Sir Dunkan Culligan. Instead of impersonating a character, you will remain yourself. And you'll be the only one you can count on to fight the enemy. Well, unless you decide to form an alliance and fight in the name of the team. However, you must be ready for anything, because the enemy never sleeps. And he can quickly revive. And most importantly, know that it can be anyone. Even your existing friend. Why? Because in M.E.A.T. Veterans you'll be up against a formidable opponent - the opponent on the other side of the screen! M.E.A.T. Veterans is a multiplayer shooter, and that means you'll face not just NPCs, but the truest players. Well, unless you're initially afraid of confrontation - there's nothing stopping you from testing your mettle against Bots beforehand. Nevertheless, your time will come, so start training now! Currently, you can do this on two maps. One is the familiar Sudbury town from the M.E.A.T. RPG, and the other is the MBS XII Sect Crypt. There are four gameplay modes to choose from: Team Deathmatch (a team game characterised by quick respawns - the team with the most enemies defeated wins), Deathmatch (an individual game with random respawn and 3-second spawn protection). You have a variety of weapons at hand, including a revolver, shotgun, rotary machine gun, crossbow, dynamite, smoke grenade and even a Molotov cocktail or Tomahawk. But that's not all your options. The list of weapons will continue to grow with future updates. However, you already have the opportunity to fully customise your weapons with skins and stickers available in the shop, as well as extensive settings, for example in the form of a customised sight. You can also individualise your profile with avatars, badges and achievements. You will also be able to make your presence felt - for example through the spray system, but also, and perhaps above all, through the possibility of saving your position in the global player ranking. A significant improvement, especially in the team game modes, is the voice chat, thanks to which you will be able to keep in touch with other players.

rows.name: Gutasaga
rows.short_description: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game. Immerse yourself in the 550 - 600 AD saga. Be the Viking who opened trade routes with Constantinople. Encounter over 40 nations with unique cultures on your journey. Succeed in trading 205 historically recreated goods. Or try raids and piracy.
rows.description_html: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game HISTORICAL WORLD The game is set in the 6th century AD. The map is based on historical prototypes of that time, and all locations, buildings, ships, and items are inspired by historical findings. If you are interested in the historical background of anything in the game, it is ready to provide you with answers. FIRST-PERSON NARRATIVE Immerse yourself fully in the game. Everything that happens in the game is described from the perspective of the main character of that time. Paganism, which would later be replaced by other religions, was the dominant belief at that time, and the game allows you to see the world and historical events from a different angle. EXPLORATION A vast territory is open for exploration from the very beginning, without limiting your actions. The world is filled with historically unique locations, goods, and factions. Explore the world and discover rare artifacts that will aid you in the game. TRADE SYSTEM Trade with various factions throughout the map for profit or the development of your settlement. Find unique goods that are not available in other settlements or even discover items for which others are willing to pay five times the price. RAIDS AND PIRACY If you need to quickly acquire different resources, goods, coins, or artifacts, remember the path of force. Gather a crew and raid other settlements along the coast or along rivers. Study the routes of trading vessels to launch surprise attacks and seize ships. REAL-TIME COMBAT SYSTEM Engage in battles with your assembled team against enemies from different factions. Use various artifacts and items in combat to achieve success. If a challenging battle takes place on the water, knowledge of your own and the enemy's ship will play a decisive role. SANDBOX Buildings in settlements will be randomly generated at the start of the game. This means that each new game will be unique, providing a fresh gameplay experience. You will have to make decisions regarding the placement of your buildings, considering the availability and demand for goods in other settlements. LIVING WORLD Both you and NPCs will influence the development of all settlements. The more you trade and satisfy the needs of a specific tribe, the faster it will progress. Resources obtained by NPCs do not disappear from the game but remain with them and can be used for the development of their own settlements. Each settlement has a level that determines the amount of available land for buildings, and each building has its own level, which improves its functions with development. Consider the carrying capacity of your ship, efficiently manage your supplies, allocate funds for the maintenance of the crew, and monitor their health. Prioritize wisely and develop your settlement to increase the construction area and gain access to unique goods and artifacts. Additionally, companions will help you with weekly tasks that appear in the settlement.
rows.about_html: Gutasaga - 2D Strategy RPG pre-viking era game HISTORICAL WORLD The game is set in the 6th century AD. rows.name: i feel very lonely and i don't remember myself
rows.short_description: A short sci-fi visual novel about four scientists trapped in an underground lab. Explore their chat records to uncover the mysteries of Inturg Technologies. How can they escape their doom?
rows.description_html: An emergency has occurred at the underground facilities of Inturg Technologies. Trapped in a metallic maze and engulfed in darkness with no apparent means of escape, four employees discover access to an internal group chat. United by their dire circumstances, they must unravel the enigmatic origins of the crisis and find a way to survive. What triggered the emergency? What is the true purpose of Inturg Technologies? And amidst the chaos, will they be able to trust each other? CAN I REMEMBER MYSELF? Experience a visual novel of mystery and thrill inside an old computer interface. Enjoy a non-linear story through 4 different chat records containing the point of view of each character.

rows.name: Abyssal Descent
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic platforming adventure through treacherous caves and mysterious realms in Abyssal Descent. Battle enemies, solve puzzles, and unlock hidden secrets as you journey through procedurally generated underground worlds. With optional local co-op, share this adventure with a friend.
rows.description_html: Embark on an epic adventure through treacherous caves, solving intricate puzzles, and battling fearsome enemies in Abyssal Descent . Journey from the depths of underground caves, through the underworld, and into the mysterious Hollow Earth Oasis and beyond as you search to find your place in the afterlife. With captivating exploration, strategic combat, and charming playable characters, this thrilling platformer delivers an exciting blend of action, puzzles, and discovery. Optional local co-op allows for you to bring a friend with you on this adventure, and the procedural generation means no two playthroughs will be the same. Are you ready to take the plunge into the abyss? Key Features: Traverse diverse, procedurally generated underground caves, underworld, Hollow Earth, and more Solve challenging puzzles and unlock hidden secrets... in the dark. Engage in thrilling combat against a variety of enemies. Purchase new gear, unlock new abilities, and harness ancient relics. Optional local co-op to bring a friend on this adventure of a lifetime.

rows.name: ForeVR Suck It! VR
rows.short_description: You’re invited to Suck It! … early! Suck It! is the ultimate intergalactic vacuum simulator. Suck up coins, bananas, the cat, the sofa… level up to grow as big as a house! Capture stars and head to the teleporter to claim your win! Fire the contents of your canister at anyone who gets in your way.
rows.description_html: Suck It! is the ultimate intergalactic vacuum simulator. Suck up coins, bananas, the cat, the sofa… level up to grow as big as a house! Capture stars and head to the teleporter to claim your win! Fire the contents of your canister at anyone who gets in your way. As a valued employee of S.U.C.K. (Superstellar Universal Cleaning Korp), you’ve been equipped with the latest high-tech vacuum. This top-of-the-line tech collects anything that fits; empty your haul into the closest Dumpy, and you’ll continue growing in level and size. Don’t forget the best perk of the job: Jet Packs! These super-powered packs will let you reach heights and escape rival employees! With easy-to-learn gameplay and high replayability, 'Suck It!' is perfect for players of all skill levels. Suck It! features: ⭐ Treasure Hunt Mode: Suck up items around you to fill your canister. When your canister is full, head to a Dumpy who is ready to level you up. Collect 10 stars and head to the beachside teleporter platform to secure your win. Watch out for other players; use your jet pack boosters or fire back to try and steal their stars! ⭐ 4 unique avatars: Shark, Cat, Ducky, and Basic Bot ⭐ 6 unique vacuums Coming soon: ⭐ Zen Mode: Suck up items, give them to Dumpy, grow as big as possible. Perfect for the pacifist playstyle. ⭐ More maps! ⭐ More game modes! ⭐ More avatars and vacuums! This game is still navigating the beta quadrant; please share any feedback, issues, and ideas at help.forevrgames.com.

rows.name: Cecelia
rows.short_description: A mysterious island. A giant baby made of stone awakens. Learn to trust each other if you want to explore the perilous terrain, seeking answers from the island's enigmatic call and an ominous force awaiting you in the distant lighthouse.
rows.description_html: Delve into the mysterious beauty of a daunting and surreal setting. Cecelia is an ephemeral, atmospheric adventure offering a captivating blend of first-person exploration, platforming, and leaning on an unlikely giant companion. Waking up on the coast of a fantastical island laden with basalt columns, searing lava flows, and perilous cliffs, you find yourself stranded, left to unravel your presence and purpose. However, your journey is not one of solitude. You unearth a magical rock that awakens a colossal stone baby, whose origin is as mysterious as the island itself. The giant’s size is both a challenge and an advantage, as you'll need to maneuver and use her immense stature to negotiate the challenging environment. But Cecelia is still learning, and she’ll need your help to survive the island’s hazards as well. Each step and leap forward brings you closer to understanding the island’s secrets, and the entity within the distant, foreboding lighthouse. More than just a game, Cecelia is a journey of introspection, exploring trust and interdependence.

rows.name: Pyroworks
rows.short_description: Pyroworks is a free-to-play online multiplayer game containing fireworks from real-life companies from all over the globe. You can choose to make your own show, cause destruction and chaos or simulate new years. Don't miss out on playing with your friends - the most fun part.
rows.description_html: Pyroworks is a free to play, mainly multiplayer game about fireworks. Realistic effects In Pyroworks, we have spent a lot of time creating the most realistic effects possible to provide a better overall experience for our base of players, immersing them in the beauty of the world of fireworks. Real life fireworks Pyroworks contains several fireworks from real life companies from all over the world: Funke Fireworks (Iskra Line, Argento, Alba) Lesli Zena Vuurwerk Weco Fireworks Nico Europe JGW Berckholtz Zink Fireworks Aba Pyrotechnik (Startrade) ... and many more! Modding support We have included modding support to enhance the gameplay of our game. You can install and create new fireworks, maps and saves! Along with our modding documentation, adding your own mods won't be too hard. Express your creativity In Pyroworks we have included a COBRA™ 18M firing system to create the shows of your dreams. You can load and save the entire world to show off your shows to other players, or share your saves with others to download!

rows.name: Delta Force
rows.short_description: Delta Force is back! The iconic series returns as the definitive free-to-play modern team-based tactical shooter and featuring three distinct gameplay modes: large-scale PvP warfare, intense extraction shooter action, and a remake of the legendary Black Hawk Down campaign.
rows.description_html: 【AHSARAH】SEASON EVENTS AND REWARDS About the Game Delta Force is back! The iconic series returns as the definitive free-to-play modern team-based tactical shooter, and featuring three distinct gameplay modes: - Warfare: battle the enemy across land, sea and air in truly epic 32 v 32 PvP combat, featuring a wide range of vehicles and unique tactical gear. - Operations: Delta Force meets the next generation extraction shooter as you deploy behind enemy lines with your squad, search for valuables, take on rival players, and extract before it’s too late. Alternatively, our PvE Raid mode offers challenging objective-based missions designed to push your squad to the limit. - Black Hawk Down: step into the boots of legendary Delta Force operators for this remake of the classic series campaign based on the gripping 2001 movie.  We are committed to NO PAY-TO-WIN and development is driven by community feedback. Fair play is a top priority, and our dedicated G.T.I. security anti-cheat team ensures a fair gameplay experience by proactively targeting and removing cheaters. And remember… “No-one gets left behind” Words from the Game Director, Shadow Guo As a player: Delta Force was the first shooter I ever played, igniting my passion for the genre. I'm extremely grateful for the opportunity to create Delta Force, and my goal is to share that unforgettable joy with even more players. I hope this new Delta Force game will become the tactical FPS experience I dreamt of all those years ago. As a Game Director: We're pushing Unreal Engine to its limits to deliver a truly cross-platform experience that allows players worldwide to immerse themselves in a vivid world of deep characters, explosive destruction, and top-notch action...all worthy of the 'Delta Force' name. Join me in crafting a game for all Delta Force players - Delta Force, a game for us all.

rows.name: Bot Crisis
rows.short_description: Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a bot in a game… well now is your chance! Grab Bot Crisis now and see if you can trick actual people into thinking your a bot!
rows.description_html: Put your wits and acting skills to the ultimate test! In this 3D online game, players are transported to a variety of captivating stages. The goal? To identify which of the characters are real players and who's just pretending to be a bot! Gameplay Identify real players : Can you discern who's a real player and who's an expertly disguised bot? Behave as a bot : To avoid detection, you must behave as a bot yourself. This means moving around randomly and avoiding doing anything that would make you stand out. Expose the players : There are animals and other hazards that can expose the real players. For example, some innocently annoying animals will only approach real players. Owls that only follow real players! Competition leaderboard. Features Multiple stages : The game features multiple stages, including a farm, a desert, a haunted forest, a snow level, and a battlefield. Customization : You can customize your appearance, including your skin color and clothing. Chat : You can chat with other players. Though it is up to you whether to help them or fool them :). Leaderboard : Compete on a global leaderboard to become the ultimate Bot Crisis champion! Cross-play Players using PC and players using mobile can play together. Humor The game is full of humor, with funny animals and other hazards that can expose the players. This makes the game both challenging and fun. FAQs Is the game multiplayer or single player? Yes the game is an online multiplayer game. However, you can also play it alone if you only want to discover the stages. How many players can play in a single room? Up to 10 players can play in the same room. Is the leaderboard global? Yes the leaderboard is global. Compete with everyone to become the number one in the world! Do I need to play it with my friends or can I find random people to play with? Both. You can play it with your friends or with random people. You can also discover the stages alone.

rows.name: Joy-N Help Me
rows.short_description: JOY-N Help ME
rows.description_html: 'Hello, can you hear me? My name is Joy-N. I don't understand how I ended up in this place. I was playing, and suddenly a big storm started. I got hit somehow, and I can't explain what happened. I just woke up now, and everything around me looks different. The world seems colorless. Maybe I'm dreaming, maybe not, but everything feels very realistic. I've started to feel scared and very lonely. rows.name: Misled Madness
rows.short_description: Side-scroller platformer where you avoid hazards and race to the finish line for the fastest leaderboard times.
rows.description_html: Misled Madness is a side-scroller platforming game where the player is attempting to complete deadly obstacle courses and survive with their life as the grand prize. In the game, the player will be able to jog, sprint, jump, wall jump, and die.... a lot. The current obstacles the player must avoid include circular saw blades, Pendulum styled swinging axes and spikes scattered around the courses. While the casual player can play just for fun to avoid obstacles, more competitive players have the ability to speed run through the levels and gain a ranking on global leaderboards in an attempt to have the fastest times per course. The player is also able to customize their character to give a more personalized feeling when playing the game. Camera settings allow the player to adjust their view to better suit their preferred playstyle.

Please enjoy the wonderful character voices in the main part of 'I AM MAGICAMI'. About the Game [Game overview] A secondary creation fighting game which you can battle with attractive characters, magical girls, and demons from 'I Am Magicami'. The player becomes their partner 'Omnis' and gives precise instructions to the fighting girls! [Notice] - Modification and secondary use of game data is prohibited. - Magicami Fighting Game Club cannot be held responsible for any problems that occur while playing this game. [Story overview] The group of magical girls finally accepted the Seven Demon Lords of Erebos. As they deepen their friendship, Luxria, the Demon Load of Lust, proposes holding a fighting tournament in order to know each other's strengths and improve their cooperativeness. The winner will be presented with an exceptional reward, any wish that Luxria's magic could grant. Then the MGCMCE (Magi Cami Cooperative Elimination) was held here. However, when players are progressing smoothly, surprisingly The Cacodemon Emerges! * Initial 12 magical girls + 7 demons can be used! A large volume of playable characters, that you can choose from 19 + 1 girls from the beginning! DLC characters will also coming soon! * Operation system can be enjoyed from beginners to advanced users! - Attack is the basic 3 buttons of A, B, and C! - There are simple commands that can be used with one button for throwing, skills (special moves), etc.! - By pressing the D button, you can use the high-performance evasive technique 'Flux Evasion' on the ground and in the air! - Enjoy an exhilarating attack with 4 types of jumps that are abundant and highly flexible! - 'Auto Rush Combo' that connects attacks from skills to Magi Kami Skills (super moves) with a series of short-range A attacks! - There is also 'Babel Chain Combo' that easily connects normal moves with character-specific routes such as A > B > C! - Let's seize victory by unleashing flashy magic such as Magi Kami Skills and True Power using the 'possibility gauge'! * Battle type corresponding to various proclivities! From clean standard characters to samurai-like one-shot characters, high-speed combo characters, high-risk high-reward gamblers, barrage shooters, throwing characters, and installation characters, we have a wide variety of tactical types that no one character is the same. You will surely find a character that suits your taste. * A wide range of battles are possible from 1 to 1, to 4 to 4 team battles! You can use one of your favorite characters, or you can also have fun with all the characters you care about! * Supports local/net battles! While chatting with your friends, enjoy a great match! ***To enable network matches, you need to open ports or use VPN software. * Full mode for one person! In addition to the arcade mode story, you can hone your skills through training, and once you've gained strength, you can also train in high-level end contents such as survival and boss rushes! Aim for a high score by defeating the demon lords who show their seriousness as bosses! ***To change difficulty level, access OPTIONS > Game settings > Difficulty level. * This game has been officially approved by the management of 'I Am Magicami', but it is only a derivative work, and the management of 'I Am Magicami' is not involved in this game. Please refrain from making inquiries about this game to the 'I Am Magicami' management.

rows.name: Pixel Royale 3D
rows.short_description: Ever imagined a world where mechanical skill and actually playing the game was what mattered? Yeah, we have too. Pixel Royale is a pixelated FPS with a high focus on aim and strategy, and is actively updated with the features that the community requests the most.
rows.description_html: Ever imagined a world where mechanical skill and actually playing the game was what mattered? Yeah, we have too. We grew up playing pixel shooters for most of our childhood, and we've had to watch the genre shift in a way that isn't healthy for the community. So we decided to take the genre in a better direction. We made Pixel Royale to gather the community to a place where they can have fun with the genre again, and most importantly where their voices can be heard again. One of our main goals is to build the game around the community, after all, without a community, there wouldn't be a game! Pixel Royale  is a pixelated FPS with a high focus on aim and strategy . With 6 categories to use in-game, there are virtually endless combinations to fit any play-style. Maybe you want a balanced loadout with good consistent damage for anywhere from short to long-range, or maybe you want to just rocket jump around and shotgun people in the face. We won't judge! Primary: Your main consistent and (usually) reliable weapon. Shotguns, Rifles, SMGs, you name it, we got it. Secondary: Switching to your secondary is always faster than reloading, but sometimes they can hold their own. Melee: Most people just pull them out to run faster, but if you can get up close they won't even see it coming. Experimental: As the name suggests, these are the most unique weapons, but also the most difficult to use. Sniper: Find a good spot, start scoping, and give your enemies a swift end. After all, professionals have standards. Explosive: Pesky enemy hiding behind a corner? Send a rocket their way. See a group of enemies? Send a rocket their way. Don't feel like aiming? Send a rocket their way. It's also important to build your loadout on the map you decide to play in. River Battlefield: A large battleground divided in 2 by a river. With plenty of peeking spots, this map is perfect for avid snipers. Night Battlefield: River Battlefield, but dark! Prison: A close-quarters map with plenty of corners and hallways to hide behind. Keep a sharp eye out and watch your back! Pixel Manor: A medium-sized map with 2 fortresses for each team. Shoot through the windows, get on top of the buildings, or sneak into enemy territory. Space Station: A large indoor map with winding corridors and a maze-like design. Have your gun ready any time you turn a corner! Cargo: A small and chaotic battlefield with few places to hide. Be quick on your feet and ready for anything to end victorious. Pixel Royale  is frequently updated with active support from the developers for any problem you may be facing. Updates can range from cool content and quality of life adjustments to huge new features and changes. But there aren't only practical customizations, your character and every weapon have tons of skins available to fully configure your loadout. Don't forget the skin creator for creating skins in-game and the skin importer for importing skins from other games of a similar 'blocky-quality'. So if you feel the well's run dry for pixel shooters, download the game and join our effort to bring pixel shooters back to what they were, and beyond!

rows.name: Little Shrimp：Legend Reborn
rows.short_description: Little Shrimp：Legend Reborn is a captivating Wuxia idle RPG that offers an open-world concept and an engaging storyline. With its free exploration of the Jianghu, leisurely gameplay, and auto-leveling fun, you'll have a blast with high levels of character involvement.
rows.description_html: This is a highly immersive role-playing game set in the martial arts world, and the existence of this world is shaped by you. Here, you can experience classic storylines from famous martial arts novels, and enjoy a variety of entertaining gameplay systems, whether it's the thrilling life of martial arts or the leisurely farming life – the choice is yours. In the martial world, bonds between people are inseparable, and stories collide with one another. The game features hundreds of NPCs, each with their own stories waiting for you to discover and explore. As you, still green behind the ears, step into this world, what kind of stories await you? Can you feel a sense of belonging in this martial world? This is the story of Little Shrimp. [Game Features] The martial world is full of mysteries, with intense battles and numerous sects. The game gathers various classic martial arts techniques from famous novels, covering both internal and external skills. The combination of martial arts, tactics, and the synergy between martial arts and heroes requires strategic thinking. Why not showcase your skills and demonstrate your superior martial arts strategy, young hero? [Chosen Ones, Embrace the Gifts] Every hero who arrives here is chosen by fate. However, Little Shrimp martial world doesn't follow the usual path. The chosen ones are entitled to generous gifts. Accept this VIP10 and a heap of gold and silver treasures on your journey. There are even more treasures waiting for you to explore and unearth along the way. [Humorous Martial World, Fun Everywhere] Little Shrimp martial world not only recreates classic scenes from famous martial arts novels but also adds its own unique flavor. Don't miss any corner of the martial world, as it is filled with surprises and hidden Easter eggs. While wandering through the martial world, you might unexpectedly encounter flower-picking bandits, money-robbing villains, or witness a fierce battle between two tigers. What choices will you make as a young hero? Will you fuel the chaos, rescue those in danger, or stand by and watch? Who said there's only one choice, after all, life is about having fun! [Six Years of Crafting, Masterpiece of Ingenuity] Six years in the making, this game boasts a mature and comprehensive system. The game's features are diverse and well-developed, ensuring that monotony and predictability have no place in the game. The retro art style, coupled with martial arts-themed background music, and a variety of gameplay modes – once you dive in, it's hard to pull yourself out. [Martial Arts Mastery, Intelligence and Valor] Come and experience the mysteries of martial arts, which involve not only physical but also mental challenges. The choice of formations, the pairing of heroes, the influence of secret techniques, and the timing of skill releases – all require a sharp mind. Engage in exhilarating sparring sessions with other martial artists in the martial arts competition. The stage is set, waiting for you, young heroes, to showcase your skills. [Entertaining Gameplay, Free Exploration] Practices, adventures, dual cultivation, and inheritance – the martial world is full of stories waiting to be uncovered. Sect conflicts, gang invasions, and the pursuit of villains paint a colorful picture of life in the game. Sometimes, stepping away from the conflicts, cultivating fields, running a tavern, or leveling up through AFK activities allows for a relaxed and enjoyable experience. May your journey in Little Shrimp martial world, which is filled with excitement and discoveries! Little Shrimp Team

rows.name: Warrior Next
rows.short_description: Few against many... Fight with a handful of Spartans to save Greece. Destroy hordes of enemies until the fight with creatures sent by the Gods. Lots of action for everyone!
rows.description_html: What game is it? Many years ago, Ancient Greece. The Persians and beasts sent by the Gods destroy entire villages and kill defenseless peasants. A handful of mighty Spartan warriors are ready to fight and stop the fierce enemies. Warrior Next is a simple and intuitive action game with gameplay that takes seconds to figure out. Hordes of enemies will come from everywhere and you will need to level up as much as possible before going hunting for the mythological beast. Move your Spartans in 8 directions. Your attacks will be automatic so you'll only have to worry about avoiding enemies and carefully choosing which weapon and skill you want to upgrade. Leave the center part of the map when you are strong enough!

rows.name: Cosmic Clash
rows.short_description: Battle your friends for space superiority in this arcade style space shooter. Select your star fighter and jump into Cosmic Clash where you try and eliminate your friends while surviving the perils of space.
rows.description_html: Cosmic Clash is minimalistic arcade shooter where you battle your friends in the star fighter of your choosing. Dodge or destroy enemy munitions with precision flying and shooting or defensive utility, while you weave your way through random events. Be the last player standing and become Clash champion. Play local multiplayer, online, or in a mix with local players connecting on the host machine. Remote play supported.

rows.name: Monday Meltdown
rows.short_description: Fast. Bloody. 8-Player Mayhem. Dominate. Taunt. Repeat. Free. No strings attached. Ever.
rows.description_html: It's time for a Monday Meltdown. A solo-developed, super-fast 8-player top-down shooter built for one thing: dominating your friends . Inspired by classics like Hotline Miami and Soldat , and spiced up with plenty of gore. Dominate your friends or foes in a variety of fast-paced gamemodes. Host or join a match and you're straight into the action—no waiting around. Got no friends? Bots are supported. Equip yourself with a wide range of weapons  that all serve a specific purpose -  Good plays win the game, not just the gear you're holding If you're on a killing-spree, killstreak  weapons will be awarded ensuring chaos unfolds Winning is cool, but winning with style is better. Unlock new character and weapon skins to look good doing it. Add salt with taunts and custom killphrases , or hunt for cool in-game secrets to unlock exclusive skins. Are your ready to melt some Mondays?

rows.name: Potions & Emotions
rows.short_description: Potions and Emotions is a creative game where you play the conscience of the villain. Join Thalia—a fae with big ambitions—who intends to take over a town hidden in a magical forest. Whether her shoulder angel or devil, you get to guide her actions and witness the consequences of your choices.
rows.description_html: Potions & Emotions is an indie visual novel created by a small team of student developers. Accompany Thalia--an aspiring alchemist and wannabe super villain--who is hell-bent on taking over the entire planet. She travels to a magical forest in order to collect raw materials for her alchemy projects, and stumbles upon a sleepy town hidden within. After seeing this and recognizing the potency of the magic surrounding this town, she decides to start small and set up her secret lair within its walls by taking over as the town’s next mayor.

rows.short_description: I'm not sure why there are two descriptions but pretend I put something really funny here
rows.description_html: Mark February 22 in the history books since my dog turned five today and I finished TNT. IT'S TIME to Thunk on a Thursday Nite with the best rhythm game in 22 years! Follow Jim-Bob's day, which includes: Six levels that all play differently! (Two coming soon in updates) Uniquely animated cutscenes for each level, done in several different styles! An entertaining story! T.N.T. is pretty short, and will most likely only take around an hour to complete, which is why it's free. I doubt anybody would buy it if it costed money. But the whole TNTeam put a lot of effort into this game and we hope you enjoy it!

rows.name: Pow Vista
rows.short_description: Enter an MMORPG where skateboarding is tied directly to combat, gathering, and crafting. Level up elemental skills, chase rare drops, and build your legend as an early player. Play how you want with optional PvP, zero pay-to-win, and frequent updates shaped by the community.
rows.description_html: Level up in a real-time online world with other players, unlocking new skateboards and hoodies as you go. Get XP in over 10 skills, each opening up new abilities and ways to play the game. Every mob has its own loot table, so even the weakest foe can drop rare items for your PowDex. There’s also a chance that mob might drop an egg that hatches into a pal to follow you and help out.

rows.name: DORONKO WANKO
rows.short_description: 『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game. In this game, You can become a cute, innocent Pomeranian, make your master's home messy and dirty. 'Will the master be angry with me?' Don't worry. Because you are a sweet doggie.
rows.description_html: 『DORONKO WANKO』 is a DORONKO Action Game. In this game, you can become a cute, innocent pomeranian. And you can make your master's home messy and dirty. Let's explore this beautiful house and make it dirty and muddy at will! Pomeranian can get muddy by 'rubbing' against the 'mud' spread on the floor. Spread out the mud with 'splash'! Let's make the whole area muddy and messy. Sometimes you can find 'hidden pome' when you are spreading mud all over the house. When you find all the 'hidden pome', the 'Good Smell Room' 's door will open. (Let's go inside quietly before others notice!) More mud, more damage! You can check the total amount of damage you have caused from the ending “Receipt”. When you cause enough damage, you will receive a “gift”?! They will help Pome’s exploration by making it easier to splash mud and obtain key items. A little action can cause a huge damage? Use personal appliances and toys to get even muddier. The Pomeranian's adventures will remain as a 'badge of memory'. A random move may get an unexpected badge. 'Put on' the 'Goods' and make your Pomeranian more pretty. Don't forget the special goods that can release mud!

rows.name: Fight! Olyn Island
rows.short_description: Explore the mysterious Olyn Island! Play against other players and use cute animal heroes towards victory!
rows.description_html: Join Our Discord We value your opinion, so if you have any feedback on the game, or if you need any help, feel free to join our Discord. Game Features Smooth and detailed fighting scenes featuring brand new 3D modeling & immersive experience into a fantasy world of animal chess pieces. A game that can live up to every little bit of your imagination of auto chess. Easy to play, fast-paced, and strategy-oriented. There are even Runes, Hero DIY, and other new and well-designed elements, created all for your best experience! A great number of Geos and different types allow you to adopt a wide range of strategies so that victory and defeat are instantly reversed following each and every move of yours on the battlefield! Whether it's the interplay of stats and special effects or the position arrangement of Geos, everything remains essential to victory! Come participate in the PvP modes, Match, Ranked, and Championship! The thrilling battles are always on! Do you dare to invite your friends to fight together and become the top auto-battler player?

rows.name: To Have and to Hold
rows.short_description: A short boys love / yaoi / gay visual novel about a couple of cousins whose paths cross at a family wedding. They both get a little drunk, emotions run high, and things take a surprisingly steamy turn.
rows.description_html: Yuel’s life is a mess. He’s twenty-eight years old, he works a boring office job, and he’s barely scraping by with his limited finances. Throw in the fact that his wealthy father disowned him almost a decade ago, then died six months prior, and his life really couldn’t be any worse… Or could it? After being invited to his aunt’s wedding, Yuel reconnects with his handsome, easygoing older cousin, Tavi. A string of unfortunate circumstances lead Yuel to sharing a hotel room with Tavi for the wedding, and (more worryingly) the same bed. With emotions running high and fancy champagne in abundance, what will happen next? The answer: something Yuel will probably regret. 40k words of text (approx 2-4 hours of reading) A linear story with no choices or branches Detailed character and background art A cute BL story about a couple of cousins Drunken confessions Emotional angst Sex!

rows.name: Pawggle
rows.short_description: Pawggle is a physics puzzle game. Help poor-sighted adorable fur creatures by strategically positioning your pegs and immerse yourself in a joyous furry symphony.
rows.description_html: One simple rule: Eliminate all the red pegs from the game board before running out of balls. Pawggle is a casual Peggle/Pachinko style game but, this time, you step away from the visor. Step into a world where you become the guiding hand for your furry companions, aiding them by strategically placing blue pegs. Features: Assist five adorable fur creatures Conquer a series of challenging levels ensuring you never run out of balls Exercise your skill and try being number one on the leaderboard Join the fun and experience the joy of Pawggle as you master the art of the peg!

rows.name: The Forest of Conx
rows.short_description: The Forest of Conx: A spooky noir styled survival horror tower defense game
rows.description_html: The Forest of Conx is a survival horror tower defense game, where you have came to a forest to find a mysterious creature named 'Conx', unfortunately, this task isn't as easy as once planned.. Features in The Forest of Conx: -Exploration The vast forest provides lots of environments to explore -foraging Before night hits you must collect a descent amount of globs, these globs will allow you to buy towers to defend yourself -Upgrades The makeshift cabin you hunker in has many uninstalled upgrades that you can use to better your chances of survival -Progressive Difficulty The difficult of enemies increases as the days go by, make sure to not overstay your welcome in the woods.. -Towers There are many Towers you can buy and place around your cabin, these towers will defend you from creatures once night hits.. -Challenge and Freeplay Modes Even after you complete the main story, there are still more things to do! Such as mods, the level editor, challenge mode, or the freeplay menu. Some other things to keep in mind: -Your cabin has a limited power supply, make sure to recharge power via the fusebox outside. -There's a large cave system underneath the forest, make sure to explore these tunnels thoroughly -Be aware of flash floods and other disasters! -Beware Conx...

rows.name: The PenguinGame 2 -Lies of Penguin-
rows.short_description: The heroic penguin pulled the legendary club from the rock. pass the ordeal! Revenge on humans! Save Antarctica in crisis! The Penguin Game2 : Lies of Penguin is an action game made with a deep impression of the soul-like genre. Challenge a total of 7 types of boss battles!
rows.description_html: Pass the trials of the penguin wise men and save Antarctica! The Penguin Game2 : Lies of Penguin is an action game made with a deep impression of the soul-like genre. The story of the penguin hero's desperate struggle to save Antarctica, a total of 7 types of high difficulty boss battles, and 2 endings have been implemented. Human destruction of the environment has caused the earth's temperature to rise. Antarctica is turning into an environment where the glaciers are melting, making it difficult for penguins to live. You appear in a hopeless penguin village after pulling a legendary club from a rock. Pass the trials of the 4 penguin wise men and awaken as a hero! You are the only penguin who can save Antarctica from crisis and take revenge on humans.

rows.name: Keepers Of The Lost Arts
rows.short_description: This is an endless runner set in a Medieval town and time.
rows.description_html: This game is an endless runner set in a Medieval town and time. We understand that running can be rather tiring, so you can also just walk and enjoy that medieval vibe. Just watch out for those oncoming horses! If you want to collect some loot along your jogging route, we've got you covered. Coins and gems, and someday we'll have scrolls about lost arts. How do I win? It's endless. You win when you're done chilling with the game. Can I shoot or beat up bad guys? Oh nonono... none of that here. We just jogging along. Or walking. And running. And also sliding. Like, under obstacles. Oh yeah, and jumping over stuff. Just run forward? Yeah, pretty much. You can also go sideways. As in left or right. In fact, it's recommended. And jumping way up and sliding under stuff, as was made clear a few the sentences ago.

rows.name: Project Z: The beginning of the end. Chapter I
rows.short_description: Tower & Defense game, with TopDown view set in a post apocalyptic world of zombies
rows.description_html: Project Z is a TopDown view Tower & Defense game, set in a post apocalyptic city from the future. The title is exclusively developed for PC by Parisi Interactive Games. The game system consists of defending a shelter while placing traps to defend yourself from zombie attacks. We transport you to the year 2025, where a human experiment laboratory tries to develop a substance that would bring the dead back to life. But whose experiment hasn't gone quite right, and now the world isn't what it once knew. Our character (Leonard) faces alone against waves of zombies whose objective is to attack the shelter, to contain these attacks, Leonard will place traps throughout the levels and use the few weapons that he possesses. Special features: To get the use of the traps, you must collect lots of money that you will find distributed in the levels or by killing the zombies. The weapons you will use will be provided by non-playable characters Explore the level to get an idea of the key points marked on the map to prepare your defense Play slowly, since the waves are not automatic, you must press the wave call button. Contains moderate violence and gore

rows.name: Salaryman RESCUE!
rows.short_description: Dive into VR-exclusive Salaryman RESCUE!, a puzzle-management game set in the neon streets of Tokyo. Guide inebriated salarymen to safety, manipulate coin-operated machines, dodge bustling traffic, and thwart UFO abductions, all while soaking in the unique citypop atmosphere!
rows.description_html: 🏙️ About this game VR-exclusive Salaryman RESCUE! plunges you into the vibey, citypop-kissed streets of Tokyo, tasked with guiding wave after wave of groggy salarymen to safety - by any means necessary! Use zany physics toys and automation management to solve wave after wave of puzzles, avoiding the Tokyo traffic and the looming threat of UFO abduction! --- 🍺 Key Features 🎵 Citypop Vibes: Soak in neon-lit vibes and a wavey, dreamy aesthetic, perfectly capturing that citypop nostalgia! 👨🏻‍💼Save the Salarymen!: Endless waves of tipsy office workers need your help to get home safely. 🧩 Challenging Waves & Puzzles: Every wave presents a unique challenge, each with multiple solutions. It’s up to you to strategize, experiment, and find the most efficient way to guide the salarymen safely home. 🚗 Ragdoll Hilarity: Stay alert! The bustling traffic isn’t kind to our inebriated salarymen. It might be hilarious, but try to avoid letting speeding vehicles send them ragdolling across the streets. 🛸 Watch Out For UFOs: Safeguard the skies and thwart UFOs attempting to abduct the wandering salarymen, using a variety of tools and tactics. 🪙 Coin-Operated Mechanics: Explore the vibrant streets to discover hidden coins - then use them in various coin-operated machines to unlock new strategies and solutions. --- Ready to embark on a neon-soaked adventure? These salarymen ain't gonna rescue themselves! Grab your VR headset and join the rescue mission today!

rows.name: Dark Lord
rows.short_description: Unleash your power in Dark Lord, a roguelike RPG filled with strategy, adventure, and sardonic wit. Rule your growing realm with an iron fist in Story Mode, dive deep into the legends created by other players, or forge your own in Community Stories Mode!
rows.description_html: Join Official Discord About the Game Step into the treacherous yet alluring shoes of the Dark Lord, steering a realm filled with eccentric characters and convoluted plots. As you stretch your tendrils of darkness across new lands, exercise your cunning in balancing political intrigues and military might. Juggle advisors who are as likely to stab you in the back as they are to kneel in awe. Fortify your stronghold, and revel in a narrative that’s as endlessly unfolding as it is drenched in layers of deliciously dark humor. The cherry on top? Community Stories Mode, where you can dive into the tales crafted by other players, as well as compose and share your own adventures using a convenient editor. Dive deep into a rich strategic role-playing game with roguelike elements and embark on an adventure unlike any other. As the enigmatic Dark Lord, watch as chaos reigns in your kingdom. Cultivate your territories, manage cunning advisors, mastermind devious conspiracies, and tackle quests brimming with dark, witty humor. In a realm where shadows dominate, humor—of the darkest kind—finds its way. Relish in the game's unique brand of comedy as you expand your domain, engage with quirky subjects, and embark on hilariously twisted quests. Face challenges with a wicked grin! Your choices have weight, dictating the twists and turns of the narrative. From outsmarting assassins to navigating interactions with wise yet cunning advisors, craft a tale unique to your reign. Get ready for challenging trials and complex tasks. What fate awaits your kingdom? It's in your hands! Find the delicate balance between military might and cunning political intrigues, as not all battles are won with strength. Skillfully manage your advisors to solidify your rule, but beware, as they may engage in their own treacherous game behind your back. The hand-crafted visuals of the game plunge you deep into the ambiance of a brooding kingdom. Every detail, every shadow speaks of a world built with care and passion, ensuring a visually captivating journey intertwined with riveting narratives. As you ascend the throne of darkness, you'll find that ruling is no easy task. Trust comes at a premium; decide who to execute for disloyalty and who to shower with gold for their undying allegiance. Yet, beware—today's faithful servant may be tomorrow's backstabbing traitor. And if you think you can play favorites, think again. Pin your advisors against each other in a treacherous game of divide and rule, ensuring no single advisor gains enough power to challenge your dark reign.
rows.about_html: Join Official Discord About the Game Step into the treacherous yet alluring shoes of the Dark Lord, steering a realm filled with eccentric characters and convoluted plots. As you stretch your tendrils of darkness across new lands, exercise your cunning in balancing political intrigues and military might. Juggle advisors who are as likely to stab you in the back as they are to kneel in awe. Fortify your stronghold, and revel in a narrative that’s as endlessly unfolding as it is drenched in layers of deliciously dark humor. The cherry on top? Community Stories Mode, where you can dive into the tales crafted by other players, as well as compose and share your own adventures using a convenient editor. Dive deep into a rich strategic role-playing game with roguelike elements and embark on an adventure unlike any other. As the enigmatic Dark Lord, watch as chaos reigns in your kingdom. Cultivate your territories, manage cunning advisors, mastermind devious conspiracies, and tackle quests brimming with dark, witty humor. In a realm where shadows dominate, humor—of the darkest kind—finds its way. Relish in the game's unique brand of comedy as you expand your domain, engage with quirky subjects, and embark on hilariously twisted quests. Face challenges with a wicked grin! Your choices have weight, dictating the twists and turns of the narrative. From outsmarting assassins to navigating interactions with wise yet cunning advisors, craft a tale unique to your reign. Get ready for challenging trials and complex tasks. What fate awaits your kingdom? It's in your hands! Find the delicate balance between military might and cunning political intrigues, as not all battles are won with strength. Skillfully manage your advisors to solidify your rule, but beware, as they may engage in their own treacherous game behind your back. The hand-crafted visuals of the game plunge you deep into the ambiance of a brooding kingdom. Every detail, every shadow speaks of a world built with care and passion, ensuring a visually captivating journey intertwined with riveting narratives. As you ascend the throne of darkness, you'll find that ruling is no easy task. Trust comes at a premium; decide who to execute for disloyalty and who to shower with gold for their undying allegiance. Yet, beware—today's faithful servant may be tomorrow's backstabbing traitor. And if you think you can play favorites, think again. Pin your advisors against each other in a treacherous game of divide and rule, ensuring no single advisor gains enough power to challenge your dark reign.

rows.name: Save the Dungeon!
rows.short_description: Save the Dungeon! Is a tower defense game from the perspective of the villain. Upgrade your minions to hold back the relentless hordes of heroes.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Save the Dungeon! Heroes are invading your home, they aim to take everything you have. They have declared you evil Overlord as a justification to desecrate your land and end your life. It is time to call forth your minions and prepare the Dungeon for war! We stand with you Overlord to prove to these “heroes” that you are revered as the Overlord of these lands for a reason! Save the Dungeon! is a top down tower defense game where you must summon your minions to defend the dungeon from a horde of heroes! There is three levels implemented in the game with two different overlords to choose from and 6 different minion types to summon! Features Buy new items and upgrade existing ones in the shop! Summon Dangerous Minions Will you show the so called heroes why you are the Overlord or will you allow them to extinguish life and rob your home?

rows.name: Infinite Borders
rows.short_description: With over 10 million downloads, Infinite Borders is a popular strategy game set in China's Three Kingdoms period. Fight alongside legendary heroes to conquer lands and defeat enemies. Build unique teams, guide your city to prosperity, and make special policies. Infinite Borders is calling you!
rows.description_html: Do you want to define your own war style in a strategy game? Infinite Borders is calling you! With over 10 million downloads, Infinite Borders is one of the most popular strategy games in East Asia. When you enter Infinite Borders, you will return to the Three Kingdoms period--a turbulent dynasty in Chinese history--and have a chance to pen your epic. You will play as a lord and fight alongside Liu Bei, Cao Cao, Lv Bu, and other great Three Kingdoms heroes. Form unique teams with diverse combinations of generals and tactics to defeat more enemies and conquer more lands. You can make special policies and guide your city towards prosperity. In Infinite Borders, grasping the final victory requires not only strength, but also intelligence and strategy. Now, on the brink of war, it's time to join the battles and rewrite history, my lord! Build Your Estate, Gain Abundant Resources Construct buildings and upgrade facilities in your city to attain numerous supplies like wood, iron and soldiers. Devote your resources to expansion and development! Command Your Troops, Various Generals Collocation There are over 300 heroes with different skills waiting for you to recruit. Assemble your generals and formulate kinds of lineups to defeat your enemies! Fighter or Farmer, Diplomat or Spy, Make Your Choice How to rise to the top in this chaotic world? You can be an aggressive fighter who crushes the battlefields. You can be a hardworking farmer who concentrates on building and defending. You can be a sociable diplomat who establishes good relations with other alliances. You can be a mysterious spy who disintegrates enemy forces secretly. Determine your law of victory and write a new chapter of history in this war game! Open Eastern World, Free To Explore The upgraded 3D graphics restore an authentic ancient eastern world with dozens of famous historic landmarks like Yangtze River, Yellow River and Yueyang Tower, proving immersive gameplay experience. Embark on your unrestricted adventure right now!

rows.name: Crowned Control
rows.short_description: A couch co-op multiplayer game, where the goal is to grab the crown and keep it on your head for as long as possible to win the game!
rows.description_html: Crowned Control is a game about a group of knights, lured into an old dungeon by tales of legend. According to the stories, there's a legendary crown in there that grants ghostly powers to the one wearing it! Of course, every knight wants that crown for themself! Acquiring it will require teamwork, however. They'll need to work together to get the crown off of the current wearer's head, and onto their own! Our knights are armed with their trusty sword, shining armor and whatever artifacts (or rubbish) they can scavenge from within the dungeon. Hit each other with swords, spill oil to slow the others down or taste some exquisite cuisine in the fine peppers of the underground, to give yourself a speed boost. Other than legendary artifacts, this dungeon also houses a myriad of traps. Our knights can choose to expertly avoid these, or cunningly use them against the one wearing the crown (or their friends, of course). At the end of the day, all that matters is who gets to wear the crown the longest, so employ whatever tactics you need to make sure that person is you! This game is made by 5 students from Howest - Digital Arts & Entertainment in the 2nd year of their bachelor in a period of 11 weeks.

rows.name: The Chef's Shift: First Course
rows.short_description: A fast-paced typing game in a restaurant setting, where you’ll both cook & serve food to hungry customers, all done by TYPING. Play through the Italian restaurant and get a taste of The Chef's Shift!
rows.description_html: Get ready to cook up a storm in 'The Chef's Shift: First Course' - a fast-paced typing game set in a bustling restaurant! With your keyboard as your weapon, you'll need to cook and serve delicious dishes to hungry customers before they lose their patience. But that's not all - you'll also need to juggle all kinds of crazy distractions, from rat invasions to unruly customers. Embark on a culinary journey through the Italian restaurant in The Chef's Shift: First Course, and experience the start of Lorenzo's chef career. Savor the diverse flavors of the cuisine, where each dish will feature different quirks & challenges. 1 teaspoon of chaotic, fast-paced gameplay 1 package of easy-to-pickup, hard-to-master TYPING mechanic 1 cup of fun time management bits And we mean it! Navigate through the menu by typing Prepare & serve your customers by typing Select your dialogue choices by typing Throughout the game, you will meet various characters, from customers with their own personality, to characters who propel the story forward.

rows.name: The August Before: Chapter One
rows.short_description: The August Before: Chapter One is the first chapter in a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. Clean up and don’t forget your old belongings on your way to the new life!
rows.description_html: ‎The August Before is a meditative narrative 3D puzzle about cleaning up, sorting out and packing up your life before moving on. In Chapter One, play through the first snippets of the story and get acquainted with your room, and the people in your life. Teenage love, first losses, and notes from friends are scattered in the corners: explore the details of the heroine's life, pack up the life you will take with you, and say goodbye - if you can. And remember - you can't take the past with you. All is well that ends well — and all is well that ends. Features Clean up the room before leaving, find the necessary items, and pack them in a suitcase. Keep track of the diary, change the music, arrange the objects, and try to remember not to disturb the dark corners of the room. Sort through the items and appreciate the resulting order and the details of the story that unfolds in the process. Explore the chaos and enjoy your freedom to drag, erase, disassemble, break, and fix things in the highly interactive space.

rows.name: Heroes & Redemption
rows.short_description: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell where you face hordes of enemies, annihilate them, learn new abilities and enhance your skills. Explore different regions, acquire new companions and embark on adventures again and again.
rows.description_html: Heroes & Redemption is a rogue-lite bullet-hell game where different characters and ability combinations are utilized to fight against progressively stronger enemies in order to survive. Play as the warrior Otwin Reid, who defeats the creatures and enemies that suddenly appear in the world. Acquire new companions and try to find the ones responsible for this chaos. FEATURES 8 playable characters with different ability appearances. 4 types of altars with different tasks. Epic boss fights. 4 sets of armor that provide different powers. 10 rings, each possessing a unique power. 20 active and 22 passive abilities, a total of 42 skills . 29 empowered skills that enhance your base skills. FIGHT AND EXPLORE  Level up by slaughtering enemies that spawn in every direction. Make your character near immortal in this adventure by choosing one of randomly offered abilities each time you level up and by purchasing runes, armors, rings and empowered skills at the hub. Complete levels by fulfilling objectives at altars that appear in specific waves. Explore special locations on the maps or complete achievements to unlock new characters and abilities. MEET THE HEROES Each hero brings unique strengths and a dark past to the battlefield. Whether it's the furious warrior, the elusive rogue who strikes from the shadows, the spell-weaving mage, or the unstoppable paladin with hammer in hand, every character is ready to confront dark forces. Join them, harness their powers, and fight for the fate of the realm! COMPLETE YOUR TASKS In addition to defeating enemies, you need to complete tasks at altars that appear in random places with random objectives. EQUIPMENT You can earn soul shards by completing altars or killing enemies, and you can purchase armors or rings with soul shards. There are 4 types of armor sets in total. Some of them grants you increased protection but slows you down, while others grants you less protection but different powers. Combine or use the set that best suits your playstyle and destroy the enemies in your own way. Purchase 10 mystical rings, each granting unique powers to transform your character’s abilities – from enhanced strength and speed to soul absorbing magic and life-stealing powers. SPEND YOUR GOLDS AT THE HUB At the hub, you can purchase characters, runes and even buy empowered skills that evolve your powers. A WORLD FULL OF CHAOS Survive in the putrid dark crystal cave, embark on an expedition in old graveyard that filled with the traces of forgotten tombs, uncover the secrets of snowy village, be careful where you step in toxic sewers that filled with perilous waters and creatures, explore the old prison with ancient stone cells and annihilate all the enemies that cross your path.

rows.name: BYLE
rows.short_description: Fight through a corrupted city, battling over 50 unique enemies and powerful bosses. Arm yourself with an arsenal of weapons and uncover mysterious power-ups as you strive to liberate the city from the clutches of the mind-altering BYLE.
rows.description_html: Step into a world where the line between sanity and madness has been blurred by the malevolent force of BYLE. In BYLE, you are a mercenary on a mission to liberate the people from the clutches of this mind-controlling substance. Embark on a journey through the city consumed by chaos, as you battle hordes of twisted enemies, discover powerful weaponry and powerups, and take down the sinister BYLE. Fight Against the Corruption: Take on the role of one of many unlockable characters, each with their own stats and armed with the sole purpose of saving the city from BYLE's malevolence. Every playthrough is different as levels are procedurally generated and powerups are random. Multiple Game Modes: Choose your path to victory between the Save the City and Colosseum game modes. Save the City offers the traditional roguelike experience, traversing through procedural levels, collecting weapons and powerups, and taking on bosses. Colosseum offers wave-based combat where difficulty increases the longer you survive. An Arsenal of Destruction: Equip yourself with an extensive selection of powerful and unique weapons. Experiment with melee combat, firearms, and experimental BYLE-fuelled technology as you find the perfect weapon to suit your needs in combatting the corruption. Face Over 50 Unique Enemies: The city is brimming with enemies, once residents of the city but now corrupted and forced to fight in the name of BYLE. From mutated abominations to corrupted civilians, you will confront a diverse range of foes that will test your combat skills. Confront Powerful Bosses: Test your mettle against formidable bosses that guard the heart of the BYLE's corruption. These colossal adversaries will push your skills to the limit, demanding flawless combat techniques in order to come out on top. Discover Unique Powerups: As you delve deeper into the heart of the city, discover special powerups that will give you an edge in your fight against BYLE. These enhancements can change the tide of battle, allowing you to grow stronger or use powerful abilities that will help defend against the horrors that await. Prepare to confront your worst fears, battle relentless foes, and liberate the city from the imprisoned by BYLE. Are you ready to become the hero this world desperately needs? Will you be the saviour that cleanses the city? Find out in BYLE. Featured at Insomnia i70's Indie Zone
