rows.name: Can Strike
rows.short_description: Your employers at Fish Co are sending in Robots to end your strike! Use your union-granted weapons to destroy the waves of robots to keep the strike going.
rows.description_html: In “Can Strike,” you play as a worker at Fish Co, where the employees have gone on strike to demand better working conditions and fair wages. But the company isn’t backing down - they’ve sent in waves of robots to break up the strike and force the workers back to their jobs. As a member of the union, you’ve been granted powerful weapons to defend yourself and your fellow workers against the robotic onslaught. Use your skills and strategy to destroy the robots and keep the strike going. The future of your job and livelihood is at stake - will you be able to hold your ground and fight for justice? With intense action, challenging gameplay, and a gripping storyline, “Can Strike” is an epic battle for survival. Join the fight and defend your rights!

rows.name: Bouncers
rows.short_description: Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear.
rows.description_html: Short Description Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear. The Mini Square The Mini Square (creative name huh?) will follow you forcing you to constantly move as you avoid all the other enemies. The Bouncer The Bouncer (The names get more creative I promise) bounces off the edges of your screen and can switch directions at any bounce. The game starts off easy with 1 Bouncer but multiplies as your score gets higher. 1 Bounce = 1 point * multiplier. The Asteroid The Asteroid (See? More creative huh?) spawns every 10-15 seconds and will track you. Juke it to avoid it! The Dahser The Dasher can spawn more than once at a time in any location across your screen. They will face a random direction and charge until it leaves the screen. The Thief If the thief spawns, it will go faster than the mini square! If you get hit by it, it will take some of your points! Avoid it for 30 seconds and it will de-spawn. Slow Motion When an enemy gets close to you, other than the mini square, it will trigger slow motion putting a red vignette smoothly faded onto your screen and slow motion will activate so you can be precise when dodging. Collect Powerups Powerups will help your run last longer! Collect powerups like +1 Life, Shield, Star, Purge, and Speed! Healing Healing is handled by a random chance of health packs or passive healing! Health Packs: Collect health packs to heal instantly! Passive Healing: Avoid damage to continue healing! Health Zone: The health zone can spawn randomly, stay in it and it will continue healing you! Leaderboard Compete on each difficulty to get on the top 5 leaderboard! Key Settings / Fun Options Movement Mouse Controls (Strongly Recommended): The player moves smoothly towards your mouse. Most recommended for beginners WASD/Arrow Keys: Snappy movement using WASD or the arrow keys Rainbow Bouncers A toggle to have every bouncer spawn as a random color Special Thanks Special thanks to my best friend George N. for coming up with some of the ideas in my game. He is in the credits section for the ideas he came up with. Backstory Well the short reason why this exists is my computer science teacher. But here is the long story: I was a freshman in high school (at the time I'm writing this, I’ll be a sophomore) at 14 years old. (I turned 15 6 days ago at the time I’m writing this, July 16 2023) I recently finished a project I started the year before using python. I didn’t have to do any of the labs, I was way ahead of everyone, they were learning python and I learned it in 5th-6th grade. But since I was not working on anything, I started failing. I talked to my computer science teacher and he said for me to make another project with something new, he needed to challenge me. So I decided to learn 2D game development with Pygame. Pygame was nice, I learned it in 2 days on vacation, but following a tutorial was not enough, I wanted to prove to myself I knew something. I decided to recreate pong but then I wanted my own original idea. So I made the first version of Bouncers, called “Dodge Lines” I know it’s terrible. But it is a concept I had in mind for a few years. I worked on the game way too much and also during class and adding constant updates. 47 days later, I had 46 releases of my game on GitHub. I loved it, but I was limited by pygame and wanted to learn Unity. Surprisingly it was easier. I remade Bouncers from scratch. Remade almost every feature and improved it. I upgraded the graphics an insane amount because Unity is insanely better. And then for about half the school year, I worked non stop in and out of my classes. rows.about_html: Short Description Bouncers is a single player retro styled action game that has you avoiding enemies to climb the leaderboard. The bouncer will bounce around the screen in random directions and multiply over time, but more enemies for example the asteroid will appear. The Mini Square The Mini Square (creative name huh?) will follow you forcing you to constantly move as you avoid all the other enemies. The Bouncer The Bouncer (The names get more creative I promise) bounces off the edges of your screen and can switch directions at any bounce. The game starts off easy with 1 Bouncer but multiplies as your score gets higher. 1 Bounce = 1 point * multiplier. The Asteroid The Asteroid (See? More creative huh?) spawns every 10-15 seconds and will track you. Juke it to avoid it! The Dahser The Dasher can spawn more than once at a time in any location across your screen. They will face a random direction and charge until it leaves the screen. The Thief If the thief spawns, it will go faster than the mini square! If you get hit by it, it will take some of your points! Avoid it for 30 seconds and it will de-spawn. Slow Motion When an enemy gets close to you, other than the mini square, it will trigger slow motion putting a red vignette smoothly faded onto your screen and slow motion will activate so you can be precise when dodging. Collect Powerups Powerups will help your run last longer! Collect powerups like +1 Life, Shield, Star, Purge, and Speed! Healing Healing is handled by a random chance of health packs or passive healing! Health Packs: Collect health packs to heal instantly! Passive Healing: Avoid damage to continue healing! Health Zone: The health zone can spawn randomly, stay in it and it will continue healing you! Leaderboard Compete on each difficulty to get on the top 5 leaderboard! Key Settings / Fun Options Movement Mouse Controls (Strongly Recommended): The player moves smoothly towards your mouse. Most recommended for beginners WASD/Arrow Keys: Snappy movement using WASD or the arrow keys Rainbow Bouncers A toggle to have every bouncer spawn as a random color Special Thanks Special thanks to my best friend George N. for coming up with some of the ideas in my game. He is in the credits section for the ideas he came up with. Backstory Well the short reason why this exists is my computer science teacher. But here is the long story: I was a freshman in high school (at the time I'm writing this, I’ll be a sophomore) at 14 years old. (I turned 15 6 days ago at the time I’m writing this, July 16 2023) I recently finished a project I started the year before using python. I didn’t have to do any of the labs, I was way ahead of everyone, they were learning python and I learned it in 5th-6th grade. But since I was not working on anything, I started failing. I talked to my computer science teacher and he said for me to make another project with something new, he needed to challenge me. So I decided to learn 2D game development with Pygame. Pygame was nice, I learned it in 2 days on vacation, but following a tutorial was not enough, I wanted to prove to myself I knew something. I decided to recreate pong but then I wanted my own original idea. So I made the first version of Bouncers, called “Dodge Lines” I know it’s terrible. But it is a concept I had in mind for a few years. I worked on the game way too much and also during class and adding constant updates. 47 days later, I had 46 releases of my game on GitHub. I loved it, but I was limited by pygame and wanted to learn Unity. Surprisingly it was easier. I remade Bouncers from scratch. Remade almost every feature and improved it. The full game features: Get access to a lot more stuff! Make amazing builds with 325 items, 65 heroes, 150 relics and 60 origins. Access to the third act and meet the final boss in a secret act! Recruit special heroes, fight deadly encounters, loot and craft powerful gear, discover and create unique synergetic builds! rows.name: Toy Shire: Room One
rows.short_description: Are you prepared for a thrilling toy army tower defense adventure? Welcome to the Toy Shire! Battle diverse foes in various locations, defend your family, and repel foes from your area. Save the world by strengthening your defense with toy towers! FULL GAME AVAILABLE NOW!
rows.description_html: Play through the three levels in Kevin's Room and defend your room against your old toys. Face Memphis-X in the final level and put a stop to his assault as he crushes your soldiers in an attempt to get to your base. You received new toys from your family. Isn't that lovely? Oh, it's for sure... Your old toys, though, aren't getting along as well. They are no longer cared for and have been forgotten. So what follows next? They're going to join together against you and assault your brand-new toys, so be prepared. But never worry! You're in luck since your brand-new toys are troops of green soldiers. They still require your aid though! Control, strengthen, and defeat the opposing forces! However, focus with care, the enemies you encounter might not be your old playthings! Tower building alone won't be sufficient to repel incoming attackers. Build up your own troops in the best feasible positions, then unleash attacks into enemy territory. Never abandon your towers, and deploy your troops in accordance with the traits of the enemy. First, the attacking forces will attempt to get past your defenses. Build and improve towers to aid your army. By using unique abilities, you can support your troops and towers as well. Safeguard your base against waves of attackers. You need to pick the right troops if you would like to prevail. Clean the paths and guard any open routes. Upgrade your troops and unlock new ones to take down the waves and claim victory. Enter a world and a narrative built around the toys that enriched your youth, including toy soldiers, dinosaur sets, robots, building blocks, and more.

rows.name: JustWatchMyCat
rows.short_description: It's a cat puzzle game that solves using the direction of gravity.
rows.description_html: JustWatch MyCat is a puzzle game that manipulates blocks of cats to eat fish. When you press the arrow keys, the cats move in that direction all at once on a 2-d map. In addition, new gimmicks appear every 10 stages, and there are a total of 50 stages. Cat Block : Move in unison in the direction entered until blocked in that direction. Cat blocks bite the fish in their mouth when they touch it. Puffer fish : When a cat block touches the puffer fish, the cat becomes addicted. You can heal by eating regular fish blocks. At this time, the cat blocks don't bite the fish in its mouth. In other words, cat blocks that ate puffer fish are only satisfied by eating two blocks of fish. Switches and gates : Open or close the gates on the map when a block steps on the pink switch. However, passing over the switch is not applicable and there must be a block on the switch at the end of the movement. A closed gate acts like a wall. Dog Block : Dog blocks move in unison in the opposite direction of the input direction. If a dog block and a cat block compete for position with one space left when they collide face to face, the cat block takes its place. Dog blocks can operate the switch, but they do not interact with regular fish or puffer fish. Portal : Portal always appears in pairs. When a cat or dog block touches one portal, it sends it in the opposite direction of the other. Cute Cat Photos : Provides cat photos for every multiples stage of 10. In fact, one of the reasons I made this game is because I want more people to see my cat. If the game is too difficult, you can also skip it by pressing the space or enter key. However, it is made up of puzzles that can be solved with a little thought, so I recommend you to try it.

rows.name: Mixing Ammos
rows.short_description: A turn-based free-move strategy game. Walk/Run/Sprint freely without the grids. Your attack could be countered so choose your next move wisely.
rows.description_html: Use the skills to attack (or being counter-attacked by) the enemies, and defeat the boss. Control Ely, Astra, and Jennifer to hunt down their long-term frienemy - Exo, uncover the traitor - Dreyar, and defeat the ultimate Exo - red. You are not going in grids, but moving freely. Walk, Run, or Sprint to any movable place and attack your enemies with Gun/Sword/Shield. Gun/Sword/Shield skills are long/mid/short ranged, while Gun skill can break Sword skill, Sword skill can break Shield skill, and Shield skill can counter-attack Gun skill. Choose your next move wisely!

rows.name: Triplets Trouble!!!
rows.short_description: Triplets Trouble!!! is a visual novel slice of life about a father and his triplets in a period shortly after the pandemic. Each game played by the children became a mini-game, in a short narrative over seven days in the life of this family.
rows.description_html: Being a single parent is hard. Being a single parent of triplets is pretty hard. Being a single parent of triplets shortly after a global pandemic is very pretty hardy. But do you know what is much, much, much harder? Enduring boredom! It is almost impossible to survive! All the games have been played! All the cool books have been read! All the cartoons have been watched! Everything has been done and undone, turned and turned over! What will Kazuki, Kazumi and Kazuko, the amazing and mischievous triplets, do to continue existing in such a boring world?!

rows.name: The Wild Outback
rows.short_description: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game in a Wild Western setting. It's a single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots!
rows.description_html: The Wild Outback is an arcade top-down shooter game set in the West. It's a goofy single player game where you join cowboys in the fight against an alien invasion of mutant animals and lazer-firing robots! The Wild Outback is a large, barren territory located in the middle of a country called Witherwest. It is a lawless, uncharted area where anything goes, and it just so happens to be the place where the aliens want to settle down. The main cast of characters who are trying to stop the invasion are volunteers, equipped with their own unique set of weapons to stop the invasion. In this war against the invaders, you may find cowboy allies, powerups, and a whole lot of money to increase your fire power, you're going to need all the help you can get! Picking up stars will summon Cowboy Allies, whom will follow you around and aim wherever your cursor is pointed. Collect as much money as you can, as this will level you up and increase your vitality and your weapon speed. Survive in a chaotic and wacky world where everything's out to get you!

rows.name: THEORY
rows.short_description: 'Theory' is an intense first-person shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. Players find themselves in a vast, desolate landscape. As a survivor, you'll navigate through various environments.
rows.description_html: 'Theory' is an intense first-person shooter (FPS) game set in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by hordes of ravenous zombies. Players find themselves in a vast, desolate landscape As a survivor, you'll navigate through mountains, decaying cities, and treacherous rural landscapes, all while facing constant threats from zombies. Your arsenal includes an array of a handgun, and rifle and shotgun weapons, all of which are essential for fending off the undead and ensuring your own survival. This game was developed as a final project by a team of three people. There are various mechanics such as: Shooter Car driving Books Hand Lamp (F key) Interact Storytelling with objects Elif and Ali escaped from city life and settled on a farm. After spending many years on the farm, Elif puts her thoughts on paper and publishes a book. In his teachings spread from hand to hand, he states that a civilized and prosperous life is possible, away from mechanized modernism. 'Every effort and breakthrough in human history is for happiness. A person who is not happy cannot contribute to life.' The theory spread among the people and people began to get used to the idea of leaving monotony and living a comfortable life. City administrators are against this situation and declare Elif persona non grata. Meanwhile, Elif gives birth to Vefa. After a while, Vefa gets sick and Ali takes Vefa and goes to the hospital. Even though a few days have passed, Ali and Vefa still haven't arrived. Thereupon, Elif decided to hit the road and jumped into her car with her hunting weapons. Various difficulties and adventures await Elif in this quest. Will these difficulties bring Elif back to her family?

rows.name: Feywing
rows.short_description: Feywing is a short game loosely inspired by classic internet ritual stories. You must memorize and navigate the strange environment of the Crossroads to collect materials for the ritual, and escape the Crossroads. During all of this, the whimsical Feywing will be there to guide you along.
rows.description_html: 'Ever wonder how some folks always know where to go, and how to find what they need? Ever wonder what it'd be like to have the intuition that leads you out of harm and into safety? Would you like the ability to choose not just the safest path to a destination, but also the ability to avoid dangerous paths? If you're daring enough, there is a way to gain a supernatural sense of direction and finding your way around. Be warned, it's not safe. Some people trigger the ritual without intent, becoming another number in missing persons cases. Perhaps it is not a bad idea to know how it works in order to avoid it.' Feywing is a short game loosely inspired by classic internet ritual stories. As a participant of the Feywing ritual, you must memorize and navigate the strange environment of the Crossroads to collect materials, make effigies for the ritual, and find a way out of the Crossroads. During all of this, the whimsical Feywing will be there to guide you along. Of course, the Crossroads is a strange, liminal world with dangers all around. In daylight, you may be safe. As night draws near, your worst enemy is the environment surrounding you... Multiple endings to discover. Randomly generated maps, relocating landmarks all around. No map, only your compass and landmarks to memorize the area. Survival hinges on attention to your surroundings. That tree behind you was further back a moment ago.

rows.name: Hidden Nightmares
rows.short_description: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. Experience the horrors generated by the human mind and wonder if you will ever wake up again.
rows.description_html: Hidden Nightmares is a horror experience set inside the endless nightmares of a psychiatric patient. How would you behave if your psychiatric disorder continues to keep you stuck inside endless nightmares and you begin to feel that someone demonic is slowly taking control of your mind? Have fun going back and forth from the dream world to the real world, but take a good look at the world around you-something may have changed and may no longer be as you left it the last time you fell asleep. Hidden Nightmares is just a horror experience built in an attempt to bring within a video game the feelings felt within the nightmares we experience on a daily basis. Waking up will not be so easy anymore, especially if someone has invaded your dreams by force.

rows.name: Project Rogue
rows.short_description: Explore the endlessly generated dungeon as you kill monsters, level up, and collect loot in this first-person dungeon crawler. Magic items improve your character's stats so that it's easier to use better equipment and learn better spells. You choose how your character progresses.
rows.description_html: Created by programming students at the Academy of Art University on our free time, Project Rogue is a roguelite, first-person dungeon crawler inspired by classic RPGs with a modern touch. Explore the endless dungeon as you kill monsters, level up, and collect loot. The dungeon is procedurally generated so it will always be a different experience. Find magic items to improve your character so that you can survive boss fights in deeper levels. The class you select determines your starting equipment, and then you choose how your character progresses. Will you play a hardened fighter wielding two-handed weapons? Or perhaps a spell caster that overwhelms enemies with magic? You are in control. Features Procedural content generation Old school RPG vibe Stat-based progression Character customization Endless replayability

rows.name: Resonite
rows.short_description: Enter a novel digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you resonate with people around the world in a casual conversation, playing games and socializing or you riff off each other when creating anything from art to programming complex games, you'll find your place here.
rows.description_html: Dive into a brand new digital universe with infinite possibilities. Whether you come here to socialize and hang out with people around the world or to build, create and develop anything from beautiful art, interactive avatars and gadgets, to complex interactive worlds and games, Resonite is an endlessly customizable place where you'll be welcome and where you'll find a group to resonate with. Thanks to our advanced engine, we ensure that multiplayer experiences stay perfectly synchronized between players with zero effort for our community content creators. Whether you're just hanging out with people or building complex worlds and contraptions with other creators, Resonite will make sure every details stays in perfect sync and keeps you in control of your experience. Socialize with anyone Online socialization and real-time communication whether you're in desktop or VR is the foundational layer of everything in Resonite. Being able to communicate and be yourself is an important part of the platform. To make this possible, we offer a number of key features: Low latency voice - communicate in real time with other users in session with latency rivaling that of other messaging applications Fully custom avatars - import, build and customize any avatars in-game and in real-time to look like the best version of you Full body tracking, eye & face tracking - to maximize your avatar's expressivity we support 8 trackers (feet, knees, hips, chest and elbows) as well as eye and face tracking Haptics support - with support for haptic vests such as bHaptics, you can increase your immersion and become part of the virtual world Instant messaging - chat over text, send invites, voice messages or even arbitrary items to your contacts Flexible session visibility & security - you are in control of the visibility and accessibility of your sessions, anywhere from public to fully private, with an access list you control. All validation and verification of joining users is done on your client - if you set your session to Private, you can be sure that it is private Customizable UI - the user interface is your gateway to using the platform and just like everything else in Resonite, it can be customized and extended to better suit your needs and make your daily experience more comfortable Self-moderation tools - we understand that not every interaction on the platform will be good and that's why we want to empower you with a number of self-moderation tools - moderate your own worlds with silence, kick and ban functions or easily mute and block individual users avatars or their entire presence. Our goal is to give you as much control over your virtual experience as we can. Multi-world presence - just like tabs in a web browser, you can be present in multiple worlds and switch between them in a fraction of second Play, explore and share Socializing does not have to end at chatting with your fellow users. Resonite is a universe full of fun gadgets, avatars and games to explore, with features to make any session fun and exciting. Easy media sharing - drag & drop pictures, audio/music or videos into any world to share with other users with synchronized playback - it's that easy! Inventory system - did you find or made something cool? Save it to your inventory! You can spawn any items, gadgets and tools in any world (as long as you have permissions to do so) - everything is fully synchronized too! Dynamic avatar scaling - exploring the world or interacting with users at different scales can give you quite a different experience - you can change your avatar's scale anywhere, at any time (unless it's limited by the host of the session)! High quality audio streaming - want to host a party and be the DJ? Streaming your system audio in full stereo in high quality is a few clicks away World search & session discovery system - looking for a cool world to visit or what your friends are up to? Searching worlds by their names and tags as well as seeing which worlds your contacts are in will help you there Stream to your audience - our in-game recording and streaming tools make it easy to produce captivating and dynamic camera shots, whether you're streaming or filming videos for social media Custom locomotion - we don't limit you to just walking around - you can fly, noclip switch to zero-g or build your own customized locomotion system - ever tried to walk on a surface of a Möbius strip? Build and create If you have a creative itch, you may enjoy the powerful toolset that Resonite offers to you. Not only you can build and edit absolutely anything - from your avatar, items, to the entire worlds or even making your own tools, you can collaborate with others in real time and achieve true creative resonance! Realtime collaboration - the collaboration on our platform is so seamless, that you will often forget it's there - our powerful engine ensures that the world and everything in it starts in perfect sync, no matter what you do - you'd be hard pressed to find any feature or functionality that'd be visible only to you (unless it's your private UI of course!) Edit anything - everything you see in the world can be edited and customized with the game tools - in fact, we built a lot of the official functionality in-game with the same tools that are accessible to you - from the home world, default avatars, to video players, color picker UI or progress bar - you can take them apart or build your own from scratch and favorite them Save anything - you can save literally anything on the platform! Whether you built a new item, an avatar or a world, or made modifications to an existing one, everything can be persisted with a single click of a button. You can efficiently store multiple copies as well - our deduplication system will ensure that any shared assets only get counted once Development tools - our development tools range from simple brushes and procedural meshes to more advanced and powerful ones, similar to ones you find in classical game development tools - except that you can use them in VR with real time collaboration! Cross-world synchronization and persistence - with our integrated cloud tools, you can easily preserve user data between sessions or synchronize state across multiple different worlds Import 3D models - thanks to open source libraries, it's extremely easy to bring in large variety of 3D model formats - simply drag and drop your FBX, OBJ, GLB or other files and bring them in Texture/Audio/Model processing - need to make a quick edit to a texture, audio file or 3D mesh? Basic editing functions are fully accessible in-game - from hue-shifting textures, normalizing and clipping audio to recalculating normals and tangents on meshes or baking them Export content for external tools - as easy as it is to bring content in, it's just as easy to take it out! With this, you can make edits using external tools or make Resonite part of your workflow Code and develop ProtoFlux - ProtoFlux is the crown jewel of our creative tools - the most powerful visual programming language that our experienced team has designed to date, which lets you quickly prototype and build anything from simple interactions to complex games and systems - with full real-time collaboration support and immediate feedback Script anything - ProtoFlux can interact with anything - the world, the items, your avatar and any combinations of these! Websockets - thanks to built-in websocket support, you can easily communicate with external applications and scripts and build extensive functionality, such as your own game servers, fetching external data to integrating new and custom hardware, without having to depend on official integration Async Flows - creating code that needs to yield or wait across different frames is a native feature of ProtoFlux, with full execution scope preservation - you can even have multiple async flows running off the same code, each with their own unique context, which is a highly powerful and flexible tool for simplifying your logic Flexible storage system - locals, stores and data model - pick where you store your computational data depending on the desired scope and context, to build highly efficient systems Resonate with anything, anyone, anywhere... We are a team of passionate developers, who are developing more than just a piece of software, but something that we call a second home. We are committed continuous development, with frequent updates and community driven focus. This project is a combination of our dreams and visions of what digital spaces like this should offer and the collective needs, desires and aspirations of our community. Much of our focus and vision is on giving you, the users and inhabitants of this virtual universe, as much power and agency as we can, whether it's over controlling your experience on the platform or being able to (re)build anything we do. It would be our honor if you decide to join our universe and help us build it together. Whatever your background or interests are, we want to build a place where everyone can resonate together.

rows.name: Entropic Decay: Prologue
rows.short_description: This is the free prologue version of Entropic Decay, a fast paced, but slow burn horror/action FPS inspired by games from the late 90's through early 2000's. Enter volatile scenarios filled with danger, from both the living and the dead, where wits are as crucial as brawn...
rows.description_html: “The definition of entropic is having a tendency to change from a state of order..to a state of disorder...' Entropic Decay is a lovingly crafted linear first person shooter driven by narrative, puzzles, combat arenas, and horror sequences. It takes inspiration from Valve's games, with its use of environmental story telling and pacing between enemy encounters, striking a balance between combat and atmosphere. Think the atmosphere of a slow-burn horror inspired walking simulator fused with movement and combat options of a shooter... One level featuring combat between the military and mutants in the world of Entropic Decay. A preview of the horde mode, featuring waves of enemies (including soldiers) that gradually get more difficult as waves progress. Includes a custom soundtrack. Use time dilation to outmanoeuvre enemies and dodge projectiles- including bullets! Time dilation also allows for altered movement, dashing multi-directionally to evade enemies and dodge projectiles, and a double jump to reach places not achievable otherwise. Projectile based ballistics system. NO hit scanners here! Every ranged enemy/player firearm are ALL projectile based. Dynamic dismemberment. Blow your enemies apart with a robust blood and gore system. Feel the impact of each distinct weapon, or just shoot an explosive barrel and watch the bloody show! Cunning, reactive A.I - The soldiers in Entropic Decay don't mess around. They react to grenades, can hear you, take cover, flee, and throw their own grenades. The mutated work in packs, can hear you running and will roam the area you were last seen. The military will shoot the mutated on sight, but taking them down is no easy task, even for the well trained. A variety of mutated to fight against - Currently there are over ten different mutated to contend with. Ranging from agile spider mutants and dogs, to hulking tanks weilding lead pipes. Puzzles to break up combat sequences - Puzzles and narrative pieces are used to keep the player engaged to avoid simply being one type of genre and keep things fresh and dynamic. Physics interaction - Interact with the world with physics puzzles, and deceive enemies by throwing objects or craft a devious trap by arranging explosives in your environment to detonate on an unsuspecting foe. Stealth, A.I and how they interact - Distract your foes by throwing an object or bring them closer to setup an ambush with a whistle, or simply sneak by and avoid combat all together. Use your wits and the environment and the A.I will respond allowing emergent gameplay and tactical options. Narrative driven gameplay - The story will be told through the environment with the player merely an observer of things outside it's control. Find notes, audio logs, and data entries to piece together the collapse of society and the scientific ambition that caused it. Some time in the future, a signal is detected carrying a small meteor. The signal is tracked, and the crash site investigated on impact. A mineral is found. Astrobioligist's are amazed to find a living pathogen inside the mineral. The pathogen is extracted and experimented on, and the findings indicate aggressive cell growth when in contact with other organisms....dead or alive. Rapid cell mutation causes a rabies like disease. Anything infected with the pathogen becomes a hive-minded aggressor to everything not infected. The pathogen spreads and envelopes the world. Civilisation becomes an overgrown, decaying husk of the nature we once knew. The decay and despair is juxtaposed with beauty, as plant life flourishes due to the pathogens effect on cell growth, and everything man-made returns to nature, but rises again with a twisted skew. The last bastion of humanity are elitist's, deploying the military to kill anyone on sight who aren't in uniform. Military death squads roam in packs, taking orders for food and protection from the pathogen, while trading their humanity. You awaken in a facility, fumbling for hazy memories of before the place you find yourself in.... Journey through a world foreign to all but the mutated, and find a place free from decay and entropy at any cost...

rows.name: Powers in the Basement
rows.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure game set in a comedic medieval fantasy world, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production.
rows.description_html: Will Phail is a fifteen-year-old like many others: lazy, spoiled, and phlegmatic. But he has one thing that others lack: he's useless! Experience Will's drama in this short adventure as he searches for his favorite T-shirt so he can hang out with his friends trying to defend his already compromised reputation. Dodge lazy grandparents, mischievous rats, and carnivorous plants, and find the courage to descend into the frightening basement, where powers beyond understanding lurk, waiting to be awakened! A dive into the golden age of point-and-click adventures A state-of-the-art, ultramodern 9-verbs interface, to put you in total control The humor of the great classics, with jokes conceived for smart people, like YOU who have decided to play this game! Amazing 3D graphics: Dimple, Dlat, and Dapproximate Awesome MT-32 music and 22KHz sound effects that will blow your mind Challenging and merciless puzzles that will force you to rack your brains! The Game Powers in the Basement is a 5/6 hours long point-and-click adventure game, deliberately reminiscent of the great classics from the 80s / 90s, with a specific sweet spot for LucasArts production. It's a witty and sometimes surreal game, with clean humor, also suitable for children, set in a pseudo-fantasy world in which the medieval fairytale is punctuated by anachronisms, elements of modernity, and absurd references to nerd pop culture. It's a challenging game made for puzzle lovers, those who like to have a-ha moments in the shower or while cooking, but we did our best to make it a fair and enjoyable experience for casual gamers as well If you are a longtime fan of this genre, well... we hope we can bring you back to your childhood for a while.

rows.name: Gumbowl's Adventure
rows.short_description: You play as the main character Gumbowl and have to get your missing gumballs.
rows.description_html: description Gumbowl’s Adventure is a 2D Platformer with loads of stuff to explore . You play as the main character “Gumbowl” and your goal is to find him some more gumballs. You will meet all of Gumbowl’s friends who are eager to help you through… whatever necessary to get you those gumballs. I wish you luck on your journey! features Rhythm Games Parkour Exploration story Boss Battles A Whole Lot Of Caves

rows.name: Love In The Dark
rows.short_description: In this multiplayer horror game, a loving couple receives an invitation from a wealthy man for an event. Despite my concerns, she insists on going. To protect her, I decide to secretly join and keep her safe.
rows.description_html: Dark Love is a multiplayer cooperative horror game where players need to form a team and work together to save the protagonist's girlfriend, who has been possessed by an evil spirit. [Game Plot] The girlfriend is a recent graduate in civil engineering, full of hope for the future, but she gets assigned to work in a remote mountain area. Despite being separated due to work reasons, the couple maintains a sweet romantic relationship. Tonight, while talking with the girlfriend on the phone, she suddenly receives a call from a local wealthy businessman inviting her to his house. The businessman claims to have an important project that he wants the girlfriend to handle, hoping to exchange engineering experiences with her. Although the girlfriend is very reluctant, she reluctantly agrees to the businessman's invitation for the sake of their future. For the next few hours, you anxiously wait for the girlfriend's message, but there is no response. You become extremely worried as her phone is also unreachable. Feeling panicked, you immediately rush to the businessman's house with your friends. When you open the door to the businessman's house, a strong smell of blood hits your nose. You cautiously peek inside and find the floor covered in bloodstains, while the businessman sits in a chair, pale and staring at you. Your heart races with fear and disbelief. You feel a sense of despair, suspecting that the girlfriend's situation might not be optimistic. Suddenly, a foreboding feeling arises in your heart, and you quickly turn around, only to see the girlfriend's figure appearing at the door. She looks terrified, with tattered clothes and wounds all over her body, rushing towards you... [Gameplay] Teamwork: Players need to form a team of up to 4 members. Each player has different skills and abilities, requiring proper task allocation and mutual cooperation. Mysterious Rituals: The game's objective is to save the girlfriend possessed by an evil spirit. To achieve this, players must find and destroy ritual items hidden throughout various locations. Exploration and Puzzle-Solving: Players need to explore the game map and solve various puzzles and challenges to find clues and items to help the team complete the mission. Confronting the Demon: During the game, players must face the attacks of the evil demon. She will chase players and attempt to capture them, requiring the team to avoid her and find defensive methods. Agility and Strategy: Players need to demonstrate agility and strategic thinking. They must react quickly, allocate tasks properly, and use various items and skills to survive and accomplish the game's objectives. Visuals and Sound Effects: The game's design and sound effects create a horrifying atmosphere, immersing players in a tense and terrifying gaming experience. Overall, Dark Love is a horror survival game that tests teamwork and strategic abilities. Players must work together to find clues, solve puzzles, and be cautious in facing the demon to successfully save the protagonist's girlfriend.

Exploration and Puzzle-Solving: Players need to explore the game map and solve various puzzles and challenges to find clues and items to help the team complete the mission. Confronting the Demon: During the game, players must face the attacks of the evil demon. She will chase players and attempt to capture them, requiring the team to avoid her and find defensive methods. Agility and Strategy: Players need to demonstrate agility and strategic thinking. They must react quickly, allocate tasks properly, and use various items and skills to survive and accomplish the game's objectives. Visuals and Sound Effects: The game's design and sound effects create a horrifying atmosphere, immersing players in a tense and terrifying gaming experience. Overall, Dark Love is a horror survival game that tests teamwork and strategic abilities. Players must work together to find clues, solve puzzles, and be cautious in facing the demon to successfully save the protagonist's girlfriend.

rows.name: The Light in the Darkness
rows.short_description: The Light in the Darkness tells the story of a working-class family of Polish Jews in France during the Holocaust. It is the first videogame to portray the Holocaust, releasing free for educational purposes.
rows.description_html: The Light in the Darkness is a captivating role-playing game that takes players on an emotional journey through the dark times of the Nazi occupation of France during World War II. In this game, players take on the role of a Polish Jewish family living in Paris, experiencing the hardships and challenges they face as they try to survive in a world that is becoming increasingly hostile towards them. Gameplay in The Light in the Darkness revolves around making choices and exploring the environment. Players will interact with various characters, engage in dialogue, and make decisions. The game's story is told through a mix of in-game events and documentary evidence, which adds a layer of authenticity to the experience. The game also features a variety of simple mini-games, which help to break up the narrative and add variety to the gameplay. One of the key features of The Light in the Darkness is its educational platform. Players will be able to access archives and photos, as well as explore history in a way that is designed to make Holocaust education accessible for all, including those who don't have the ability to visit museums.

rows.reviews_html: “Opening with the Évian Conference of 1938, which doomed Jewish refugees by refusing them entry to safe countries, the game follows a family of Polish Jews in Paris as they experience the Nazi occupation, leading, ultimately, to the Vel d’Hiv roundup in 1942. In the space of a moving hour, Bernard touches on the Nuremberg Laws, antisemitism in fairy tales and anti-Jewish propaganda. He shows how the Holocaust was, pace Whoopi Goldberg, a “race-based” genocide and how quickly France went from embracing Jews to sending them to their deaths.” The Times “Mr. Bernard’s approach could even be used to deepen people’s understanding of other genocides. The game arrives at an urgent moment. The Anti-Defamation League, an advocacy group, reports that anti-Semitism has reached a record-high in America. Elsewhere, memories of Nazi horrors are waning as elderly survivors die. By keeping their stories alive, the game helps to inform new generations about the atrocities that Jews were made to endure.” The Economist “The Light in the Darkness forces you to consider the terrifying emotional truth of this dark chapter in history... it’s hard to think of another game that has really dug into the horrors and the trauma of the war like this.” Radio Times

rows.name: DawnOfCombat
rows.short_description: I'm elated to unveil 'Battle at Dawn,' a game born of my passion, now in development. Immerse in core combat, navigate a universe teeming with challenges, and join me in refining this free experience. Your insights are golden! Explore more on BiliBili:
rows.description_html: Battle at Dawn' is a game I developed independently in my spare time, created out of a passion for the hobby. The game is distributed for free, and I welcome interested peers to join in the exchange and learning. My BiliBili homepage is: The game is still in the development stage, and the launched version only contains the core combat slice. I hope to gather everyone’s ideas and opinions during the early experience stage to continuously refine and optimize this product. In this game, players will find themselves in a vast universe full of unknowns and challenges. They will pilot a spaceship in this endless sea of stars, battling hordes of enemies in an intense competition for survival. Before each round of the game starts, players need to remodel their spaceship and choose weapons to prepare for the upcoming battles. They may have to remove some armor and shields to install more weapons, meaning they must take on greater risks but at the same time, the potential rewards could also be higher. Throughout the game, players need to collect coins dropped by enemies upon their death. These coins can be used to purchase various upgrades in the store. These stores randomly appear during the player's game progress, and players need to fly their spaceship over the store to buy upgrades. Choosing and allocating these upgrades wisely is key to victory. Each new game represents a whole new set of challenges and possibilities. Players need to constantly adapt and evolve in the ever-changing battlefield in order to survive and win. Whether to risk choosing more powerful weapons, or finding the store at the right moment for upgrades, each decision could impact the final outcome of the game. 'DawnOfCombat' is waiting for every player seeking excitement and challenge, as they navigate their way to glory and victory in this infinite cosmic adventure.

rows.name: Stacks:Jungle!
rows.short_description: Stacks:Jungle is an engaging adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more!
rows.description_html: Stacks:Jungle is an adventure card game set in the lush heart of the jungle. Get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey filled with crafting, quests, and exploration! Unlock new cards with booster packs, combine them to uncover craft recipes, build amazing structures, gather loyal companions, try delicious exotic food, venture into uncharted territories, make new friends, discover hidden treasures, and so much more. DISCLAIMER: This game is inspired by Stacklands, but it is not Stacklands, and it is not a sequel to Stacklands. It is a completely independent project that feels and plays differently in many ways. Please use the Steam discussion forums if you notice any issues with the game or the included localizations. Key Features: Immerse yourself in a beautiful and magical jungle environment, where adventure and exciting quests await, all through the power of cards! Powered by the Stacks: Engine, a card game framework heavily inspired by the renowned Stacklands game. Collect, create, and use over 150 unique cards. Learn and master 70+ craft recipes creating game-changing strategies. Explore 22 breathtaking locations filled with mysteries and secrets waiting to be uncovered. Take on over 200 tasks and quests, testing your skills and unraveling the jungle's mysterious lore. Experience a lightweight survival aspect with the hunger mechanic, adding an extra layer of challenge to your adventure. Choose from three captivating scenarios: go on a treasure hunt, master the art of fishing, or indulge in the beauty of butterfly collecting.

rows.name: FatalZone: Outbreak
rows.short_description: Outbreak is the demo version of FatalZone, a bullet heaven zombie apocalypse shooter where you'll have to upgrade your base, hone your mercs' skills, and put them to the test to survive.
rows.description_html: Survival takes a deadly toll… The world has been ravaged by a zombie virus, but humanity doesn’t give up that easily! Outbreak is the demo version of FatalZone, a bullet heaven zombie apocalypse shooter where you have to clear a path to safety through hordes of the living dead. The demo version includes: 1 location 4 character classes 30 unique perks to upgrade your characters with 6 types of weapons 6 types of armor 28 attack and defense skills 10 evolution paths for weapons and attack skills 31 enemy types (12 of them have unique art) 6 different difficulty levels for the location 6 base camp buildings, each with its own features and 3 upgrade levels 51 character stats Lots of mutations that change character stats randomly 5 powerups (on top of all the resources and XP) 34 achievements Take on the zombie epidemic and add the full game to your Wishlist to get notified when it launches! Your mission is complete if you hold out for 30 minutes during a raid. Can you last that long? If you're about to be overwhelmed by the zombie onslaught, just get to the chopper! Evac is always an option—wrap your mission up early and live to fight another day. Risk your merc to get resources and upgrade your base, level up your skills, and develop a deadly build to fight the undead. In this world, whatever doesn’t kill you makes you stronger! But remember, no one is immortal... Develop your survivor camp to unlock buffs. Upgrade merc skills in the Training Hall, recruit new mercs at the Mercenary Base, and upgrade your weapons and armor in the workshop. Upgraded buildings increase your chances of survival. During a run, your mercs are exposed to the virus that takes its toll on the body. A bigger viral load undermines a merc's physical state and increases their chances of developing a mutation that could be beneficial or detrimental. Experiment to create the most viable fighter! Features: Upgrade your camp to unlock buffs, equipment, and mercs Your mission is complete if you hold out for 30 minutes during a raid, but you can always cut your game session short by evacuating the contaminated area. Hire and train new mercs to replace KIAs Use the evac copter to wrap up missions early Create the most effective merc build Gain mutations that give unique skills or debuffs Use the inventory to place weapons and armor. Weapons grant starting fighting skills, while armor provides stats Choose from 5 levels of difficulty Fight on procedurally generated maps. Every run is a new challenge! Unlock numerous achievements to prove your mettle

Enjoy observing the growth of chickens through four seasons, dancing chickens, and others in the coop. What does the protagonist look like in this dream? Although the game is short, it is filled with lots of hidden elements , so we highly recommend exploring every corner of the island right away! If you ever feel like ending the exploration, look for 'Hun'! If you had a great time with this game, please take a look at our other games at LIONST! We promise to continue delivering various experiences to you through the medium of games!

rows.name: Merchant Master
rows.short_description: A simulation game. Start from scratch to build a merchant empire.
rows.description_html: There was a young man who dreamed of becoming a wealthy and powerful merchant, with the hope of becoming the richest man in the world. Recruit talents, obtain pets, and meet your beloved beauties. From a humble merchant to the master of merchant empire, this is the way of merchant! - Game Features - 1. Nostalgic scenery and beautiful view: With full ink wash painting graphics, this game presents you a fully recreated ancient prosperous town. 2. Manage the best business in town: In this thriving town, there are various business to run: bank, grocery store, tavern. Start from scratch, work your way up to the master! 3. Recruit all the talents: Magician, taylor, jester, poet, all the talents from each profession are here to aid you. They are the best at their time, now it's time for you to shine in this ancient era. 4. Meet the beloved: Travel through the world and meet all the charming gorgeous ladies. The lovely maid, exotic princess, female general, who will accompany with you along the way to the very top? 5. Raise offsprings: Raise children with your beloved. Then look for a matching partner within the fellow merchants, to bond together with marriage; thus creating a strong merchant empire. 6. Mythical beast, spiritual pet: Collecting mythical beasts, pets will grant you a great boost in the business war.

rows.name: Fun with the Fitzgeralds
rows.short_description: Welcome to the Battle of the Fitzgerald's there can be only one King or Queen of the land, so join in on the funniest battle you will ever play. It's all just about the FUN.
rows.description_html: Before you say 'Oh here's another Battle Royal game' Let me tell you FWTF aka Fun with the Fitzgerald's it's what it says in the title it's all just about the fun. My six-year-old Daughter is a massive gamer just like I was at her age but most of the more suitable popular titles were just too difficult for her. So we teamed up to create a simple yet fun Battle royal game that can be enjoyed by all ages. The Fitzgerald's family is a fun loving bunch. Drop into the land where you will find a cool array of weapons to knock out your opponents with. From small snowball guns to epic ice blasters or electric zappers, rocket launchers, slime bomb guns, and paintball guns there are so many fun ways to play be sure to grab a cake or two and splatter your opponents right in the face. Pick up and eat beans to land smelly pumps. For quick getaways get your hands on a jetpack to fly away if you're finding yourself in trouble. The battle is played out on the Fitzgerald land and there can be only one king or queen of the land. There are handy level shops around the land to buy your favourite weapons by simply collecting as many coins and diamonds from the wide range of chests scattered around the land and if you are lucky enough to pick up some x-ray glasses you can seek out your opponents much easier. The safe zone will shrink in fast making matches quick and fun. Oh by the way watch out for Bruce the zombie and the ghost of posh aunt's mansion they think they own the Fitzgerald's land too. So come on and join in on the fun.

rows.name: Embers: Return to Dragonland
rows.short_description: Save your legacy from the goblins by embodying legendary dragons in this cooperative twin-stick shooter action.
rows.description_html: PLAY WITH A CONTROLLER (Keyboard and mouse are not working properly) Dive into the heart of an epic adventure in our Twin Stick Shooter-style action game. Take on the role of one of two iconic dragons: Shango or Pogo. Join forces in cooperative mode to confront hordes of goblins and bats. Choose your legendary dragon to make the best use of its unique abilities. Play as Shango, the master of fire, capable of spitting fireballs at goblins and instantly eradicating bats. Or opt for Pogo, the lightning manipulator, who can shoot a laser that bounces between enemies to electrocute the goblins. Your talents and coordination will be put to the test as you work together to fulfill objectives and bring the eggs back to the nest. Be cautious, though—do not underestimate the resilience of the goblins, as they have trained new allies to thwart your plans. So be ready to defend your wings and face unexpected challenges at every moment. Explore vibrant and fantastical environments, each with its own set of enemies and dangers. Whether it's the forest, the goblin village, or the ruins of Embers, each area offers unique challenges and different combat opportunities. During this journey, cooperation is crucial. Life and rewards are shared, adding a new dimension to every decision you make. Your success will depend on your communication, use of skills, and ability to react quickly to each situation. Get ready for an exciting and memorable gaming experience. Immerse yourself in the fiery world of Shango and the electrifying realm of Pogo, and reclaim what's rightfully yours from the clutches of greedy goblins. Are you prepared to tame the flames and embrace the lightning? Your destiny as a legendary dragon awaits.

rows.name: Pixel Gun 3D: PC Edition
rows.short_description: The legendary mobile multiplayer FPS Pixel Gun 3D comes to PC! Experience an enhanced world of colorful, blocky action. Featuring dozens of game modes and maps, 1500+ guns plus cross-platform multiplayer and progression.
rows.description_html: Join millions of veteran Pixel Gun 3D players and experience ten years of updates, maps, modes and features in this iconic, expansive pixel multiplayer shooter. Battle in arenas across multiple competitive modes, cooperate against monster hordes or become the hero of the multiverse in an expansive solo story mode. Unlock, collect and upgrade over 1500 unique weapons across six varied categories, from the humblest of pistols to the most spectacular artillery to blast your way across this blocky world. Customize them with modules, suit up in powerful armor and personalize your loadout Embrace the block madness and rise to the top! Participate in monthly tourneys and events, improve your aim and dish out some block-rocking beatdowns. Climb the leaderboards and become a living legend among Pixel Gunners and master this shooter game! Team up with your pals or frag them across a vast number of game modes and maps. Co-op games, massive Battle Royales, a universe-hopping campaign and mini-games of all sorts, including parkour and racing. Whatever your flavor of action, we’ve got it all on tap, plus epic clan wars for the most dedicated and competitive Pixel Gunners. Express yourself and join the friendly Pixel Gun 3D community, picking from hundreds of distinct avatars, capes, pets, cosmetic items and more. The most creative among you can even create your own character skin from scratch, pixel by pixel! Veteran Pixel Gunners will feel right at home here. Those of you who started playing as a kid and have been on this decade-long journey with us will find your account ready to link to Steam. Relive days gone by and gear up for a universe of new experiences, as Pixel Gun 3D expands into this new era on PCs of all shapes and sizes!

rows.name: Under Pressure
rows.short_description: What happens when you make a VR game only about Pressure Washers? From cleaning any object imaginable, playing soccer or volleyball up to flying - Under Pressure is a multiplayer playground that’s all around what you can do with a power washer in your hands.
rows.description_html: What happens when you make a VR game only about Pressure Washers? From cleaning any object imaginable, playing soccer or volleyball up to flying - Under Pressure is a multiplayer playground that’s all about what you can do with a power washer in your hands. Bring your friends to clean objects together or soar through the skies using a variety of water guns with various power levels. Throw cleaning bombs to quickly clean huge items, give bulldogs a refreshing scrub and earn coins to unlock new areas, new power washers or fancy hats. Features Multiplayer-First Pressure Washing in all it’s glory Import and clean an unlimited variety of items with the Sketchfab Implementation (Ab)use your power washers to play volleyball, soccer or clean the dog Use the OP power washer to fly and explore a whole pressure washer playground Unlockable hats and power washer upgrades

rows.name: 鈴集無名の丘 ～ Little Doll Queen
rows.short_description: Gensokyo suddenly plunged into a huge miasma of toxic fog, and the lands are now gloomy and lifeless. The source of these strange phenomena is the Nameless Hill, a forgotten land of sin. It's a danmaku experience full of poisons and suffocation. That means, this is a shooting game.
rows.description_html: [1.About the game] Little Doll Queen is a derivative work (fangame) of the Touhou Project series under Team Shanghai Alice. In this game, you play as living dolls, following the instructions of your master. (well, except Medicine) It's a danmaku experience full of poisons and suffocation. That means, this is a shooting game (bullet hell), where the screen is full of enemy bullets which you have to avoid, and enemies which you have to shoot. Your goal is to defeat the enemies and clear the levels one at a time, in sequence, to solve the incident affecting Gensokyo. [2.Story] Gensokyo suddenly plunged into a huge miasma of toxic fog, and the lands are now gloomy and lifeless. But that is not the only problem: Children’s spirits have flooded out en masse to possess nearby phantoms and fairies. The source of these strange phenomena is the Nameless Hill, a forgotten land of sin. These spirits have overwhelmed the lands, from the Sai no Kawara to Gensokyo, and the miasma’s spread has taken the usual human incident resolvers out of commission. In response, the sage Okina Matara held a discussion with the other sages of Gensokyo, and sent out her two dancers to solve the incident. Meanwhile, in the Primate Spirit Garden, Keiki Haniyasushin sent out her pride and joy –- Mayumi Joutouguu –- to investigate, in the hopes of expanding her territory into Gensokyo. As for Medicine Melancholy, someone who dwells in the Nameless Hill itself, she appearsto have set off on her own. In particular, she is conducting her affairs, in her own time, separately compared to the others, as if with her own agenda in mind. Thus, the four of them headed towards the Nameless Hill. Coincidentally, all four of them are doll-like beings. [3.Controls] Up, down, left, right : Control your character Shot key (Z) : Shoot Bomb key (X) : Spell card (bomb) (limited use) Slow key (Shift) : Slow down your movement. This puts your character in a focused state (focusing), so your character’s hitbox and grazebox will also be visible. Pause key (Esc) : Pause the game User 1 key (C) : Perform a Spirit Release (explained later) User 2 key (V) : Press and hold this key after the first text box of any dialogue scene, to skip subsequent text boxes. In-game, only Satono and Mai can use this key, to swap between each other. Please see the “config.exe” file next to the game executable, for reference and reassigning of the controls above. Alt+Enter : Toggles between window mode and fullscreen mode. Left Ctrl: Speeds up replays and the Staff Roll. [4.System and items] Spellcard item : Gives you an extra spell card (bomb). Point item : These give you score, and also raise your M-Point Item Value. The height at which you collect them is irrelevant. Infant spirit item : Collecting this charges up your Spirit Release for use. See the relevant section for further details. Infant Spirit Meter : When spirit items are collected, the Infant Spirit Meter on the right of the screen fills up. See Spirit Release for further details. Heart’s Poison Meter : This is a meter of lily of the valley flowers (a.k.a. suzuran, or convallaria majalis) on the far right. As you graze bullets, the meter fills from right to left. Once full, it turns white, and you unlock a Last Word, an optional end-of-level extra attack. Last Words do not take away lives or bombs even if you fail, so they are always beneficial to you. [5.Spirit Release] Defeated spirits and fairies drop a fixed amount of infant spirit items. Infant spirit items fill the Infant Spirit Meter on the right of the screen. When it is full, you can use a Spirit Release with the User 1 key (C), and release the infants’ spirits around you. This creates a shockwave attack that keeps you invincible, and clears away enemies and their bullets, like taking candy from a baby. Except you’re taking the babies... and you’re throwing the babies at enemies... and the babies have long since passed away. (there’s no candy either lol) There’s no candy, but each Spirit Release produces a free spellcard item (bomb) for you, so use the Spirit Release proactively! [6.Miasma Promptuary] A list of the poison clouds you will see in this game is provided below. Pink : Has a diamond texture. Collect it for an extra life! Oh, how refreshing! Red : Staying inside for too long is dangerous; you will lose a life after 2 second. Orange: These clouds fire out bullets, so stay far away. Yellow : You’ll be immobilised as long as you’re inside it. Green : You’ll move faster as long as you’re inside it, for better or worse. Light blue : Totally safe; guides your way through poison. Can still visually distract you. Indigo : A puff of pacifism. You won’t be able to shoot when inside. Purple : Perhaps you’re already familiar with purple miasma; it slows you down. It’s an old friend! But you have no camera to help you this time. Use the Poison Lab found in the main menu to practice working with the poisons' appearances and effects for yourself. [7.Advice for Novices] Pink poison clouds with diamond textures are Extends (extra lives). Get extra bombs from Spirit Releases. Please look for the pink clouds and frequently use Spirit Releases! Pink clouds have diamond textures, but there are also dangerous red poisons -- you must tell them apart. If you see suspicious objects approaching, a basic strategy is Streaming and Restreaming. Focus (press Shift), then slowly move sideways, thus gathering aimed bullets together behind you, giving you space. When running out of space, do a quick dash in the same direction, wait, and let the aimed attacks target your new location. Then you can stream back in reverse. Remember to use spell cards (bombs) anytime you feel threatened; it’s wiser than wasting all the bombs you currently have after accidentally getting hit. (The excess WILL be lost.) [8.Scoring] For advanced players looking to reach a high score, it is essential to avoid getting hit needlessly, capture spell cards successfully, and collect point items, which do not change their value depending on your height. Having lots of lives, spell cards, and point items ensures the end-of-stage score bonus is higher. Grazing helps, but is not single-handedly enough to greatly influence score. Of course, you should ensure you graze enough to unlock the Last Word, in order to get its spell card bonus and point items as well. [9.Flower Wreath of Death] If you are hit by a bullet, a flower wreath effect appears on you and shrinks away in half a second. Using a spell card (bomb) during this time produces a deathbomb. Deathbombs are almost identical to normal spell cards (bombs), but there will be an additional flower wreath that expands outwards from you. Continuous damage is dealt to enemies enclosed within. Do note that deathbombs will always consume TWO spell cards. Only one spell card will be consumed if you have exactly one left.

rows.name: The Rush
rows.short_description: The Rush is a horizontally scrolling shoot 'em up with graphics inspired by classic space shooters of the MSX. Buckle up and see if you have what it takes to master the highly adaptive Chameleon Quartz space fighter and single-handedly obliterate the alien invaders!
rows.description_html: The Rush is a horizontal shoot 'em up with an MSX inspired art style and plenty of that arcade excitement (without a hunger for quarters)! Features: 8+ Unique stages Many enemies and boss fights that (I severely hope) are fun and challenging 13 different weapons that can be mixed and matched with one another 2 Playable ships with unique weapon variations Some surprising exploits I decided not to fix because they can help you out An easter egg or two... An OST that was a collaborative effort between yours truly and my good friend BuckChickens Controller Support from start to finish! Controls: Default keyboard controls are WSAD for movement, L to shoot, K to bomb Alternate keyboard controls (which can be enabled in the options menu) use Arrow Keys for movement, Z to shoot, X to bomb For either keyboard control method, enter is start/pause/confirm On controller 'A' is shoot and 'B' is bomb, with 'Start' acting as start/pause/confirm Holding alt and pressing enter will enable/disable true fullscreen mode Thank you for checking out The Rush! Do not hesitate to voice your opinions regarding anything in game.

rows.name: The House [zebaxx]
rows.short_description: You are an 18-year-old Spanish boy called Antonio who one day went shopping, and when he returned home he noticed things that were somewhat strange...
rows.description_html: ' The House ' is a short psychological horror Indie game based on a fictional story. This is the first game of this video game saga. In ' The House ' you play an 18-year-old Spanish boy named Antonio who is home alone and one day he decided to leave home and when he returned he noticed things that were somewhat strange... Game features: VHS movie aesthetic. Character texts and other NPCs.

rows.name: Harvest Havoc
rows.short_description: Grow, harvest, (steal) and sell your crops to win! Fight with your fists or grow some weapons to smack your rivals and take their crops. Gather your friends online and compete to become the best farmer-warrior in this chaotic PvP party game.
rows.description_html: Join our Discord About the Game A unique fusion of farming and slapstick combat, Harvest Havoc is a chaotic online PvP party game for 2-6 players. Grow, harvest, (steal) and sell your crops to win! Fight with your fists or grow some weapons to mess with your friends and aid your crop-stealing mischief. Gather your friends, bring out your inner gremlin and compete to become the ultimate farmer-warrior! Multiplayer for 6 Best played with friends, family or co-workers, play with up to 5 other farmer-warriors in online multiplayer Grow, Harvest, Sell! Find the seed packets scattered around the map and plant it to start your farming spree. Be the one to earn the most money. But watch out: farmers might have their eyes on your precious crops. Steal & Sabotage! Wanna mess around with your friends? Use your fists or grow some weapons to smack them around and steal their crops for yourself! Teams VS Free-for-all Want to work together? Or is it every farmer for themselves? Choose how you want to play. Character Selection Choose your wacky character from a selection of 5 animal costumes and 8 colours. 5 Thematic Maps & 3 Game Modes Play in a variety of 'farms' with different ways to play and navigate each map. If it feels too slow for you or you want more bare-knuckle brawling, try out the different game modes!

rows.name: They Linger
rows.short_description: Navigate the narrow hallways in the darkness to find and rescue Jessica and survive the infinite Labyrinth.
rows.description_html: A Horror game for PC and Mac. Navigate the narrow hallways in the darkness to find and rescue Jessica and along the way you must...well...you'll see... Headphones recommended for best experience. This game contains flashing lights, loud noises, and blood. Controls: W,A,S,D or arrow keys to move Spacebar or Enter/OK button to interact hold Shift to run Gamepad Dpad or L-Stick to move bottom button to interact hold left button to run This is my first time making a horror game. Hopefully I did alright...It scared the pants off me, but I'm a big baby, so... Mac Troubleshooting: If you can't open the file: right click and select open. If you see 'move this app to another folder' you must move the app itself out of it's original folder, either to a new folder, or away from it's original folder.

rows.name: Star Legacy VR
rows.short_description: Star Legacy VR is an immersive virtual reality shooting game that incorporates intriguing Roguelike elements into gameplay. Players assume the roles of interstellar guardians who venture across diverse planets and traverse through various time zones.
rows.description_html: Regarding the Suspension of Updates on Steam Regarding the Suspension of Updates on Steam Due to the limited manpower within our team, we have devoted a significant amount of time to the optimization and updates for the Quest standalone VR system. As a result, we are unable to continue to guarantee the frequency of updates or the gaming experience on the Steam version. Consequently, we have made the difficult decision to temporarily suspend updates for the Steam version of our game. For those who wish to experience the latest version of our game, we encourage you to visit the Quest platform to download the updated content. We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to all our players for your affection and support throughout this journey.and we welcome you to join our community to discuss everything about the game with us. Thank you for your understanding and continued passion for our game. About the Game Game Background： As an interstellar guardian, the player will travel between various planets to protect the interstellar heritage while fending off waves of enemy attacks in the game's universe, which is full of interstellar artifacts and mysterious energy. Gameplay & Features： This is a VR shooting game with Roguelike elements, featuring multiple planets for you to challenge. Each planet offers a unique environment to explore. Choose from a variety of characters, each bringing a new gaming experience. With a wide selection of weapons available, each offering different control mechanics and immersive audio-visual feedback, you can customize your gameplay. Unlock numerous skills and props to enhance your abilities and defeat waves of enemy attacks. Face powerful chiefs as you showcase your gaming prowess. rows.name: Sword of Convallaria
rows.short_description: Fantasy Tactical RPG revitalizing the beloved Japanese turn-based & pixel art genre. Collect & train a roster of mercenaries, customize your squad, and use your own strategy to save the nation of Iria. Journey through a world of plot twists where every choice you make will reshape your destiny.
rows.description_html: An Epic Collaboration Coming Soon! ⚔ Join the Sword of Convallaria Discord Server! About the Game PROFOUND STORY Journey through to Iria, a mineral-rich country whose magical resources have drawn unwanted attention from dangerous external factions. As tensions rise and riots break out, it’s up to you as a mercenary leader to navigate complex situations whilst finding ways to save the fate of Iria. STRATEGIC TURN-BASED COMBAT Experience authentic grid-based tactical battles. Deploy unique allies against diverse enemy types and use every battlefield detail whether it's a cliff, boulder, obstacle, or even a bangalore to secure victory. CHOICE-BASED NARRATIVE Your decisions shape how your town evolves and influence the unfolding story. Be sure to Build relationships and skills to your advantage, and watch as the storyline changes depending on your choices and achievements. “NeoPixel” ART “NeoPixel” retains the popular pixel-style graphics, whilst adding modern 3D renderings (real-time shading, full-screen bloom, dynamic depth of field, HDR, etc.), contributing to premium HD picture quality and lighting effects. STUNNING HERO COLLECTION & DEVELOPMENT Recruit and train a roster of unique companions at the tavern, teach them amazing skills, build their equipment at the forge, improve their stats in the training field, and lead your self-built mercenary group into legendary quests with different factions SCORE BY HITOSHI SAKIMOTO Music producer Hitoshi Sakimoto - best known for scoring FF Tactics, FFXII, and Tactics Ogre - lends his passion to Sword of Convallaria with his finest musical pieces to date. JAPANESE VOICE-OVER STARS Enjoy performances from over 40 anime and game voice-acting stars like Inoue Kazuhiko, Yuki Aoi, and Eguchi Takuya who bring each character to life.
