rows.name: Noble's Life: Kingdom Reborn - Prologue
rows.short_description: Experience the first months after a brutal assault on your own estate in the free prologue of a realistic simulator of a medieval noble combined with a strategy game of historical depth. Manage your town and villages and make decisions in non-linear events.
rows.description_html: Fires in the villages and cities in the south of France haven't yet extinguished and big English armies are already wreaking havoc in the north. War spreads over new territories, more countries are involved in the conflict, Brittany is plunging into a civil war, and high war taxes are pushing peasants into revolts. The power of the Church has also been broken, it is fought by simony, nepotism and heresies. Meanwhile, the Pope remains in Avignon's captivity. To make matters worse, the first rumors of a mysterious epidemic, that will soon be known as the Black Death, reach Europe. In the uncertain times of the Hundred Years' War, you play as a noble who goes to war at the behest of his king, for which your enemies repay you by devastating your estate. In this unique combination of simulator and strategy game, you will get a chance to lead the rebuilding of a city - the center of your lands - and restore the power in your family's villages. To do this, you will have to make hundreds of decisions and find your ruling style. Free prologue will give you an overview of the early stages of the game, which include the first three months meaning over an hour of gameplay. You'll have the chance to manage a city devastated after the assault, trying to bring it back to life while trying to determine who dared to attack your subjects. Dozens of decisions await you showing the potential of the game's non-linearity and the first, also dramatic, consequences of your decisions. Your choices will affect the look of the city, which you will be free to explore, and the townsfolk, each of whom will be interactive and many of whom will offer all sorts of opportunities to strengthen your estate. Decide on taxes and conscription of peasants into the army, write letters, but also look for clues, as not everything is as it seems at first. And create your own battle plan, then command your troops in real time in a skirmish presenting the beginnings of an unusual and realistic battle system we are preparing. You play the role of a single nobleman, not an omnipotent entity with control over each subject. Therefore, control your estates by imposing or lowering taxes, organizing military conscription among the population, employing specialists, financing various projects, settling disputes, negotiating with various factions or local magnates. Increase your prestige by organizing balls, festivals or tournaments. You can also fill the treasury with stolen goods by doing raids, but then your city should be prepared for the possible revenge of your enemies. You have the option to both take care of everything yourself, as well as commission some tasks to an employable advisers. On the other hand, under the layer of negotiations, elections, orders and diplomatic correspondence, you will find an extensive economic system, giving you many different paths to expand your lands. Decide what kind of ruler you want to be. Each path will give you access to different types of investments, units, diplomatic options, and ways to deal with problems. A battle-hardened raider, a saintly paladin with the support of the Church, a skilful diplomat with allies, a wealthy, enterprising aristocrat who can afford mercenaries, an alchemist ruler, a mad sadist magnate, a carefree swagger are just some of the paths to follow. Nothing prevents you from combining several of them. Find your ruling style! There is a war going on, so the enemy will come to your gates sooner or later. May you be ready! Order recruits to train, turning them into loyal soldiers, pay for the construction of defense machines, invest in fortifications and prepare a detailed plan to defend the city. Additionally, when the enemy approaches the city and prepares to conquer it by attacking the walls, you personally manage the defense. Hard, high walls, siege machines, skillful use of units, and the right strategy will allow you to survive, even when the enemy overwhelms you with numbers. Gather and equip mounted warriors and lead them to plunder enemy lands, harass the vanguard of a larger army, suppress a rebellion or defend your lands. Remember that you have to act quickly and that you can sometimes face unexpectedly great forces. Then, pay attention to the terrain and weather, as well as the equipment of the defenders. There is nothing worse than driving uphill under fire from the archers on top. We focus on historical accuracy, being inspired by the most interesting events of the period. The goal is to reflect the realities of the medieval city and the challenges faced by aristocrats. All this so you can feel the atmosphere by playing the ruler you have created. In addition, the main plot of the game is closely related to one of the most interesting and the longest ever military conflict in Europe - The Hundred Years' War. Feel what it's like to rule real people and face challenges never seen in strategy games. Fight diseases, negotiate with parties that have their own interests, take care of the loyalty of commanders, but also settle (or not) conflicts and problems of ordinary subjects. Rule your lands wisely or brutally crush any manifestations of rebellion or betrayal. Find your ruling style!

rows.name: Wrong Landing
rows.short_description: Wrong Landing is free to play survival open world story horror game where you shipwrecked on a deserted island and try to survive the hunger, cold, fear and much more!
rows.description_html: in General : You're ex-military, you and your team were sent on a secret mission after 10 years of non-service, to check out an island where nuclear weapons and radiation were allegedly being tested, after you land badly on the island you have to face hunger, thirst, cold, but most of all fear, you have to make tools, build shelters and try to SURVIVE. You are the only survivor in the whole team and you try to understand the island. Procedural vital system : - For example to keep from getting cold, just start running to keep warm or you need to find a heat source like fire or armor or your health will decrease - when you are in a scary situation, your fear rises and hunger is decreasing faster - each level procedurally increases the maximum level of hunger and thirst - etc... Interesting inventory and crafting : Each item has specific place, like in game the forest... About me and team: Hi, i am Honza Záruba, i am 16 years old and I've been interested in games since I was little, but I didn't always want to just play games but also create them... since 2018 I've been interested in game development in unity engine so at the end of 2022 I decided to do this... it's not as I expected but it's enjoyble and that's the main thing, I want to share it with you and collect feedbacks for future updates :) Thanks for all! We also have a lot of testers, art designers and story creators (Daniela Drábková, Miroul, Jamal, Filip, etc...)

Platform gun is a complete free experience that should take around 30 minutes to complete. rows.description_html: Find A Way Out A renowned archer Nuoli, embarks on a journey to escape from a mysterious castle. Mizeria is a short game where you need to climb a giant tower with the help of your bow and a friendly spirit. Game Features -Simple game where you just have to climb out of a tower. -Fun little bow, that can aid your climbing journey. - Retro late 90's graphics. All the graphics from the early 5th gen era, with modern controls for smooth yet atmospheric gameplay.

rows.name: Darkless
rows.short_description: Get ready for an adventure as Nameless, a clever spirit trapped in a lamp by a curse. Regain your form by exploring the Silent Mansion. Uncover secrets in this platform and puzzle game.
rows.description_html: Darkless looms over the Silent Mansion under the mysterious moonlight! Ghosts and spirits lurk, seeking to sow fear, but it could be that Nameless has unleashed more than he imagined. After being sentenced to the prison of a lamp as punishment for defying the powerful organization that rules the Mansion, Nameless is willing to do whatever it takes to defeat his enemies. Will you join him in this desperate battle? GET READY FOR AN EPIC ADVENTURE! ● Immerse yourself in an exciting single-player campaign with diverse and unique locations. ● Use your light as your faithful guide to navigate mysterious worlds. ● Uncover all the mysterious spectral medallions hidden throughout the levels. ● Embark on a chilling journey through a nightmarish world where appearances can deceive. ● Make friends with intriguing characters along your journey, each with their own fascinating personality. DISCOVER THE DARK WONDER OF DARKLESS Are you ready to enter the exciting world of children's horror? With Darkless, we have created an exciting 2D platformer that is suitable for all ages. In this game, the player's skill is tested in daring jumps and challenging puzzles, while exploring our protagonist's unique mechanic: the amazing light he emanates. We challenge you, player, will you be the hero who defeats the sinister X-Men, who have plunged the entire mansion into darkness? And most crucial of all, will you be able to recover Nameless's body from the clutches of the X-Men and their dark selfish designs? The fate of the mansion depends on you! Are you ready to face this exciting adventure full of terror and mystery? Discover the world of Darkless now!

rows.name: Uncharted Ocean 2
rows.short_description: Time to set sail! This is destined to be a journey full of opportunities. Open new trade routes, accumulate fortunes, and establish a maritime empire of your own! It is also a dangerous journey, you must defeat the evil pirates and other mystical dangers the ocean offers to a captain.
rows.description_html: Join us on Discord RECOMMENDED FOR YOU About the Game Time to set sail! This is destined to be a journey full of opportunities. Open new trade routes, accumulate fortunes, and establish a maritime empire of your own! It is also a dangerous journey, you must defeat the evil pirates and other mystical dangers the ocean offers to a captain. Each ship can be further transformed, from the stern, auxiliary sail, bow, armor, and cargo warehouse, all can be processed to meet your need. Wanna war? Then fit more cannons. More money? Build a larger warehouse. You will also meet interesting characters from all over the world, not only can you learn their backstories, but also recruit them to form a team with unique abilities and personalities. All of your partners will be responsible for the corresponding work on the ship, according to their expertise. To achieve the best outcome, you need to put everyone in their appropriate places. As the captain, you have a wide range of choices of professions and skills, as well as more powerful equipment, characters, and warships. Constantly strengthen yourself, and challenge harsh enemies in the deep sea. Once encountering pirates, you must move your fleet flexibly, avoid deadly blows, and defeat enemies through reasonable 'skills' . You can have a MOBA-like experience. As the adventure progresses, your fleet will enter into one instance after another, facing more powerful and special challenges. You can also play your captain as and dive into the heat of hand-to-hand combats, on both sea and land. The land instances are full of surprises too, with powerful bosses and treasures waiting for you! Making money en route is a major source of fun when sailing. In Uncharted Ocean 2, the prices of goods are dynamically changing according to the real supply and demand of goods. You must keep an eye on the market to make a profit. Ships are not only tools to conquer faraway places, but also cozy homes. You can carry out various activities such as planting, breeding and forging on your ship, which would give you rich profits. Based on the real world, Uncharted Ocean 2 builds an extremely large open world, with real land and sea terrain, as well as real coordinates and current systems. This open world is full of amazing details, the latest version has over 200 cities for you to explore each with its own unique flavor. In Tianjin, China, you will encounter storytellers and monkey players on the streets. You can see cherry blossoms and torii in Japan. In Vietnam, you will find the golden temples of Southeast Asia. In Europe, the spectacular churches and castles are a must to see. You're not the only adventurer, there are countless fleets traveling around you, sometimes competing against each other for treasures! Sometimes you will work together to form a powerful combined fleet to face challenging enemies, such as pirates’ dens or giant monsters in the deep sea. It is fascinating and full of depth and fun, and is sure to bring you a colorful and exciting sea adventure!

rows.short_description: 'Gentleman puzzle, relying on puzzle skills and skills to keep moving into the hearts of various beautiful girls! '
rows.description_html: It has been a busy day, and both your body and mind need some relaxation. Why not try this light-hearted casual game? In between the game, you can also get to know them, understand them, and delve deeper into their personalities! But it's not just about the game – there are also thrilling special scenes! But remember, don't share this with anyone else. Click, relax, level up, collect items. Each of them, exclusively for you, awaits you to explore their most intimate moments! • Engage in flirtatious banter with 8 girls! • 50 challenging puzzles • Use skills to devise strategies • Up to 120 different branching dialogues for various scenarios • Enjoy the in-game gallery P.S. rows.name: Jake's Halloween Night
rows.short_description: 'It's October 31, follow Jake as he gets ready for a killer Halloween party.'
rows.description_html: 'It's October 31, follow Jake as he gets ready for a killer Halloween party.' Jake's Halloween Night is a short horror game inspired by old slasher movies, that at the same time, makes a bit of fun of said genre. The project originally started, developed, and finished in October 2021 as a personal challenge, but now comes back remastered with new art, improved graphics, and lots of new secrets. Features Pixel art visuals. Drawn cutscenes and objects. Story-driven with environmental storytelling. Three endings. A couple of classic (and cliche) horror references. Gameplay The game has a duration of 15 to 25 minutes of gameplay, with simple puzzles. If you enjoy clicking everything to find bits of information in your surroundings, and piecing together the untold events going on, this game is for you. Controls: Full screen: F4 Move: WASD / Arrow keys Interact: Enter Menu: E Cancel: Esc / X

rows.description_html: Next part of the URBO About the Game A relaxing puzzle game in which you build a miniaturized city on a green island in the middle of a vast azure lake. Get away from your daily routine and immerse yourself in the world of URBO: Dream One. Watch your city grow house by house. This is just one of the worlds of URBO. Each one offers the opportunity to build mysterious cities in an atmospheric, dreamlike setting. Focus on the game when you feel your mind needs a rest. Follow our news via the link below, perhaps it is exactly URBO's realms that you need for inspiration... URBO: Dream One features a grassy island with a mystical Tower, willing to reveal its secrets to those who are wise. The strange monuments that are part of the landscape hint at the mystical origins of this realm. Look at the world from different angles, at different times of day. After all, the familiar always appears in a new light when night changes to day. In URBO: Dream One, the architectural style and color palette of your city perfectly blends in with the beauty of the surrounding world. Every house built, every lucky move will be seen by the Tower. Using its bonuses will add a nice touch to the gameplay, and you will build a truly prosperous city that many inhabitants will want to call home.

rows.name: Anarchy Park
rows.short_description: Welcome to Anarchy Park! An Isometric Boss Rush Bullet Hell set in a wacky amusement park! Featuring a 3D environment that will challenge your ability to aim, shoot and dodge simultaneously!
rows.description_html: Step right up to the most chaotic carnival you've ever seen: Anarchy Park! Dive into a frantic fusion of isometric exploration and intense bullet-hell action. In Anarchy Park, every twist and turn offers unpredictable challenges as you venture through a zany amusement park that's as dangerous as it is delightful. With a vibrant world painted in shades of madness, this isn't your typical day at the fair. Instead of sweet memories, you'll face four formidable bosses, each with their own unique styles and tricks up their sleeves. Beyond the bullet hell mayhem, players will explore an amusement park searching high and low for 10 elusive stars, if you manage to collect them all, you'll be rewarded with a silly prize to add to the adventure. Developed over 10 months with a dedication to challenge and precision, Anarchy Park provides players with a concise 2-5 hour adventure that packs a punch. Every moment in this park is meticulously crafted to test your skills, ensuring every victory feels earned. What sets Anarchy Park apart is its distinctive 3D shooting system – a feature seldom seen in isometric or top-down shooters. As you weave through a hailstorm of bullets and chaos, you'll need more than just quick reflexes; precision aiming and strategic planning are essential. Engage with enemies in three-dimensional space, challenging players to aim, shoot, and dodge in ways they've never done before. So, are you up for the challenge? Do you have the grit and gumption to survive the wild rides of Anarchy Park? Step in, take aim, and let the mayhem begin!

rows.name: The Lost Son
rows.short_description: The Lost Son is a short but challenging indie puzzle platformer game tease. Have your wits about you and use both characters to decode the cyber ruins and find your lost son!
rows.description_html: Story Sean and Belle are on their way to visit their son for his birthday but suddenly they wake up in a mysterious world. Lost and confused, the couple ventures out into the unknown to find out where they are and where their son is. Gameplay In The Lost Son is a puzzle platformer where you play as two characters that you can switch between. Each character has a unique interaction with color. The blue character can only collide with blue barriers and pink circle can only collide with pink barriers. As simple as this constraint is it can create some interesting puzzles where you have to use both character's unique abilities to progress! Solo Mode Ready to take on the challenge all alone with that big brain of yours? In solo mode character switching is the key. Make sure to use both character's unique attributes and abilities to advance through the levels! Work Together Want to play with a friend? We've got you covered! In The Lost Son you can connect a controller to the game and it will automatically enter split-screen! Work together to beat the stages and have a blast! (Only works is there is one keyboard and one controller at the moment). Required - Keyboard & Mouse Co-op - A Keyboard & Mouse for the first player, and a controller for the 2nd player Keyboard Controls Move - Arrow Keys/A and D Switch Characters (only in single player mode) - Tab Pause - Escape Jump - Z/Space Stomp Attack - X/S Air Dash - C/Left Click Gamepad (2nd Player Only) D-Pad/Left Stick - Move Button South - Jump Button North - Air Dash Button East - Stomp Attack

This game tells the story of a girl with a special fate who meets a cat and a mysterious talking body in a different world, and the body and cat help the girl return to the real world. Gameplay: Players need to control the girl to pass through each level. Due to her special fate, the girl has special skills in a different world, which can help players better avoid monsters and traps. Special mechanisms: Some mechanisms can provide lighting and open paths, but they can also activate some enemies. Players need to make instant route judgments. In addition, there are mechanisms on the map that can accelerate players' movements.

rows.description_html: A short walking narrative for people who enjoy relaxed exploration. In this experience you will walk the environment in first person listening to a narrative that is triggered in certain areas. It is less a game and more a short narrative artwork. A group of children are brought by a singularity AI to their new home in an abandoned subdivision. This is a immersive short story (one hour) that is part two of a trilogy. Part one is seen through a machinima video. It is a chapter in a larger interconnected narrative I am creating.

rows.name: Dropkick Navvy: First Step
rows.short_description: Dropkick Navvy: First Step is a physics-based crafting/survival sim. Help the World Tree rebuild the broken cosmos as the responsibility falls upon you. Scurry through diverse landscapes, gather essential resources, and build your way towards finding the eternal source of water for the World Tree.
rows.description_html: ' First Step ' is a short demo for the upcoming 'Dropkick Navvy', designed to help us fine-tune the fun. Do you dig crafting games like Minecraft , Astroneer , and Forager ? How about goofy physics sims like Human: Fall Flat or Moving Out ? We love both — so we smushed em together! Go ham on rocks and trees with slapdash tools you made yourself, then pile ‘em into your little wicker basket and wobble back to your workbench in charmingly precarious fashion. Or just dropkick them suckers clear across the map. Ain't nobody got time for all that. Roam the cosmos and knock down everything in your path to turn them into stuff! Can’t hold all the stuff? Try throwing it or using a basket or something! Craft some tools! And then craft some more tools! And keep crafting until you run out! rows.name: IronWolf: Free Non-VR Edition
rows.short_description: This is the Free Non-VR version of IronWolf VR. A co-op submarine game with a light touch on realism, making the submarine sim genre accessible to a wider audience.
rows.description_html: IronWolf was originally designed from the ground up for VR and we're excited to make a standalone NON-VR version of the game that's free for everyone. This free version includes all of the missions from the original IronWolf VR as well as the randomly generated missions, however it does not include the map based OpenWorld gameplay, submarine upgrades or leaderboards. If you want to experience this in VR or if you want to enjoy the OpenWorld Gameplay and other features check out IronWolf VR. Unleash torpedoes on enemy ships, shoot down fighters and bombers using anti-aircraft guns, and attempt to survive depth charges dropped by deadly destroyers. Gameplay Fast paced shooting to repel enemy planes with the .50 cal machine gun Stealthily hunt enemy merchant convoys Duel with enemy destroyers, frigates and battleships Single and Multi player Cooperative online multiplayer Play on your own by enabling assists to your requirements

rows.name: World of Rune
rows.short_description: World of Rune is an MMORPG game with tons of different characters and mystical cute pets. You can play as a Swordsman, Mage, Archer and Cleric.
rows.description_html: Welcome to World of Rune, a thrilling and immersive MMORPG where you'll embark on epic adventures across a stunning fantasy world filled with magic and danger. With countless quests, dungeons, and battles to conquer, you'll never run out of excitement in this action-packed game. Customize your character, team up with friends and pets, and take on powerful bosses to unlock new areas and uncover hidden treasures. Get ready to explore a vast and magical universe! ● Four Playable Classes with Unique Abilities You start out as a novice class character, and later you can choose a class. You can play as a Swordsman, Mage, Archer and Cleric. Make your character your own – become a unique adventurer in the world of Rune. ● Unique Card System There are over 100+ cards in the game, each with their own unique abilities and stats. You’ll need to collect them in order to become stronger! Collect and Level up your cards to unlock more abilities and powers to conquer different monsters and bosses. ● Partners Formation: Combat with Your Partner Call the best fighters in the land to fight by your side. Collect partners as you adventure through the land and add them to your formation. Deploy partners to increase your Power and join more difficult dungeons and battles. ● Trustworthy Pets to Keep You Company Collect and grow mystical pets that help you on adventures. You can also capture monsters in dungeons to raise them as new pets. ● Hunt the Boss and Win Rich Loots Explore unique maze dungeons and defeat the Boss! Get rare and exciting drops from dungeons to get stronger and increase EXP. Take your character’s power to the next level by leveling up your abilities to overcome dark dungeons and powerful MVP monsters that you'll encounter on your adventures! A fantastic journey awaits! Become an unbreakable adventurer and overcome obstacles in this world!

rows.name: Whispering Shadows
rows.short_description: Put yourself in the shoes of a schizophrenic person and experiment the hell of the voices
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the darkness with Whispering Shadows, an immersive gaming experience that transcends traditional boundaries, exploring the deepest corners of the human mind. Explore Minimalist Settings, Breathe Oppressive Atmosphere : In this two-dimensional world, every step you take brings the protagonist closer to the thin line that separates reality from the nightmare. Minimalist decors, while evoking apparent simplicity, hide deep emotional nuances. Each visual element is carefully designed to amplify the emotional impact, creating a striking visual experience. A Unique Auditory Odyssey: Immerse yourself in this sensory experience where sound becomes your guide. The disturbing voices that resonate in your head are not just noises, but essential components of the narrative. Audio plays a crucial role, creating an immersive symphony of tormented thoughts and inner voices that guide your journey. Schizophrenic Narrative: Whispering Shadows offers a unique perspective by putting yourself in the shoes of a schizophrenic person. Experience the emotional ups and especially downs as you face the disturbing voices and tormented thoughts that emerge from the mind. Each breakthrough reveals a new aspect of the mental mess, offering a poignant glimpse into the complex reality of schizophrenia. Minimalist Gameplay, an Intimate Connection : Whispering Shadows offers minimalist gameplay to highlight the narrative and emotional aspect of the experience. Deceptively simple, your only means of interaction is a single key on your keyboard, used to advance. However, do not underestimate the power of this simplicity. Each step you take represents one more step in the protagonist’s psyche, creating an intimate connection between the player and the character. Evolution of the protagonist : As you progress through the various minimalist backgrounds, watch carefully the subtle changes that occur. The protagonist gradually loses color, reflecting the gradual loss of mental aspects. This visual transformation adds an emotional dimension to the gameplay, making every step significant. Emotional Challenges : Each scene offers unique emotional challenges, corresponding to the themes discussed, such as passion, friendship, family, love, mourning, and finally, the inevitable emptiness. These challenges manifest themselves through subtle events, visual changes, and audio variations, testing your understanding and empathy for the schizophrenic perspective. No Return Choice : Proceed with caution, because once you have passed a step, there is no turning back. This game mechanic reinforces the feeling of inexorability, parallel to the reality of schizophrenia, where choices can have lasting consequences. Whispering Shadows offers a gameplay experience that goes beyond convention, encouraging reflection and empathy through simple but deep interactions. Each advance is an emotional exploration, an advance in the complex labyrinth of the mind. Will you dare to move forward, without ever looking back?

rows.name: Stick and Balls
rows.short_description: Stick and Balls is an exceedingly difficult climb up a minimalist tower. Control two balls, separately yet simultaneously, connected by a stick, with other physics shenanigans that are simple to learn, hard to master. The smallest mistake might lead you on a (psychologically) painful fall.
rows.description_html: Disclaimer : A controller with two analog joysticks is highly recommended, and very nearly required, to play this game. If you want to torture yourself on a level even beyond what I made this game for, then sure, try and play with keyboard. Don't say I didn't warn you though. Completing this challenge won't be easy. You will fall, many times, and it will always be your fault. Eventually you'll feel into the technique of controlling two things at once. Through your failures you'll learn the many emergent tricks of a seemingly simple game. Maybe, just maybe, you'll find the peak of this tortuous game. Even more difficult will be the quest to discover each secret and shortcut. The art and music might not be this game's selling point, but there's 26 ball costumes, 8 world themes, and 13 original music tracks to hopefully keep your interest. If you manage to beat my game, I'd love it if you let me know.

rows.name: She Fell Off
rows.short_description: Uncover the cryptic remnants of a destroyed world in 'She Fell Off,' a solo-developed indie game. Embark on Eve's intense journey through a dark post-apocalyptic underworld, devoid of familiar life. Navigate a dark environment, endure unforgiving gameplay, and immerse yourself in an eerie mystery.
rows.description_html: Unravel the enigma of the post-apocalyptic world in 'She Fell Off,' an indie game crafted by a single developer that plunges you into a dystopian, sci-fi reality where everything familiar has been lost. This atmospheric, third-person, 3D platformer draws you into a mystery that transcends reality as we know it, enveloping you in a paradox where you control Eve, a vibrant, mysterious heroine. 'She Fell Off' paints a dark yet colorful World where the Earth's crust has been devoured, replaced by an unforgiving, acid ocean. With nothing but three enormous, black lily pad-like plants spanning the size of Africa as the only remnants of life, you'll navigate the once-vibrant world, now turned silent and spectral. But the real mystery lies beneath the surface. Test your courage and step into the underground realm, a perplexing anomaly that houses horrors more terrifying than the surface's desolation. Here, in this minimalistic, precision platformer world, danger lurks in the darkness and the only source of light is you, with Eve's radiant yellow outfit piercing the ever-present gloom. Survival is a matter of skill and grit in this game. Designed for gamers seeking an intense and frustrating challenge, 'She Fell Off' provides no save points. Every demise, every failure, will bring you back to the beginning, forcing you to learn, adapt, and ultimately, to conquer the unknown. It is a relentless test of your resilience as you leap from platform to platform, seeking answers, and perhaps, redemption in the eerie quiet of this post-apocalyptic underground landscape. The game’s precision platforming, combined with its terrifying premise, creates a unique and unsettling twist on the 3D platformer genre. The heart-pounding tension of a horror game mixes with the demanding, unforgiving gameplay of a precision platformer to create a truly distinct experience. As a single-player game, 'She Fell Off' offers an immersive and nerve-wracking adventure that pushes the boundaries of what a 3D platformer can be. Play as Eve, the game's mysterious female protagonist, whose backstory remains as enigmatic as the world she traverses. Delve deep into the head cannon of her mystery, unraveling threads of intrigue and deception. The true essence of Eve, however, is never explicitly revealed, keeping you forever on edge, questioning, wondering, and fearing the unknown. Experience the eerie beauty of a stylized, post-apocalyptic world in 'She Fell Off.' It's a journey into the unknown, a descent into darkness, and a leap of faith into a reality where mystery prevails and danger lurks around every corner. Do you have what it takes to navigate this terrifying underground environment, and unmask the chilling secrets of the past? 'She Fell Off' awaits your challenge. Remember, in this world of shadows and deception, the only beacon of hope is you.

rows.name: SCP: Nemesi - Alpha Testing
rows.short_description: SCP: Nemesi is a multiplayer survival-horror game where one player takes on the role of the SCP (anomalous creatures, each with its own abilities and appearance), and the other four players play as Humans, each with their own personal goals and tasks that may branch into different paths.
rows.description_html: ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST! IMPORTANT: This game is in Very Early Access, positioned between the Alpha and Beta phases. Please treat it with the appropriate consideration. Approach it with respect, read carefully, and understand before offering your review. Additionally, please bear in mind that since the game has just been released, the initial player count may be low. We highly recommend joining our Discord server to find people you can play with. Overview SCP: Nemesi is an intense multiplayer survival-horror game that offers a thrilling experience for fans of the SCP Foundation universe and for newcomers too! In this game, players are divided into two groups: one player takes on the role of a powerful anomalous creature, the SCP, while the other four players become Humans, each with their own objectives and branching tasks to complete. Immersive First-Person View Experience the chilling atmosphere through a first-person view, whether you are playing as the SCP or the Humans. The immersive perspective enhances the tension and keeps you engaged in the heart-pounding gameplay. Strategic Human Gameplay As a Human, you have no means of combat, leaving you vulnerable and exposed. Your survival depends on mastering the map and utilizing your surroundings to your advantage. With superior mobility, including vaulting, sliding, and crouching to minimize noise, stealth and cunning are your greatest allies. Key Features Did you see that?! - The Humans' visibility is severely limited by a thick fog, making it difficult to see far ahead. Blinking at regular intervals may cause them to miss something crucial... Every man for himself! - Each Human has a unique set of tasks to complete before they can escape. There's no need to rely on teammates to achieve these objectives, and only when a player accomplishes all their tasks can they make their escape. This place seems familiar... - Explore maps inspired by everyday locations from various eras around the Earth. These meticulously designed non-procedural maps feature intricate pathways and hidden passages, challenging players to learn layouts and navigate effectively, which is crucial to their success. Something old, something new - Each SCP featured in the game closely adheres to the SCP Lore, both in appearance and abilities. To set this game apart from other SCP titles, both lesser-known SCPs and intriguing original creations will be featured as the game evolves! It's dangerous out there! - Prepare for the unexpected with the presence of Environmental SCPs, AI-controlled entities that introduce unique challenges during each match. Be warned! While some are friendly, others may not be...

rows.name: Line Link
rows.short_description: Line Link is a logical puzzle game, perfect for relaxing or while your computer is loading another game.
rows.description_html: ************************Gameplay************************ In the level, you need to freely choose a marker point as your starting point, and plan a line based on this starting point. This line needs to contain all the markers in the level *************************Game Control************************ Click the mouse, select or connect the direction with the left mouse button, and cancel the operation with the right button *************************Game Features************************ >> Easy to learn, simple mouse controls >>Very suitable for relaxing yourself after a heavy game >> Some logical thinking challenge, but not overly complicated >>The puzzles in the level have multiple solutions *I used google translate, hope you can understand what I want to express

rows.name: Duskbound
rows.short_description: Pursue a cursed romance with a possibly unhinged vampire under the eternal glow of the red moonlight...
rows.description_html: Story A red moon shines ominously on a city shrouded in endless night. The people here don't seem to have any life left in them. Well, all except for him. A young woman looking for an escape from her dreary everyday latches onto the only man left with light in his eyes, and musters up the courage to confess her love. If only she had noticed his sharp teeth before it was too late... Features Around 9k words (30-45 minute playtime) One possibly unhinged vampire love interest 5 different endings, plus one unlockable final ending 3 CGs (with variations) Content warnings This game features possibly disturbing content including blood, violence, manipulation, death/murder and dubious consent.

rows.name: Small Kingdoms Prologue
rows.short_description: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rival as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield. Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game, the Small Kingdoms Prologue is a free introductory campaign
rows.description_html: Rule a small fantasy kingdom and conquer your rival as you build up your cities and armies on the world map and command your troops on the battlefield Small Kingdoms is a streamlined grand strategy and real-time strategy game, the Small Kingdoms Prologue is a free introductory version to the full game with a single campaign and a smaller number of buildings and units The Prologue comes with a single campaign map which is a small world consisting of several islands with 2 playable kingdoms and each kingdom having 3 cities. The main game allows more kingdoms and cities on procedurally generated campaign maps In the Prologue the two kingdoms are very much alike. In the main game, you choose to play as one of several kingdoms that each has their own set of islands and cities. The main kingdoms all have similar unit types, but each has their own unique flavour, with strengths and weaknesses for you to use strategically Build up your cities by constructing buildings, gathering resources and training units for your garrison from the world map. Will your cities be economic powerhouses producing loads of resources? Or will they be military training camps designed to get a variety of new units into your armies? Train units for your armies on the world map, then send them into battle and command them on the battlefield to achieve victory in siege and field combat. Will you build a balanced army capable of engaging in close quarters or at a distance? Or will you focus on ranged units to strike down the enemy from afar?

rows.name: Heart and Core
rows.short_description: A twin-stick action brawler. Young engineer JJ and her robot companion, KAI, evade the totalitarian control of the ruthless Santiago. Traverse, hide, and fight your way through a seemingly unending onslaught of enemy RAMs. Use JJ’s Gravity Gun and KAI’s fists to stun and destroy enemies.
rows.description_html: A 2.5D twin-stick action brawler, Heart and Core allows the player to pilot both JJ and KAI simultaneously, using half the controller for each character for a unique experience. Young engineer JJ and her robot companion, KAI, evade the totalitarian control of the ruthless Santiago. Traverse, hide, and fight your way through a seemingly unending onslaught of enemy RAMs. Use JJ’s Gravity Gun and KAI’s fists to stun and destroy enemies. Each of the two player character has unique abilities that will need to be used together in order to defeat the unstoppable onslaught of RAM's robots. JJ is quite nimble and can jump around a flip levers to allow herself and KAI to navigate the city. JJ also uses her Gravity Gun, allowing her to pickup and move objects in the world, as well as immobilize RAMs themself! KAI on the other hand, although unable to jump, can break through destructible walls using his fists. KAI is also exceptional at destroying the enemy RAM's in just a few punches. JJ and KAI will need to work together to play to their strengths and help each others' weaknesses. However, the forces of Santiago's city will stop at nothing to take KAI's core to power the city. Santiago has deployed many different types of RAM robots to stop JJ and KAI that can shoot, charge, and sometimes even fly to eliminate the duo. Defeat the many RAM enemies in your way and march to the Heart of the city, where you can face Santiago's himself in his Airship. Santiago will stop at nothing to ensure that KAI's core is back in control of the city. Heart and Core features several different traversable areas, each blending seamlessly into each other with no loading screens. Explore several different environments from the Junkyard to the City Center in addition to several unique enemy robots. All characters in Heart and Core, both friend and foe, feature full Voice Acting to create a unique, action-packed adventure!

rows.name: MELLOWOLLEM
rows.short_description: 'MELLOWOLLEM' is an adventure game where you explore maps and find objects to progress. The main character meets a girl on a sunny summer day, and the story unfolds guided by her words. However, detailed story elements remain undisclosed, leaving only the setting of a hot, dreamy summer landscape.
rows.description_html: 'MELLOWOLLEM' is an ADV game where you explore maps and find objects to progress. ◆Story Under the blue sky on a summer day, the main character meets a girl. The story isn't revealed in great detail and is guided by her words. Where exactly are they and why are they here? Only a hot, dream-like scenery stretches out before them... ◆Game Features ・Advance the story by finding objects. ・Puzzles that are intuitive and not too difficult. ・No quest markers or time limits, allowing for a relaxed gameplay experience. ◆Video Streaming Guidelines ・Regardless of whether you are an individual or a business entity, streaming is allowed without the need for permission.

rows.name: The Book Of Hiro - Prologue
rows.short_description: “The Book Of Hiro - Prologue” is a 3D visual puzzle game where players solve challenges and puzzles using illusions and perspective to find the hidden key. The game tells the story of a brave villager named Hiro who was ordered to meet the king and encountered various challenges and puzzles.
rows.description_html: “The Book Of Hiro - Prologue” is a 3D visual puzzle game developed by two independent developers. Players help Hero embark on an adventure to the palace, using illusions and perspective to solve puzzles and explore the magical world in this book. [Innovative Visual Puzzles] The game features innovative visual puzzles that are imaginative and visually stunning. The innovative visual illusion finding gameplay involves moving the viewing angle, clicking, and other operations to find the hidden “key” pattern in the picture. Each puzzle solved can advance the plot and provide a unique gaming experience and visual impact. [Vivid 3D Graphics] The game features a simple and fresh 3D low-poly style that is full of childlike innocence while meticulously depicting the different scenes in the story. The game’s soothing and distant music complements the graphics to create a mysterious visual pop-up book. [Challenging Gameplay] The game features shiny gold coins, ordinary keys, hammers, gears, and other objects that are common but difficult to find due to the game’s unusual mechanics. Players must make bold guesses and not be fooled by seemingly unrelated images. They must carefully observe and remember that what they see is not necessarily what they get! [Intriguing Storyline] The game features an energetic and art-inspired storybook style. Behind the seemingly ordinary protagonist’s travel story is a hidden plot and an extraordinary experience. The game includes a main storyline and hidden endings waiting for you to explore. The game is still in the intense development stage. If you have any suggestions, please feel free to join our DISCORD channel for discussion

rows.name: Falling Ever
rows.short_description: Hundreds of years later, humans and Heflites coexist on a hidden planet near Earth. Finding a mate is the goal, but will something like that really help her break free from the deep darkness she experienced as a child? '...This feeling...is not an obsession...'
rows.description_html: ◆History: This game is both the beginning and the end... 'Even if they're not as prepared or worse than me, that's okay...' 'Even if you don't throw me away, it's okay...' 'Maybe I'm the only one in the world who can throw his life away for someone he cares about...' This is a story where everything takes place on a new planet with a new specimen called 'Heflite' who has emotional weaknesses but an immense love for her loved ones and others who live around her. This is a story with a lot going on as it is a Visual Novel Romance where you can 'enter' the story and forget about real life for a few hours full of pleasure for this story and captivating characters! It is not possible to make changes in the future, but you can make some choices during the game that will NOT affect the course of the story. The 'Replay' resource is not available because it is an unnecessary option for this game, as you can easily go back and continue in the dialogues you have already seen with the mouse scroll. In addition, it is possible to change the sound settings for a pleasant experience for each player, and the main thing is that you can also change the speed of the text and the speed of the automatic text so that there is no need to even put your hand on the keyboard and mouse, thus generating a PERFECT experience for those who just want to relax and make the most of their time while enjoying this moving story. This story is about a girl named 'Sutelz Selz' who is kidnapped when she can't even think for herself, and she will have to deal with the feelings and difficulties of being someone of the 'Heflite' species... 'Even though I could organize my emotions to some extent, I couldn't stand it...' With an immersive and dramatic soundtrack, it portrays the moment and the feelings of the characters. ...This is the story of a Heflite girl who was kidnapped and had to learn about love, trust, relaxation and faith... ***The planet and the Hefrids are told of their origins in 'Reset'. *** ◆Cast: < Production / Character Design / Original Story / Main Visual / Character Design / Music Production / Development ＞ Lucas Vacari Gomes All content was designed, created and produced by Lucas Vacari Gomes, who wants to show much more about this planet and the new world of origin of the light novel 'Reset'!

rows.name: Super Mayor
rows.short_description: A 100% free, feel-good 2D platformer where you play as a councillor to a rural farming district in New Zealand! Solve problems, meet the public, and become MAYOR in this hilarious, story-rich adventure.
rows.description_html: Customise your councillor! Meet the locals. Navigate perilous paths. Spend council funds. Deal with pests with your special councillor shoes... Track quests and other progress with your smartphone. Become SUPER MAYOR!

rows.name: Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day
rows.short_description: 'Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day' places you in a law enforcement role during minor post-match riots. Manage crowds, establish secure perimeters, and navigate confrontations, choosing strategies that prioritize bystander safety. Learn, decide, and lead! *This is a free prologue*
rows.description_html: This is a free prologue for the Riot Control Simulator game, where you can have a short sneak peek at the gameplay and overall game experience. In 'Riot Control Simulator: Rookie Day,' step into the boots of a law enforcement officer faced with their first mission: managing security during minor riots sparked by pseudo-fans after a local football match. Experience life at the station, prepping for the task ahead. Your mission is to prevent clashes between these pseudo-fans on the streets. Safely clear the area of bystanders and other fans lingering near the local pub. Establish a secure perimeter using barriers or police cordons to isolate the riot zone. Develop your skills in responding to aggressive individuals, be they riotous pseudo-fans or concerned citizens. Depending on the situation, employ various means, from negotiation to the use of batons, tasers, or gas. Handle confrontations by issuing fines or detaining and searching unruly individuals. Throughout, you'll be supported by your squad. Issue them precise commands, and collaboratively work to avoid escalating the situation further, prioritizing the safety of bystanders above all.

rows.short_description: Delve into the spine-chilling world of 'Spirits Uncovered' where you will accompany the fearless YouTube Ghost Hunting sensation, Scott Warren. Scott is excited that after years of building his YouTube following, he has finally hit Episode 666!
rows.description_html: Delve into a spine-chilling episode of a popular ghost hunting YouTube channel, where you will accompany the fearless YouTube Ghost Hunting sensation, Scott Warren. Scott is excited that after years of building his YouTube following, he has finally hit Episode 666! To celebrate, Scott heads into the sinister depths of Cificap High, a place shrouded in darkness, for what promises to be his most bone-chilling and petrifying episode to date. rows.name: Arkanoid - Eternal Battle : Battle Royale F2P Edition
rows.short_description: The Iconic Block-Breaker Returns! Embrace for free the intensity of the Battle Royale, thanks to the Eternal Battle Mode, up to 25 players online. Play now for free and try to reach the top of the leaderboard. Additional modes are available for separate purchase.
rows.description_html: Important Available DLC are not compatible with the F2P Edition. Full version About the Game Arkanoid is an iconic arcade game, developed by TAITO Corporation in 1986. When the mother ship ARKANOID comes under attack, the small spacecraft VAUS manages to escape but ends up warped into another dimension. Wandering in an inter-dimensional labyrinth, VAUS must destroy blocks called 'spacewalls' in order to defeat 'DOH', the creator of the maze responsible for ARKANOID’s destruction. For the first time ever, players will be able to compete against each other, offering an online experience thanks to the Eternal Battle mode, the main new feature of this game, brining the arcade experience to a whole new level. This Battle Royale mode offers the possibility to compete among 25 players online. Arkanoid is one of the most accessible, if not, the most accessible game in the history. The concept remains simple, but you'll will face level after level an increase of progressive difficulty. Features: A brand-new artistic direction and new surprising features, items and powers, conceived by the famous French Studio Pastagames. ETERNAL BATTLE (25-player): Players competing online, the last player standing wins the game. Champions can use special powers to take the advantage during the game. AVAILABLE FOR PURCHASE SEPARATELY NEO (1-player): A new game mode. Same Gameplay as the classic Arkanoid Game with new power-ups and new spacewalls RETRO (1-player): Discover a part of History through a vintage Arcade Cabinet VERSUS (2-4 players): Players competing on the same screen (split-screen) based on the Neo mode gameplay INCLUDED IN THE FULL VERSION 4 GAME MODES, including: 2 single-player modes (Neo & Retro) and 2 multiplayer modes, Local Versus and Eternal Battle

rows.name: Nephilim Uprising
rows.short_description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey in 'Nephilim Uprising,' an early access celestial third-person shooter. Navigate procedurally generated labyrinths, face intense combat scenarios, and conquer divine challenges to prove yourself in the celestial arena!
rows.description_html: Embark on an extraordinary gaming experience with 'Nephilim Uprising,' an early access third-person shooter that pushes the boundaries of celestial challenges. Immerse yourself in a divine creation known as the Labyrinth, intricately designed for those deemed worthy to challenge the heavens. Navigate intense battles, strategize to overcome celestial trials, and earn coveted loot reflecting your prowess. This unique adventure beckons to those who seek to ascend among the angels, offering a glimpse into a world where the divine meets the thrill of conquest. Join the uprising and prove yourself in the celestial arena! Gameplay Overview: Immerse yourself in fast-paced combat within procedurally generated environments, ensuring every playthrough is a fresh challenge, delivering an adrenaline-pumping experience. Weapons and Combat: Arm yourself with a diverse array of weapons and engage in intense combat scenarios. Strategic shooting is key as you face waves of enemies, with each encounter testing your skills and adaptability. Labyrinth Exploration: Embark on a journey into mysterious labyrinths that shift and change with each run. Explore the depths, but be prepared – the labyrinth is as unforgiving as it is unpredictable. Randomized Dungeons: Dive into dynamically generated environments, ensuring that no two runs are ever the same. The ever-changing landscape keeps you on the edge, providing a unique challenge in every corner of Nephilim Uprising. Planned Next Updates: Looking ahead, anticipate exciting updates for 'Nephilim Uprising.' We have plans for more weapons, diverse challenges featuring additional randomized dungeons, confrontations with new celestial adversaries, and the thrill of discovering loot boxes within the dungeons.

rows.name: Afterlife
rows.short_description: He who is chosen as a hero must take a test. Pass the test to gain power of hero, and return to the original world.
rows.description_html: Objective The end goal of the game is to complete all the missions and return to the original world. Opportunities If you start the game, you will be given 3 opportunities to try the mission. You must complete all the missions given before you exhaust all of this opportunity. If the mission fails, opportunities are reduced one by one. When all opportunities are exhausted, you cannot return to the original world and dies, and the game ends. How to play the game The defense of a village Your mission is to protect a given village from monsters for a few days. Interact with objects to acquire resources, defeat monsters, and be strong. Interaction and aetheron Left-click on the mouse to interact with the objects in the field. When interacting, you can get an essence called Aetheron . This is the good you need for the upgrade. You can get it by interacting or killing monsters. When interacting with a monster object, it attacks the monster and causes a certain amount of damage. When interacting with resource objects such as trees or rocks, resources are collected to cause a certain amount of damage and acquire resources. When interacting with the village object, repair the village to restore a certain amount of value. Obtaining items If you attack a tree, you can get a certain amount of wood, attacking rocks will allow you to acquire a certain amount of rocks. Crafting Items You can create items with the material items you have obtained. Click the second icon, Craft icon  in the left icon menu to display the craft view. Once enough material items are collected, the craftable items are activated. You can click to consume the material items to create them. Day and Night Day and night change over time. Resource objects are mainly created during the day, and monsters are created at night. Survive Rewards You can earn a reward after one day. You will be given a reward option and you will earn a reward by choosing one.

rows.name: Everbee
rows.short_description: This is a game about managing a beehive. Collect resources from flowers to raise bees and expand the hive!
rows.description_html: Bees pollinate the most flowers among pollinators. However, bee populations have been declining in recent years due to the accumulation of multiple factors: pests, agrochemicals, and habitat loss. Everbee aims to draw awareness to this issue by letting people raise their own virtual bee hive! Collect Resources Flower: Nectar and pollen can be collected from flowers by clicking on them. The bees will also automatically collect resources for you. Convert Resources: The collected nectar and pollen can be converted into the likes of honey and wax in the top left converting panel. Build New Cells: New cells can be added to the beehive using wax. Functional Cells: Functional cells can automate your work. Once built, the bees will fill functional cells with the needed materials to convert into other resources automatically, for example. Hatcheries can provide the queen bee with space for her eggs. Grow the Colony: New worker bees can hatch if the queen bee is fed and if there is a hatchery available. New workers can boost the hive. Collect New Flowers: If you give it nectar, the hummingbird will fetch new seeds for you. These can be used to grow new flowers that have different nectar and pollen producing capabilities.
rows.about_html: Bees pollinate the most flowers among pollinators. However, bee populations have been declining in recent years due to the accumulation of multiple factors: pests, agrochemicals, and habitat loss. Everbee aims to draw awareness to this issue by letting people raise their own virtual bee hive! Collect Resources Flower: Nectar and pollen can be collected from flowers by clicking on them. The bees will also automatically collect resources for you. Convert Resources: The collected nectar and pollen can be converted into the likes of honey and wax in the top left converting panel. Build New Cells: New cells can be added to the beehive using wax. Functional Cells: Functional cells can automate your work. Once built, the bees will fill functional cells with the needed materials to convert into other resources automatically, for example. Hatcheries can provide the queen bee with space for her eggs. rows.name: Aurora
rows.short_description: Welcome to a whole new world of Ultraleap Hand Tracking.
rows.description_html: NOTE: Requires Ultraleap Hyperion or Gemini to be installed, with a compatible tracking camera connected. Aurora is a virtual space created by Ultraleap – it contains islands where each hosts a different experience for you to explore. Follow our tutorials which will show you how to navigate around the space without having to physically move yourself, and learn how to use your hands by imitating our ghost hands. Aurora is all about interaction. You will pinch in the air to generate different colour ribbons of paint that you can use to create your own abstract art in VR. You will spawn shapes with your fingers, and then grab and stack them with your hands. You will interact with an exploded view of a product, using your hands to orientate a turntable to more easily examine and pick up different sized components. Along with being a fun creative experience, Aurora showcases our experience with hand tracking interactions and interface design reflecting a lot of what we have laid out in our XR design guidelines. It has been built using our Unity plugin which means you can see exactly what is possible to build for yourself with our developer tools.

rows.name: Fittest Fire
rows.short_description: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up.
rows.description_html: In a ruined world, overrun by evil robots, a disabled cyborg named Blaze rests. Send a spark of energy from your world to Blaze’s to wake him up. Help Blaze take revenge against the robots in this fast paced 2D platformer where you workout to level up. The Fittest Fire game features: Powerful melee attacks that devastate enemies and recharge your ammo Fast ranged attacks to dispatch enemies from a distance Tight movement controls with variable jumping, dashing, and wall jumping An explorable world with 12 unique areas, 8 bosses, and 20+ enemy types Fittest Fire comes with a mobile app Fittest Fire is both a game and mobile app. The Fittest Fire mobile app allows you to log exercises and get points based on the weight, reps, time, and/or distance. These points can be used in the Fittest Fire game to: Increase sword and gun damage as well as the attack speed Unlock powerful special attacks for both the sword and gun Increase health points, movement speed, and power up durations Power up with Fire mode once it’s unlocked It's possible to play the game without downloading the mobile app. However, you will not be able to level up without the mobile app and will face significantly more difficult gameplay.

rows.name: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings
rows.short_description: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings is a high fantasy RPG that reenvisions turn-based combat in dynamic ways, telling the story of Alexander—an idealistic yet pragmatic nobleman—and his allies as they navigate politics, intrigue, ruling, and love amidst a tempestuous civil war.
rows.description_html: Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings is an epic high fantasy ruler RPG being built in an episodic format. As a solo developer, I strive to deliver a game of the highest quality, the kind I've always wanted to play myself, with innovative turn-based combat, a richly developed world, memorable characters, romance, and an in-depth story. I call Noblesse Oblige a ruler RPG because it combines exploration and turn-based RPG combat using a core party with aspects of rulership, including kingdom management elements, castle customization, and important story decisions that have long-term consequences. At present, new chapters of the game are released every 2-3 months. Old save compatibility with new versions is always maintained, so you can always pick up where you left off when a new version releases. Current Content Current playtime: 50+ hours Latest Version: v0.16 'Promises to Keep'  (released 9-5-2025) Chapters: 15 extensive chapters Words: 900,000+ Other: An eclectic soundtrack of over 140 carefully chosen songs, intricate maps made with over 65 separate tilesets, hundreds of customized animations, and several major story branches with continuing differences. Characters ...and many more to discover! About the Game What does it mean to be nobility? Is it no more than an inherited title, or does it hold some greater meaning? To some, nobility is not merely a station to be held, but an obligation to be met, and yet... Can such convictions hold firm in the face of intrigue, betrayal, and overwhelming odds? Noblesse Oblige: Legacy of the Sorcerer Kings tells the story of Alexander, an idealistic yet pragmatic nobleman, and his companions. They will have need of cunning and conviction in equal measure, if they are to navigate the intricacies of politics, intrigue, ruling, and love amidst a tempestuous civil war. Kingdoms dance upon the stage set by those who rule them, and upon this one shall play out a war born from the confluence of three unyielding wills... Upon his return from studying in a distant land, Alexander’s birthright has been stolen and his lands thrown into chaos. Faced with this betrayal and the sudden loss of all that he has spent his life preparing for, he must take up the sword and retake what is his. But a true ruler does not—cannot—live by the sword alone, not if he seeks to create something that can endure. No, victory in battle may be essential, but true triumph comes in subtler ways: to claim a lasting, meaningful victory, Alexander must not merely crush or outwit his enemies, but also navigate the labyrinthine politics of court, inspire his people… and perhaps find love for himself amidst it all. To some, the obligations of a lord are but a burden; to others, a farce. Yet to one like Alexander, who is possessed of the conviction to embrace his obligations, naught could bring greater satisfaction that using his power for good. Beneath the banner of such a lord gather allies, both those drawn by the flame of his will and those who have been touched by the light of his actions. Along the narrow path to victory, Alexander will gather a group of loyal companions—lovers, friends, rivals, allies, even those who were once his enemies, each with unique personalities and skills. Together with them, he will delve into the dark places of the world, traverse mountains, fight great battles... and perhaps most of all, struggle against those most terrible of shadows—those that lurk in the hearts of men, wrought by greed, hatred, envy, and sometimes lust. But it is in deepest darkness that light can shine the brightest. Will you join Alexander on his journey to change the world for the better? Features In Noblesse Oblige, every character is unique, with his or her own opinions, personality, and reasons for joining the party. Every party member has loyalty, driven by their opinions of choices made and paths taken; increasing loyalty unlocks powerful skill upgrades and extra story content for that character. In addition to their unique perspectives on the story, each of Alexander’s companions brings unique mechanics into battle. These include not only a wide variety of skills and playstyles, but also unique passive effects that shape how they approach combat. Combat in Noblesse Oblige is a novel take on the traditional turn-based RPG, one intended to promote skill and judicious use of abilities, rather than merely managing attrition or spamming generic attacks. Beyond the battlefield, a lord must rule his realm. To see this done, Alexander must carefully build and manage key factors like Popular Support, Noble Support, Economic Status, Army Size, and Army Quality, factors that will have important impacts as the game proceeds. Hold court and rule upon upon the disputes that divide the realm, and determine where best to spend your Royal Funds for the good of the realm! Other choices hold far greater import, shaping the very path you seek to walk: with whom to ally, who is most worthy of holding strategic lands, or what faith the realm should follow. These choices, though few, will have a lasting impact upon the story. But ruling the realm is not without its perks. Any lord of any importance has need of a castle, and that castle should reflect its lord’s desires. Accordingly, Noblesse Oblige features a system allowing for extensive castle customization: At present, Noblesse Oblige is free; when the game is closer to completion, this may change. For now, if you enjoy the game, please consider purchasing the optional Crown Loyalist DLC.

rows.name: Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude
rows.short_description: A boy regains his hope and a girl finds herself in solitude. A kinetic novel that will take you through their darkest days and immerse you in their deepest emotions.
rows.description_html: Stories from the troubled pasts of two young adults, Alex's Hope & Alex's Solitude will take you through their darkest days and immerse you in their deepest emotions. Alex's Hope The difficult story of a boy with a bleak future and a critical lack of love finding a reason to regain hope. A dark atmosphere, a cold journey, and a soft warmth will change his fate. Alex's Solitude The story of a stubbornly good-hearted girl finding rejection and struggling to fit in. A change in persona, a new friend, and a serious wake-up call will lead her to make a life-changing resolution. Content Warning This visual novel contains themes that may be distressing to many individuals, including: Depression Anxiety Suicidal Thoughts Self Harm Substance Abuse Drug Overdose It does not contain any written or visual depictions of death or any graphic depictions of injury or self harm. Features Two individual short stories (Combined length of about 7,400 words) Immersive and intensely emotional storytelling Original hand-drawn characters and backgrounds Original, immersive, and very emotionally driven soundtrack with 12 unique songs Three CGs in each story A cute cat

rows.name: Brood Ma : Dadda
rows.short_description: Manipulate the limbs of a fragile automaton to shape an immense dynamic noise score.
rows.description_html: Originally a real-time audio-visual experience designed for live performance, Dadda has now been adapted for into an avant-garde desktop PC experience, crafted within the UE5 engine. This unique adaptation captures the essence of the live show, offering a disruptive take on technology, experimental noise music, and anxious expression—remapped for you to perform yourself on your own PC. Live Performance Adaptation: Experience the powerful and chaotic spectacle of Dadda, originally designed for live performance, now reimagined as an interactive desktop game. Dark Humor & Symbolism: Explore Dadda's metallic anatomy and personal signifiers, symbols of fragility, resilience, and collective anxieties. Interactive Gameplay: Engage with Dadda's sonic contraptions, from squeaking toys to spinning spirals, creating unpredictable sonic outcomes more in tune with experimental noise music. Advanced Audio Capabilities: Experience fully spatialized audio with standard stereo, and the potential for 5.1 or 7.1 surround. Variable Play-Time: Perform, sequence and replay Dadda differently each time, with play-time ranging from 5-35 minutes. This desktop game adaptation of Dadda re-captures the energy of the original live performance as a single player narrative experience. James B Stringer is an artist, producer and developer. He co-founded the Quantum Natives label and collective and has released music on Tri-Angle, Hemlock and Mantile under his Brood Ma alias. He was Creative Director and co-founder of digital studio Werkflow and has created videogame powered visuals and artworks for artists such as Actress, Rachel Maclean, Sidsel Meineche Hansen, Kuedo, Libby Heaney and many more.

rows.name: Ocean's Venus
rows.short_description: A point and click horror game aboard a ship with inscrutable history. Your job as a maintenance worker aboard is to make sure everything runs as it should, or so you've been told...
rows.description_html: “Bell Platinum” also known as “Ocean’s Venus”, now shipwreck, used to be a cargo ship built in the 1950s traveling the North Atlantic ocean. As a newly hired maintenance worker aboard, you live through the vessel’s final voyage, uncovering and documenting its dark history. Complete Tasks Throughout your work day, you must make sure the ship’s systems are in check and are working as they should. Survival is Key A dead worker is a bad worker. If anything or anyone gets in your way, you must always have a careful plan of escape, since there’s not much else you can protect yourself with. Certain crucial game mechanics may require close attention to sound - using headphones in a quiet environment is highly recommended!

rows.name: Keali
rows.short_description: The other guardian spirits have gone missing, and it's your responsibility as Keali, self proclaimed master of chores and errands, to fix whatever has gone wrong. Use your tether and other movement abilities to traverse past the creeping vines, fly past dangers and master your skills.
rows.description_html: Keali includes Six to Ten hours of content. Extra challenges in the form of Mural Fragments that unlock secrets of the past. Leaderboards to race friends and strangers. A complex and engaging movement system with a high skill ceiling for you to explore and master. Unique levels that explore custom platforms, threats, and puzzles. Levels have multiple solutions, some easier than others. Lots of attempts, some frustration, chill beats and more. A quick use tether that auto targets based on your movement, allowing you to attach to world terrain and tether points. Race against the vines to complete levels before they cover everything. Master when to sprint and when not too, saving energy or time. Dash over large gaps, while clearing your fall speed.

rows.name: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype-
rows.short_description: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype- is a small scale prototype anime style, action RPG with high speed, stylish action game combat mixed with in depth RPG stats, abilities and systems inspired by classic JRPGs! Show us just how much flair you can bring forth!
rows.description_html: Horizon To Crinoa: Have Faith in Radiance -Prototype- is a small scale, prototype, anime action RPG showcasing some of the general ideas, aesthetics and gameplay style we’re hoping to achieve with our future game projects! It’s a high speed, stylish, action game with major RPG elements, skills and abilities inspired by classic Japanese RPGs! Follow the simple story of our main character, Yellette, set in the world of Crinoa, on a small excursion in order to find ingredients for cooking. What was assumed to be nothing more than a simple quest, transforms into more trouble than she could have seen coming! Make your way through a small section of the Island of Ezelpor, where the local Jeletan Season has spread wild Jeletan throughout, and take down the few species of these beasts you find with cool, stylish combos and flair! Main Features: -Stylish Action Gameplay By chaining skills together with the game's unique systems and mechanics, you can unleash devastating combos and skills on enemies to show off your abilities in order raise your 'Flair Meter' higher and higher for better rewards! -Active Character Switching and Assists For this prototype, you will be able to control and play as two characters; the fully fleshed out main character, Yellette, and the simpler character, the Jeletan, Ermli! By tapping the 'character switch' button you can instantly switch characters in the middle of a combo or chain to further extend your combos and show just how much flair you can pull off with the techniques available! Furthermore, by holding the 'Switch' button, combos can also be extended by instantly calling your non controlled party member to activate an assigned 'assist skill' for them to perform on a target. -Simple story with in depth lore and an in game glossary Though the story is simple and sweet, it is used to set up the personality of Yellette, our main character, and to further set up the world and setting around her for future titles. Enjoy the voiced main story cutscenes and partially voiced sidequest stories to get a true feel for our characters and world! And then delve into the many terms, places, people and ideologies of the world of Crinoa! Venture into the World of Crinoa and show us just how stylish you can be and just how much flair you can bring forth as a 'Hero of the World'!

rows.name: Mayhem Survivors: Animals
rows.short_description: Mayhem Survivors is an action rogue-like game, where you feed cute animals with various different foods in order to Survive. It is inspired by Survivors-like games and features 3 different game modes.
rows.description_html: Animals have gone crazy. Feed them all to survive the Mayhem! Choose your food and items carefully, try out unique builds each run. Features Manual or Auto Attacks. 23+ Weapons 55+ Items 250+ Upgrade choices Fast Paced Gameplay Difficulty Options Choose between challenging mods or casual mods Game Modes Classic Mode(Fast Pace): Fight againts hordes of animals, Collect gems to level up, Upgrade your character and survive for 15 Minutes. Mayhem Mode(Fast Pace): Enemies get stronger each wave, Open a mysterious box to get a random item or a weapon to upgrade your character. Survive for 15 Waves or try to stay alive as long as you can. Feed all the animals to advance through the next round. Survival Mode(Moderate Pace): Survive for a certain time each round. Buy upgrade from the shop with gold obtained from animals fed. Each run takes 15-20 Minutes.

rows.name: George McGeehan Gamer Hero
rows.short_description: George McGeehan wants to save a cat! Play this chill platformer by jumping onto light fixtures while avoiding annoying enemies!

Install game on Steam Deck then before launch set compatibility to Proton experimental, then change the default controller setting to game controller with gamepad! enjoy! :D Reach level 99 in this casual, chill game. rows.name: Midnight Witch Starlight
rows.short_description: A 90s anime inspired, wave based, 2D run and gun side scroller, where you are a magical girl on the side of light. Load out your arsenal of spells to free the legion of spirits corrupted by the legion of shadow.
rows.description_html: In this 90’s anime-inspired, wave-based, 2D run-and-gun side-scroller, you play as a magical girl on the side of light. Load out your arsenal of spells to free the legion of spirits corrupted by the legion of shadow. Progress through an ever changing forest, to get to the bottom of what's causing the corruption. What is the legion of shadow and what do they want with our world? Defeat waves of enemies to find the truth. With different elements at your disposal, combine them with light to create powerful explosions of magic to push back the dark. Dodge and position yourself to make the most of the spell patterns to deliver the strongest attacks possible. The forest is dangerous though, you'll need help. Meet a mysterious person who offers his wares in exchange for purging the dark. No matter how you choose to play, the forest needs your help to free the light once more. Magical girl character! 4 colorful magic spells! A simple and straightforward side scroller! Big spell explosions! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
