rows.name: Crime Scene Cleaner: Prologue
rows.short_description: When there’s a call, you are the man to clean up after your client’s dirty job. Siding with the mafia is a dangerous game, but they pay well, and you need money, right? So take your mop and better remove those bloodstains quickly before the police come.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the crime scene ...which also happens to be your workplace. Sometimes it’s almost terrific how much of a mess a simple hitman can make, but you’re not here to complain. There’s a reason you took on that job, remember? Your daughter’s life lies in your hands – that’s why you became so good at this. Dispose of bodies and destroy pieces of evidence, all while staying out of the police’s radar. Meet the protagonist in an introduction to his crime scene cleaning struggles. The prologue is free and includes a part of the main character’s story, which takes place in a local entrepreneur’s villa. Discover and hide its dirty secrets using some tools from the full game’s arsenal. Core Features Deep clean the crime scene Activate your cleaner’s sense Destroy crucial pieces of the evidence Explore stories behind the crimes Upgrade your equipment Steal to make more money Stay out of suspicion

rows.name: RAINBOW CREAM SAGA
rows.short_description: Welcome to RAINBOW CREAM SAGA, a kickass melee action survival game with some RPG vibes! You can craft weapons, build bases, capture mounts and much more! Come through on this epic adventure and test out your survival skills.
rows.description_html: Get ready to explore a vast universe with 21 planets spread across 7 epic galaxies, each packing a unique elemental punch. Source Energy (green), Gravitational Energy (purple), Static Energy (blue), Magma Energy (orange), Legendary Energy (yellow), and Anti Energy (red)! On each planet, you'll meet enemies with their own unique weapons. It's not all fun and games tho, cuz each planet is guarded by a wicked Deity. Take 'em down and score some data cubes. You'll need them to triangulate the Ultra Planet, a mind-blowing place with endless resources, rare stuff, and supercharged weapons. And the best part? Ultra crystal gems, baby! Those gems fuel your warp travel, so you better get 'em. Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to craft the elusive Ultra Ring. It's your golden ticket to unlimited fuel and intergalactic travel. But you gotta work for it, defeat that final Deity on the Ultra Planet, and collect that sweet ultra essence. But here's the kicker, you might stumble upon a unicorn on your wild journey. And this ain't no ordinary unicorn – it grants you an infinite amount ultra essence, and the ability to travel across all dimensions. A supreme shortcut to victory! Don't forget to gear up and bring your A-game. Enhance those weapons to counter those elemental baddies. It's all about strategy and skill on this wild ride. Plus, you can tame Deities and ride 'em like a boss! Get those tech traps and show 'em who's the real king of the Galaxy. We got 24 unique weapons, each with its own wild combo set. Power and weakness are the name of the game! Plan your moves wisely as you'll face off against 7 elemental enhancements and powers. Get ready for an electrifying combat experience. So are you ready for this epic adventure? The universe is calling, and it's time to show 'em what you're made of! Take the reins on RAINBOW CREAM SAGA and become the legend you set out to be. Let's go, baby!

rows.name: Cooking Craze
rows.short_description: Cooking Craze is a fast and fun cooking game that lets you explore the cultures of the world through their delicious food! Upgrade your restaurants to serve only the best dishes and use a variety of special boosts to cook your way to victory!
rows.description_html: Cook up a storm serving food from around the world playing our free restaurant game Cooking Craze. Prepare, cook & serve tasty dishes like a professional chef and master the kitchen as you click to grill, bake and cook your way to the top. Bake wood-fired pizza in Rome, grill juicy burgers in New York and prepare fine French cuisine in Paris — but be careful, playing fast isn’t enough! You need to keep your customers happy in order to grow your empire. Can you take the heat, Chef? Cook classic restaurant dishes from across the globe; • Make hundreds of delicious dishes including burgers, pizza, sushi, ramen, dumplings and more • Grill fresh fish, tasty steak, succulent shrimp, and veggie kabobs • Love desserts? Why not deep fry sweet donuts, bake baklava, serve ice cream, cheesecake or cakes? Create a Restaurant Empire! • Choose from over 100 ingredients cooking up tasty cuisine • Create premium dishes with delicious new ingredients • Launch new restaurants while learning new cooking techniques • Add a new recipe from each city you visit • Cook in a variety of settings Level up with Cooking Quests, Powerful Boosts and features! • Serve food fast while managing your time to earn kitchen upgrades • Beat over 4000 levels across six continents • Master all 3 difficulty levels to get golden comment cards to earn free coins and spoons • Dash through service to earn BIG TIPS or work extra shifts to earn money for upgrades • Equip your chef with treats for customers, non-stick pans and MORE! • Upgrade your kitchen & increase your speed • Use a variety of special boosts to cook your way to victory • Cook GREEN with an Eco Boost & go organic for more tips • Win achievements by completing combos, cooking perfect meals & earning big tips The best restaurant gaming experience: • New levels and cities around the world added regularly • Hours of free fun, whenever, wherever you want! • Play online or OFFLINE WITHOUT WIFI or internet after initial download! Download Cooking Craze and create your own kitchen empire!

rows.name: 2099 Gravity Havoc
rows.short_description: Shoot at enemies in a WEIGHTLESS space station to save yourself from burning alive in the atmosphere!
rows.description_html: In 2099 Gravity Havoc The player will play as a special agent trapped on a space station falling into the Earth's Atmosphere. The only way to survive is to collect all the energy cubes scattered across the space station and use them to restart the station's reactor. In the game, the player will have an advanced weapon that can shoot in three different fire modes and a gravity gun that can move objects around. The space station where the player will be fighting is an open map with plenty of resources that the player will need to collect to make ammunition for the weapons, health syringes, and unlock new skills and weapons.

rows.name: Flow Parkour
rows.short_description: A simple yet fun platformer game made with the game engine unity.
rows.description_html: Flow Parkour is a 3D platformer made with the game engine Unity. Early versions of the game caught my friends attention so I took it seriously and decided to publish it. It has an art style that revolves around the infamous cube and a difficulty that will have you smashing your keyboard in 30 minutes. Flow Parkour comes in two game modes, the normal version and the endless version. The normal version, which has around 30 levels on release, is the original game mode. Your target is to make it to the finish of the obstacle course as quick as possible without dying. (getting hit by a turret, falling in a trap...) In most levels you have access to your weapons, sometimes you only have one of the weapons. It depends on the level. Each level has its own difficulty with a given target. Endless is a game mode with a score, you need to rank up the highest score possible while lasting as long as possible with no weapons but a grappler. You need to cross a large map just to collect around a 100 points without dying every time... Flow parkour has 5 difficulties : Easy - A short or simple level Moderate - A short level that has little to no obstacles (such as turrets) Difficult - A longer level that has a bit more obstacles Very difficult - A level with a very hefty amount of buffed turrets or any other obstacles Extreme - A very long and complex level with buffed turrets with a ridiculous amount of obstacles that makes it nearly impossible to finish So what are you waiting for ? Download Flow Parkour today on steam !

rows.name: Only Wish
rows.short_description: Climb to the top and try to defeat Mister Mysterious! Be careful not to fall!
rows.description_html: Only Wish Welcome to 'Only Wish', the next-generation advancement of the acclaimed 'Only Up' genre. Embark on an unparalleled gaming journey enriched with breathtaking landscapes, groundbreaking gameplay, and an array of unique features that set it apart. Uncover Hidden Realms Delve into the heart of mystery. Every door you encounter conceals secrets and untold stories, beckoning you to discover what lies beyond. Revolutionary Vehicular Exploration Why limit your exploration to walking? Jump into a diverse selection of vehicles and traverse the vast expanses of our world. Feel the pulse of authentic driving dynamics and harness the full power of vehicle propulsion. Engaging NPC Dialogues Deepen your immersion with intricate interactions from our varied NPCs. Each conversation is designed to amplify your engagement and propel the storyline. Engage with characters, unravel hidden tales, and make pivotal decisions that could alter the trajectory of your adventure. Enter a realm where dialogue is an art, and every character weaves their own unique narrative.

rows.name: Cyber Space Driver
rows.short_description: This is little project in the spirit of endless runner genre, so as this a real CyberPunk style project, this is... buggy, synthwavy, peace of junk-art. Cyber Space Driver... Drive straight, that's it.
rows.description_html: This is just a student project for fun, that have an idea simple as straight road to space. In spirit of endless runner genre. Choose one of the four cyberpunk style environments (Cyber City top and down, Road to Moon, Mars Desert) and just drive. The project Inspired by synthwave videos on YouTube where music playlist accompanied by 80s style car, which drive through infinite Cyber space. If you wish you have a chance to put your songs to in game radio. Every CyberPunk style game have its own Cyber Bugs. Beware...

rows.short_description: Each time you press the button, it will either double or lose all the points you’ve put in. How much will you risk?
rows.description_html: Recommended for you About the Game 5050 is a simple game of chance. Are you feeling lucky? Insert some points and press the button. They’ll either get doubled or turn to nothing. Your objective is simply to accumulate as many points as possible. It’s up to you how cautious you want to play, but it’s high risk reward. Points in your account are safe, but what fun is safety without progress? With only 2 controls, you must play this game on instinct alone. The game is won once you reach 1 million points, and your progress towards this is shown at the bottom of the screen. You can of course keep playing even after surpassing this goal. Controls: The game was designed with a mouse in mind, but you can also play with the keyboard too: Space = Press the button Arrow keys = Change deposit amount

rows.name: AploVVare Collection
rows.short_description: You found an old game console along with some games at a garage sale. You remember playing these as a kid, and couldn't resist getting it. Maybe you could give them a whirl, just for old time's sake?
rows.description_html: The AploVVare Collection is a collection of small games from the creator of Roseblight, Project Malice, & more! Most games were created for and submitted to game jams, originally created in under 72 hours. Some games are short-term projects, created just for the hell of it. Most have been updated from the original versions to include more content for this collection. Games Included: Terato Tamer - A turn-based strategy game where you seduce monsters to survive Citri Plays Noirwood - A game where you play as a vtuber playing a horror game Reversary - A reverse boss battle game where you are the big guy with a big sword Hellfire Pizza - A game where you deliver pizza... in HELL WELD - An atmospheric game where you fuse weapons to survive the wilderness ...and more!

rows.name: Waking Up: Way Back Home
rows.short_description: A child infiltrates a spaceship to carry out a secret rescue mission. His objective is compromised when they must make a forced landing on a strange planet. Explore this mysterious place, overcome obstacles, and find the way back home!
rows.description_html: When Earth became an uninhabitable place, humans were forced to live in space. Captain Urus Kramp, governor of the mothership Babylon 3, founded a new civilization and organized intergalactic exploration missions alongside Sub-Officer Leonard Thoran. Years later, Roby, Leonard's son, leaves Babylon 3 and infiltrates a ship heading to an unknown planet where he believes his father is located. Face danger with Roby and join him on his epic mission to uncover what's happening with Captain Urus Kramp and Babylon 3. Will he unveil the mystery, find his father, and return home? His destiny is in your hands. Key features: Third-person adventure. Immersive story. Atmospheric scenarios. Puzzle solving. Relaxing gameplay. Decision making. Exploration and secrets. Alternate endings.

rows.name: Electoral Dynasty
rows.short_description: A political-simulation watch-the-clock strategy game. Pass laws, executive orders, and deal with events, all while maintaining the balance of your nation's most important attributes. Will you manage to keep your coalition together or establish a dictatorship? Only you can decide, Prime Minister.
rows.description_html: Become the Prime Minister of one of many nations, each with its own strengths and weaknesses. You must keep your job by balancing the agenda of the various parties forming your coalition while also ensuring that your country stays healthy through various decisions. Will you pursue free market capitalism, install a planned economy with workers at the forefront, or strike a balance between the two? Will you form a brutal police state or pursue individual freedoms for all your citizens? The choice is yours... By approving or vetoing Bills and Executive Orders from all sects of the political spectrum, you must ensure that values intrinsic to national health, such as the strength of the military and the quality of education, maintain balanced. You also need to make sure that you're doing enough to make the people want to keep your party in power. Features: - Over 200 Bills, Executive Orders, and Events, making each play through experience distinct - 7 political parties to choose from, falling on all points of the political spectrum - 4 nations with distinct advantages and disadvantages

rows.short_description: We insist on fair competition, and focus on testing players' strategic intelligence and teamwork. We are committed to creating a user-friendly game, so that every player can easily enter the game, enjoy the glory of the ancient civilization, and feel the endless fun of conquest.
rows.description_html: [Game Bonuses] The Early Access Test will open on December 20th. Enter the exchange code: COE888 in the game, and you can get 888 diamonds and 6 kinds of rare items. Join Conquest of Empires 2. Discover the charm of civilization, and enjoy the joy of conquest! rows.name: Jissou Land
rows.short_description: Jissou Land is a simple clicker game that grow a cute little creature, 'Jissouseki'.
rows.description_html: Jissou Land is a light clicker game. Increasing Jissouseki Population Get rainwater in a bucket, water the grass, and give Jissouseki flowers that grew. Jissouseki, who received the flower, gives birth to a child, makes a Poop hole and collects Jissouseki's poop, and repeats this process to further develop! Give the child enough food and he will soon grow into an adult. Battle of Wild Jissouseki In Jissouseki's world, power is the law. Send Jissouseki to fight and grow Jissouseki stronger. Jissouseki, who has exhausted his HP during the battle, has a broken stone and can never be turned back. (More features and content will be added in the future!)

rows.name: Tales Up
rows.short_description: Your choices. Your adventures. Become the heroes of the Tales Up universe! You decide which path to take. Choose your team wisely and explore a new kind of role-playing game with Tales Up, the interactive multiplayer adventure video game.
rows.description_html: Be the hero of the story! In Tales Up, you are the masters of your destiny. You decide which path to take, if you should trust that beggar who claims she can see the future, which one of you should give their life to save the others… Discover unique adventures Each adventure is unique! Want some conflict? Choose a Survival story! An ounce of magic? Choose a Fantasy story! Each story has artwork, a soundtrack and unique animations… and for those who don’t like overly-long stories, we’ve even got series! Play the way you like You decide until the end, and that includes the game mode. - Tabletop mode : share the experience physically with your relatives; in a bar with friends, during a family dinner, with your colleagues... - Online mode : enjoy adventures with the person you choose from all over the world. - Solo mode : take control of your team of adventurers. Progression & Collection You can customize your avatar with different trinkets and goodies. For the more curious among you, you can accomplish missions by exploring secrets in the stories, and level up to earn more rewards! Regular releases New content comes out regularly: new stories, new objects, new characters. Tales Up is a cooperative role-playing game combining board games and gamebooks such as 'books in which you are the hero'. But it's also very easy to learn, so it's perfect to bring fun when having a few drinks in the evening! You'll find stories about zombies, pirates and Vikings... Funny situations and surprises guaranteed! Key Features : - Unique Adventures - Play in the mode of your choice - Individual progress - Updates and new content added regularly - Impactful multiplayer features Enter the world of Tales Up and become the hero of your own story. Get ready for unforgettable adventures! We are an independent french studio made up of a team of passionate people, we hope you have a great time! NB: The game is free to install and you will have free access to all the first episodes of the series to try them out. The complete stories must then be purchased individually via in-game currency (for a fee) or via the Adventurer's Pass, which contains all the stories and more. After a mobile version and also a web browser version, Tales Up arrives on Steam.

rows.name: Tip of the Tongue
rows.short_description: Boost your English vocabulary with this engaging survival puzzler! Guess objects, learn, and progress through diverse categories.
rows.description_html: Tip of the Tongue: The Ultimate Word Association Game! Everyone's been there: knowing what something looks like, but unable to find the word for it. 'Tip of the Tongue' transforms that experience into a thrilling game, pushing your vocabulary skills to the limit. Game Features: Survival Mode: Keep up the pace! Identify objects correctly to stay in the game. Stumble too much, and it's the end of the line. Vast Categories: From birds and celebrities to kitchen appliances and tools, there's always a fresh challenge awaiting. Educational & Entertaining: Whether you're an English learner or a native speaker, this game offers an enjoyable way to sharpen your language skills. Flexible Gameplay: Dive in for a quick challenge or indulge in extended play sessions. It's all about how much you're ready to test yourself! With 'Tip of the Tongue,' learning becomes an adventure. Can you keep up with the pace and master the vast expanse of the English language? Dive in and find out!

rows.name: Guidelicious
rows.short_description: A short, interactive visual novel about waking up in a strange room with a mysterious man. But why are you here? Let Him be your Guide to the truth.
rows.description_html: Guidelicious is a short, interactive visual novel about waking up in a strange room with a mysterious man. Engage in a fully voice acted story as every powerless move forward leads you closer to the truth of why you're here... hopefully. <1,000 words (10-15 minutes of playtime)! Fully voiced! 1 animated Guide + 1 interactive background! 5 endings! Nameable female protagonist! 9 Steam achievements! This game was made for the O2A2 VN Jam 2023, a micro Visual Novel jam with strict asset limitations and a 1000 word limit.

You can jump an infinite amount of times while mid-air but you cannot stop your horizontal momentum. Watch out for death blocks because they will certainly be your doom. rows.name: At Winter's End
rows.short_description: At Winter's End is a cozy narrative dice-rolling RPG about 12-year-old Noel growing up in the forest of spirits. Explore the forest and complete quests while rolling dice to see how Noel responds to the challenges they face.
rows.description_html: Every Winter gives way to Spring. For most people, this is a passive event: something that happens naturally thanks to the positions of hemispheres and stars. But I know the reason why Winter ends. I know because the Wind told me. At Winter's End is a cozy narrative dice-rolling RPG about 12-year-old Noel growing up in the forest of spirits. Explore the forest and complete quests while rolling dice to see how Noel responds to the challenges they face. Play as Noel, a 12-year-old child who has grown up exploring the lakes and woods surrounding their home. These are no ordinary woods, however, and in these woods, Noel has befriended the spirits of the woods. The Wind, Lake, and Stone are just a few of their best friends. Stone, the oldest spirit of nature, told them once that nature only appears to the youngest humans, and that one day they'd no longer be able to see nature the same way. Thirteen years is all they get with these friends. Every winter, it's Stone's job to explain to Winter that the season is over and it's time to leave. But this year, Stone is sick and has lost its voice, so Noel is tasked with speaking to Winter in just one week's time. On the Spring Equinox, Noel's birthday, they must talk to Winter and ask it to allow spring to come. Along the way, Noel will have to assist the spirits of the forest in preparing for spring, talking to them, exploring the forest and helping them make tough decisions with the help of their trusty dice. Along the way, Noel will learn about responsibility, growing up, and eventually, how to say goodbye. Join Noel as they spend one last season in the forest of their childhood in At Winter’s End. Discover a cozy interactive narrative and meet a charming cast of forest spirits and animals. Explore the forest of Noel's childhood, finding old trinkets and new friends as you go. Roll dice and make decisions to help the spirits of the forest prepare for spring. Customize and upgrade your dice to prepare for Noel's final encounter with the spirit of Winter.

rows.name: On Call
rows.short_description: On Call is a visual novel that takes you through a 3-day rotation at Merritt General Hospital. Build trust with your patients and their families to get them on the road to recovery. Manage your own stress while confronting these challenges or you may just crack under the pressure.
rows.description_html: About the Game On Call is a visual novel that invites you to work a rotation at Merritt General Hospital to learn about stress management for workers in the healthcare industry. Key Features During your rotation at Merritt General Hospital, you’ll encounter a diverse group of patients facing challenging ailments and disorders. Build trust and rapport with them to help them recover from their maladies. Manage your own stress while confronting these challenges or you may just crack under the pressure. Choice Driven Narrative Make dialogue choices to influence patient outcomes and manage your stress level as you work through your rotation. Overcome their objections to help your patients make healthy choices to improve their conditions. Manage Stress Build trust with your patients and use breaks to manage your stress level effectively. Don't forget to take a moment to decompress every now and then. Patient Tracking Utilize patient SOAP notes to track the treatment progress and decisions made for each patient. Remember to check your clipboard regularly to remain informed on each patient.

Welcome to Summoner's Defense, an immersive and strategic tower defense game that will test your skills as a master summoner. Gather your wits, harness the power of the elements, and lead your forces against hordes of relentless enemies in this captivating fantasy world. Summoner's Defense offers a unique twist on traditional tower defense games. As a summoner, you'll have the ability to conjure various mystical creatures and legendary guardians to defend. You must strategically place these entities along the enemy's path, leveraging their diverse abilities and attributes to thwart waves of intruders.

rows.name: Yujiro's Mansion
rows.short_description: As a thief who does his job well, you stumble across a mansion. What you didn't know was that this mansion belonged to the 'Strongest Creature In The World', Yujiro Hanma. Can you rob Yujiro's Mansion and get out alive?
rows.description_html: You're a robber going around a neighborhood doing what you do best. After robbing many houses you stumble across a huge mansion. You break into the mansion, but what you didn't know was that this mansion belonged to the 'Strongest Creature In The World.' The Pinnacle of Physical Force, Yujiro Hanma. Can you rob Yujiro's Mansion and get out alive? This is the first game I've made with a game engine. Let me know what you guys think and what bugs I could fix. Enjoy! Features - Singleplayer - Survival Horror - Stealth - Multiple Endings (Secret Ending, if you can find how to get it!) - Immersive Atmosphere - Hidden Collectibles - Easy to learn controls - Fluid Player Movement - Added in UI crosshair which changes color to denote which objects are interactable - AI stalking you around a dark mansion. Run, hide, or die. - After grabbing all the items, Yujiro's AI will get faster and harder to read. - Additional AI visibility if you go for the secret ending (view angles and radius changes)

rows.name: RegicideX
rows.short_description: RegicideX is a 3D Hack'n Slash that takes place in a dark fantasy world plagued with rotten and evil angels and possesed people who have invaded the castle of our Lord. You will have to fight in order to liberate your castle and overcome the invasion.
rows.description_html: Is a 3D Hack'n Slash inspired by games like Nier Automata, Devil May Cry, Bayonetta and Hades. It takes place in a dark fantasy world plagued with rotten and evil angels (visually inspired by biblically accurate angels) and possesed people who have invaded the castle of our protagonist. Our protagonist fights in a series of consecutives arenas, each one with multiple waves featuring different enemies, until he reaches the throne and overcomes the invasion. Failure means starting again from the beginning. The game is fast paced and movility is key, giving importance to dashes, dodges, jumps (and double jumps) and well timing attacks from the attack toolset the player has available. The player also has access to limited powers useful for combat. Each attack or action is suitable for a particular situation or enemy. The final wave of each arena presents a new angel as a final boss to put the player's skills to test and overcome the arena, being able to advance to the next one.

rows.name: VAHLUNA CORP.
rows.short_description: Confront the alien invaders head-on, but risk dwindling ammo and their sharpshooting abilities, or take the stealthy path, sneaking around, and seeking hidden vents and passageways to outmaneuver his enemies.
rows.description_html: In a quiet little town, there lived an unassuming character named Blorp. He was just an average guy, spending his days working hard and dreaming of a better life. Every evening, after finishing his mundane job, Blorp would kick off his worn-out boots, settle down on his comfy couch, and watch the news while eagerly waiting for the weekly lotto draw. Little did he know that his life was about to take an extraordinary turn. One fateful evening, as Blorp watched the lotto draw, he couldn't believe his eyes when the numbers on the screen matched the ones on his ticket. He had won the Mega Jackpot, an unimaginable sum that promised to change his life forever. However, Blorp's elation was short-lived as, in that very moment, a strange noise echoed from the sky outside. Before he could grasp the situation, he found himself sucked up into a blinding beam of light, transporting him to an otherworldly space vessel. The Vahluna Corporation, a mysterious and powerful alien organization, was behind this abduction. Blorp, now trapped within the alien spaceship, realized that he wasn't the only human on board. It appeared that the Vahluna Corporation had abducted other innocent beings from various planets across the universe. With newfound courage and determination, Blorp knew that he had to find a way to escape and expose the truth about these malevolent aliens to the world. As he explored the vast spacecraft, he discovered that he had two choices: confront the alien invaders head-on, but risk dwindling ammo and their sharpshooting abilities, or take the stealthy path, sneaking around, and seeking hidden vents and passageways to outmaneuver his enemies. Throughout his daring journey, Blorp would encounter different types of aliens, each with unique abilities and behaviors. He would have to use his wits, cunning, and the resources he finds along the way to outsmart these extraterrestrial adversaries. The spacecraft itself would be a labyrinth of advanced technology, filled with mysterious rooms, high-tech gadgets, and secrets waiting to be uncovered. As Blorp delves deeper into the alien vessel, he begins to uncover the sinister motives behind the Vahluna Corporation's actions and their plans for Earth. The fate of not only Blorp but also the entire human race now lies in his hands. Will he successfully locate the escape pods and make it back to Earth to warn everyone about the impending alien threat? Or will he succumb to the challenges and malevolence of the Vahluna Corporation, becoming just another forgotten captive on their ship? Embark on this thrilling sci-fi adventure with Blorp, as players must make strategic choices, solve puzzles, and outmaneuver the alien enemies to secure a path to freedom and save humanity from the looming extraterrestrial peril.

rows.name: Code Name: Operation Dawn
rows.short_description: In 'Operation Dawn,' you play as a mother who recently lost her son. Now, with her husband kidnapped by terrorists, she joins a secret organization to rescue him. Navigate an open world with dynamic NPCs and cars, and embark on high-stakes missions in the covert Operation Dawn.
rows.description_html: In 'Operation Dawn,' players step into the shoes of a determined mother who recently lost her son, brutally killed in a tragic event at his military base. In the wake of this devastating loss, her husband is kidnapped by a ruthless terrorist group. Driven by love and a thirst for justice, she joins a secret organization dedicated to taking down these terrorists and rescuing her husband. Set in a vast open world filled with dynamic NPCs and customizable vehicles, players will navigate through treacherous environments, gather intelligence, and engage in high-stakes missions as part of the covert Operation Dawn.

rows.name: Rings of Harmony
rows.short_description: Rings Of Harmony est un jeu de puzzle médiéval-fantastique VR dans lequel vous interagissez avec votre environnement pour mener à bien votre quête. Attirez des objets, lancez-les et tracez des lignes pour sauver le monde de la destruction dans un environnement immersif.
rows.description_html: Incarnez Elea, une jeune magicienne ayant pour but de sauver le monde de la destruction dans un environnement médiéval-fantastique. Dans ce jeu solo narratif, vous vous plongez dans l’histoire et combinez vos capacités physiques et mentales pour progresser dans l’avancée de votre quête. Le monde est régi par le grand principe d’Harmonie et celui-ci est en danger. L’Harmonie est composée de six principes : la nature, l’artéfact, la magie, la sorcellerie, la dualité et l’unité. Ces six principes ont été matérialisés et contenus dans des anneaux et un événement a perturbé leur équilibre, les endommageant. Il va falloir les réparer pour rétablir cet équilibre et empêcher la fin du monde. --- Play as Elea, a young magician whose goal is to save the world from destruction in a medieval-fantasy setting. In this single-player narrative game, you immerse yourself in the story and combine your physical and mental abilities to advance your quest. The world is governed by the great principle of Harmony, and it's in danger. Harmony is made up of six principles: nature, artifact, magic, sorcery, duality and unity. These six principles have been materialized and contained in rings, and an event has upset their balance, damaging them. They must now be repaired to restore balance and prevent the end of the world.

rows.short_description: A ragdoll physics infinite runner
rows.description_html: A classic Infinite Runner game with an amusing twist-- Ragdoll physics. Run, flop, and tumble your way through the chaotic city with law enforcement hot on your tail! - Collect coins along your journey to unlock new skins. - Dodge obstacles: Cars, buildings, and other challenges that block a clear path through the city. - Beat your own high score in this novel infinite runner. - Have fun when you fail-- Enjoy the show as you watch your limp body flail around.

rows.name: I will make you scared of this Red Box.
rows.short_description: The Red Cube wants to eat all of the pills in the hospital. The problem is that he has already had WAY too many! You need to collect all of the the pills in the facility so that he doesn't eat any more. Be careful though...The Cube REALLY likes his pills...
rows.description_html: The Red Cube wants to eat all of the pills in the hospital. The problem is that he has already had WAY too many! You need to collect all of the the pills in the facility so that he doesn't eat any more. Be careful though...The Cube REALLY likes his pills... Inspired by previous indie horror games, join the Red Cube and the rest of the hospital staff in a search for the pills in a first person shooter horror experience! Use the stun gun to stun the cube before he gets you and reload at the vending machines when needed. You also need to watch out for the hospital staff and make sure they don't get in your way. You will need to avoid the doctor, the nurse, and the facility house spider and not get caught by their antics which can slow you down. - Collect the 9 pills while avoiding the Red Cube. - Don't get lost in the maze of hospital rooms. - Use your stun gun to temporarily freeze the Red Cube (you will need it). - Reload the stun gun by standing next to 1 of 3 vending machines for 5 seconds. - Avoid the Doctor. - Avoid the Nurse. - Avoid the Spider. [Warning] This game does contain jump scares and spider scares, play at your own risk. This game is designed to be challenging (I can barely beat it myself).

rows.name: Up Against Aliens
rows.short_description: Navigate cosmic debris using time-bending tech in this 3D platformer. Solve puzzles and thwart the alien threat across shifting landscapes. Will you be Earth's unexpected savior when you go Up Against Aliens?
rows.description_html: Roadmap We are making the game free to play in hopes of more people trying it out and challenging peoples high scores in the mini games! About the Game Welcome to the mind-bending adventure of 'Up Against Aliens,' a captivating 3D platform puzzle game that will challenge your wit, reflexes, and courage. Prepare to embark on a journey through space, mystery, and intergalactic peril. Unveil the Extraterrestrial Enigma: As you wake up to the echoes of a thunderous explosion, you are thrust into a bewildering world where the rules of reality have been shattered. Your quest begins in your apartment, but the moment you step outside, you realize something unthinkable has occurred—your entire building is suspended in the cosmos among a chaotic sea of debris. An Unlikely Ally: Amidst the cosmic turmoil, you encounter a weathered and enigmatic old man who shares a chilling revelation—he believes he witnessed an entity spiriting away into the maelstrom of floating detritus. With urgency etched into every word, he urges you to hasten upwards, setting the stage for an odyssey that will test your every skill and intellect. Master Time-Bending Mechanics: Your journey will lead you to a discovery that changes the very fabric of your mission—a device that bends time for the swirling debris while leaving you unaffected. With this ingenious tool, you can manipulate the flow of time for the platforms you traverse, turning tumultuous terrain into calculated pathways. Harness this newfound power to leap from one platform to another with grace and precision. Conquer Puzzles and Challenges: As you navigate the treacherous expanse of space, you'll encounter moments of impasse that demand more than reflexes alone. Solve intricate puzzles that blend physics, logic, and creativity to forge a path forward. Traverse shifting landscapes, manipulate gravitational forces, and unlock hidden mechanisms, all while piecing together the puzzle of what has happened to your city. Battle Beyond the Stars: The climax of your journey looms as you finally confront the alien spaceship. Engage in an epic showdown that tests not only your mastery of time manipulation but also your bravery in the face of overwhelming odds. The fate of Earth itself, hinges on your ability to overcome this otherworldly menace. Dive into the immersive world of 'Up Against Aliens' and experience a fusion of heart-pounding action and brain-teasing puzzles that will keep you on the edge of your seat. Uncover the truth and become the unlikely hero in a story that spans the cosmos. The challenge awaits—do you have what it takes to triumph over the unknown?

rows.name: One-armed robber
rows.short_description: One-armed robber is a chaotic first-person heist game that centers around a uniquely challenging premise. Players take the role of a determined robber equipped with only one arm, tasked with pulling off daring heists on banks, shops, and various establishments.
rows.description_html: Experience the challenge of robbing banks, but now with only one arm! Grab a friend and you'll have two arms in total. Unlock and buy new guns, which can be customized to fit your playstyle. If you are trying to go stealth, the optimal choice might be a suppressor, but if you're going loud, damage and bullets is all that matters, so put on an extended mag and get going! Each heist is suited for any playstyle, whether you want to sneak in and take out guards quietly, or you go in guns blazing shooting everthing in your sight until you reach the vault, the choice is yours. As you become a more experienced robber new tools will be unlocked, which will make it easier for you to complete the heists. Each tool has a special purpose, and unique tools make it possible to complete heists in new ways you couldn't do before. Whether you go loud or stealth, once you are in the vault, the objective is the same: Gather as much loot as possible, and get out alive! If you can't fit all the loot in the vault in your duffel bag, you can either run back to the truck and get a new one, or get your friends to help you carry out everything!

rows.name: The Balls
rows.short_description: The game 'The Balls' is perfect if you're stuck in comp sci class, killing time at work when the boss isn't watching, or even just to get your brain fired up. But dude, make sure to play it with friends, 'cause playing solo is kinda lame...
rows.description_html: Probably the SIMPLEST but HARDEST FPS in history. This is a simple, free game that you can play at school during computer science class , at work when the boss isn't looking , or when you just want to warm up your mind instead of morning coffee. 'The Balls' is not just another PVP FPS (Battle Royale) game. It redefines the freedom of movement in a virtual world. Breaking the boundaries of usual running and flying, we offer players complete freedom as geometric spheres, unrestricted by gravity or centrifugal forces. Unlimited Freedom of Movement Imagine a world where you can instantly reach any location without physical limitations. This dynamic changes everything you know about strategies and tactics in Battle Royale games. Community and Communication In 'The Balls', community is our priority. A simple and transparent communication system allows for easy connection with other players. Create lobbies, join matches, and invite friends with the press of a single button. Family-Friendly Graphics Our game is free from blood and explicit violence. Instead, players compete by attacking abstract, geometric shapes. Perfect for players of all ages. Ranking System An advanced ranking system tracks your daily, monthly, and overall results. Get ready for the introduction of clan duels and periodic tournaments, offering a new level of competition. Key Features: MULTIPLAYER Deathmatch and Battle Royale. The most dynamic movement mechanism. Global rankings and achievements. Vibrant, cartoon-style graphics. Simple communication system. Strategic build-and-destroy mechanics. Unique arenas for various battle strategies. Upcoming Features Clan Creation: Organize and manage your own clan in 'The Balls'. Monthly Tournaments: Compete for prizes in regular tournaments. Map Creation Mode: Design and share your own maps, offering extraordinary creativity to players. Join the 'The Balls' community today and experience unparalleled freedom of movement and exciting competition!

rows.name: KILLFISH
rows.short_description: Welcome to KILLFISH. In this Action/FPS game, you'll dive into a captivating world where robots have taken control on a factory. Embark on an epic adventure filled with a unique hook mechanic that will give you freedom to explore and kill in flashy ways.
rows.description_html: Welcome to KILLFISH , an immersive gaming experience that will take you on a journey like no other. In this Action/FPS game, you'll dive into a captivating world where robots have taken control on a factory. Embark on an epic adventure filled with a unique hook mechanic that will give you freedom to explore and kill in flashy ways. Key Features · Fast-pace movement mechanics: Immerse yourself in a fast-pace world in which you will have to use the hook and move fast in order to kill all enemies. · Stunning Visuals: Dive into a visually stunning world where every detail is meticulously crafted to bring KILLFISH's universe to life. From breathtaking illumination to intricately designed characters, prepare to be amazed. · Customization Options: Tailor your gameplay to your liking with an array of customization options. Express your personal gameplay style as you explore KILLFISH's levels. · Unique Style Meter: Kill in flashy ways to improve your score and buy the upgrades such as the explosive sniper.

rows.name: Tricky Doors
rows.short_description: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the 'escape the room' genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests.
rows.description_html: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the 'escape the room' genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests. You can open a lot of different doors. Behind each door, you will find hostile and friendly worlds, as well as familiar and exotic landscapes. Your task is always the same - you need to leave the place where the game sent you this time through a portal to move forward. Solve puzzles and find hidden objects. Many of them will be familiar to you. Some of them you'll see for the first time. Can you use all of them to find a way out? Challenge your quick-wittedness! Fantastic locations and beautiful graphics Unique escape stories Exciting search for hidden objects Challenging mini-games Will be interesting for both beginners and experienced players

rows.name: CIPHER-8
rows.short_description: CIPHER-8 is a brain-twisting minimalist arcade puzzler where you push numbers into a grid and manipulate them with randomly drawn special abilities! Play blitz mode for frantic combo streaks, or analyze every move in puzzle mode. Both scale infinitely in their difficulty. How far can you go?
rows.description_html: 🎊 CELEBRATING 8 YEARS SINCE THE RELEASE OF THE VIRTUAL FANTASY CONSOLE PICO-8, THIS TITLE IS RELEASED AS A FREE GAME! 🎊 You just couldn't let go of your dream to become some sort of cyberpunk Robin Hood, so you invented a device that connects your brain to the inner world of a high-security safe’s digital lock. Somewhat irritated, the safe suggests you play a game to make up for your intrusion. Lose and be locked in forever, or win to attain unimaginable wealth (to redistribute among those in need of course). Can you crack the cipher? CIPHER-8 is a brain-twisting game where you push numbers into a grid. Well, numbers or all kinds of manipulatory tricks (also known as 'special abilities' ). Or bombs apparently. Anyways, after all it’s about making the total value of each column match its goal value. However, changing one column affects the others as well. Oh and by the way, bonus points if you manage to plan ahead a few turns to keep your cipher streak going in the process! There are two game modes: ⚡️ BLITZ asks you to reach a target score in just 90 seconds, so you better get that brain juice flowing fast! 🧩 PUZZLE mode on the other hand is all about planning since there’s no timer, but you lose energy if you go without scoring for too many turns. Both modes track your skill and become more challenging every time you beat them . Note: This game is made using the virtual fantasy console PICO-8 (digipad + 2 buttons), but controls just fine via keyboard (arrows + X and C) or pretty much any controller. 💻 Design & Code: Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur) 🎶 Dynamic music: @muse_energy

rows.name: Ocean Protector
rows.short_description: Ocean Protector is a free online educational game that teaches students about the impacts of ocean acidification and how they can take action to prevent it.
rows.description_html: Overview Ocean Protector is a free educational game that teaches students about the impacts of ocean acidification and how they can take action to prevent it. Through a series of interactive decisions and evaluations, students will learn about the causes and effects of ocean acidification and evaluate solutions that can help reduce its impact on marine ecosystems and people. This decision-driven experience helps students construct explanations, reason effectively, and become self-directed learners involving marine science and ocean literacy. Option to play in browser If you would prefer to play the game in your browser, feel free to go to the Outreach Games website by clicking the ' Visit the website ' button on the External Links section of the page. For educators Note for educators: lesson plans, guides to Next Generation Science Standards, and examples of module integration are also provided at the Outreach Games website.

rows.name: Shadow Overlord: The Beginning
rows.short_description: As a player, you will have to lead your armies of undead and magical creatures to expand Your empire and defeat your enemies. With an exciting plot and a challenging gameplay, this game will take you through epic and dangerous adventure battles while you become the most powerful ruler.
rows.description_html: Shadow Overlord: The Beginning Become the Lord of Shadows in our exciting indie strategy game! Engage in challenging medieval battles as you command an army of the undead on your quest for domination. Lead your dark creatures in the conquest of towns and castles, all while immersing yourself in a captivating fantasy world. Experience the thrill of real-time strategy as you take control of your army and plunge into epic battles. The side camera puts you in the center of the action, allowing you to watch your every move on the battlefield. Become the essence of a dark entity and make crucial decisions to upgrade and evolve your units, preparing them for the ultimate challenge. Develop your army of the undead as you collect magical essence from the places you ravage and conquer. Use this energy to summon the great Dark Lord, an entity of unimaginable power that will turn the tide of battle in your favor. Discover the satisfaction of strategizing and seeing your tactics unfold on the battlefield. With a polygon graphic style that adds a unique touch to the game, you will be immersed in a dark and captivating world. Do you have what it takes to lead your dark hosts to victory? Master the strategy, evolve your units and make the medieval kingdoms tremble under your power. Get ready for an intense and exciting strategy experience in our indie game, where the fate of your undead army and the quest for ultimate power rest in your hands!

Develop your army of the undead as you collect magical essence from the places you ravage and conquer. Use this energy to summon the great Dark Lord, an entity of unimaginable power that will turn the tide of battle in your favor. Discover the satisfaction of strategizing and seeing your tactics unfold on the battlefield. With a polygon graphic style that adds a unique touch to the game, you will be immersed in a dark and captivating world. Do you have what it takes to lead your dark hosts to victory? Master the strategy, evolve your units and make the medieval kingdoms tremble under your power. Get ready for an intense and exciting strategy experience in our indie game, where the fate of your undead army and the quest for ultimate power rest in your hands!

rows.name: Mad Viking Games: VR Experience
rows.short_description: Introducing the Mad Viking Games: VR Experience. Immerse yourself in an all-round experience of the Viking life. Not only will you be able to grab any sort of weapon or shield, but you will also have the ability to roam the hall of the races.
rows.description_html: Introducing the Mad Viking Games: VR Experience . Immerse yourself in an all-round experience of the Viking life. Not only will you be able to grab any sort of weapon or shield, but you will also have the ability to roam the hall of the races . The hall will offer the player the ability to visualize the future characters of the Mad Viking Games universe, starting out with the Humans and the Trolls . Enter each room and get a highly detailed version of every character, you can also interact with a smaller version of each character. Not only will you have the ability to visualize every character, but we have also added essential activities for you to enjoy the Viking lifestyle. The first and most important of all: fire . Get ready to use your torch to light your way around the hall . Remember that some braziers can light up the fire from your torch ! Of course, the last activity was lying. DRINKING is the most important part of the Norse experience . Enjoy some mead alongside the shields of the Mad Viking Games world. Beer stations will be available for you to fill your pint infinitely, exactly how the Gods intended it! Grab a weapon and destroy your enemies! You will have the ability to wield the Mjolnir , the hammer from the son of Odin . Use it to smash rocks and transform them into little pieces. Smashing not your style? No worries, we have Surtr's sword ! Slash your dummies with ease and transform each piece into molten lava. Fancy a little competition? Take some axes and throw them at the target! Compete with your friends to see how many you can stick to the highlighted sections. Remember to check your windows ! There might be a little peek into the unknown...

rows.name: Mission: Space
rows.short_description: After the Earth exploded, the fate of the Earth is in your hands. By creatively building your own spaceship, you'll fight your way through space against pirates. On your journey you will meet many different life forms, some with good, others with bad intentions.
rows.description_html: After the Earth exploded, the fate of the Earth is in your hands. By creatively building your own spaceship, you'll fight your way through space against pirates. On your journey you will meet many different life forms, some with good, others with bad intentions. After the Earth exploded, the pirates collected the last remnants to generate energy. As one of the last survivors, it is your task to explore the planets. These play an important role in the fight against the pirates, because on them you can mine various materials, as well as trade with the inhabitants to create more components for your rather small spaceship. On your journey through space, it will happen more often that pirates attack you. To progress further, you'll have to defeat them to get money to trade with. When you have enough equipment, you can face different bosses that will test your combat experience. Once you have defeated them, you will receive very special rewards. Shape your spaceship: As you progress through the game, you will unlock more and more different components, whether through trade or crafting. You can use these to upgrade your ship and make it stronger. In a construction menu, you can build the spaceship as it suits your play style to wipe out the pirates. Materials: Ores and important materials can be mined on planets and exchanged for money to buy other materials or objects, or you can keep it for yourself and collect more materials to upgrade your spaceship without having to buy stuff extra. Pirates: After a short explanation and briefing from your on-board computer, you'll have to prove yourself in a first battle, but be on your guard. There are different types of enemy ships and each one has special properties as a result, which can quickly make you stagger. Story: The goal is to expand your spaceship more and more, defeat all the pirates, and in doing so you will encounter different challenges that you must overcome. If you have upgraded your spaceship well enough, you can face various bosses that deliver a completely different combat experience. If you defeat the boss, you not only get special rewards, but you also recapture the stolen parts of Earth from the pirates until you have collected them all. Once you've captured all the pieces of the Earth, you'll be able to patch them back together.

rows.name: Egyptian Ratslap - Card Game
rows.short_description: Enjoy a laid-back session of your new favorite card game that mixes the rules of slap jack and more!
rows.description_html: As you enter the game, you will be welcomed with the smooth jazz music and the main menu screen. From there you can configure settings, look at a detailed instructions on the rules of the card game, or go right ahead and play the game! The aim of the game is to make the player use short term memorization skills to beat 3 bots who are all trying to have the most cards to win the game. And don't forget that anyone in the game can slap back in once they have lost all of their cards so make sure you keep track of what cards have been placed or you might be in trouble. Once a player has reached 52 cards, they have won Egyptian Ratslap!

rows.name: Viral
rows.short_description: Stylized sci-fi FPS shooter
rows.description_html: Viral is a fast-paced campaign based First Person Shooter with stylized enemy AI behavior. Set in the digital realm, you are the Firewall tasked with stopping a computer virus from infecting all programs. Equipped with an array of weapons and your wits, you will have to fight hordes of infected programs, explore vibrant digital environments and solve puzzles in order to progress. Are you the savior the Server needs?

rows.name: Birds Aren't Real: The Game
rows.short_description: Birds Aren’t Real is a 3D sandbox game with a comic twist.Based on the real-life satirical conspiracy theory, play as a government surveillance pigeon drone, using sneaky maneuvers and creative thinking to manipulate the citizens and dispel their suspicions about the government's avian task force.
rows.description_html: Birds Aren’t Real is a 3D sandbox game with a comic twist. Based on the real-life satirical conspiracy theory, play as a government surveillance pigeon drone, using sneaky maneuvers and creative thinking to manipulate the citizens and dispel their suspicions about the government's avian task force. Fly around to explore and surveil your surroundings! Sabotage the conspiracists working against your organization! Deploy your poop in order to undermine your political detractors! Birds Aren’t Real aims to find some humor in a time of misinformation and distrust. It's a game for anyone that may need a brief escape from what at times can seem like an overwhelming and deeply pessimistic world. We invite anyone and everyone to give our game a try!

rows.name: Subject Debris
rows.short_description: Subject Debris is an indie 3D Dungeon-crawler game
rows.description_html: Subject Debris is an indie 3D Dungeon-crawler game You will play as Reid, a person with memory loss, who wakes up in an abandoned laboratory. Your mission is to go deep into the last floor and destroy a dangerous test subject. - Level up your character, loot and equip weapon - Freely change between third or first person view - Two different story route (will update more in future) - Kill monster or run away from them, it's your choice - Use 'Night vision' to navigate in darkness

rows.name: King of Avalon
rows.short_description: Summon your Dragon and be the King of Frost and Flame in Avalon!
rows.description_html: King Arthur fell in battle, a victim of the betrayal of his nephew Mordred. Now, his body lies in a fortress on the sacred Isle of Avalon next to his powerful sword, Excalibur. It is only when Excalibur is raised again that a new king again will be crowned and the kingdom will be unified. The whole empire has been split into cities fighting each other. Many desire the power and magic of Excalibur but there is only room for one in the king's throne... King of Avalon is set in a fantasy medieval England bringing back the legend of King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table. Build a mighty city, raise a greater army, master war strategy skills for an intelligent strategy to go to battle, train your magic dragon and wage war against your medieval enemy! Join a multiplayer alliance to survive every enemy assault and increase your chances of succeeding! The great war between kings is about to begin! Build the most powerful empire ever! Raise your dragon and build your army in the PvP quest to lift Excalibur and become King. Taste power and victory while making friends and enemies along the way. Chat, help, trade, and wage war with players around the globe in a multiplayer adventure. King Arthur’s death has left an empty throne... Get ready to get medieval! The epic battle to conquer the kingdom with your dragon has started! ◆ War! Everywhere. You and your army allies need to be prepared. Build up and upgrade your bases and bulk up epic armies with a war strategy - you're not the only ones with your eyes on the throne of the Empire! ◆ Multiplayer kingdom war alliances! No man is an island. Whether you’re rallying against a GvE Barbarian Leader or marching at a PvP bully, you’ll need allies that you can trust. ◆ Send a spy to your enemies with your troops before waging war against the enemy castle! ◆ Dragons! A legendary weapon of mass destruction. How will you train a legendary dragon to battle in your fantasy army? ◆ Chat & play! Easy-translation feature brings thousands of players from around the world together in this real-time multiplayer war. ◆ Strategy! Research and master army attack and defense skills to ensure that you have the edge over your magic enemies. Know when to be invisible and when to order an invasion in this PvP adventure! ◆ Building! Build the foundations of an Empire strong enough to survive in a dragon-fire war zone! ◆ Experience a realist gameplay in every mission. Manage and produce resources to build your army, conquer the kingdom, and win the throne! ◆ Epic free MMO fantasy adventure! The Legend of Camelot lives. Awesome monsters and dragons! Make strategy your ally and build the greatest army of all time in this multiplayer RTS! Be one of the heroes of King of Avalon and become a myth of the dragon-fire war!

rows.name: Conquistadorio: Prologue
rows.short_description: The conquistador, who has faced many trials in his life, decided to retire and become a hermit. Just lying in his solitary cave away from people. But it seems that fate itself throws new challenges at you even in such a simple matter.
rows.description_html: Special Offer About the Game The conquistador, who has faced many trials in his life, decided to retire and become a hermit. Just lying in his solitary cave away from people. But it seems that fate itself throws new challenges at you even in such a simple matter. The coffin in which you like to sleep has disappeared. You need to embark on a search and solve a multitude of puzzles until you find it. This is how its story begins. There are 4 levels in which you will understand the backstory of the Conquistador and get the answer to why he went on the quest. Plot: You are about to embark on a search for the missing item and find it. Puzzles: Inventive and challenging puzzles will help you spend many hours solving captivating logical riddles. Graphics: A distinctive hand-drawn artistic style will allow you to enjoy a unique and charming aesthetic. Sound: Ambient sounds, background music, and character-specific sound effects will further immerse you in the game. Dialogues: Conquistador relies on non-verbal storytelling. So, no long and boring dialogues - only expressive animation of characters and the surrounding environment.

rows.name: Stormshot
rows.short_description: 300 brilliant levels await! Come unveil the myth of Treasure Isle!
rows.description_html: Rise to the calling of lost treasures! Ready, aim, fire! Have a blast in the 300 levels of mind-twisting shooting puzzles! Enjoy the fun with a storm of bullets and become the most skilled shooter on Skull Isle! Beneath your feet lies the lost treasure island filled with danger and mysteries. To survive this unforgiving world, you must wield your greatest weapons: your unmatched wit, flawless aiming and absolute focus to fend off whatever evil may come! Game Features ◆ Never the same levels 300 challenging levels await you, use your wisdom and find the fastest way to solve every puzzle. Here’s some free advice: being a top challenger requires more than making the right choice, it is being able to plan ahead, capture the right timing and most importantly, precise execution. ◆ Explore the mists and experience various strategic gameplay. The Treasure Island is covered with mist, use your adventure instinct to find the lost treasures, defeat mysterious ghosts and the terrifying Sea Monster! ◆ Collect treasures to renovate ancient relics and decrypt the mysteries even words can’t describe. ◆ Reinforce your Stronghold and forge a strong alliance with others on the Treasure Isle, they will be your biggest support through the challenges and the best treasure you’ll ever find on this journey!

rows.name: Too Shroom!
rows.short_description: Slash your way through hoards of hellish shrooms, defending your once peaceful land! Choose upgrades that synergize with your build to survive as long as possible against the infinitely scaling waves of monsters attempting to overwhelm you!
rows.description_html: Too Shroom! is a Slash 'em up meets Roguelite game where the upgrades you choose are vital. Master the simple yet satisfying combat system, and find synergies and builds to clear as many waves as possible. You need to survive the hoards of hellish shrooms and kill each wave before time runs out. Collect seeds each run to unlock new characters and permanent upgrades.

rows.name: Rage Simulator
rows.short_description: Rage Simulator is a minimalist hand-drawn beat-em-up simulator. I made this little game for myself and for you guys, I just wanted to beat something up.
rows.description_html: Game Description Rage Simulator is a minimalist hand-drawn beat-em-up simulator. I made this little game for myself and for you guys, sometimes I just want to beat something up. Once the game starts, please press any key to start an impromptu beating, and as you beat up more, you can unlock more tags and conversations. You can also switch the color of the character, the color of the blood, the background and the foreground at will during the game. About the Developer I'm Liujiajun , this is my seventh game on Steam, I hope you like my work and thanks for playing.

rows.name: Charon's Crossing
rows.short_description: A mythological arcade-style game where you navigate Charon through the rivers of the Underworld. Dodge obstacles, confront adversaries, and strategize with Hermes' power-ups. Delve into a pixel-art world inspired by ancient legends.
rows.description_html: Journey Through The Underworld In Charon's Crossing, you play as the mythic ferryman, Charon. Your task is to safely ferry the souls of the departed through the treacherous rivers of the Underworld. As you maneuver through each of the five rivers—Lethe, Acheron, Cocytus, Phlegethon, and Styx—you'll confront a variety of obstacles and menacing foes that aim to obstruct your path. Power-Ups & Strategy With each completed stage, Hermes offers you a brief respite. Visit his shop to purchase vital power-ups that can make your journey smoother. From bolstering your health to manipulating the very fabric of time, choose the enhancements that align best with your strategy to ensure the safe passage of souls. Pixel-Art Arcade Action Experience a blend of strategy and skill in this Game & Watch-inspired title. Charon's Crossing presents players with a nostalgic trip featuring minimalist pixel-art graphics combined with classic 8-bit soundscapes. Will you successfully navigate the rivers and deliver all the souls, or will the Underworld's perils prove too challenging? Features Traverse five distinct rivers, each with its unique challenges. Battle and evade various foes and obstacles that aim to hinder your journey. Utilize strategic power-ups from Hermes' shop to aid in your travels. Engage in a visually captivating pixel-art world complemented by 8-bit tunes. Test your reflexes and decision-making skills in this arcade-style experience.

rows.name: Russian Warship
rows.short_description: This game is a comic relief in the otherwise tragic war in Ukraine. Based on many popular jokes, it mixes shoot 'em up and tower defense genres to create an action-filled top-down shooting experience which requires tactical thinking and smart resource management
rows.description_html: This game is a comic relief in the otherwise tragic war in Ukraine. It uses multiple popular jokes, starting with the famous phrase about the russian warship. It's a top-down shoot 'em up game with tower defense elements. You start at Zmiinyi Island (Snake Island) in the midst of the Black Sea where you find yourself attacked by multiple waves of enemy ships. You need to defend the island, gradually growing your arsenal with new weapons, turrets and upgrades. If you succeed to defend Zmiinyi you can proceed to free other territories and try to win the war.

rows.name: Century of Anticipation
rows.short_description: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl. Enjoy our gift to you, this delightful adventure with an unforgettable soundtrack by Brazilian artists.
rows.description_html: You are locked at home, eagerly anticipating the moment to step outside again. Only it's.... . . . . ...taking really long. In this tiny world filled with surprising interactions awaiting to be discovered, you must find ways to pass the time by engaging with various activities around the house, as you deal with the only company you have in this adventure: yourself. AS THE CLOCK TICKS AWAY... Deal with the slow passage of time in a short, visually striking adventure developed by musician and game designer Gools Explore the confines of your home and reach up to four different endings. Experience a unique soundtrack composed by artists from Recife, Brazil. Find and take part in a variety of activities around the house to make time pass! Try your hand at poetry... and send it to us! Or keep it to yourself, it's your choice! Play an instrument. Maybe get better at it? Explore your bedroom, take a nap, make a snack... ...AND ENTER THE REALMS OF YOUR OWN THOUGHTS.

Or keep it to yourself, it's your choice! Play an instrument. Maybe get better at it? Explore your bedroom, take a nap, make a snack... ...AND ENTER THE REALMS OF YOUR OWN THOUGHTS.

Step into the shoes of an interstellar explorer and embark on an awe-inspiring journey into the unknown cosmos with a captivating group of space companions. The game features a card-based mechanism where each space companion, or 'waifu,' is a distinctive Star Maiden with unique skills and characteristics. rows.name: Minute
rows.short_description: A 3D action platformer where you play as a wind-up toy in a Tinkerer's workshop set in the Victorian Age. As a small wind-up toy, you must rely on your wind-up key to embark on an arduous journey. Defeat enemies and uncover a dark secret within the rooms.
rows.description_html: Embark on an action pack steampunk journey like no other! Plunge into a mesmerizing fantasy world where gears spin, steam hisses, and brass contraptions come to life! Minute is a 3D action platformer where you'll play as a brave wind-up toy named Tink, a magical steampunk automaton toy crafted by a skilled tinkerer who embarks on a perilous journey in his creator's workshop. Experience a whimsical tale of courage, discovery, and self growth as you venture through the maze of whirling cogs and ticking clocks. Hone your combat skills as you challenge mischievous adversaries who get in your way. Master your abilities to overcome an abundance of expected obstacles and unlock hidden routes as you uncover the mysteries behind this clockwork world. Beat up gangster bugs, avoid nasty falls and scale the heights of a workshed. Embrace a heartfelt and soul-stirring story where narrative and gameplay weave into a uniquely metaphorical experience. Custom Combat Experience : Experiment with attack patterns as you fight through the workshop. Explore A Open Clockwork World : Dash, jump and bounce with your trusty key. Uncover the mysteries : What is your purpose? Who created you? Where are they now? This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: The Intruder
rows.short_description: Uncover the chilling secrets of 'The Intruder.' Navigate a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking darkness. A suspenseful horror-adventure that tests your survival instincts.
rows.description_html: Important Note:  This game was made free because it doesn't meet JoyTree Studios standards Thank you to all the people who have bought the game while it was a paid product and supported us. This game was our first product on steam therefore it has great sentimental value so we don't want to remove it but we also don't want to keep charging people for an inferior product.  Embark on a Heart-Stopping Journey in 'The Intruder' - a spine-chilling 3D Horror Adventure game. As the protagonist sets out to meet his girlfriend, a fateful turn leaves him stranded with an empty gas tank. Desperate for help, he seeks refuge in an ominous mansion, unaware of the nightmare that lurks within. Discover the true meaning of terror as you navigate the dark corridors of the mansion, encountering unimaginable horrors and an insidious monster determined to claim your life. Every step you take is filled with tension, as you unravel the dark secrets hidden within the walls. Immerse yourself in a meticulously designed environment, complete with atmospheric soundscapes and bone-chilling visuals that will leave you trembling with fear. Solve intricate puzzles, outsmart the relentless pursuer, and unveil the mystery that binds you to this haunting place. With 'The Intruder,' prepare to face your deepest fears and fight for survival in an interactive horror experience like no other. Will you escape the clutches of the mansion's malevolent entity, or will you become just another victim trapped within its sinister grasp? Dare to confront the unknown, experience the terror of 'The Intruder' and test your nerves in a game that will haunt your dreams long after you've played.

rows.name: Cellosseum
rows.short_description: Cellosseum is a bullet heaven following the progress of a lone cell as it battles a variety of enemies on its quest to guide the evolutionary process of life itself. Upgrade your attacks, shields, health, and speed to understand your role in the creation of life on the planet of Ceres Prime.
rows.description_html: Cellosseum is a bullet heaven following the progress of a lone cell as it battles a variety of enemies on its quest to guide the evolutionary process of life itself. From upgrading your attacks, shields, health, and speed, to understanding your role in the creation of life on the planet of Ceres Prime—will you create life from nothing, or will you be lost to the cold indifference of the galaxy. The Lone Cell: Play as a cell on its quest to become the leader of evolution on Ceres Prime. Choose from a range of unique attack types that evolve the range, power, and type of projectile as you blast your way through enemies. The Enemies: Life for a cell isn’t just about peacefully floating through the primordial soup—prepare yourself and your reflexes as you face off against challenging and unique enemies with varied attack characteristics such as: Edgelord, Snowflake, and Snuggle Bear. Content: This game’s content includes a wealth of watercolor artwork, characters, and music that is completely scratch made. Float your way across beautifully stylized cellular landscapes while engaging with memorable hand-drawn characters. Features: This game features an ability upgrade system for your character. Choose the evolutionary traits that you want to keep that suit your gameplay style.

rows.name: Intergalactic
rows.short_description: Destroy Asteroids and Ships, Explore Space!
rows.description_html: Intergalactic is a VR game centered in the setting of space. You can explore a range of levels with big enemy ships, black holes, asteroid fields, and more! You fly through space in a ship with a fully interactable, working futuristic HUD. Fly through the levels and destroy randomly spawning ships, minibosses, and asteroids. This game features a semi realistic graphics design with low poly models. Defeating these ships will sometimes spawn gears that you can collect and use at the shop in the main menu to upgrade and improve your ship. There is also a 5-mission campaign where you raid a huge enemy ship and destroy it. The game comes with many QOL features such as a standing mode and setting to make the game more comfortable for players who may experience VR sickness.

rows.name: Floating Life Record
rows.short_description: I found myself in a strange place filled with dangerous monsters, You must find a way to escape here and return to the real world, but before that, you need to collect materials, food, and weapons to ensure that you can survive here.
rows.description_html: Introduction: One morning, I woke up and was about to go to work, but upon leaving, I found myself in a strange place filled with dangerous monsters, You must find a way to escape here and return to the real world, but before that, you need to collect materials, food, and weapons to ensure that you can survive here. Gameplay: The game is a 3D horror survival game, where you need to collect food to ensure you don't starve to death and also face dangerous monsters. In the game, you will play the role of a person who accidentally enters a strange world, using W, A, S, D to move, and the mouse to control the perspective. You are not the first person to come here. There are many notes left by predecessors on the map, and reading more notes can provide more clues. In the game, some enemies cannot be killed, and you need to avoid these special enemies. This game includes mild horror, survival, shooting, and more. Features: First person horror survival game, thrilling exploration, clever survival. A small sandbox map for you to explore. You need to follow some strange rules in the game, otherwise you will be punished. Exciting and tense gaming experience. Support for Windows

rows.name: Clash of the Elements
rows.short_description: Wield the elements to compose the music in real time by battling your friends! Choose among the proposed maps, unite and combine the elements to create your unique mix, reflecting the process of fierce battle in abstract 2D space.
rows.description_html: Wield the elements to compose the music in real time by battling your friends! Choose among the proposed maps, unite and combine the elements to create your unique mix, reflecting the process of fierce battle in abstract 2D space. You can move up and down, and capture the nearby elements. Captured elements will deliver their sound, and by combining elements from both players (air, water, fire, earth) a unique musical blend is created. With capturing two elements, the spells become available depening on the elments pairing: air+water, air+fire, water+earth, fire+earth. Hitting enemy with the spells reduces their hit points, while captured elements increase hit points. When the music ends, the player with most hit points wins the match. Play multiplayer against other people or locally vs AI: W,S - movement, E - capturing, Z,X,C,V - spells. P.S. The mobile version is planned soon.

There are 6 bounties and 4 areas, each with different pros and cons. More bounties you complete, stronger you get, more skills you unlock to help you with increased difficulty.
