rows.name: AG Legacy Builder
rows.short_description: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy! Challenge players worldwide in a universe of classic kart racing fun! Use skills like lightning strikes and super jumps, customize your avatar’s appearance and abilities, and even design your own game modes. Unleash your racing dreams in a colorful, nostalgia-fueled galaxy!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy, a classic kart racing universe full of fun and games. Inspired by gaming classics like Rollercoaster Tycoon and Super Mario Kart, players can join in on an intergalactic adventure full of high-speed joyrides. And for those that seek even more challenges - players can enjoy a fusion of party gaming and user-generated modes, making for nearly endless possibilities! In Arcade Galaxy, players can seamlessly drop into matches with friends and share their creations. Create your own Cub avatar with a vast array of cosmetics and abilities. This rich customization system lets players craft truly unique identities to set them apart from the competition. Beyond pure gameplay, the game also offers a robust level editor. With this tool, you can create and customize almost every element within the game, from racetracks, obstacles, to the behavior of objects in each world. The editor includes accessible level design tools and a visual, esay-to-use logic editor, all boasting unique features which highlight player creativity. Once crafted, players can publish their creations with friends and even race on custom tracks. Through the logic editor, you can harness the power of a visual programming language to transform the gameplay experience. From setting traps, designing hurdles, to establishing your game rules – everything is within your grasp. Embark on this intergalactic racing adventure, share your passion and imagination with players worldwide, and dive into the endless joys that Arcade Galaxy has to offer! - Complete custom racing challenges using unique power-ups and skills. - Create custom racetracks, obstacles, and game rules with an intuitive level editor. - Share and race on user-generated tracks globally. - Customize your Cub avatar with a galaxy of cosmetics and abilities.

rows.name: Adventures in Anglonia
rows.short_description: A language learning game created for a master's thesis -- play as one of four unique adventurers in the mysterious land of Anglonia, searching for the wish-granting artifact, the Heart of the Word. Practice listening comprehension, TOEIC vocabulary, and problem-solving.
rows.description_html: Created for a master's thesis on learning games, engagement, and language instruction, Adventures in Anglonia is a text-based RPG created in RPGMakerMZ meant to be played in local groups of four students (though it can be played singleplayer) in the first-year Japanese university classroom. Play as one of four unique adventurers sent into the dangerous and mysterious land of Anglonia to search for a mystical wish-granting Artifact, the Heart of the Word. Engage in narratively driven battles that test your listening comprehension about the story of the game, solve dialogue puzzles, and negotiate deals. Make impactful narrative decisions that shape the future of your adventure, Anglonia, and the world. In battle, harness the power of language to use impactful skills by associating TOEIC vocabulary, and constructing sentences. Please be aware that the game features blood, fantasy violence, and language (the bad kind). It features themes of colonialism and native exploitation, and these themes feature heavily in the choices that players are asked to make throughout the game. When incorporated in the classroom, Adventures in Anglonia took 6 weekly classes (roughly 9 hours). The game is divided into five 'weeks' but oftentimes (particularly for week two) groups took multiple classes to complete them. If playing singleplayer, these divisions can be safely ignored. Originally, the game experience contained supplemental materials such as readings, but those have been incorporated into the game as scrolling text and items. It should work. It was a truly rewarding experience to build and then play this game with my students, and the results of the research should be published somewhere online at some point in the future following the completion of my thesis.

rows.short_description: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free Simple Linear single player first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Will you make it out alive?
rows.description_html: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free Simple Linear first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. rows.name: Totality
rows.short_description: A simulation of a total solar eclipse, complete with time control, a pane of #14 welding glass, and a pinhole projector.
rows.description_html: If you can’t travel to a total solar eclipse, bring the eclipse to you! Experience a complete total solar eclipse from start to finish. Feeling impatient? Speed up time or jump ahead. You can even pause time for extended totality! Want to stare at the sun without going blind? You can do that here. Just don’t do that with the real sun! You can also view the eclipse through a pane of #14 welding glass or a pinhole projector. Beyond the eclipse itself, the environment is designed to be very relaxing. Watch the day pass from sunrise to sunset and overnight under a clear, cloudless sky. Listen to the wind dynamically blow through the trees on top of a low mountain. Breathe, relax, and enjoy your time here.

rows.name: True Dice Roller
rows.short_description: A physics based dice roller that keeps the fast, intuitive fun of rolling real dice while automating the math. Hand recorded sounds and fine-tuned physics bring 60+ dice sets to life with materials like glass, plastic and metal. Use advanced features like Dice Analytics or the Dice Calculator
rows.description_html: Perfect for tabletop RPGs and board games alike. True Dice Roller offers the best of two worlds: it combines the convenience and automated math of a digital dice roller with the fun and realistic feel of rolling actual dice. Basic Features Better than Real Dice. Dice results are based on actual physics and not computer generated numbers, which never feel as trustworthy as physical dice. Unlike real dice, TDR dice are mathematically perfectly balanced, no salt water testing required! Fast and Intuitive. TDR is designed to be extremely fast as well as user friendly. It’s at least as fast and intuitive as rolling real dice in a real dice tray. Auto Math. Automatically adds dice results and additional modifiers are a button press away. Enjoy rolling physical dice without the mental math (unless you like the mental math). True Materials and Sounds. Realistic, hand recorded sound effects and altered physics based on material, such as glass, plastic or metal. Widely Compatible. Show the sum of all rolled dice or show each dice result separately based on your needs, making TDR compatible with any tabletop game that uses standard dice (d20s, d6s, d10s, percentile dice, etc). This includes classics like D&D as well as newer games like Candela Obscura or Blades in the Dark. 60+ Dice Sets. A vast array of dice sets from colored plastic to polished obsidian to solid gold. Place and roll unlimited copies of dice you own. Four dice sets are included for free, others can be purchased for significantly less than dice sets in real life. Be a dice goblin on the cheap! Advanced Features Custom Dice Templates. Arrange and save the placement and configuration of your dice inside your virtual dice tray, making it easy to use different templates for different occasions, or to quickly reset and reorganize your dice with the push of a button. Fast Dice Calculator. An advanced tool for GMs. For maximum speed, use a digital-only dice calculator that can roll and add huge numbers of dice (if you need 100d6 damage, for example), or roll up to 50 checks against a target number at once (in case of needlessly large numbers of enemies or attacks). Numpad inputs make for extremely fluid usage. Also, you can roll nonstandard dice types, such as a d3 or a d500, useful for funky dice or large rollable charts. Dice Analytics. See if a specific die really is only rolling low or high. Display graphs and averages data for any die you’ve placed in your dice tray. Useful as an educational tool or to learn which dice have really betrayed you.

rows.name: Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - Prelude
rows.short_description: You are Earth's last line of defense in a relentless alien invasion. Experience intense 3D top-down roguelite action. Outsmart, outgun and survive smarter, increasingly menacing foes with a versatile arsenal in diverse landscapes. Every run escalates the challenge - adapt, evolve, dominate!
rows.description_html: PURCHASE THE FULL GAME NOW DISCLAIMER: If you decide to purchase the game and continue playing, your save game will be fully compatible with the full version of the game. This is the PRELUDE for 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors'. In 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - PRELUDE', you will experience: Thrilling auto-firing bullet hell action Rich character progression with multiple agents to unlock and upgrade Deep customization with a vast arsenal of weapons, modules, and ultimate abilities Intense, fast-paced runs lasting between 10 to 20 minutes Global warfare with levels modeled after real-world locations Flexible difficulty with various game modes offering increased rewards Use your Ultimate ability to annihilate vast numbers of Xenos! In the tumultuous year of 2058, Earth faces its darkest hour. An alien invasion, known as the Xenos, threatens the survival of humanity. Our regular forces crumble, overwhelmed by the otherworldly onslaught. Amidst the chaos, a beacon of hope emerges - an elite group of warriors: DEFCON: Xenos. Your mission? Repel the alien invasion and secure humanity's future! As a member of this prestigious unit, you will traverse the war-ravaged cities and desolate landscapes of our beloved home planet, Earth. You will face an evolving enemy, growing more intelligent and ferocious with each encounter. Brace yourself for an escalating challenge that will test your mettle and push your strategic prowess to the limit. Carve your way through hordes of aliens with your powerful arsenal! Explore endless combinations of agents, skills, ultimate abilities, and augmentations to forge your path to victory! Each run, carve through the alien hordes, leveraging your ultimate ability to decimate vast swaths of Xenos, and try different agent and ability combinations to keep the enemy guessing. In the face of oblivion, will you stand as Earth's last line of defense? Join the fight in 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors'. Try different combinations of Agents, Skills, Ultimate abilities and Augmentations!

rows.name: Roles & Dice
rows.short_description: Roles & Dice is a dynamic online virtual tabletop RPG! Dive into worlds you create, assume roles, and strategize in turn-based battles. Real-time exploration and imaginative map creation await. Ideal for Game Masters and players seeking dynamic, interactive adventures!
rows.description_html: Roles & Dice is a meticulously crafted online virtual tabletop game, where imaginations run wild, and epic adventures await! Tailored for fans of tabletop RPGs, this game enables you to load any image file to construct immersive maps and draw your friends into exciting worlds, all from the comfort of your home! Features: 🗺 Versatile Map Integration: Load any image file as a map, allowing boundless possibilities to explore and create intricate worlds, designed by your imagination. 🎮 Distinctive Game Modes: Engage in the Exploration mode where players control their characters in real-time, uncovering the realms set by the Game Master, or dive into riveting turn-based battles, strategizing every move. 💼 Dynamic Role-Playing: One player takes on the role of the Game Master, orchestrating the universe's destiny, while others immerse themselves as characters in the unfolding tale. 🧙 Character & Group Creation: Game Masters can forge characters, assemble groups, and craft maps, which can be saved and swiftly loaded to streamline gameplay during campaigns. 👥 Multiplayer Interaction: Play with friends and experience collaborative storytelling, all while forging memories and facing challenges together. 🎢 User-Friendly Interface: Designed with players in mind, Roles & Dice provides an intuitive and seamless experience, allowing easy navigation and game setup. 📜 Campaign Saving: Save your meticulously created characters, maps, and groups for quick load and play, ensuring smooth transitions between sessions. Engage in Unparalleled Adventure: Whether you're exploring uncharted territories, battling formidable foes, or immersing yourself in stories untold, Roles & Dice provides the ultimate virtual tabletop experience, allowing you and your friends to create and live out your fantastical tales. Embark on your journey in Roles & Dice and unravel the realms of endless possibilities! 🌌

rows.name: Dung Beetle Adventure
rows.short_description: A short (and free) adventure game, where you are tasked with helping a hurt, hungry, but inventive dung beetle on its journey to find something to eat near the end of the mushroom season.
rows.description_html: Once upon a time there was a small dung beetle, and like most dung beetles it was hungry. Mushroom season was coming to an end, but there were still rosetops to be found, a favourite in the beetle community. When morning came purple dung beetles flocked out of their homes dead-set on getting their tiny insect hands on the much sought-after treat. In the end, only one single beetle remained, and it just so happens to be the hero of our story. With its broken wings everything seemed doomed... But maybe there is hope left for a hurt, hungry, but inventive dung beetle? Features: Meet a whole cast of insects (and spiders) in a mildly challenging short adventure Listen to a lot of insects, all bathed in the soundscape of a lovely sunny day Meet one of natures unsung heroes: The dung beetle Dance to an original soundtrack, composed for bugs and humans alike Collect eight simple (and two fairly simple) achievements

rows.name: Stellar Bewitching (Remastered)
rows.short_description: Find your destiny and your boyfriend in the Limbo Realm. Play as a teenage farian witch named Elya Seres, looking for a boyfriend for Venusia's day so she can remain one of the cool kids. Venture into the Limbo Realm with her slime-familiar Floryn in this turn-based Sci-Fi RPG.
rows.description_html: In the Galaxy of Xerxes, Year 212 A.XW. (After Xerian War), parallel to the events of 'Rave Heart.' A teenage farian girl named Elya Seres residing in Crasper City, Planet Kardel, is troubled for Venusia's Day, the day of love and romance. The pressure of her friends asking her why she's still single all this time has pushed her to ask for her slime familiar's help to get her a boyfriend. Her familiar Floryn, however, has different ideas on how they can get Elya her boyfriend for Venusia's Day. A roller coaster ride of an adventure to the Limbo Realm. Will Elya be able to find a guy to show off for Venusia's day to her friends, will she forever live in the reality that she will remain a single loser in front of her friends for Venusia's day? Fast-paced turn-based battles Secret boss fight Fun-filled adventure Remastered Art by Berry B Side View Battle System that uses the Order Turn Combat Style. Taking extra actions or manipulating them using agility manipulation. Inspired by Octopath Traveler, you can reduce an enemy's shield points by inflicting weaknesses on enemies. rows.name: Envoy
rows.short_description: You have been created by a mysterious monolith with a single goal: to retrieve five force crystals back to it as quickly as possible. Deal with the plights of space physics, evade the locals, and complete your mission as soon as possible.
rows.description_html: Envoy is a short physics based spaceflight game where you have been created by a monolith for the sole purpose of retrieving 'force crystals' to it. Evade increasingly aggressive locals, utilize special abilities, all to complete your mission. Your mission is to retrieve five force crystals to the monolith. Your sole and only purpose is to deliver force crystals back to a monolith. Weave and dodge around asteroids by utilizing realistic space physics, and have your flight somewhat regulated by a slight drag force applied when going too fast. Locals have noticed your presence and will get more aggressive over time. You are not alone on your mission, and not in a good way. For some reason, locals don't want you to complete your mission and will do their best to stop you. The further you progress and longer you take, the more aggressive ships they'll send, ranging from police ships to military battleships. Utilize various abilities to keep yourself safe from the locals. As you retrieve force crystals, you will unlock new abilities to utilize to make your mission easier. You can use them to outwit the locals, avoid an asteroid collision, or just accelerate the speed of your mission. Survive as long as possible after completing your mission. Once the mission is complete, you have only one objective: survive. Utilize abilities and the skills you have learned to fight even more aggressive locals, as they throw their most powerful forces your way. Why is Envoy a free game? Envoy was made for the summer flowjam 2023 game jam, and is a free game available on the web. Additionally, it is being listed on Steam for free because it lacks the following: Precise volume (game can be muted) , graphics, resolution, and keybinding settings. A pause menu. More than 30 minutes of gameplay. Support for controllers or users without a computer mouse. Please be aware of these when downloading the game!!

rows.name: Carball 360 (beta)
rows.short_description: A game of carball where the last team to touch the ball scores the goal. An AI named Vicky is there to fill the void when friends are unavailable. Light, simple, competitive.
rows.description_html: *Carball360 is in test_hover Welcome to Carball 360, a game of skill, experience, and a bit of luck. Carball 360 is a simple game. There are no skins to buy, there are no glitches to exploit. There’s an arena, a ball, 2 players, two optional AI and 60 seconds. There are no assigned goals. The team that touches the ball last before it scores, scores the goal regardless of what goal they scored on. This last-touch scoring blurs the line between offensive and defensive roles creating an exciting and different playing experience. We capped the frames per second (fps) at 90 fps to promote a gameplay of skill. Who’s the better player, not who has the better computer. There are no settings to change. Everyone is playing the EXACT same game. Same camera angle, same perspective, same everything. The cars are exactly the same. Same hitbox, same top-speed available, same everything. Wins are wins. Losses are losses. Ties are meaningless. Find your play style, find your stance, find your strategy and beat the player in front of you. Join the beta and let us know what you love and what you hate as we strive to make the best game possible.

rows.description_html: Liked it? Support it! Tickled your pickle? Show support by leaving a review, and wishlisting or purchasing: Thank you in advance, I'm glad Shuffle brought you some enjoyment! Search ' Suspicious Shuffle ' on Steam. About the Game This is the free version of Suspicious Shuffle , it's the full game with no features held back, drag your friends in for a romping good time! Imagine if Mario Party was Co-Op, or if you're kinda old (feels bad man): Pyramid Escape from Warcraft 3. Mario Party meets Geometry Wars in this minigame adventure for 1-6 players! Play through a 1-6 player solo/co-op campaign (approx. 4-5 hours) utilizing a diverse set of skills in a ever-Shuffling 29 minigame fiesta! In the process, enjoy a light-hearted story involving the Suspicious Dealer and restoring balance to the universe. The stakes have never been lower! Is an adventure really complete without hats? Clearing the campaign rewards you with priceless Stars which can be used to unlock customisation options and get fancy! Sometimes we all need a break from helping one other to show off and find out who really is the very best. It'll be you, obviously. Prove it over 18 PvP minigames. Mix and match your favorite minigames with modifiable settings to play them the way you like them, no judgement.

rows.name: Farm Garden Simulator
rows.short_description: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals.
rows.description_html: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals. - Grow a variety of crops You can get coins by growing crops, raising animals, harvesting, and selling them in the market. You can use the coins you collect to purchase seeds for other crops, and as you level up, the types of crops you can grow will increase, and the farmland you can unlock will expand. Increases the number of animals you can keep. ・Use coins and jewelry Collected coins and jewelry can be used to obtain various farm tools and tractors. Farm tools and tractors allow you to efficiently plow many farms at once. In this game, after planting crops, when the game is started after some time has passed, the crops are completed and can be harvested. ・Types of crops that can be grown 　Apples, apricots, asparagus, bananas, beans, beets, broccoli, cabbage, carrots, cherries, corn, cucumbers, eggplants, hemp, lemons, lettuce, onions, oranges, peaches, pears, pepper, plum, potato, pumpkin, Italian pumpkin, white pumpkin, Squash Butternut, Squash Delicator, Strawberry, Sunflower, Tomato, Watermelon, Wheat, etc. ・Types of animals that can be kept 'Cats, dogs, pigs, cows, chickens, horses, etc.

rows.name: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles
rows.short_description: Dive into a world of Victorian elegance and mechanical marvels. Discover steam-powered wonders while testing the limits of your puzzle-solving skills.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the enchanting world of Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles! Immerse yourself in a captivating realm of Victorian aesthetics and intricate machinery as you embark on your puzzle-solving adventure. Assemble a wide variety of fascinating scenes, from opulent airships to ornate clockwork contraptions and much more. Enjoy a selection of 24 steampunk puzzles, expandable to over 200 with DLC. With its intuitive gameplay, Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles is accessible to both newcomers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Play the game your way, with a wide variety of puzzle sizes and piece shapes. Enjoy a leisurely experience, or face a mind-bending test of your puzzling prowess! Solve jigsaw puzzles to earn Steam achievements and unlock hidden bonus puzzles. The gears are in motion. Begin your steampunk puzzle adventure!

rows.name: Scarlet Thread
rows.short_description: Scalet Thread is a deck building game. Our core game is based on PVP ranked game .More postion strategy, More resource management ,Fight at winning blocks and get more resource at 'Jungle'.PVE Mode provided is a roguelike deck building game. you could pick up random cards during the PVE sessions .
rows.description_html: Scarlet Thread is a deck building game , you could build up your deck with your own card and fight with other players at rank game. Players could build up your deck with Hero cards, Equipments , Spells and Followers.In the action phase, both sides will deploy cards simultaneously, deploying them in different areas. After the turn ends, the cards of both sides will automatically fight. Players who win in different areas will receive more resources or cause damage to the enemy. We also provide a PVE mode based on the same battle structure.You could start up with a random deck or build your own deck for your own journey. PVE mode would generate dungeons randomly, so you will always facing unknown dungeons. Onece you finish the PVE fight , you could get more cards which you could build into your deck.

rows.name: Argo
rows.short_description: Argo is a unique roguelite action strategy game in a minimalist style. Use combos to use abilities, dodge enemy attacks and defeat the Void, Hell and Pestilence bosses. You don't have to do it alone either, because you can play the entire game in online co-op mode!
rows.description_html: Argo is a unique roguelite action strategy game in a minimalist style! Use combos to use abilities, dodge enemy attacks and defeat the Void, Hell and Pestilence bosses. You don't have to do it alone either, because you can play the entire game in online co-op mode! - Unlock different abilities during the game and explore new combinations again and again. - Play with a total of three different characters, each with their own stats and special abilities. - Survive together with a friend via the online co-op mode. - Find runes in the game that grant you permanent upgrades. - Discover crafting recipes to create unique equipment for the next run. - Fill the bestiary and learn the most effective ways to avoid enemies' abilities.

rows.name: Sky Conquest
rows.short_description: In summary, Sky Conquest is a fun and enjoyable platform game to play with friends! 🌟 With cute graphics and entertaining gameplay, it's the perfect combo. Download it for free now on Steam and get ready to jump and have fun! 🚀🎮
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game ⭐ Sky Conquest is a fun 3D platformer game designed to be played with friends. In this game, you play as colorful and cute characters who must jump, run, and avoid obstacles to be the first to reach the finish line. 🌟 Sky Bomber 🌟 Blast your enemies in this thrilling Bomberman-like mode! Strategy, speed, and precision are your best allies as you place bombs to destroy obstacles and defeat your opponents. Navigate through complex mazes, collect power-ups, and become the master of explosive skies! 🌟 Adventure Mode 🌟 Get ready for a colorful and challenging epic! Inspired by Mario classics, this adventure mode transports you into a 3D and 2D universe where every jump counts. Traverse varied levels filled with platforms, puzzles, and dangers. Master the art of jumping, discover hidden secrets, and face formidable enemies to restore peace in the celestial kingdom. 🌟 Search and Find 🌟 Rick has lost valuable items in his sky house and he needs your help to find them! This mode plunges you into a hidden objects game where every room holds concealed treasures. Explore detailed environments, use your observation skills, and solve puzzles to find Rick's lost items. the Game's Features Colorful and cute graphics that will appeal to players of all ages. Simple and intuitive controls that allow players to focus on the fun of playing. Fun cosmetics that will make the gameplay even more exciting. Varied and challenging levels that will test players' skills. 🏆 Sky Conquest Features 🏆 Dazzling Graphics: Stunning high-definition environments that bring the skies to life. Varied Gameplay: Three unique game modes for a diverse and captivating experience. Get ready to conquer the skies and discover a world of mysteries and explosions with Sky Conquest! Download it now and let the adventure begin!

rows.name: Kwark
rows.short_description: Kwark is a single player game about a creature that has to go through levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be both from 1 person and from 3!
rows.description_html: Kwark is a single-player game in which you are a character named Kwark ! Your main task is to complete all levels, but it's not as easy as it seems! A lot of levels available for passing, character customization, in-game currency and qualitatively made menu will not let you get bored. In Kwark there is a large functionality of settings, such as: full screen mode, game graphics selection, sound settings and much more! Kwark can run, jump, crouch, walk in a crouch and jump in a crouch, in general, everything you need for a comfortable game! The game has a menu with a large number of buttons such as, mechanics, good design and elaborate interface! And localization between Russian, English and Polish will allow you to play as you feel comfortable. Also frequent updates won't let you get bored! Can you pass all the levels?

rows.name: Survivors
rows.short_description: Travel through an unknown alien world, collecting new weapons to fight alien monsters and upgrading the Time Tank to withstand hordes of unknown monsters.
rows.description_html: You are the commander of the Time Tank, a formidable vehicle that ensures the fight is never truly over, stranded on an alien planet with nothing but your wits, heavy weaponry, and the allies you rescue along the way. Battle through hordes of eldritch monsters to rescue your friends, upgrade your arsenal, and claw your way into the future. Through rescuing your allies and completing their quests, you unlock their tower, a bastion of defense or offense that aids you in all future battles. Through further quests, you unlock unique weapons, such as the railgun and deadly mist, in addition to your tank's trusty automatic turret system. If you're brave enough and give a valiant effort, you may be able to escape this alien planet and venture back home. Don't worry, if the zombies get you, your trust Time Tank has the ability to travel back in time whenever it is put in grave danger; You will simply travel back to the last know safe timeline.

rows.name: Star Farmer: Prologue
rows.short_description: In this bullet heaven, farming adventure, play as a powerful Warlock who has a side hustle harvesting plants in space.
rows.description_html: Wishlist the full game! About the Game This is the free version of Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe . As a Warlock, fund your expedition to discover rare and powerful flora through your participation in the lucrative profession of star farming. Build the ultimate space farm as you explore the galaxy and stumble onto the mystery of a dead planet. Cultivate exotic plant life, trade your harvests for credits, and customize your runs with unique powers in this roguelite adventure. Star Farmer: Prologue Features Star Farmer: Prologue is a part of the full version of the upcoming game, Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe . It includes: 2 acts from the full version of the game (from a total of 5) Over 100 powers to take advantage of on your runs Cutscenes and story moments covering the early portion of the game 3 unlockable Warlock Powers Herbarium 6 audio logs to collect Full farming gameplay for 6 different plant types A save file that is shared with the full version of the game Collectable furniture for your ship An upgradeable character and ship to a fifth of the power of the maximum in the full version of the game Harvest the Cosmos Venture into uncharted territories and gather an array of seeds and rare materials. Cultivate Your Bounty Onboard your trusty spaceship, transform your harvested resources into flourishing crops. Create the ultimate interstellar farm. Warlock Life On your travels, find rare and powerful flora you can bring back to your den. These plants can then be utilised to give you powerful boons on your runs. Trade Among the Stars Encounter wandering traders during your galactic escapades and strike deals to sell your produce for credits. Decorate Your Ship Find furniture on your expeditions and bring them back to spice up your farm. Upgrade Your Cosmic Expedition Spend your hard-earned credits to enhance yourself and your spaceship. Unravel the Secrets Immerse yourself in a story that unravels the mysteries of a long-dead planet. The fate of this forgotten world lies in your hands. Features Auto-firing weapons Fast runs (under 15 minutes) Over 150 unique powers available to customise your runs Find furniture and cuddly companions on your runs to take back to your ship Expand your farm, recruit drones to aid you in the busy work, and use your profits to increase the power of your character Each run takes you to many different planets, survive waves lasting 20-40 seconds and harvest as much as you can in that time

rows.name: Dream #46
rows.short_description: Chill exploration, contemplative ride game with a boat.
rows.description_html: Dream #46 is a contemplative ride game in an idyllic world that could come out of a dream. You control a small sailboat in a tiny world made up of 6 areas where each of them has its own color palette, its inhabitants. Navigate wherever you want among what is on offer. The idea is that you have a good time. Scrolls are scattered across the dream. Collect one and a positive affirmation will present itself to motivate you...about you. Like any dream, this one has an end. To do this, you must collect petals in order to reconstitute flowers and create a bouquet of flowers to finally give it as an offering... Have a nice dream.

rows.name: School: The Hardest RPG in Your Life
rows.short_description: School: The Hardest RPG in Your Life is a small RPG game that is happening at a high school. You play as Eli who has learned that he needs to pass all of his classes otherwise he will have to go to Summer School for his entire summer break.
rows.description_html: The Story Eli hasn’t always been the brightest crayon in the box, mainly because he ate those ones back in kindergarten. It’s almost summer break and he is ready for it, he has made multiple plans with his best friend, Joey. However, there is only one thing that is in his way, HIS GRADES. The government has just passed a law where if a student has a failing overall grade they will have to go to Summer School for the entire break. Determined to change his fate of an entire summer break spent at school Eli has hatched a plan for his final day of school. He is going to challenge all of his teachers and peers to an RPG battle for his GRADE. On the last day of school, Eli gets ready to challenge every single person in his school and to challenge everything we knew about High School. The Team Austin McKinney Thomas Watson III Martin Margolin Andrew McFall Tobie Allen Jared Laing Music Credit to: Kevin MacLeod Inspired By Final Fantasy Kindergarten Highschool (Trauma)

rows.name: Banter
rows.short_description: Welcome to Banter, the ultimate social VR sandbox where goofy physics and good times reign supreme! Adventure, excitement, and hilarious experiences with friends await you in the Bantaverse. So, what’re you waiting for? UNMUTE THE VIDEO! Can you recognise the voice?
rows.description_html: Physics-fueled games with friends Hello there. I assume you’re here to learn more about Banter. It does say ‘About this game’ up there, doesn’t it? Well, SideQuest (do you know them? Great bunch) made a Social VR game. With excellent physics in it. Go ahead and scroll down to see what else you’ll find in Banter. I promise it’s interesting.  The best physics in Social VR Harness cutting-edge FlexaPhysics ™️ (made with ❤️ by Nimso) and bend gravity to your will. Or get rid of it entirely. Who needs gravity, anyway? Be who you want to be Fully customize your Ready Player Me legs (with avatar) or import your creations from Blender to own your look. You look stunning, by the way. Banter’s better together Meet friends and make new ones at Banter’s regular hangouts, meetups, movie nights, karaoke-thons, and more. It’s called Social VR for a reason.  Get your game on—and push that tush From Ski Jump to Tush Push, challenge your pals on the Banter leaderboards. Can you become the number one number two? Share in the adventure Portal across the Banter-verse, explore thousands of community-created worlds, and survive the Banter Backrooms if you dare… Slam your body down and wind it all around Or don’t… Either way, you’ve got options for motion-tracking. If you build it, they will come… Build worlds, make games, host events, and share it all with the Banter community. Go on. Flap your wings like a social butterfly.  Join the Banter Banter is free to play—and always will be. Welcome to our worlds.

rows.name: Frontline 1942: Battles of the World War 2
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in the times of the Second World War II and become a real hero! Shoot, capture, win – the path to glory is paved with shells!
rows.description_html: Frontline 1942 World War 2 is an exciting online shooter that takes you into the thick of the battles of the Second World War. In this epic game, you will become a real hero, being on the front line as the best soldier. Accept the challenge and embark on a journey through destroyed cities, burning fields and dangerous jungles. You will fight in first-person mode, feeling the adrenaline and tension of each battle. The graphic execution of the online game will simply amaze you with its quality. Every texture in this shooter, every effect is created with love of detail so that you can fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Second World War. The soundtrack recreates the sounds of shots, explosions and commands, making the game even more realistic. You will have to fight in various theaters of military operations, including city streets, trenches, snow-covered plateaus and other dangerous locations. Each place has its own characteristics and strategic advantages, which you should skillfully use in your actions. Weapons will be your faithful companion in battles. You will be able to choose from a diverse arsenal, including rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenades. Each weapon has its own characteristics and capabilities, and you have to use them according to the current situation on the battlefield. Your teammates will be your friends or other players who also strive to win. Cooperation and coordination with the team will be important elements of success. Team tactics, communication and interaction - all this will help you overcome obstacles and win. Fight in exciting game modes, including team battles, assaults and holding positions. In each mode, you will have to use your skills and strategic thinking to achieve goals and win. The game features the intersection of several game genres such as: shooter, action, strategy, world war, race and pvp. You won't be bored! Frontline 1942 World War 2 will allow you to plunge into the historical atmosphere of the Second World War, feel a real spiritual connection with the heroes of the past and experience large-scale battles full of tension and dynamics. Be brave, be heroes and prove your strength on the battlefield!

rows.name: Why God?
rows.short_description: Climb high up the Tower of Babel by swinging and dodging all the children of the Lord to be able to ask GOD in one once and for all because he has made you so horrible in a world 2D cartoony. Explore in the most frenetic way the sad but exciting story of our little Amalgama.
rows.description_html: Ask GOD why he has made you so horrible On an ordinary morning at the foot of the Tower of Babel, our protagonist, an amalgam, was sleeping very peacefully, when suddenly, a piece of mirror falls from the sky and hits him on the head, causing him to wake up. The amalgam looks in all directions and realizes when looking at the ground the cause of its awakening. Picking up one of the mirror fragments, the amalgam realizes that there is something moving in it. rows.name: Gulf Echoes: Tent of Treason
rows.short_description: Embark on a co-op puzzle journey rooted in the Arab gulf region. Grab a friend and unravel tales from the past. You and your partner must bridge time, sharing clues to unveil hidden truths. Solve intricate puzzles from the present to the past.
rows.description_html: Note: This is a shortened version of our upcoming game Gulf Echoes: Memories of the Past . If you enjoy this game, consider adding Gulf Echoes: Memories of the Past to your steam wishlist! Gulf Echoes is a Co-op only game, two players require their own copy of the game. The game also relies on communicating with each other. Delve into the tale set in the Arabian gulf region. A cooperative puzzle adventure that traverses the threads of time. Play with a partner to navigate two intertwining times. You and your partner must choose between two paths. Each one of you will choose a separate path and explore the game from a different perspective. Your journey begins in a secluded desert tent, where betrayal casts a shadow on age-old friendships. Discover the clues, solve the puzzles and work together to finish the chapter Tent of Treason . Discover hidden truths, forge new pathways, and piece together fragments of memories as you embark on this mesmerizing journey. In Gulf Echoes, the past is not a distant shore but a living, breathing realm awaiting your exploration.

UNDO THE CURSE Placed upon you by a sword of dubious origin, the Princess has been turned into a pointy-eared goblin by a curse! Only the Dragon Goddess, the one you received the sword from, may know the the way to reverse it.. UNCOVER THE TRUTH OF THE DRAGON The Dragon master of the dungeon is not a simple monster! Traversing the dungeon, learn of her true nature from her minions and one mysterious friend... Traverse 3 unique levels of the Dungeon! Immerse yourself in instense turn-based combat! Experience pixel art inspired by classic RPGs! Face off against 8 unique monsters! Undo your curse to find the one your heart truly yearns for! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Animus Toil
rows.short_description: The legend speaks of an illusive temple cursed by the evil wizard Somnus. In this experimental puzzle-adventure game, two explorers uncover the temple and dive deep into its depths, only to find connections to our own future. Will they survive the madness, or will their psyches break them first?
rows.description_html: 'Ahead of you lies the temple of my creation.' Welcome to Animus Toil , the debut video game from Mindset Makers! The Temple Of The Herring was a legend to the people of Thera, said to be cursed by an evil wizard known only as Somnus. Two explorers find their way into the illusive temple, finding themselves trapped in a dynamic, yet parallel path towards their own fates. Who exactly is Somnus? Why is the temple cursed? What is the secret behind the mysterious artifacts? And how does this tale all tie into the future of our humanity? Animus Toil is an experimental puzzle-adventure game, featuring two playable characters and randomized room sequences, giving each player different experiences. While each puzzle can be solved on their own, it is encouraged for players to exchange solutions and reach the game's end together. Each playthrough has an estimated completion time of 1-2 hours, and there are 4 possible endings to discover. 'Proceed with curiosity.' Play the PC port for FREE! This native Windows version is the original Game Boy ROM running on GB Studio's built-in emulator and exported to an executable. This version allows for easy windows/screen-resizing, as well as plug-and-play support for controllers (such as the newer Xbox controllers, which have been tested and working). The controls are as follows: Arrow Keys = move player Z = A/select/interact X = B/back Receive the transmission in your own world. Donate to gain access to all bonus content! This includes access to the Game Boy ROM itself, as well as an exported version for Analogue Pocket, allowing you to experience the game natively through hardware or emulation. Also included is the official soundtrack, enhanced and exported to both FLAC and MP3 formats, as well as assets to create your own physical copy. Physical DVD-ROM copies are also available to order via the official Mindset Makers website (found on the side of this game page). These DRM-free discs include the full game and all bonus content. Animus Toil has been tested and working on most Game Boy emulators, although please be mindful when saving is implemented. VisualBoyAdvance is recommended. For the most authentic experience, as the creator intended, play on Game Boy Color hardware using a burned cartridge (requires battery for saving) or flashcart of your choice with stereo headphones. Thank you for playing. Good luck, explorers! Credits: Story, graphics, gameplay, and music all created by Hunter Gerace . GB Studio engine created by Chris Maltby . *STEAM DECK DISCLAIMER: Unfortunately, Animus Toil has been tested on every version of Proton and currently fails to launch. Until a solution is found, we recommend using the Game Boy ROM.

rows.name: Little Dew Drop
rows.short_description: Little Dew Drop is a small, relaxing and slow-paced 2D platformer. Enjoy the original soundtrack while travelling through six increasingly challenging levels.
rows.description_html: How does one sparkle in the darkness? Drip, the little dew drop, needs your help! Lead him through the forest to find the perfect spot to shine at the first light of dawn. Little Dew Drop is a small, relaxing and slow-paced 2D platformer. Enjoy the original soundtrack while travelling through six increasingly challenging levels. Don't fall on dry ground or get lost in flowing water! Can you find your way through small caves, around spiky caterpillars and over the great river to reach the perfect spot? ============================== This game was created as a family summer holiday project (🏝️😎💻🏖️). If you wish to support us, you can buy your own copy of the game's original soundtrack.

rows.name: Castle Empire
rows.short_description: Empire falls eventually. Build your own empire and conquer the world.
rows.description_html: At the end of Medieval time, firearms prevailed. The knights who had been glorious for more than one thousand years began to withdraw from the main stage of history. The power of the old empire fell apart... In Castle Empire, players will take on the role of alliance leader in the game and compete against the forces of the old empire with other players! -The chivalry lives on Eliminating evil and supporting the weak, building castles to protect your people. Unite with the surrounding rebels, and fight against the old empire together! -Unique Castle Feature Infinite map zoom, cutaway perspective, assign every castle room, training residents, and building your own dream castle! -Casual Tower Defense at Your Fingertips The game has added a casual tower defense gameplay, which is currently available in single-player mode. Although the gameplay is casual, it still offers strategic depth and requires certain finger flexibility! -Real-time Combat Control RTS large-scale map combat control, freely switch between marching and combat, multiple teams fighting simultaneously, flexible tactics and real-time operation, making the battlefield situation ever-changing!

rows.name: You're Not Family
rows.short_description: A (really short) free narrative rhythm game by Atiya Nova. Attend family dinners and time your key presses to the flow of conversation. Features lots of familial tension with a dash of misery. And cute bunnies!
rows.description_html: You’ve been invited to a week of family dinners with your parents and brother. Hopefully things will go well? Navigate tense social dynamics in this (really short) narrative rhythm game by Atiya Nova. Keep the flow of conversation going by pressing keys at the right time to fill up the family's heart meter. Fill it up all the way before time runs out to progress to the next level. But at what cost... Key Features Enjoy ~10 minutes of classical music and anxiety Feast your eyes on some cute 3D visuals Experience several rounds of moderately-paced rhythm action Explore what it's like to be the firstborn daughter. It's not a miserable experience at all! Look! Bunnies!

rows.name: Crunky's Fun Rager
rows.short_description: Hop your way through an endless arcade running experience where you complete challenges, collect letters, and defeat the Crunko Pops and anything they may be hiding. The game features tons of Achievements to collect, Stats to track, and Daily Leaderboards to compete against!
rows.description_html: In Crunky's Fun Rager , you play as Crunky , a bouncy energetic bunny seeking revenge against the mischievous Crunko Pops . Your goal? Keep Crunky hopping, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies. Jump on Crunko Pops to squash them or collect power-ups that grant Crunky unique abilities. Aim for high scores in order to top the Daily Leaderboard , complete Achievements for a completionist experience, and track your Stats along the way! Navigate trampolines , leverage knives , guns , and vehicles to take down enemies, collect red coins and protecting balloons . Each challenge completed earns Crunky a letter , and collecting 2 letters brings you to the next area. Crunky’s adventure starts in the sunny Crunkopolis Plains . Collecting the first 2 letters will bring you to the Crumpy Desert , where things start to heat up a bit. After collecting 2 more letters you will find yourself in the Cropular Underground before 2 more letters brings you to the forgotten Frunky Fields ... There are tons of wacky and zany Crunko Pops for you to encounter in Crunkoland, each with their own unique behaviours, and some only found in certain areas at certain times... Killing 100 of each will add their entry to the Michaelnomicon in your Crunkipedia . Want to support the game and snag some fun cosmetics for Crunky? Check out the Crunky Pass DLC ! Get 14 exclusive outfits/hats/accessories to customize Crunky’s appearance which can also be seen by your friends on the Daily Leaderboards .

rows.name: REPTILE CHRONICLES
rows.short_description: 'Reptile Chronicles' immerses players in a vivid 3D fantasy PVP arena where they wield powerful magic, from fireballs to laser beams, battling opponents in real-time multiplayer duels. Dive into the realm of reptiles and prove your dominance!
rows.description_html: Enter the realm of the reptiles, where magic and might intertwine. 'Reptile Chronicles' is a captivating fantasy PVP arena, drawing players into heart-pounding battles set in magnificent 3D environments. Whether you're a wizard craving arcane showdowns or a warrior thirsting for combat, this game is designed for those who seek glory in real-time multiplayer clashes. Key Features: Dynamic Magic Combat: Master a wide variety of spells ranging from the classic fireball to the devastating laser beam. Strategize and unleash your arcane powers to decimate the opposition. Stunning 3D Arenas: Fight across intricately designed battlefields, each boasting its own challenges and opportunities. Every arena is a spectacle of graphics and realism, ensuring players remain immersed in every duel. Real-time Multiplayer Duels: Engage in intense PVP matches against players from around the world. Forge alliances, challenge foes, and climb the leaderboards to prove your supremacy. Regular Updates: The world of 'Reptile Chronicles' is ever-evolving, with regular updates bringing in new arenas, spells, and champions to ensure the battle never grows old. Prepare your strategies, sharpen your skills, and step into the arena. In 'Reptile Chronicles', only the fiercest will survive. Are you ready for the challenge?

rows.name: メガロサミア -木星絶対防衛圏- Heaven's Fall
rows.short_description: This is a space fleet shooting game that can be easily enjoyed with FPS-like controls.
rows.description_html: Megalothymia - Jupiter's Absolute Defense Sphere - Heaven's Fall' is a space war 3D shooting game set in the solar system of the near future. As the commander of the War Monger, an independent fleet of the Unity, you take on the fleet of the space exploration conglomerate Lumberyard in a battle for control of the planet. You command your own fleet and aim for victory in a complex battlefield of many-to-many battleships, attacks, and explosions. In addition to attacking from your own ships, you must also be strategic in directing your fleet in order to gain the upper hand in the war. The game combines FPS and tactical elements to create a new kind of space warfare experience. Players can enjoy a variety of stages such as Asteroids, Jupiter, Earth, Sun, and Mars, as well as different missions such as retreat lines, defensive battles, and sieges. Your mission is to thwart Lumberyard's plot, which will be revealed as the battle progresses, and lead Unity to victory. Will you be able to fight through this war and chart the future?

Players can enjoy a variety of stages such as Asteroids, Jupiter, Earth, Sun, and Mars, as well as different missions such as retreat lines, defensive battles, and sieges. Your mission is to thwart Lumberyard's plot, which will be revealed as the battle progresses, and lead Unity to victory. Will you be able to fight through this war and chart the future?

rows.name: Interstellar Shore VR: I LIVE
rows.short_description: This timely avant-garde transdisciplinary work pioneers the concept of 'life intelligence' with a metaphysical space odyssey. Surging atop the AI explosion of 2022, it elevates discourse and provokes thoughts on human-machine relations, even arrays alternative futures.
rows.description_html: Interstellar Shore: Synopsis and Art Illustration The Interstellar Shore Program | ILIVE: The Illuminating Life-Intelligence Venture Engine The project was initiated as an Art-Tech-Philosophical Transdisciplinary Experiment collaborated by students from MIT. Subsequently, young creators from universities and colleges around the world joined in this collaborative transdisciplinary experiment. This timely avant-garde transdisciplinary work pioneers the concept of 'life intelligence' with a metaphysical space odyssey. Surging atop the AI explosion of 2022, it elevates discourse and provokes thoughts on human-machine relations, even arrays alternative futures. Via the Bridge of Myth and the legend of Interstellar Shore, Tabman and Shawn(you) set off to find new cosmic frontiers. You explore, climb, play, age, sicken, create, forget, pursue, and examine identity and existential question. Echoing Heidegger, our essence lies in living 'the question'. Like art, this visionary work 'brings the truth of Being to shine forth' — a digital-age satori unveiling reality as infinite self-discovery. Challenging Cartesian duality, it collapses inner/outer onto a Möbius strip threading through all infinitudes. Proposing technology as portal to awakening, this work generates insight into consciousness creating worlds anew with inter-enabling technology and humanity. Destined to shape the zeitgeist of generations to come. The work invites people to examine ego, id, superego - and beyond. The solid story, ample details and tripartite metaphorical allusions make the experience profoundly provoking. Hey, think about Tabman the name - anything new you are feeling now?

rows.name: homebound
rows.short_description: Tasked with finding humanity a new home, a lonely astronaut braves a desolate planet while making a fluffy friend along the way. homebound is a short 2D puzzle platformer that explores the feeling of home.
rows.description_html: Tasked with finding humanity a new home, a lonely astronaut braves a desolate planet, making a fluffy friend along the way. homebound is a short 2D puzzle platformer that explores the feeling of home. Play as the astronaut and the cat as they make their way through an abandoned planet. Prepare yourself to explore a mysteriously barren planet and find out why its inhabitants are all missing except for a lonesome cat, while delving into what feeling of home is. Features Cute Pixel Graphics: Featuring original hand-drawn pixel graphics, homebound creates a cozy and nostalgic atmosphere with its sweet and simple aesthetic. Retro Puzzle Platformer: Solve puzzles by manipulating the environment and utilizing the unique qualities of both the astronaut and the cat. Featuring 5 distinct levels, homebound keeps you on your toes by introducing new mechanics and puzzles of increasing complexity. Atmospheric Narrative: Explore the mystery of the abandoned planet, its inhabitants, and why they left. As you navigate deserted buildings and arid wasteland, discover the essence of home and what it means to leave home and to find a new one. What will you uncover about the missing civilization and the legacy they left behind? Original Soundtrack: Become immersed in the original soundtrack by William Watson as you explore and solve puzzles with your feline friend. homebound is intended to be a short 30-90 minute immersive experience.

rows.name: Dark Moon Deities
rows.short_description: Dark Moon Deities is a deeply strategic auto battler that can be played online vs. other players or offline against bots. Go beyond the grid with forceful spells. Subjugate the Old Gods in order to make their power your own. Bring forth nascent dark moon deities by stealing fragments of their power.
rows.description_html: Dark Moon Deities is a PvP auto battler with an emphasis on strategy as well as dynamic spells and effects. Units are able to specialize upon ranking up, allowing you to tech into countering your opponents or create insanely powerful combinations. Many abilities in the game apply Force, which may send enemies flying off the board and into the abyss... Ascending the Auto Battler Knock Out! Go beyond the chess board with powerful spells and abilities that may send enemies flying off the grid. Items: Units are able to attune to different items that allow them to bridge the gap between Devotions, creating powerful combinations that you may not think to be possible. Make your Warriors into Assassins, your Beasts into Undeads, your Archers into Elementals... the possibilities are endless! Specialization: Heighten the power of your unit's Devotions when ranking up. They are granted one specialization point to allocate as you see fit. Use this in order to shore up weaknesses in your draft, or go all out and acquire an effect that combines with your other effects in some unspeakable way. Graphics: This game takes full advantage of Unreal Engine 5's lighting and VFX to provide an immersive, next-gen experience. Online Ranking System: Coming soon! Chaos Garden: Coming soon!

rows.name: Interballistic Symphony
rows.short_description: A musical, fast-paced indie game all about speed and swift thinking. Navigate through tricky environments, use powerups to your advantage, push your skills to the limit and become the next interballistic master.
rows.description_html: Interballistic Symphony is a musical, fast-paced indie game all about speed and swift thinking. Easy to learn, hard to master, interballistic features several levels set in galactic and cold, unforgiving environments. Navigate through various obstacles and see how far you can make it. Featuring a normal mode and a marathon mode for more casual gameplay and endless mode with highscore lists for competitive players. Several EDM soundtracks. Normal mode. Go from point A to point B. Marathon mode. Multiple levels put together and speed being a more important factor than normal mode. Endless mode. See how far you can make it, while the speed increase over time. Powerups such as slowmotion, low gravity and score boosts to help you through tricky obstacles and reach new heights. Set and save public highscores in endless mode. Discover collectibles, unlock a bunch of achievements and push your skills to the limit.

rows.name: Tiki Tandems
rows.short_description: Tiki Tandems is an online and local multiplayer PvP game. With fast-paced gameplay and easy-to-learn mechanics and combat it's a great game to play with your friends or grind against anyone worldwide!
rows.description_html: Tiki Tandems is an online and local, fast-paced multiplayer game! The genre of the game is a Fighting game, although it doesn't really fall into 1 category. The best way to classify Tiki Tandems is a fun party game to play with your friends! But you can also queue up against anyone in the world and fight for the number 1 rank. The fighting style is somewhere in between Brawl Stars and Super Smash Bros but with 1 key difference. The players do not have health or knock-back bar and you can fight each other as much as you want So what is the main goal and how do you win then? Both Tikis fight over the grace of the Totem. In the middle of the 2 players, there is a big Totem which decides who wins the match. The Totem can be turned by both players all the time by hitting one of its 2 wings. Depending on the angle and distance between the players and the Totem, the totem rotates in the appropriate direction with the appropriate amount. The first Tiki to successfully turn the Totem by 180 degrees wins the match! There is also a second functionality to the Totem. If you were to turn the Fists of the totem you increase your Dedication to the Totem. The more dedication you have, the more powerful your attacks become Tiki Tandems is a fast-paced game. The game is meant to be very straightforward and easy to play for anyone. There isn't a huge skill cap but you definitely need practice to be the best at the game. We wanted to make the game accessible to as much of a wider audience as we can, so whether you are playing at home with your friends or grinding against players worldwide you can always compete with everyone. The matches last 3 minutes, so that you can play many rounds without being stuck playing against 1 person. Or if you are playing a local tournament on one machine, everybody can play without having to wait a long time, similar to Tekken-style rounds

rows.short_description: A mouse only 2D precise plateformer who will challenge you.
rows.description_html: JAPP: Just Another Precise Platformer is a mouse based 2D precision platformer that is quite challenging. But when you have the physics of the game in your fingers, it's a pure bliss. Climb to the top the fastest possible way is your mission on this game! You can (for now) play 2 characters, the Square & the Circle . Both have their advantages and disadvantages, but you can climb to the top as fast with both. I hope you will enjoy this as much as I enjoyed making this game. Have fun :)

rows.name: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered
rows.short_description: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered is a strategy-based indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics, featuring chaotic and intense gameplay mixed with an old-school psychedelic artstyle. Solve math problems, meet Dave's friends, and uncover the secrets of Dave's school.
rows.description_html: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered is a strategy-based indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics, featuring chaotic and intense gameplay mixed with an old-school psychedelic artstyle. Meet Dave, a math teacher in a motorized wheelchair. You need to grab your friend's art contest drawings, but Dave wants to do some math with you! Solve some math with Dave and get all of your friend's missing papers. Make sure you don't make mistakes, Dave doesn't like mistakes. If you do happen to make a mistake, don't worry! There are many different kinds of items lying around the school that you can use to your advantage. Dave knows what you're doing though and just to make it even, he's brought his friends to help him out. Can you get all 8 missing papers (and solve some math here and there) and escape? Hey there! Welcome to my school! Return to Dave's school in this brand new version of Dave's Fun Algebra Class! Solve math problems, navigate the halls, and uncover the secrets of Dave's school. It contains everything from the original mod, but with a brand new coat of paint! Many new features have been added to the game, and many features from the original have been brought back and improved upon. Some of these features include gameplay improvements, visual improvements, and more! New ways to twist up the game! Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered brings new ways to change up the game! If you think you have the hang of the normal game, try out 'Hard Mode' where the math is harder and the characters are faster! If you're feeling wacky, try out Modified mode, which contains a selection of modifiers that change up the game in different ways when activated. There are also some secret gamemodes you can discover by doing certain things in the game!

rows.name: Solomon's Link
rows.short_description: In Solomon's Link, catch a glimpse of two lives on the lam: A pair of fugitives, raiding an abandoned factory to survive. Piece together their pasts, and watch over their fragile partnership as it grows - or crumbles - around the shackles that serve as their only unquestionable bond.
rows.description_html: This game is a result of 6-month long challenge during which three people tried to create a short but complete game. Unfortunately, due to personal life issues, we couldn't finish the story in time. We're releasing the game as a short demo for archiving purposes but please keep in mind that the game will not be expanded on any further . FREEDOM IN CHAINS Solomon's Link is a short (~15 minutes), story-driven, point-and-click demo , in which you serve unseen as both witness and guide to a pair of fugitives living out their first night of freedom after years behind bars. With two vastly different minds and two specialized sets of hands to work with, lead the escaped convicts through an industrial maze of fuse boxes and factory lines by leveraging each prisoner’s strengths to offset their partner’s mental and physical limits - not to mention, the limited reach of the chain that binds them together. PRISONERS’ DILEMMA In the process of their escape, jailbirds L.T. and R.T. broke free from their chain gang, but not from each other, leaving each of them bound to a criminal they hardly know, guilty of crimes they’d never learned. With no choice but to work together, yet no clue of each others’ intentions, each is left to weigh their mutual dependence for survival against the looming threat of betrayal, and balance the trust needed to move forward against the deceit necessary to stay safe. For better, or for worse - every word that is spoken, and every thought that goes unsaid, holds a chance to tip the scales. FLY ON THE WALL Justice is blind; you are more fortunate. Watch the world from above through the countless eyes of the factory’s security system, and hear the whispers of the concrete jungle with environmental sounds packed full of custom-made foley. Independently control R.T. and L.T. in both movement and conversations through simple, intuitive UI, stay immersed with menus designed to help you settle into the role of an investigative observer, and indulge in a fully-fledged original soundtrack to score it all. SOURCE CODE The source code for the game, together with all the assets, is available at .

rows.name: 20 Small Mazes
rows.short_description: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. They're good mazes, though.
rows.description_html: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. If you solve the mazes, you beat the game. It's about 1-2 hours long, maybe. You need a keyboard and mouse to play it on PC. There is some basic controller support, but at one point in the game you have to type something. If you're playing it on the Steam Deck, the game is Steam Deck verified and the keyboard will automatically pop up. A few puzzles require knowledge of English. No puzzle requires sound or audio to solve it. No puzzle requires being able to recognize different colors. I hope you enjoy it.

rows.name: Idle Space Navy
rows.short_description: A sci-fi idler. Upgrade your ships, get new items, and conquer the stars.
rows.description_html: Your home world’s been raided one too many times. Perhaps there’s some resources the raiders want, or they just needed something to fight. Either way, you’ve had enough. You purchase an old, small command ship and take to the stars, buying whatever equipment you can get on the way. Your goal? To conquer and pacify the stars. Idle Space Navy is an idle/incremental game currently in active development by Phoenix Aura, developed as a spiritual successor to Idle Space Raider and Transport Defender by Yaroslav ‘IDNoise’ Nikityshev with their permission. Assume command of your ship, patrol space, defeat enemies, collect resources, and increase your power by upgrading and purchasing ships, weapons, and more. As of version 0.10.7, Idle Space Navy currently includes the following: Purchase and position your ships on the map grid, then outfit your ships with your choice of weapons. 7 ship types currently implemented. 10 weapons in 3 types currently implemented. Use credits to upgrade the power of your ships, boosting their damage output. Refine scrap fragments into metal ingots in the Foundry, and upgrade even further or buy new items in the Shipyard. Reset to earn Calibration Chips, then use them to unlock and upgrade item types and boost your fleet through the Laboratory. Fit your ships with Modules to boost their performance over a short period. Automate boosting your active ships’ levels as well as that of your Shipyard upgrades. When you advance far enough, collect Artifact Fragments to trade with alien powers and boost your fleet even more! Earn daily rewards just for playing the game! Earn progress to keep your fleet advancing even when you're offline!

rows.name: S.A.B.A.H. (Sun As Biased As Harmony)
rows.short_description: The bias between the sun and harmony will be shattered by the chosen one...
rows.description_html: Story The Tree of Harmony provided balance. This balance it created expressed a harmony between the Ideal universe and the Reflected universe. However, the Sun disrupted this balance, that's when harmony was lost, and the ideals and its reflections got mixed up... Only the chosen one, who woke up after all this chaos, can restore harmony and eliminate the Bias. The union of the Sun and the Tree of Harmony can be brought back into balance with the chosen one... Description S.A.B.A.H. (Sun As Biased As Harmony) is a Hack and Slash, endless action RPG game. In this game, you are creating a character and killing enemies. Map's pace changes by doing required things and you go upper 'floors'. On each 'floor', enemies become stronger and harder. The strongest one goes to the top! Caution: The game is not exactly endless, it has an ending, but it's almost impossible to reach! Will you manage to make it? Features - Fast Paced Combat - Male and Female Character Options - Warrior and Magician Classes - Level System - Title System - Various Character Stats - Endless Game (Almost Impossible Ending) - Turkish and English Language Support - Controller Support How To Play Keyboard and Mouse WASD for moving. Spacebar to attack. Shift + WASD to sprint. Left click to terrain for moving. Left click to enemy for moving and attacking to enemy. Right click to screen for camera control. Middle click to screen for jumping. Left click to dropped items for collecting them. Drag and drop the item to appropriate equipment slot to equip. Drag and drop the item to screen from inventory to remove it from inventory. Left click to buttons to function. After leveling up, left click to the plus (+) buttons to upgrade associated stats on the stats panel. Gamepad Left joystick to move. Right joystick to camera control. dPadUp to jump. Right bumper to attack. Left trigger + left joystick to sprint.

rows.name: Tiny Balls
rows.short_description: Tiny Balls is a multiplayer party game in which up to 12 friends can play against each other. In the three modes, players control a marble and must either push their friends off the track in a heated race, play a game of tag, or be the last to survive on a platform by pushing their friends off.
rows.description_html: Tiny Balls is an entertaining party game that can be played with up to 12 players. You might yell. You might even curse. And it's not sure if 'friends' will still be friends afterwards. But in any case, Tiny Balls will offer extremely fun game sessions. Please note: Tiny Balls cannot be played alone! To start one of the game modes, a minimum number of two players is required in the lobby! It is recommended that you buy the game together with at least 2-3 friends. KNOCKOUT MODE: Basically a 'Last Marble Standing' mode where you have to knock your friends off platforms. Do you risk using the boost to push a friend off the edge, even though you could catapult yourself out in the worst case scenario? FREEZE MODE: A 'game of tag' mode where a certain number of players randomly become 'hunters' at the start of the match. The hunters must hit all the non-hunters, causing the non-hunters to be frozen and unable to move. However, frozen ones can be unfrozen by being touched by a friend. If all non-hunters are frozen at the same time, the hunters win. RACE MODE: A heated and fast-paced racing fun where you not only want to be the first to cross the finish line, but also hit your friends as many times as possible along the way to gain a speed boost! GAME HIGHLIGHTS: competitive multiplayer fun for up to 12 players (online & LAN) 3 game modes for each mode there are 4 maps physically correct marbles that you control yourself marble is customizable fast, short sessions easy to understand, hard to master

rows.name: THE SOUL OF TOO BIRDS GAME
rows.short_description: Destroy all art. Free the soul.
rows.description_html: THE SOUL OF TOO BIRDS GAME. An interactive experience designed to accompany Melbourne experimental hip hop group Too Birds' 2023 album, The Soul of Too Birds. This interactive multimedia companion piece mutates Too Birds' chaotic, noisy soundscapes and opaque lyrics into otherworldly labrinyths where you are given but one objective: destroy the paintings and ultimately, free the soul. Drawing inspiration from an esoteric mix of influences, Too Birds' brutal and cryptic sound blends elements of harsh noise, hip-hop, and industrial metal to create a relentless auditory deluge. Too Birds personnel Teether, Realname, and Mr. Society concoct a musical experience that pushes the envelope in all directions. Now, you might be wondering, 'what features and content can I expect from this game?'. Well, there are many features and contents within this game. Here is a list of the game's features and contents: - Exist in a world. - Move around, said world. - Look at things. - Destroy paintings with your powerful hands. - Listen to the album The Soul of Too Birds .

rows.name: Franzen
rows.short_description: Franzen is a turn-based RPG set in a dystopian-steampunk world. Explore themes of empathy and politics as Franz and Lefsa Dellia work to uncover the truth of 'The Scream'. Meet a cast of colorful characters and fight bizarre creatures in your journey through the world of Branzen!
rows.description_html: Game Features: Snappy turn-based combat with a unique leveling system, grind free! Fast-paced, short and sweet story. Vibrant world full of diverse enemies and items. The perfect Micro-RPG! Story Synopsis: 'Branzen. The Holy Lands. A world of Light and Dark. Flesh and Metal. The massive city, Akon, created by his holiness, Akanakon. A united, true empire. Or so it would seem...' 'Eighteen years ago, a terrible event happened. 'The Scream', a massive tear from which ceaseless darkness spewed. This darkness corrupts the mind and body, twisting those affected into monsters. 'Daemons', they call them.' Eighteen years since the 'Decade of Darkness', The Scream still stains the skies of Branzen. Franz and Lefsa Dellia, amateur Technomancers, are studying this strange phenomena, in an attempt to prove that it's expanding. Rapidly. 'Now, only one thing is true. The sun is setting on this world.' Uncover the mysteries and dark secrets of Branzen. Tour a vast world of varying cultures. Rise to power as you navigate a web of bureaucracy and corruption. Meet charming party members who will join you on your quest. Read the history of Branzen and its many kings. Explore the true meaning of Empathy.

rows.name: Squeaky Squad
rows.short_description: The Squeaky Squad struck again! Fight an army of rodents in this roguelite platformer.
rows.description_html: Squeaky squad is a Roguelite platformer in which you have to defeat an army of rodents plaguing your ship. Explore 5 various areas in any order you want with their unique quirks and ennemies. Upgrade your character with equipment and weapons to find new ways to fight back the Squeakers. The Ship: This gigantic procedurally generated labyrinth is composed of 5 unique areas with their unique traps and enemies. From flooded pipelines to factories and aerial decks it will be your choice to go wherever you want first as you can defeat the Squeaky Squad in any order you want. The Squeakers: These malicious rodents are so well organized they started to become an army equipped with guns, machines and even more... You will have to use any weapon you find to fight back while dodging their traps and surviving wave fights. You may even save some prisoners who will help you out in the ship hub. The Ship hub: The hub is the best place to find new ways to fight the Squeaky Squad. Use currency kept between your attempts to buy new weapons to be found and upgrade your character with the help of the people you will save along the way. The Squeaky Squad: They are the leaders of the Squeaker army. You'll have to take them down one by one in each area to hope finding whoever is behind this organization.

rows.name: Beyond Hanwell Teaser: The Royal Hallamshire
rows.short_description: The Royal Hallamshire is a standalone teaser to the upcoming psychological horror Beyond Hanwell.
rows.description_html: Beyond Hanwell is currently in very early active development, please report any bugs or preferences via Steam's discussion boards. I'll try to keep the teaser updated as I develop the full game. Thanks! - Nathan Beyond Hanwell: The Royal Hallamshire Head through the gates of The Royal Hallamshire and discover it's secrets. A hospital far beyond the borough of Hanwell, The Royal Hallamshire is a standalone teaser to the upcoming psychological/survival horror Beyond Hanwell . Dual control melee combat system, land each hit and combo with satisfying intensity. Play your own your own way, non linear open gameplay makes for a unique experience. With multiple ways to complete the location. Immersive. All player feedback is displayed in game, with no HUD whatsoever to keep you immersed and the tension high. Explore a dynamic environment. Play through The Royal Hallamshire multiple times and discover new ways to finish the location with their secrets. We're trying to create an effortless control scheme, navigate the environment naturally with minimal tutorial. The Royal Hallamshire is dense, detailed and atmospheric, explore, search, scavenge and survive. Interact with the world in various ways, use the environment to take out enemies or open up new paths to discover. Dual combat system and environmental blocks. Open up different paths based on what you have available at the time.
