rows.name: Olive's Art-Venture
rows.short_description: Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes which then cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you.
rows.description_html: UNIQUE CONTROLS ( Although Keyboard + Mouse is still absolutely playable! ) About the Game STORY Olive is a struggling artist in her late 20s who sleeps alone at a government funded art studio that's short on supplies. Receiving a giftcard for UNLIMITED purchases at ' Magi-Art ' art store, how could she not chase up this opportunity? Tricked into entering the wizard's tower, she now must fight off waves of freakazoid art monsters so she can escape and claim her prize! GAMEPLAY Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes and cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you. Every level introduces a new enemy as you attempt to make your way to the top floor and kick whoever's butt built this crazy place. If she's extra efficient and collects enough coins, she'll enter FRENZY mode and be able to cast an infinite amount of spells for a short duration. FEATURES Battle through 8 Floors New enemies on every floor A special Boss Battle at the end Takes 20-30 minutes total to playthrough

rows.short_description: In Underlevel, you play as hordes of skeletal minions working to stop a hero from raiding the dungeon to level up and kill your boss. And as skeletons, you REALLY can't afford to lose the dental plan they provide!
rows.description_html: UNDERLEVEL '...And so it was God's Will for the Gallant Knight to seek CONQUEST , gather RICHES , and SLAY creatures of SIN. This... is YOUR DESTINY!' GAMEPLAY Underlevel is a game where you play as a horde of skeletons while a player is raiding the dungeon, trying to get as much XP as they can so they level up and potentially kill the boss at the end - it's your job to stop that from happening. Try your best to rescue all the skeletons, destroy all the loot and keep the player from levelling up before they make it to the final floor. The Knight will smash vases and skellies alike to earn loot and level up. At the end of the game, all your saved skeletons are unleashed on the Knight! Hopefully you saved enough skeletons and destroyed enough loot to overcome their growing might. FEATURES Smash loot before the Knight reaches it Gather and rescue skeletons before Knight kills them Follow the Knight's action with the Knight Cam (TM) Throw down in a final battle to save the Boss

rows.name: Lively Chair Simulator
rows.short_description: Lively Chair Simulator is an indie multiplayer game with strange controls. Let’s see if you are suitable to be a chair.
rows.description_html: Lively Chair Simulator is a game with freaky controls. In the game, you are moving a chair by controlling each of the legs of the chair individually. Sounds difficult, but walking is not the limit of a chair. They can run and maybe jump. Have a Try, it is free for now. See if you are suitable for being a chair. It is not a WASD system, instead, it is a QWERASDFGH system, four for moving legs forward, four for moving legs backward, and two for abilities. It is important to have a basic understanding of the system. In single mode, there are some levels to let you get good control of the chair. Some chairs may not be suitable for passing all levels. After finishing the levels, you should know how to walk, run, upslope, upstairs, push boxes, and jump. In multiplayer mode, there are six games. 15m Race and Seesaw games can be started with only one player. 15m Race – Just Run Pushing Game – The last one not touching the outside wins. StoneBall – The first team reaches 10000 points wins. – Earning points if public stoneball or your team target stoneball in range of your team pointing stoneball. – Losing points if no team members are in range of your team pointing stoneball or any team stoneballs from the other team in range of your team pointing stoneball. 6036 – The time of the last person who touched the ball will be accumulated. – The game ends when someone's time reaches 60s. – The one with the time closest to 36s wins. Air Hockey – Just like air hockey Seesaw – The game ends if the seesaw hits the ground. – Getting points from pushing away the stone balls. – Losing points if you fall. Features: – 7 different chairs – 12 levels – Multiplayer – Achievements – Simple 3D Graphics

rows.name: Future Breach: Youngblood
rows.short_description: Future Breach: Youngblood is a prologue chapter of the main game, Future Breach 3D. Breach and Clear areas tactically in a team-based shooter.
rows.description_html: What to expect gameplay-wise: This ISN’T a casual run-and gun that you can just pick up for a few minutes. We've made a tactical methodical game with resource gathering, teammate commands, various team classes and squad management. If you like dungeon crawlers you’ll fit right in. Your main priority is to capture workers in a nonlethal manner, though the final decision is up to you. Loot enemy bases for supplies and materials, both for yourself and to build the megaship. Command your squad to breach doors, capture workers, build turrets and heal you. Lore: It is the year 2501. Humanity colonizes space, and the war for Gliese 581C is on. Unbeknownst to both factions, an asteroid is heading their way. However, in the fighting they destroyed all the spaceferring megaships. Now, they must raid each other’s bases to capture workers to build their ship first, before the planet is hit. 3D-Rendered color game that has full XVGA resolution support. - Command a Squad and Breach into buildings! - Destructible walls and doors - Customize your and your squad's loadout - Full control of your squad- tell em what to do! - IS there a story? YES, you'll love it Command to Breach and clear! Be nonlethal when possible...

rows.name: INVERT: The Climb
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey to the moon in this rage inducing precision platformer with no checkpoints! You'll climb, fall, then cry and do it all again.
rows.description_html: No Updates Unfortunately, I have lost the source code for this project. For that reason, there will be no future updates or content added. It won't be possible to fix any bugs too. About the Game INVERT: The Climb is a rage inducing precision platformer with no checkpoints. Your Goal? To reach the moon! It's as easy as it sounds... ok maybe not. How To Play? You can invert the map to show new paths or... fall down to the start. Your choice I guess... GAMEPLAY High Stakes Platforming: The only way to the moon is up, if you fall then that's on you. Inverting: Invert the map to show new platforms but destroy old ones. Experience All Emotions: The emotions you'll probably experience are happiness, satisfaction, peace, pride, heartbreak, anxiety, stress, confusion, frustration, that one emotion you experience when you throw your controller, a sense of being cheated, pain, and most importantly, rage. FEATURES All your progress is saved, both good and bad. An addictive gameplay loop. Online leaderboards based on fastest time.

rows.name: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE
rows.short_description: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE is the first part of a dialogue-based, story-driven psychological horror game made in RPG Maker MZ.
rows.description_html: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE is the first part of a dialogue-based, story-driven psychological horror game made in RPG Maker MZ. 'Where did this all start?' Tomorrow is the anniversary of your son's death, but you can't let that distract you from your everyday life. Your daughter has just sent you a message asking you to pick her up near that one shark dude's bar. Worry not - your guardian angel can keep you company... Wait, who the hell is that? 'I think...' This game features original art/music and is about one hour long. This might depend on your reading speed, how many things you check, your choices, etc. This game has one ending. '...I think I realize it, now.'

rows.name: Home
rows.short_description: A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!
rows.description_html: Late at night you enter their world. You will inhabit a girl named Abby and influence the world around her. Accompanied by her brother Michael you will traverse beautiful lands, unfamiliar places, and dark forests. Careful your presence has caught the attention of something sinister... Many indie RPGs claim to be a new quirky game, but Away From Home is a mix of many great RPGs. It captures weirdness, difficult decision making, and a beautiful story. The game combines traditional RPG gameplay with rhythm game elements! The characters are full of emotion and let you empathize with them. Don't forget that this world needs you . Imagine if a JRPG and a Rhythm game had a love child. This game plays like Earthbound when it comes to walking and talking in it's overworld, but when it comes to missions and battles it throws in rhythm games related to the event. Characters also have real voices to help create mood and feeling to them. The big highlight of the gameplay is the huge amount of animations. The characters in this world are alive and through your gameplay you will begin to understand. The amount of things to do in locations are never ending. Chocked full of lengthy side missions that unlock you new moves and items as well as random chance based events. The progression of side quests and random town events are based from entertaining games such as Yakuza 0! The world is large and will take you hours to complete everything, not to mention alternate routes that bring replay-ability. Some routes include game changing decisions as well as items and battles you wouldn't be able to do had you made different choices.

rows.name: SKULLFracture
rows.short_description: SKULLFracture is the latest creation of Nuskadamo, notorious to few, irrelevant to most, and it's a 3D fighting game that promises to leave a lasting impression on the player!
rows.description_html: Humans have lived for thousands of years in relative peace, having to fear only their own cruelty, but this was never meant to last. The Blue Men, an ancient race of warriors thought to have been exhiled forever, have made their return, and they want to reclaim their spot at the top of the food chain. Will humans put aside their differences for the greater good? Or will they die by the hands of the Blue Men? This is the story of SKULLFracture! SKULLFracture is the latest creation of Nuskadamo, notorious to few, irrelevant to most, and it's a 3D fighting game that promises to leave a lasting impression on the player! Featuring: -21 Characters -12 Arenas -A single player campaign with multiple challenges and bosses! -6 different endings -6 mini-games! -A highly customizable exhibition mode -A local Multiplayer -And MORE! And if enough of you buy this game i MIGHT consider working on an online multiplayer feature. But you'll have to ask nicely. CONTROLLER REQUIRED FOR GAMEPLAY, MOUSE & KEYBOARD SUPPORT FOR MENUS FROM NOW ON YOU CAN ALSO GRAB THE PROTOTYPE VERSION OF THE GAME BY FOLLOWING THIS LINK!

rows.name: CODEDOOR
rows.short_description: A tense survival action game where you hunt for uniquely coded containers in an abandoned container yard infested with zombies. Survive, strategize, and fight your way to Wave 10 to unleash a decisive, game-ending nuke.
rows.description_html: About This Game Welcome to CODEDOOR, a thrilling survival action experience set in a chilling, abandoned container yard overrun by relentless zombies. Each session throws you into an eerie industrial landscape scattered with locked containers, but only one matches the unique code you're given. Your objective is clear: hunt it down and unlock it to advance to the next wave. Satisfying Combat Arm yourself with powerful weapons, including the precise M1911 and rapid-fire MAC-10, each delivering satisfying feedback with impactful visual effects and immersive sound design. Feel the intensity with every shot and elimination as you fend off waves of aggressive zombies. Ultimate Goal Reach Wave 10 and secure at least 30 kills to unlock the ultimate weapon... The Nuke. Pick it up, launch it, and celebrate a spectacular victory, bringing an explosive end to your nightmare. Key Features Dynamic Container Hunt: Freshly generated codes and containers ensure random and endless replayability, ideal for speedrunning. Impactful Combat: Satisfying weapon handling, impressive kill effects, and immersive audio feedback. Strategic Survival: Test your tactical thinking under constant pressure. Immersive Environment: Detailed, atmospheric container yard designed to keep you on the edge of your seat. Rare and Mysterious Events Be alert! The abandoned yard holds secrets... Will you unlock the secrets and survive the CODEDOOR?

rows.name: Alta's Odyssey
rows.short_description: Alta's Odyssey is a 2D Platform Adventure. After suffering the loss of his beloved rabbit, Alta travels on one final journey with his companion where together they explore the stages of grief through colorful and mysterious landscapes.
rows.description_html: Alta's Odyssey is a 2D Platform Adventure. After suffering the loss of his beloved rabbit, Alta travels on one final journey with his companion where together they explore the stages of grief through colorful and mysterious landscapes. Time your jumps right to make it across broken bridges and treacherous obstacles and find pieces of carved stone collectables hidden throughout the levels for a fitting end to a lifelong friendship.

rows.name: We're Tethered Together
rows.short_description: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.
rows.description_html: Offered as sacrifice, you play as a character desperately seeking escape from a dark presence lurking within the catacombs. Trapped below, danger lurks in a world frozen by fear. With the help of a mysterious guide, you’re not alone on your journey. To survive this perilous trial, use your wits to platform, swing, and sneak as you endure treacherous forces at every turn. Originally created as a submission for the Brackey’s Game Jam 2022.2 and ranked 14th place, the short and sweet game of 'We’re Tethered Together' has been redeveloped from the ground up. Will you escape... or become another offering?

rows.name: The InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess
rows.short_description: This game is a Soulslike Role-playing game that uses a progress system (“leveling system”) for measuring players’ rates of success. This version of the game is a single-player mode-only game.
rows.description_html: Take to the role of The InVincible Iron Ivy ('Iron Ivy') in this Soulslike 3rd person role-playing game (“RPG”) who has superpowers that harness properties encompassing concepts of science called 'Sci-fi Powers.' Iron Ivy’s powers are labeled as Geokinesis, which provides her with the ability to manipulate and control both the elements of earth and nature. This dynamic includes synthesizing lightning bolts, controlling and manipulating, moisture, and barometric/atmospheric pressure to form, and manipulating gases and liquids to cause chemical reactions. Additionally, she uses this ability to manipulate ivy leaves to make her ivy board that provides her with flight. Finally, Iron Ivy has the ability to transmute plants into humanoid and animaloid ('animal-like') creatures like her A.I. companions Sunny, Snapper, and Lily. You will unlock Iron Ivy's Sci-FI Powers by accumulating experience points (“XP”), deactivating enemy troopers, acquiring items and special attributes, rare tools; and the exploration and completing quests.

rows.name: HBD-RPG
rows.short_description: Explore a world of pixel art fantasy, where every building holds a unique surprise. Help the locals, dance in a side quest, and finish the main quest. But don't forget, it's your birthday at the end of the day! Have FUN!
rows.description_html: Explore a world of pixel art fantasy, where every building holds a unique surprise . Help the locals, dance in a side quest, and finish the main quest. But don't forget, it's your birthday at the end of the day! Have FUN ! Lore-heavy: The game focuses on the lore of Cotton Kingdom and does not contain much intense battle mechanics. Male-centric: The game was originally developed to wish the developer's brother on his birthday, so it is male-centric and does not have a gender-change feature. Short and sweet: The game can be completed in 45-60 minutes and there is no post-game content. Free to play: The game does not require any permissions or in-app purchases. It is completely free to play for life. Controls: Click 'Options' from the Title Screen to configure Keyboard mappings Use mouse pointer as a secondary control Made with RPG Maker MV: The game was created using the RPG Maker MV game engine. All credits and references are published at the end of the game as rolling credits.

rows.name: Treachery in Beatdown City U.N. Trouble
rows.short_description: Master the art of the Presidential Fist! Play as Blake Orama on his way to the UN. Meet terrible people and beat 'em up with STYLE! FREEZE TIME, build custom combos with fireballs, centrist uppercuts and roundhouse kicks in this quick prologue to Treachery in Beatdown City!
rows.description_html: Treachery in Beatdown City U.N. Trouble is the exciting prologue to the Brawling Action Tactics game Treachery in Beatdown City. In Treachery in Beatdown City, President Blake Orama was kidnapped during his speech at the U.N. This is your chance to play a fresh look at what led up to the speech. Orama may be a bit stiff and pretty full of himself, but when it comes down to it he can throw down in the streets! In this prologue, play as Orama to explore the area around the U.N. and encounter/fight off a deluge of the WORST people, from obnoxious bicyclists to werewolf loving wannabe politicians. FEATURES: Use the power of the PRESIDENTIAL FIST to throw out fireballs, flying uppercuts, spinning kicks, and more! Use a mix of real time and COMBO MENU based attacks to tackle your foes! Build custom combos from a bunch of fun unique attacks to create strike combos, grapple combos, and strike and grapple-ombos! Fight against class based enemies, each with their own unique attack styles, behavior patterns and looks! Inflict Status Effects such as Stun, Burn and Bleed; but watch out, the enemies can do the same! Nod your head to a timeless score by Inverse Phase, creator of such albums as Pretty Eight Machine and the Chipping of Isaac

Players will be matched up and the faceoffs will play out one at a time. Customize your appearance by choosing one of 10 available sprites and a custom nickname system! With 8 different maps, strategy changes from game to game!

rows.name: Full Moon
rows.short_description: An adventure in werewolf hunting, for witches.
rows.description_html: Dot Vine is a witch on a quest to kill the werewolf! But aside from that bit, it's really not a killing thing. Dot's a nice witch. You'll need to find treasures, learn secret spells, and remember obscure clues -- paper and pencil are recommended. Play is similar to Zelda. Equip one item at a time. Your principal weapon is a feather. (were you hoping for a sword or a crossbow? sorry to disappoint).

rows.name: ReversiBot
rows.short_description: The roles of keyboard and mouse will be reversed
rows.description_html: Be a transforming bot which changes its control along with its form. As the bot transforms, the roles of keyboard and mouse are reversed! Two forms You can destroy the enemies' red cores with the weapon in cannon mode, which allows you to move using WASD and shoot using the mouse Some enemies have yellow shields around their red cores. You should transform into shotgun mode so you can neutralize the shields by shooting with WASD while avoiding enemies with mouse dash Four enemy types and boss Four different enemy types each have their unique characteristics and combine to challenge the players The final boss awaits you, demanding mastery of transformation and control

rows.name: Knight Speed
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic medieval adventure in this fast-paced endless runner. As a valiant knight, leap across perilous towers, skillfully shoot down enemies with your trusty bow, and protect your kingdom while racing against the relentless passage of time.
rows.description_html: Overview Embark on an epic medieval adventure in this fast-paced endless runner. As a valiant knight, leap across perilous towers, skillfully shoot down enemies with your trusty bow, and protect your kingdom while racing against the relentless passage of time. Controls To jump, press the Spacebar. Press the Spacebar again in the air to double jump. Aim using the Mouse Cursor, and while jumping, click the Left Mouse Button to shoot. You can pause the game at any time by pressing the Escape key.

rows.name: Salvo Shuffle
rows.short_description: Salvo Shuffle is a bullet-hell roguelike that mixes turn-based and action-based combat.
rows.description_html: Salvo Shuffle is a turn-based bullet-hell roguelike with combat mechanics similar to Undertale . Enemies can only damage you by spawning individual bullet-hell attacks (aka. salvos ). Defeat the most challenging foe to make your life easier or keep them all alive for a massive combo and coin multiplier . The choice is yours! The salvos might be simple on their own, but because you fight many enemies simultaneously, the actual bullet hell can vary drastically from fight to fight. Ascend the procedurally generated Firework City and collect various augments to assist you in your fights. Manage your coins and health until you make it to the top and defeat the final boss that is waiting for you there. The City is composed of many interconnected spaces. Choose one of up to four spaces at a time until you reach the end, on the 30th space. Plan your route carefully! Some spaces are dangerous fights, while others might give you a temporary buff, some coins, or health, or they might be a shop for you to purchase new augments or to upgrade your items. Between dodging the enemy attacks, you can strike back by using your weapon or the many different augments you collected in Firework City. Focus fire is of the utmost importance. If one threat is giving you more trouble than most, it could be a good idea to focus on killing that enemy first. However, you will also be rewarded for leaving enemies alive for longer. It's high risk, high reward. Augments are the run-defining items of Salvo Shuffle. There are active augments that you can trigger manually and passive augments that either affect a stat or get triggered automatically under certain conditions. Every augment is distinct from the next and changes the gameplay in a significant manner. Applying status effects is one possible effect of augments. They can greatly impact how difficult the next wave of salvos is going to be. Watch out though, most augments also have minor negative effects , so choose carefully! The game offers many unique challenges to increase the difficulty of a run. There are 10 challenges with up to 3 levels of difficulty. Although they make the game overall more difficult, they also grant you more exp and coins. So if you want to use more augments in a run, this is where you'd do it. The game also features an action difficulty slider in the options to slightly decrease or increase the difficulty of salvos with no penalty or guilt attached. Some achievements will also greatly affect your run and will reward you with a player cosmetic to use. And best of all: Salvo Shuffle is completely free to play ! No in-app purchases, ads, or anything. The game also has a public discord server (link on the right).

rows.name: Chill Drive
rows.short_description: Welcome to Chill Drive, this game can provide a comfortable atmosphere for studying, working, or resting. Plan those long, difficult, or delayed tasks, then complete your goal in an undisturbed environment!
rows.description_html: 🔥 Neon Dash Coming Soon🔥 About the Game Introduction Make a plan you want to focus on, and then start a comfortable and undisturbed time. Music is always helpful to improve efficiency, Chill Drive has multiple relaxing music to help you focus on your plans in a comfortable atmosphere. In addition, custom music lists also support importing local music you like. Tomato clock supports custom focus time and break time, switch between multiple styles of backgrounds and different environments white noise. Through various settings options, you can design suitable arrangements and environmental atmosphere. In the calendar, you can view records of daily completion plans, as well as statistics of total time and completion quantities. NO STEPS, NO MILES. In Chill Drive, you can review every step of the past. Features Tomato clock Customizable tomato clock function, set a goal and complete it! Relaxing music 20 relaxing music tracks and support for importing local music Dynamic background Multiple styles of dynamic backgrounds, for entering an immersive state of focus Environmental white noise Choose white noise suitable for your focused atmosphere, shut out external 'noise' Calendar and Statistics Record each goal you have completed, and count the cumulative number and time of tasks completed

rows.name: Chess Ultimate
rows.short_description: Chess just got an upgrade! Chess Ultimate, where precision strategy meets colorful chaos. Build your team from a roster of unique, quirky characters to defend your King while plotting your opponent’s downfall. Easy to pick up, endlessly fun to master, and a fresh take on the classic game of wits.
rows.description_html: Prepare to rethink everything you know about chess! Chess Ultimate is a draft-based strategy game that combines the timeless appeal of chess with dynamic, game-changing twists. Build your dream team by drafting unique characters, each with their own powerful abilities, and face off in battles where no two games are ever the same. Outsmart your opponents with clever strategies, unleash your team, and dominate the board in this exciting reimagining of the classic game. Whether you're a chess enthusiast or a newcomer, Chess Ultimate offers fresh gameplay that keeps you coming back for more. Are you ready to draft, strategize, and conquer?

rows.name: SCP: Rulebreaker
rows.short_description: After the opening of Site Samekh, only Sites 15 and 19 remain active. Complex Samekh was the most secure, but a new director hastened its downfall. As a guard, surviving the madness of anomalies is vital.Survive and find the way out.
rows.description_html: Dive into the heart of horror with this survival game inspired by the mysterious SCP Foundation. [/img] Following the opening of Site Samekh , once a secure bastion of the Foundation, chaos has erupted. All other sites, except for Sites 15 and 19, have been abandoned, converging on the Samekh complex. An unprecedented concentration of anomalies, unleashed during a containment breach, has left the complex in a state of desolation. Take on the role of a Foundation guard, facing the ultimate survival test as the horrors of the anomalies threaten to consume everything. Game Features: Explore an SCP Foundation complex, once safe, now plunged into madness and danger. Follow the radio communications of Tactical Response Officer (TRO) Alex , trapped in the surveillance room, and uncover the secrets of the complex to escape. Face a variety of anomalies , each with unique behaviors and mechanics, making every encounter unpredictable. Use your diverse arsenal to fend off anomalies and switch optics ( ACOG, Red Dot, EOTECH ) to adapt to various combat situations. Deploy grenades to repel entities, and access crucial areas of the complex using access cards. Use  SCPs like SCP-714 or SCP-005 to assist in your survival quest and tackle unique challenges. Walk, run, and aim strategically to evade the dangers of the containment breach. Use  night vision goggles to explore the dark corners of the complex. Discover the game's fascinating story, particularly the key events triggered by the new director. Search the complex's various computers to understand the situation and unravel the mysteries surrounding you. Immerse yourself in a world where the abnormal becomes the norm, and strategic thinking is the key to facing your deepest fears. Dive into the unknown, survive the Samekh complex, and remember: We work in the shadows so you can live in the light. The fate of the complex now rests in your hands. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

rows.name: Virtuar Z
rows.short_description: Virtuar Z is a sci-fi third-person shooter game set in the future in a city full of conflict. Experience adrenaline-pumping laser combat from a third-person perspective that gives players a wider field of view, allowing for better situational awareness & strategic maneuvers.
rows.description_html: Character & Classes Choose from a diverse of unique character classes, each with their own distinct playstyle, weapons, and abilities. Whether you prefer being a stealthy assasin, an armed tanker, or a versatile healer, there's a class to suit your preferred. Progression & Customization Unlock new character, weapon, and special abilities as you progress in play the game by collecting combat points. Customize your character's appearance and loadout to create a unique playstyle that reflects your personality through in-game purchases. Third-Person Perspective Experience adrenaline-pumping laser fights from a third-person perspective that provides players a wider field of view, allowing for better situational awareness & strategic maneuvering. Engage in fast-paced battles, utilizing a variety of weapons, abilities, and tactics. Competitive Ranking System In Virtuar Z, the competitive ranking system is designed to reflect a player's skill level and provide a matchmaking experience that is balanced and competitive. As you win streak 5 matches, you can progress through the ranks. These tiers represent the skill level and matchmaking ranking of players. Here is a general overview of the tier pool in Virtuar Z. Zenith is the highest tier in Virtuar Z and is reserved for the absolute best players in the game. Futuristic Collection Cards In Virtuar Z, collection cards are a part of the game's progression system that allows players to customize and enhance their gameplay experience. Here are some key points about collection cards: Unlocking and Upgrading - Collection cards can be obtained by earning them through gameplay or by opening crates. Enhancing Abilities - Each collection card provides a specific enhancement or ability to your character or class. Customization - Collection cards allow you to customize your playstyle and tailor your character or class to your preferences. Elemental Weapon System In Virtuar Z, there are a variety of elemental weapon system and their effect that players can use.

rows.name: Hotel VIP
rows.short_description: Welcome to Hotel VIP, a very particular and secret place in Heaven City. Discover the hotel, meet the residents but don't say a word...
rows.description_html: You are a guest in this very particular hotel in Angel City. The room has been paid for few days by the company and you have a lot of free time. Take your time to explore the hotel, enjoy the view and meet the other residents but remember, you must not say a word. A swap puzzle game set in a strange hotel Explore, swap images and unlock cards! - Explore the Hotel VIP freely. - Meet the other residents and interact with them without talking. - Solve little swap minigames to unlock images. Is it that easy ? - 18 Clues to collect in total (40 with DLC). - 4 Rooms to discover - 16 pictures to unlock  (80 with DLC) All 3D arts by JUL3D.

rows.name: Super Paul World
rows.short_description: Experience a great adventure in 'Super Paul World' where you defeat many enemies while trying to retrieve the Cookie Nexus Core for Baker Tim. Earn experience points (EXP) to acquire various cosmetic items.
rows.description_html: Dive into an exciting adventure in 'Super Paul World' where you can choose from 6 unique characters and countless cosmetic customization options to make your hero one of a kind. Your mission? Help Baker Tim regain his ability to produce cookies. Experience the thrill of the game in various modes, including the single-player story mode where you'll battle through multiple levels, and the endless mode where you collect points by defeating countless enemies until you run out of lives. You can also team up or compete against friends in the multiplayer mode. Earn experience points (EXP) by defeating enemies or playing the multiplayer mode and level up to unlock a variety of cosmetic items, including knight armor, fox suit, blue jacket, blue cap, crown, and much more. Your skills will be put to the test as you make both big and small jumps in the game world, scale walls, and defeat enemies in melee or ranged combat. Stay alert, as defeated enemies may drop life, helping you stay in the game longer. The story begins when two villains steal the Cookie-Nexus-Core, which gives Baker Tim the ability to produce cookies. Chase the villains through different worlds and embark on an epic adventure to retrieve the Cookie-Nexus-Core and help Baker Tim. Gameplay Features Singleplayer Story Endless Fight Arena Controller Support

rows.name: Demon Of The Dark
rows.short_description: A 3D Survival Horror Game, in which the player has to investigate an abandoned medical research facility, while looking out for whatever danger that resides in the unknown darkness. An indie game made by a 14 year old student.
rows.description_html: SURVIVE Progress through the horrifying hospital, try not to fall prey for the monster who is somewhere in the darkness. Solve puzzles to get a step closer to the exit and making your way out of this nightmare. Your journey will only get more and more twisted, and troubled, as you move on. THE MONSTER The monster goes on a killing spree once it escapes its enclosure, and wreaks havoc, killing countless people. Escaping it is near impossible, due to it's stealth and quick movement. If you see him, RUN. The only option is to run for your dear life, before the monster reaches you and ends your life. PRODUCT DESCRIPTION Demon Of The Dark is a 3D Exploration / Investigation indie horror project, made by a single-developer. The player, Ethan, investigates an abandoned medical research facility, to piece together the possible events that may have taken place. The player will face many obstacles, and will eventually face a mutated organism that kills anything it sees. As the player delves deeper and deeper into the facility, the more twisted it starts to become. STORY You are Ethan Luke, a fairly new police investigator with a knack for solving mysterious cases. You find yourself standing outside an abandoned research facility late at night. There have been numerous reports regarding the missing people lately. None of the people had any past criminal record or history. All investigations so far point out to this building that has been abandoned quite for some time. As part of your job, you are directed to look into the whole area, as there has been a recent report of a fellow cop, Joseph William, a.k.a. Joey, being reported missing while investing the area. No words received from him after he went into this building. You are further advised to look for any clues, such as employee notes or any other hint around this facility to establish a better concept of the possible chain of events happened here. These steps are not mandatory, but you need to check the whole hospital, until you are at the end. The SWAT team is being engaged and will be en route soon. Good Luck. You'll need it.

rows.name: My Douchey Boss Has a Gentle Twin Brother?! - BL Visual Novel
rows.short_description: Kyle's new boss, Vincent, is mischievous and eccentric. One day, Kyle bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind. Later, he finds out he'd actually met his boss' twin brother, Vernon. The brothers are estranged, but what happens when they fall for the same person?
rows.description_html: When Kyle gets a new job at a fashion company, he meets Vincent Zircon, who happens to be his eccentric boss. Vincent, being quite mischievous, often teases the newcomer, Kyle, causing him to think that his boss is odd. One day, he bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind and gentle, even offering to buy lunch for him. Kyle starts to wonder if his boss is messing with him again. But after confronting the man about his change in behavior, Kyle realizes that the kind and gentle version of Vincent is actually someone else. Someone named Vernon Zircon, Vincent's twin brother. As Kyle gets closer to the twin brothers, he finds out that they are estranged. The two are very different individuals with different values, making it hard for them to get along. So what will happen when they both start to develop feelings for the same person...? The character you are playing as. Kyle is an average employee who just wants a normal job and a normal life. Vincent is outgoing and playful, but he's serious when it comes to his job. He works hard to maintain his fashion company. He has a bad habit of lashing out at people when he's feeling stressed. Vincent doesn't like relationships within the office. He especially dislikes it if an employee has a crush on him. Due to his busy schedule, he hasn't gotten the time to relax and go out with someone. Vernon is gentle and considerate of others. After his father retired, Vernon took over the business. Although he is talented when it comes to his job, he isn't passionate about it. Since he feel like his life is empty, he tends to visit a café to escape from it all. Being a CEO of a company, Vernon feels as though he doesn't have a genuine connection with anyone. He just wants a real friend. - Around 30K Words (2-3 Hours Playtime) - 3 Endings (Neutral Ending, Vincent's Ending, Vernon's Ending)

rows.name: Wacky West
rows.short_description: It's time to grab your revolver! You are the only survivor in a world after a nuclear disaster. Don't wait for high noon. Get moving and fight mutants and zombies to get your cat back! Collect materials, craft weapons, upgrade your gear, and show those freaks they shouldn't mess with the sheriff!
rows.description_html: Wacky West is a crazy roguelite set in the Wild West! You are the sole survivor in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Fight hordes of mutants and zombies, collect materials, and upgrade your equipment to face the toughest bosses. In the sun-scorched Arizona desert, every day is a fight for survival! Craft increasingly powerful weapons, upgrade your gear, and save your cat - your only friend in this unforgiving world! Save the kitten Imagine a world where you have no support except your furry friend. Well... At least your kitten will keep you company. Except that heartless mutants have abducted your pet, and you are its last hope ! Don't give up! Run forward and become stronger with every run. Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons , and never give up! Each run brings new upgrades and materials that will bring you closer to defeating the most dangerous bosses . As is often the case in roguelite games, the further you run, the stronger your survivor becomes. Very Wild West Wacky West is the wildest west on Steam. You'll need a keen eye and quick fingers to take on the toughest bosses. The atmospheric music and desert landscape of the map will provide you with the highest level of immersion. Zombies and mutants won't let you go, but they don't know that justice has looong guns ! Key features: Create weapons: A unique arsenal of weapons, from auto-aiming machine guns to rocket launchers and flamethrowers. Gather resources: Use everything you find along the way - scrap metal, trash, and other materials - to craft tools and weapons. Fight bosses: None of them will go down without a fight. They'll throw grenades, unleash hordes of mutants, and do everything they can to stop you. Traps and power-ups: Avoid dangerous barbed wire, acid puddles, and other traps. Collect useful items—both consumable and functional—that will help you throughout the game. Test different modes: After defeating the final boss, you can continue playing in infinite mode, with greater challenges and double rewards. Grow in strength: Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons, and unlock maps. Each game opens up new possibilities for you.

rows.name: Virago: Reality New
rows.short_description: Virago: Reality New invites you to a chilling adventure where you guide Willow, a survivor escaping abuse, through a world of terror. Master the torchlight, outwit relentless stalkers, and navigate between reality and nightmare. Can you ensure Willow's survival in this heart-pounding pursuit?
rows.description_html: Virago: Reality New invites you to delve into an immersive narrative that follows the tumultuous journey of Willow, a young girl escaping an abusive home only to find herself entangled in a realm of terror and intrigue. This third-person adventure/horror game offers an intense pursuit experience, blurring the lines between reality and nightmare as you strive to outsmart relentless pursuers. Storyline Embark on a haunting odyssey as Willow breaks free from the chains of her troubled past, seeking refuge amidst the enigmatic cityscape. Unforeseen alliances offer fleeting solace, until a sudden abduction compels Willow to ingest a toxic substance. As poison courses through her veins, Willow's reality fractures, plunging her into a surreal realm of hallucination and dread. Gameplay Virago: Reality New promises an adrenaline-charged gameplay experience, where you must navigate a perilous world teeming with danger. Equipped only with a torchlight, skillfully maneuver through dimly lit environments, leveraging the flickering light beams to disorient stalkers and unveil concealed pathways. Survival hinges on your resourceful evasion and mastery of stealth tactics. Features Intense Third-Person Adventure: Immerse yourself in Willow's harrowing journey, racing against relentless stalkers and confronting the horrors born from the depths of her psyche. Eerie Atmosphere: Traverse an atmosphere saturated with suspense, seamlessly blurring the boundary between reality and illusion to maintain an unrelenting tension. Stealth and Survival: Utilize your surroundings to outsmart tireless pursuers, employing strategic cunning to elude danger at every juncture. Torchlight Mechanics: Manipulate the eerie torchlight to your advantage, distorting stalkers' perceptions while illuminating paths toward safety. Mind-Bending Hallucinations: Experience Willow's fragmented reality firsthand, grappling with disorienting hallucinations that twist the very fabric of her environment.

rows.name: Hues of the Void
rows.short_description: A dark, eldritch defense game, involving color matching and minion management! Can YOU stave off the Chromacrusade?
rows.description_html: Combining color matching, line defence, and some random puzzle elements, Hues of the Void is a unique and engaging take on the “x-defense” game genre. Within these prismatic lands, you must defend yourself against the advancing knights of an oppressive theocratic order - The Chromacrusade ! Hone Your Minion Mastery Charge your portals and release a spectrum of creatures from the Void against the onslaught of the Chromacrusade. Minions such as Slimes, Skeletons, Shades, Gazeblasters and many more are at your disposal. Once a minion has served it's purpose, dismiss them just a readily! Scheme plots from your Inner Sanctum Customize your load out of Artefacts , Familars and Friends ! Within your Sanctum, fine-tune your menagerie of eldritch horrors and undead monstrosities, and claw your way to victory over the Chromacrusade! With plenty of summonable monsters to unlock, synergies to uncover and experiment with, your journey is uniquely your own. Delve into Forbidden Secrets Follow the trail of the Chromacrusade, right to the very source! Lead your Summoners to victory through Story Mode, following the story of the Prismatic Lands, unlocking more along the way. As your grand pilgrimage through the Story campaign is complete, dive into endless mode! You can test your most clever combinations and skills against ever-increasing waves of unique and challenging enemies. The vibrant and colorful world of Hues of the Void offers uniquely challenging gameplay experience. As a small family team, it's our sincerest hope to provide an entertaining and engrossing game for players of all ages; it will test your skills and keep you engaged throughout many hours of gameplay!

rows.name: Louma
rows.short_description: Louma is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler. Fight through the procedural generated floors and save the World of Louma.
rows.description_html: Story: The evil never sleeps, it just wants one thing, its power back. Stop it and search in the Dungeon after artefacts. But be aware, it’s getting more dangerous the deeper you get. Procedural generated floors: The World of Louma will be generated procedural. Fight the enemies and find a way to your destination. Search after keys, artefacts and collect resources. Categories: In the beginning there are different categories between you can choose. Each category has its individual abilities. Upgrade your character: You can upgrade your weapon and buy potions to get a better level. Your level defines your life/power.

rows.name: Battlesmiths: Blade and Forge
rows.short_description: Craft. Battle. Grow. Join thousands of players in the ultimate tactical RPG where every piece of gear is forged by you — and every fight tests your strategy.
rows.description_html: OVER 1,500,000 INSTALLS WORLDWIDE – NOW ON STEAM! After two years of forging, countless battles, and thousands of blades created, your turn has come. Battlesmiths: Blade & Forge is the perfect blend of RPG, deep crafting, strategy, and auto-battler — available now on Steam! Build your town, manage your forge, master the blacksmith trade, create legendary weapons and gear, and lead a squad of heroes into PvP and PvE fights. Prove that you are the ultimate swordsmith and strategist in the medieval world. MASTER THE BLACKSMITH’S CRAFT In Battlesmiths , your gear is not a trophy, but the result of your mastery. Weapons, armor, and runes are created by you — they directly change the appearance and battle style of your heroes. Start forging and upgrading swords and armor, and apply powerful enchantments. Every item crafted by your blacksmith affects the tactics of your heroes in battle. A new smithing master mini-game allows you to personally participate in the creation of every blade. Feel like a true bladesmith! Experiment with skills and gear to create builds that your opponent in the PvP arena will not be ready for. Don't forget about trading: your town residents will gladly buy your handcrafted goods and fill your pockets with gold! LEAD YOUR HEROES TO VICTORY IN TACTICAL BATTLES Assemble a brave squad of powerful warriors and mages. Optimize your builds: equipment and runes directly affect your heroes' damage and movement. Your decisions before the fight determine its outcome. The semi-automatic tactical battles encourage thoughtful preparation and precise tactics. No plan is perfect, but your strategy and the right combination of classes and gear will provide you with the best chance for victory. BUILD AND DEVELOP YOUR TOWN Develop your masters, upgrade buildings, acquire valuable resources, and unlock new crafting and building technologies.  Your town is the core of your power. Protect your legacy by crafting the most perfect gear for your heroes. GUILDS, EPIC BOSSES AND EPIC BATTLES Join a clan or create your own. Unite with allies to fight epic bosses, share resources, and receive guild bonuses. All for the sake of victory! EVENTS AND CHALLENGES Participate in challenges with time-limited rewards, complete daily quests, and earn rare resources. Events are regularly updated: a new goal, a new enemy, and new trophies always await you. FULL PC EXPERIENCE Battlesmiths on Steam is the full, uncompromising functionality, optimized for desktop computers. Play and become one of the greatest blacksmiths to forge their legend in the crafty world of Battlesmiths .

rows.name: My Friend Aki
rows.short_description: A horror-tinged puzzle and exploration game set in an abandoned mall. Improvise tools, uncover secrets, and stumble upon something strange and bright in the darkness.
rows.description_html: My Friend Aki is a puzzle-based exploration game focusing on the use of improvised tools to make your way through the hallways of an abandoned mall. What remnants were left behind by the building's previous curators? What bright and glowing secrets now lie nestled away? Make use of the game's novel dynamic lighting system to illuminate gloomy corners and dusty hallways as you slowly turn parts of the mall back on. Make your way forward by creatively utilizing what was left behind.

rows.name: Mirrorscape
rows.short_description: Mirrorscape is bringing the table back to virtual tabletops! Build and play around the table or around the world using authentic 3D terrain, miniatures, and dice from top companies you know and love. Cross-play on iOS and Android devices using the magic of augmented reality!
rows.description_html: Mirrorscape: Immersive Tabletop Gaming Redefined Introducing Mirrorscape, the free-to-play app that delivers an immersive and authentic tabletop gaming experience on PC, Mac, iOS and Android. Built for Dungeon Masters (DMs) and players alike, Mirrorscape offers an intuitive and easy-to-use, authentic 3D environment for building and playing your favorite tabletop role-playing and war games. 'Mirrorscape uses AR to create what might be the best D&D virtual tabletop yet' - GamesRadar+ 'It's easy to get excited about the augmented tabletop, for how it might further revitalize tabletop gaming.” - Wired 'The promise of living characters and armies battling on the tables before us, across atmospheric and immersive worlds, is arguably too cool to second guess.' - Wargamer Free Starter Set and Trial Mirrorscape is free-to-play, and every player receives a Free Starter Set of terrain, miniatures, and dice from renowned brands in the tabletop world, including Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, Fat Dragon Games, TitanCraft Custom Minis and Hero Forge. Claim a bonus of 5 free Hero Forge minis when you link your Hero Forge account. Additionally, to enhance your creativity and world-building abilities Mirrorscape offers a 30-Day Free Trial of everything in the Mirrorscape Store. Intuitive World-Building Building has never been easier thanks to Mirrorscapes’s intuitive drag-and-drop stacking, snap points, copy, paste and group functionality and use of clipping planes for multi-level construction of mighty castles, simple taverns and deep, dark dungeons. Bring light to your creations with lit terrain and prop lights. DMs and GMs can easily create intricately detailed adventure maps to be shared with their players and streamed on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. Or, for the “Lazy GM”, grab a pre-built map made by our vibrant user community that fits your campaign or share your own creations on the Mirrorscape Hub! Authentic Digital Twins for Terrain, Minis, Props and Dice From Famous Tabletop Brands To create the adventure map of your dreams Mirrorscape boasts a vast collection of fully painted digital twins of terrain, miniatures, props, and dice from famous brands you already know and love including Fat Dragon Games, Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, and Norse Foundry. Each item is meticulously crafted to be an authentic replica of the original physical item for an unparalleled level of realism. Digital replicas of real-world dice bounce in the virtual world just like they do on your table. Dungeon Master Tools to Share and Manage the Adventure Mirrorscape equips DMs with a comprehensive suite of Dungeon Master Tools to manage game night and craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Once your world is complete, share it with your players for free, then use features like hide and reveal for “fog of war” effects, ambient lighting to set the mood, beacons to draw player’s attention, and line of sight and measurement tools to ensure a seamless and engaging gameplay experience. The built-in Mirrorscape HUB streamlines game scheduling, keeping your adventures organized and accessible while helping players find games and Games Masters find players. Immersive Player Experience with Character Point-Of-View Players of role-playing tabletop games and tabletop wargames can choose from a deep collection of beautifully painted miniatures to represent their characters and immerse themselves in their virtual worlds by dropping into their character’s point-of-view. Connect your Hero Forge account and drop your custom minis on the table for even more options! Roll digital dice, inhabit the world from a first-person perspective, check line of sight and bring your adventure to life like never before! Grow Your Collection With Mirrorscape you never pay for the same piece twice and with our ‘top off’ system you can buy ready-to-play maps, terrain, and mini bundles from our amazing partners, and only pay for the pieces you don’t already own. Grow your collection and unleash your imagination for an unbeatable value. And remember, anything you buy you share for FREE with your players! Play Together Anywhere, On Any Device Cross-play together whether around the table or around the world using your PC or Mac via Steam or our iOS or Android mobile versions for phones and tablets. Design on desktop, tweak on tablets, and have your players join in on their phones. Most features are cross-platform so use the screen and device that works for you! Explore in Augmented Reality on Mobile Watch your games come alive with our cutting-edge AR tech on mobile versions for iOS and Android! Drop your maps on your table in authentic, lifelike 3D as if they were real. Roll digital dice that bounce off your actual tabletop! Enter life-scale mode and literally walk through your creations. Players can view the environment through their character’s eyes while it’s being described for an unforgettable experience! Join the Mirrorscape community today and elevate your tabletop gaming experience!
rows.about_html: Mirrorscape: Immersive Tabletop Gaming Redefined Introducing Mirrorscape, the free-to-play app that delivers an immersive and authentic tabletop gaming experience on PC, Mac, iOS and Android. Built for Dungeon Masters (DMs) and players alike, Mirrorscape offers an intuitive and easy-to-use, authentic 3D environment for building and playing your favorite tabletop role-playing and war games. 'Mirrorscape uses AR to create what might be the best D&D virtual tabletop yet' - GamesRadar+ 'It's easy to get excited about the augmented tabletop, for how it might further revitalize tabletop gaming.” - Wired 'The promise of living characters and armies battling on the tables before us, across atmospheric and immersive worlds, is arguably too cool to second guess.' - Wargamer Free Starter Set and Trial Mirrorscape is free-to-play, and every player receives a Free Starter Set of terrain, miniatures, and dice from renowned brands in the tabletop world, including Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, Fat Dragon Games, TitanCraft Custom Minis and Hero Forge. Claim a bonus of 5 free Hero Forge minis when you link your Hero Forge account. Additionally, to enhance your creativity and world-building abilities Mirrorscape offers a 30-Day Free Trial of everything in the Mirrorscape Store. Intuitive World-Building Building has never been easier thanks to Mirrorscapes’s intuitive drag-and-drop stacking, snap points, copy, paste and group functionality and use of clipping planes for multi-level construction of mighty castles, simple taverns and deep, dark dungeons. Bring light to your creations with lit terrain and prop lights. DMs and GMs can easily create intricately detailed adventure maps to be shared with their players and streamed on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. Or, for the “Lazy GM”, grab a pre-built map made by our vibrant user community that fits your campaign or share your own creations on the Mirrorscape Hub! Authentic Digital Twins for Terrain, Minis, Props and Dice From Famous Tabletop Brands To create the adventure map of your dreams Mirrorscape boasts a vast collection of fully painted digital twins of terrain, miniatures, props, and dice from famous brands you already know and love including Fat Dragon Games, Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, and Norse Foundry. Each item is meticulously crafted to be an authentic replica of the original physical item for an unparalleled level of realism. Digital replicas of real-world dice bounce in the virtual world just like they do on your table. Dungeon Master Tools to Share and Manage the Adventure Mirrorscape equips DMs with a comprehensive suite of Dungeon Master Tools to manage game night and craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Once your world is complete, share it with your players for free, then use features like hide and reveal for “fog of war” effects, ambient lighting to set the mood, beacons to draw player’s attention, and line of sight and measurement tools to ensure a seamless and engaging gameplay experience. The built-in Mirrorscape HUB streamlines game scheduling, keeping your adventures organized and accessible while helping players find games and Games Masters find players. Immersive Player Experience with Character Point-Of-View Players of role-playing tabletop games and tabletop wargames can choose from a deep collection of beautifully painted miniatures to represent their characters and immerse themselves in their virtual worlds by dropping into their character’s point-of-view. Connect your Hero Forge account and drop your custom minis on the table for even more options! Roll digital dice, inhabit the world from a first-person perspective, check line of sight and bring your adventure to life like never before! Grow Your Collection With Mirrorscape you never pay for the same piece twice and with our ‘top off’ system you can buy ready-to-play maps, terrain, and mini bundles from our amazing partners, and only pay for the pieces you don’t already own. Grow your collection and unleash your imagination for an unbeatable value. And remember, anything you buy you share for FREE with your players! Play Together Anywhere, On Any Device Cross-play together whether around the table or around the world using your PC or Mac via Steam or our iOS or Android mobile versions for phones and tablets. Design on desktop, tweak on tablets, and have your players join in on their phones. Most features are cross-platform so use the screen and device that works for you! Explore in Augmented Reality on Mobile Watch your games come alive with our cutting-edge AR tech on mobile versions for iOS and Android! Drop your maps on your table in authentic, lifelike 3D as if they were real. Roll digital dice that bounce off your actual tabletop! Enter life-scale mode and literally walk through your creations. Players can view the environment through their character’s eyes while it’s being described for an unforgettable experience! Join the Mirrorscape community today and elevate your tabletop gaming experience!

rows.name: Fallen
rows.short_description: A minigame collection game where you help people in the town of Havoton to regain your angelic status!
rows.description_html: Eson is an angel who is punished with the curse of mortality when they steal the Sky God's Amulet. Now they have to help people in Havoton, a Halloween-obsessed town, in order to survive and atone for their crime. Play through many different and unique minigames as you help the residents of the town prepare for their Halloween festivities and other daily menial tasks. However, with the help of the Goddess of Balance, you can make some of these minigames easier! No strings attached! Experience the game's story and customize your experiences by helping different people out and completing all of the minigames. There are multiple endings, try and collect them all!

rows.short_description: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level.
rows.description_html: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level. You can control your cube with the 'WASD' keys and rotate the world with 'E' and 'Q'. As you complete the chapters, you can unlock new worlds. Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame offers a fun and immersive gaming experience that requires both intelligence and skill. In-Game Features Rotating the World Teleporting Platforms Challenging Maps

rows.name: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor
rows.short_description: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor is a third person, hoard-shooting deck builder where you play as Chutney, shooting down hordes of enemies with his Omni-gun. Alter your attacks by collecting different cartridges and create unique synergies!
rows.description_html: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor is a third person hoard-shooting deck builder that mixes the distinctive look of 1960's retrofuturism with comic book themes and a pastel toon-shaded palette. Face off against hordes of aliens with an auto-shooting hand of ‘cartridges’ - weapons and abilities - that you build and synergise throughout each run. Unlock new cartridges, skills, and original backing tracks through achievements and meta-progression so that you enter each run stronger than before: more weapons, more skills, more XP, more aliens, more groove! Level Up! Grow your power with stat increases as you gain experience and level up Build your Deck! Clear stages to earn rewards, and buy new cartridges to up your arsenal Defeat your Enemies! Use your new power to slay swathes of aliens Repeat!

rows.name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
rows.short_description: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.
rows.description_html: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players. Card Battles The rules of Shadowverse are simple, yet offer limitless ways to strategize and win. Use different card combinations to create unique synergies and strategies in battles against players all around the world. Dive into the game and enjoy strategic card battles with breathtaking graphics and effects. Free Card Pack Every Day Log in to open a free card pack every day! Collect cards for the new compendium feature! Enjoy battling and collecting! New Game Mechanic: Super-Evolution Each of your followers (unit cards you play on the field) can now super-evolve! Followers that have super-evolved are stronger and can knock opposing followers out with powerful attacks and deal damage straight to their leader!  Super-evolve your followers and enjoy exhilarating card battles like never before! Class Choose from 7 unique classes that match your playstyle and create custom decks. Tailor your deck to match your strategy and style, then dive into epic card battles! Story Experience a brand new Shadowverse story where characters are brought to l ife with full voice acting! Follow spectacular stories centered around seven unique characters, each bringing their own personality to the adventure. New Feature: Shadowverse Park Step into the Shadowverse CCG community where players can connect and interact! Show off your avatar with customizable outfits and emotes, bond with others, and grow stronger together!

rows.name: BLOKI
rows.short_description: BLOKI is an educational game in which you'll transform into a designer of residential building facades from the Soviet era. Using the available set of tools and guidance from the moderator, you'll design facades and develop the nearby area.
rows.description_html: BLOKI is an educational game about residential architecture from the Soviet era. It aims to make people aware of the important function of the colors of buildings, as well as to encourage reflection on the spaces around us. The game also allows you to signal your own needs related to the aesthetics and functioning of these estates while showing the consequences of their implementation. Work plan at the estate: 1. Prepare a facade design for two residential buildings. Use the color palette and available geometric patterns. Follow the instructions to earn as many aesthetic points as possible. 2. Get to know the elements of the surroundings available in the Służew nad Dolinką estate. Choose environmentally friendly, look after social initiatives, and the necessary elements of small architecture. Earn points for aesthetics, sustainability, and functionality. 3. Share your vision with us - share your design on Instagram with #BLOKIgame.

rows.name: Kitchen Quest
rows.short_description: Become the best chef in the world! Cook more than 50 dishes in your own kitchen with everything a chef needs. Automate your own restaurant with the help of employees and leave all the annoying tasks behind!
rows.description_html: Become the best chef in the world! In Kitchen Quest you can prepare over 50 delicious dishes - in your own fully equipped dream kitchen! From frying pans to deep fryers, everything a real chef needs is included. And don't forget: Your restaurant should be just as impressive as your food - otherwise guests will leave before you can even serve them. Everything a chef's heart desires Your kitchen has more than 50 different ingredients for you to get creative with. Cook, fry, bake and surprise your guests with a varied menu that leaves nothing to be desired. Watch out, the kitchen may catch fire! But be warned: in the hustle and bustle of a real professional kitchen, things can quickly go wrong. A steak on the grill for too long? You've got a problem! In Kitchen Quest, every second counts - and your guests have little patience. Critical guests, real challenges Customers are merciless in their judgement. A late order or a dish that doesn't meet their expectations will have an immediate impact on your rating. Some never give you a second chance, others remain silent - but don't come back. Learn to deal with pressure and keep improving your restaurant. The critics are coming! Invite up to 7 different restaurant critics to take your restaurant to the next level. If they like your food, they'll share their secret favourite recipes with you - which you can then sell yourself. Fancy cooking without the stress? Then sandbox mode is just the thing. All recipes are unlocked immediately, you can take your time to embellish your restaurant - and annoying guests who run away because of every little thing stay outside. Perfect for creative, relaxed play.

rows.name: Ruins To Fortress
rows.short_description: Explore a post-apocalyptic island, craft, build, tear down enemy bases, defend and nuke your rivals! Life's about surviving in this multiplayer game, no matter what it takes!
rows.description_html: Ruins To Fortress - A 2D survival game focusing on base building and PvP/PvE gameplay. Welcome to Ruins To Fortress, a thrilling 2D survival game currently in development that puts you in a world of base-building and intense PVP combat. Prepare to embark on a journey as you navigate a harsh, abandoned island teeming with danger and opportunity. Gather resources, construct shelters, cultivate plants, and forge tools and weapons to survive. Feel free to install the separate dedicated server or host the game yourself. Help us stress test the servers as we raise the maximum capacities during Early Access. Gameplay Survival Mechanics : Players start naked, armed only with a club on an island, and must gather basic resources like wood, stone, and food to survive. Unlike other survival games, food is not strictly necessary for survival but provides health benefits. Crafting : Ruins To Fortress offers an extensive crafting system, allowing players to create a wide range of items, from simple tools and weapons to advanced technologies. Resources like metal, cloth, and animal hides are used to craft equipment that facilitates survival. Base Building : Base building is a central aspect of the game. Players can construct shelters to protect themselves from other players, NPCs, and animals. These bases can be attacked and looted by other players, making the game particularly exciting and competitive. Raiding : Another characteristic element of Ruins To Fortress is the raiding of other players' bases. By using explosives and other tools, players can breach enemy bases to steal resources and equipment. PvP (Player vs. Player) : Ruins To Fortress is known for its intense PvP elements. Players can attack each other at any time, making the game a constant challenge. Alliances and rivalries between players or clans strongly shape the gameplay experience. PvE (Player vs. Environment) : Ruins To Fortress already includes numerous PvE elements to offer a non-competitive gaming experience. These PvE elements are planned to be significantly expanded and enhanced over the course of Early Access.

rows.name: English Is Hard_
rows.short_description: An arcade style typing game that evokes the nostalgia of Missile Command. Defend your cows, shoot aliens, and go for the high score!
rows.description_html: Keeping a cow farm is hard enough, but now there's aliens coming for your bovine buddies! Use your barn cannon to shoot down the aggressive extraterrestrials and protect your cows from being carried off to an untimely demise. If your cannon is too weak, brush up on your typing skills to empower it and wreak havoc on those angry aliens! Wave after wave of diverse aliens will come for your cattle. Use your barn bannon, type power-up words, and destroy cataclysmic meteors so that your animal friends can live for as long as possible. You're only competing against yourself; see if you can manage to get the high score! If you want to protect your cows, you'll need to master your aim, as well as your typing talent. With skill and a little bit of luck, you can set the new high score! At the end of the day, English ain't that hard! A mouse-aimed cannon that gets stronger the more you type Endless, randomized waves with a variety of enemy types Powerups to give you the upper hand against the alien onslaught A high score that you can beat and replace with your own This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.short_description: Fly, shoot, and even nuke your friends in Paper Planes! This 2D arcade style shooter is played with up to four players, control a plane or maybe even a wizard all while trying to eliminate each other from out of the sky. Come fly with your friends and crown yourself the victor.

Powerups can be found which will give you an edge on the competition, just be sure to avoid any hazards throughout the sky. Come fly with your friends in Paper Planes and crown yourself the victor. Local multiplayer PvP combat. Various types of planes with different abilities. Different maps with unique obstacles. rows.name: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury - 劣化：キョムの怒り
rows.short_description: Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network in this mix of exploration and 3D bullet-hell/FPS game.
rows.description_html: WARNING: this game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. Summary: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury - 劣化：キョムの怒り is a 3D bullet-hell/FPS game in which you explore a strange, seemingly abandoned island while discovering its hidden, vast virtual network. Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network. Some overall primary features: Up to thirteen chapters and three possible endings. A variety of locations, alternating between short exploration and boss battles. 6 difficulty modes, including a practice mode, and a 'MEGA' mode with unique enemy attack patterns, best suited for a second playthrough. A light story about AI, viruses, and making new virtual friends! Gameplay considerations The game can be played with a controller, but a keyboard and mouse setup is recommended. DLSS is available. Realtime ray/path tracing is necessary for some of the effects used in the game. Thus, a GPU capable of handling this type of rendering is required. Bonus content: A game not previously released on Steam, titled World Annihilation Operations: Space Manipulation. It showcases various sci-fi and surreal environments in which space seems unstable. From impossible objects, to teleportation portals, or multiple depths of reflections, explore 5 levels of weird visuals while occasionally solving environmental puzzles. A second much smaller game, never released anywhere, developed in the context of a game prototype design class a few years ago. It is a simple platformer game set in a long tunnel where gravity works in mysterious ways. A music player, letting you listen to the music found within the main game, at your own leisure. This content can be unlocked through specific in-game challenges, or immediately, as gifts for buying one of my DLCs (essentially donations). Academic context: This game (as well as the first bonus game) is done in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction. It is expected that more games emerge from this research. Following the publication of these works, the operations developed through the creation process should lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This game is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs (they do not add any content not accessible within the game!).

rows.name: Filled to the Limit
rows.short_description: ​A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity!
rows.description_html: A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for some quick cash. She is hired to test her limits with a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity! HOW TO PLAY You have two minutes to fill her up! You control the tube-feeding machine and must make sure there is enough pressure to fill her up fast enough, but not enough pressure for it to blow up. FEATURES A cute girl who gains weight. Fun and replayable. One button controls... A gallery to revisit how far you pushed her limits! Developed for the Weight Gaming's 'Push the Limits' Lo-Cal Gain Jam! Have fun!

rows.name: Bug Bash
rows.short_description: Unleash your inner exterminator in Bug Bash! Wield a virtual flipflop to squash bugs, protect your food, and navigate the challenge of sparing birds and bees in this thrilling, interactive game.
rows.description_html: Dive deeper into the bug-bashing frenzy with Bug Bash! This fast-paced, interactive game now offers 20 unique levels, each presenting its own set of challenges and a variety of bugs to bash. Protect different food items as you progress, adding a strategic twist to your exterminating adventures. On top of the regular critters, keep an eye out for rare bugs – bashing them earns you bonus points! Whether you're a veteran gamer or just looking for some engaging entertainment, Bug Bash’s blend of action and strategy will keep you engaged. Join the fun and discover how adept you are at protecting your feast while bashing those pesky bugs! Bash bugs to accumulate points and advance to the next level. Beware, as missed hits and bugs that escape will deduct points from your score. Guard the food against bugs within the set time limit to earn bonus points. Alternatively Do none of that and just sacrifice your entire head to him. He really likes them.

rows.name: MINDFIELD
rows.short_description: Experience the powerful VR short film, Mindfield, delving deep into the world of PTSD. Immerse yourself in this thought-provoking journey and witness the invisible scars of war in a whole new way.
rows.description_html: Warning: Some scenes contain violence and death, and may not be suitable for all viewers. Viewer discretion advised. As long as the scars remain unhealed, the fight isn't over. After returning from his latest mission abroad, John undergoes a profound transformation. Haunted by the trauma of his recent experience, he finds that he is no longer the person he once was, and this change is evident not only to him but also to those in his life. Though he has developed techniques to bury these painful memories deep within, they persistently resurface, threatening to consume him. In order to break free from this torment, John is compelled to confront the ghosts of his past and make a pivotal decision. Will he find the strength to make the correct choice? VR EXPERIENCE Abstractly exploring and depicting the invisible impacts of altered mental health, MINDFIELD is an immersive experience focuses on how John, an army veteran, has his life altered by his post-traumatic stress disorder. The audience will delve inside his memories, transported to the core of the emotional rift he experienced during a more chaotic time of war. Will John be able to open up about his past to a loved one, freeing himself partially from the burden he bears? Or will he remain stuck in this loop of hopelessness? The person that can determine John's fate... is you! ADDRESSING POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER The film's objective is to sensitize the viewer towards how PTSD can influence the experience of daily life, making them a witness of imagery depicting the character's inner state of turmoil, as well as exposing them to a painful memory of trauma. The film searches to evoke empathy, but also to provoke a questioning towards traumatic experiences, their impacts and the healing process.

To be able to get out of it, there is only one way, the power of music ! Escape the Mansion Try escaping the Haunted Mansion without being caught by the ghosts Cross between 23 and 27 level, depending on the path you choose to take End the adventure with an epic final BOSS fight Play Together Play as a team Be careful where you walk Play in rhythm or risk losing your partner When you die the roles are reversed Multiple Instruments Unlock up to 5 different instruments With randomly generated music scores at each level Discover their unique sounds Understand what effects they have on the mansion
