rows.name: Neon Marble Rust
rows.short_description: Build bases, manage resources, scout, strategize, tech-up, produce and control hordes of arena-bots. Neon, Marble, and Rust are the 3 factions, each has a unique economy and roster. Play online or choose from a variety of single-player modes. Classic-style RTS before a stadium crowd.
rows.description_html: Work of solo-developer Harry T, Neon Marble Rust is a Classic-style RTS that leans into the challenging aspects of beloved strategy games from the 90s. Build bases, manage resources, scout, strategize, tech-up, produce and control hordes of arena-bots. Play online or play a variety of single-player modes. - 3 Factions - What started as friendly competitions between engineers eventually grew into a massive spectator sport. Originally, it was just duels, one custom-built robot fighting against another one. The spectacle grew as teams of arena-bots were pitted against each other, and it grew further when the robots became able to replicate. Custom-designed robots were replaced with strict paradigms, and by the turn of the 22nd century society was controlled by 3 cultish Houses: Neon, Marble, and Rust. Emerged from the underground and established the first House. They were nearly ripped apart by a long-standing internal rivalry. Modern designs & ancient inspirations. To achieve success their commanders must be proactive and dynamic. Old machines from the forgotten age of consciousness. Their resourcefulness makes up for their inefficiencies. - Classic RTS - Base Building: Your bases will need resource drop-offs, army production, and static defense. Construct and defend additional expansions. Each faction has a different technology-tree and a fully unique roster. Manage Resources: Just mining resources isn't enough, you'll need specialized buildings to make advanced resources. Each faction has additional exotic resources, which define their technology-tree. Scout & Strategize: NMR is a Classic-RTS, which means your build-order is a big part of your strategy. Monitor your opponent so you can know when to expand, defend, or attack. Control hordes of Arena-Bots: Units are produced in batches, typically of size 3 to 5, so you can make big armies. Some Arena-Bots can teleport, some fire skill-shots, others can install computer-viruses on enemy Arena-Bots. - Dominate the Competition - These arena-bots don't battle to conquer territory, they're here to win in the arena. Matches are 20 minutes long, and are decided by a Score. Each player's central buildings are their Cores, these are where players make their worker units. Destroy an enemy Core to earn 1 point. - Variety of Game Modes - Online Multiplayer: Play Quick-Match or make a Custom Room and invite your friends. Matches are all 1v1, but you can watch as an observer. Skirmish/Sandbox: Play a match against the AI, can enable cheats. Practice: 6 different modes, each simplifies the game dramatically. Completing the challenges earns stars and unlocks other units. Replays: You can save replays of your matches in the basic game modes (online, sandbox, skirmish) Custom Maps: NYI

rows.short_description: BARA Labs is a short collection of experimental prototype games made by our team. We will decide whether or not to make a full-length game out of the shorts based on how the prototypes are received by the players.
rows.description_html: BARA Labs is a short collection of experimental prototype games made by our team. We will decide whether or not to make a full-length game out of the shorts based on how the prototypes are received by the players. Prototypr - Spoiled Red Riding Hood Little Red was a boy who had a loving family, living with his father, mother, and grandmother. However, for some reason, his grandfather lived separately in the depths of the forest. Little Red Riding Hood had a strong bond with his grandfather, and he always wore the red hooded cape that his grandfather had given him. He often ventured alone to visit his grandfather, and he would often encounter a kind hunter. The hunter seemed to take care of his grandfather, and their relationship appeared to be quite good. Little Red Riding Hood also had a secret crush on the hunter. However, for some reason, his grandmother despised the hunter. On the day after Little Red Riding Hood turned 18, he and his family had spent a joyful birthday celebration at home. Wanting to share his happiness with his grandfather and hoping to see the hunter he secretly admired, Little Red Riding Hood carefully packed his birthday cake and embarked on his journey to visit his grandfather...

rows.name: Tank Team
rows.short_description: A team based PVP game where groups of up to 8 players must work together to operate a tank!
rows.description_html: Tank Team, the ultimate game of cooperation, coordination and most importantly: communication . Assemble a team of up to 8 players (recommended 2 minimum) and operate your tank by doing tasks, such as rotating the barrel, loading the shells, setting the power and pressing FIRE! However, only one member of your team can see outside the tank at a time, so you're going to need precise communication to land your shots... The last team standing, wins! Free Version Host and join lobbies Play the default premade maps Experience the core of the game If you'd like to help support the development of the game and get the full Tank Team experience, you can purchase the 'Full Version' DLC! Full Version Unlock cool cosmetics Earn currency by playing games Use the level editor to create custom maps As a host, you can play custom Workshop maps And don't forget: Teamwork makes the tank work!

Adventure through unique settings and solve puzzles, play minigames, pulverize enemies and more as you live out the fantastical fantasy adventure of your wildest dreams! ... rows.name: Super Retro Rec League Racing
rows.short_description: Race against the clock in Super Retro Rec League Racing! Perfect your lines, optimize every turn, time your pits, and push yourself to absolute mastery.
rows.description_html: Super Retro Rec League Racing is a single-player, time-attack style arcade racer. Inspired by high-speed open-wheel racing, players will need to perfect their lines, optimize every turn, remember to check their fuel, and have absolute control to dominate the tracks. The game is simple, but navigating the tracks at high speed requires absolute focus, as a single slip up can shatter your shot at a new record. The game features 6 unique tracks, plus a second set of remixed hot-lap variations. The game is built on Unreal Engine 5, and supports both keyboard & controller.

rows.short_description: Can you lead four different survivors despite threats in a hostile winter area? Join the strategic multiplayer challenge! Survive It: Frozen is a small indie game that comes with a new and unique gameplay concept combining survival and real time strategy.
rows.description_html: Manage 4 different characters simultaneously Lead a group of four diverse survivors with different stats and abilities. Use their different strengths to build infrastructure, manage the cold weather and collect resources. Fight the merciless nature and various threats such as wild animals. Weaken your opponents by using threats Deploy threats on your opponents to weaken them. Your primary objective is to reach the chopper in the center of the map by completing the tunnel first! Optimize your build order Strategy is a core element of this top-down survival game: In order to be successful, you must optimize your build order. Timing with the changing weather, character micro and resource macro are key elements for success. Act wisely on a beautiful and symmetrically designed winter map. Key features Experience unique gameplay: Survival combined with real time strategy elements at its core: Top-down view, base building, resource collection Lead four diverse survivors in each game. The survivors come with unique abilities, different stats and weapons. Mange the hunger and coldness for each of your characters to keep them alive, while trying to build a tunnel to escape a hostile area Challenge other players in this 1 vs 1 multiplayer game with your strategies and get placed on the leaderboard Apply threats like blizzards, wolf packs, virus spreading and avalanches to weaken your opponent Play on a symmetrically, beautifully designed winter map with a lot of details and strategic options Deal with the changing weather Support the development of this unique and new game idea and get the full Survive It: Frozen experience by purchasing the 'Additional Characters Pack' on Steam. This DLC features four additional characters, allowing you to play the game with new character combinations and different build orders.

rows.name: Starheim
rows.short_description: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting MMO set in a universe based on Norse mythology. Materials collected by destroying AI ships, other players, and mining asteroids can be used to upgrade your ship, with dozens of models to choose from on your journey from a small fighter to a dreadnought.
rows.description_html: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting looter shooter MMO with ship progression set in a universe based on Norse mythology in early access for PC and Android (Google Play). Combat: The game focuses heavily on ship to ship combat, allowing players to blow up NPC ships en mass and collect the loot they drop, or fight other players. The main idea is to simplify the spaceship piloting mechanic seen in other big space titles like Eve or Elite Dangerous by locking ships and bullets so everything is on a flat plane. Not having to deal with anything moving up and down makes it possible to control a very fast moving ship, dodge bullets, and warp around like not usually seen in MMO space games. A major decision was made early in development to not feature any kind of 'Heat seeking missile' type weapons, meaning you have to actually point your ship at a target to hit them. I've never really cared for the 'Locking on and firing a missile and waiting to see if it hits' type of space combat, even if it is more realistic. Boss fights are designed to be taken on by a party of at least 2 players, and party members share EXP, encouraging team play. Physics: Ships are all driven by real physics, meaning when you push the forward button, your ship gets pushed forward with realistic thrust, and momentum is maintained until you press back to activate the reverse thrusters to slow down. This can be challenging to get the hang of, but it does make for a more realistic spaceship pilioting experience, and opens up ways for players to play around with the physics. Slamming into another player will effect their movement or send them spinning off, instead of you ship just bouncing off. Asteroids are driven by real physics too, allowing you to shoot them to launch them at people or NPC enemies. All ships come equiped with a Tractor Beam, which creates a gravity well in front of the ship that attracts asteroids and NPC ships, allowing you to 'grab' an asteroid and carry it around with you and shoot it to launch it at someone on demand. Open PvP: While fun combat is always important, the primary goal with the game was to create a sandbox where players can interact with eachother. A lot of inspiration was taken from oldschool MMOs where you could just get on and mess around with random people in an open PvP enviroment, and the mechanics are as open as possible to allow players the freedom to play however they like. Most of the world is Open PvP, with the ability to set it to 'Peace' or 'PK' mode. Enforcer ships protect high traffic areas like upgrade centers, and will attack PKers on sight. Death isn't super punishing unless you haven't put stuff in the bank, so it's all in good fun. PKers (Player Killers) get 10 PKPoints when they kill another player, and getting 30+ PKPoints makes a player redname, where they can drop their equipped modules if they die, upping the stakes for attacking other players. Factions: The game has a Faction system that allows peoples to create or join a faction with other players. Later the faction system will be used for a faction vs faction PvP event, pitting the followers of dark gods like Loki against the gods of order like Thor. Making the strongest ship you can: Players can build ships of several different classes including: Fighters (Speed Focus) Destroyers (Damage Focus) Frigates (Survivability Focus) Artillery Cruisers (Heavy Weapon Focus, think big railgun) Dreadnought (Good damage and survivability but slower and a bigger target) Modules to add additional offensive or defensive capabilities can also be bought or looted and equipped to ships to increase their stats. Ships and Modules have an upgrade system similar to land-based MMORPGs, with stats that go up to Legendary, +9, 2 Sockets. Since it's based on Norse mythology, we had to make the objects that go into sockets Viking Runes. These runes grant various stat inceases or effects like boosting EXP gained. Elements: The game is heavily element based, each weapon being able to change between 8 different elements, changing the visual of the projectile and changing the type of damage it does. Nearly every ship has an element based energy shield that needs to be taken down before damage can be dealt to the ship's Hull HP. Hitting a shield with an element that counters it does 50% more damage, for example hitting an Ice shield with Fire element. Hitting a shield that counters the weapon deals reduced damage, for example hitting an Earth shield with a Lightning bullet. Countering NPC shields with an opposing element increases their drop rates by 50%. The game can be played with a Mouse and Keyboard, Touch Screen, and partially with a Controller (Mouse and Keyboard still needed to navigate the UI, Controller to control the ship). It runs well on Steam Deck even in the early access version, and has an input mode specifically tailored to Steam Deck, but some functionality may always require the touch screen such as dragging items from one inventory to another. Steam Deck is kind of the perfect type of device to play it on since it's the kind of casual experience Steam Deck was built for, so good Steam Deck compatibility is high priority.
rows.about_html: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting looter shooter MMO with ship progression set in a universe based on Norse mythology in early access for PC and Android (Google Play). Combat: The game focuses heavily on ship to ship combat, allowing players to blow up NPC ships en mass and collect the loot they drop, or fight other players. The main idea is to simplify the spaceship piloting mechanic seen in other big space titles like Eve or Elite Dangerous by locking ships and bullets so everything is on a flat plane. Not having to deal with anything moving up and down makes it possible to control a very fast moving ship, dodge bullets, and warp around like not usually seen in MMO space games. A major decision was made early in development to not feature any kind of 'Heat seeking missile' type weapons, meaning you have to actually point your ship at a target to hit them. I've never really cared for the 'Locking on and firing a missile and waiting to see if it hits' type of space combat, even if it is more realistic. Boss fights are designed to be taken on by a party of at least 2 players, and party members share EXP, encouraging team play. Physics: Ships are all driven by real physics, meaning when you push the forward button, your ship gets pushed forward with realistic thrust, and momentum is maintained until you press back to activate the reverse thrusters to slow down. This can be challenging to get the hang of, but it does make for a more realistic spaceship pilioting experience, and opens up ways for players to play around with the physics. Slamming into another player will effect their movement or send them spinning off, instead of you ship just bouncing off. Asteroids are driven by real physics too, allowing you to shoot them to launch them at people or NPC enemies. All ships come equiped with a Tractor Beam, which creates a gravity well in front of the ship that attracts asteroids and NPC ships, allowing you to 'grab' an asteroid and carry it around with you and shoot it to launch it at someone on demand. Open PvP: While fun combat is always important, the primary goal with the game was to create a sandbox where players can interact with eachother. A lot of inspiration was taken from oldschool MMOs where you could just get on and mess around with random people in an open PvP enviroment, and the mechanics are as open as possible to allow players the freedom to play however they like. Most of the world is Open PvP, with the ability to set it to 'Peace' or 'PK' mode. Enforcer ships protect high traffic areas like upgrade centers, and will attack PKers on sight. Death isn't super punishing unless you haven't put stuff in the bank, so it's all in good fun. PKers (Player Killers) get 10 PKPoints when they kill another player, and getting 30+ PKPoints makes a player redname, where they can drop their equipped modules if they die, upping the stakes for attacking other players. Factions: The game has a Faction system that allows peoples to create or join a faction with other players. Later the faction system will be used for a faction vs faction PvP event, pitting the followers of dark gods like Loki against the gods of order like Thor. Making the strongest ship you can: Players can build ships of several different classes including: Fighters (Speed Focus) Destroyers (Damage Focus) Frigates (Survivability Focus) Artillery Cruisers (Heavy Weapon Focus, think big railgun) Dreadnought (Good damage and survivability but slower and a bigger target) Modules to add additional offensive or defensive capabilities can also be bought or looted and equipped to ships to increase their stats. Ships and Modules have an upgrade system similar to land-based MMORPGs, with stats that go up to Legendary, +9, 2 Sockets. Since it's based on Norse mythology, we had to make the objects that go into sockets Viking Runes. These runes grant various stat inceases or effects like boosting EXP gained. Elements: The game is heavily element based, each weapon being able to change between 8 different elements, changing the visual of the projectile and changing the type of damage it does. Nearly every ship has an element based energy shield that needs to be taken down before damage can be dealt to the ship's Hull HP. Hitting a shield with an element that counters it does 50% more damage, for example hitting an Ice shield with Fire element. Hitting a shield that counters the weapon deals reduced damage, for example hitting an Earth shield with a Lightning bullet. Countering NPC shields with an opposing element increases their drop rates by 50%. The game can be played with a Mouse and Keyboard, Touch Screen, and partially with a Controller (Mouse and Keyboard still needed to navigate the UI, Controller to control the ship). It runs well on Steam Deck even in the early access version, and has an input mode specifically tailored to Steam Deck, but some functionality may always require the touch screen such as dragging items from one inventory to another. Steam Deck is kind of the perfect type of device to play it on since it's the kind of casual experience Steam Deck was built for, so good Steam Deck compatibility is high priority.

rows.name: Wurmus
rows.short_description: Join a snake-like game of tag. Chase and dodge, collect power-ups, and manage chaos to become the longest worm on the playground.
rows.description_html: Wurmus is a non-traditional snake-like which rewards creative movement, spatial awareness, and risk management. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones. A different breed of Snake Outrun, outsmart, and eat your opponents. Move backwards, strafe sideways, and turn freely. Collect power-ups which taunt, instill fear, and grant stability. Improve your high score Earn points for captures and longevity. Purposely lose encounters—and manage the ensuing chaos—to pad your highest score yet. An accessible experience Wurmus provides high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.

rows.name: Fishyphus
rows.short_description: Traverse an impressionistic sea, listening for predator and prey. Cast a lure and feel their cues to reel them in. The reaper slowly tracks your movements, who you must outmaneuver to survive.
rows.description_html: Fishyphus is a horror fishing roguelite which rewards careful navigation, quick reflexes, and persistence. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones. Sail the waves Take command of a fishing vessel with momentum-based physics controls. Sail endlessly in any direction across abstract, colorful, and relaxing ocean waves. Catch the fish Track fish by their mesmerizing songs. Drop anchor and fish with a single button. The reflex-based fishing minigame is easy to learn—yet hard to perfect. Battle the reaper Beware the certain death which lurks beneath! Catch fish to awaken it, stun it, and strengthen its resolve. Only through death will you survive longer. An accessible experience Fishyphus provides a tutorial, high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, haptic feedback, adjustable difficulty settings, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.

rows.name: Budget Backrooms
rows.short_description: Free single-player Backrooms game developed on a low budget.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Budget Backrooms , a free-to-play game set in the classic Backrooms creepy pasta, this time keeping it low-budget. You find yourself in a mysterious place, somehow you noclipped into the Backrooms, you get up, pick up your flashlight and start exploring the corners of the so-called 'Level 0' best known as 'The Lobby'. Levels The levels in this game have a unique and linear layout, you will find plenty of content to explore, easter-eggs and 'Sub-Levels'. Immersive Atmosphere Budget Backrooms tries its best to deliver a constant and immersive Backrooms experience throughout the gameplay, from sound effects to modest graphics quality. The game uses binaural audio so playing with headphones is strongly recommended. Entities There are currently 3 Entities in this game, but the ones that stand out are The Howler which will chase you if you get too close, and The Smiler killing you if you shine light in his area. Community Driven If you want to contribute to the game you can do so by joining the active Discord Server or by contributing to the source code on GitHub.

rows.name: D.V. Ex Agent (Episode 1)
rows.short_description: 'D.V. Ex Agent' is a narrative game with elements of horror, telling the dramatic story of the main character. You will have to come face to face with skeletons in the closet along with him. The events unfold in the post-Soviet era.
rows.description_html: D.V. Ex Agent - is a short narrative game with horror elements. The plot of the game is intriguing, and the gameplay conveys a sense of gradual decomposition of the subconscious. The game also contains many jokes and references. 'Do you know what can ruin a person's life? There can be many reasons. One such reason was the events that happened to the main character.' Citizen Drankov was a respected man and worked in a secret government organization. He was trusted by the leadership, which ultimately played a cruel joke on him. You will have to go through the key moments of our hero's life. Waking up on the street near garbage cans, Drankov realizes that he remembers nothing and tries to figure out what happened. His tormented mind begins to play cruel tricks on him, and the skeletons in his closet decide to perform their sinister dance. Game Features: - Main genre: walking simulator. - Gameplay recreates the realities of a person suffering from delirium. - The feeling of being in a parallel world, or rather in the world inside the subconscious at the terminal stage of delirium. - Atmospheric sound and visual design creating a tense and mystical atmosphere. - Some puzzles will really make you 'rack your brains,' they are not easy. - A sad and dramatic plot filled with emotional content. - And what's a game without jump scares? Average playthrough time: 60 minutes .

rows.name: Love x Debut
rows.short_description: Live the life of an idol manager! Following a car accident, you’re transported into a video game world filled with great music and steamy h-scenes. Build your talent agency, train future stars and lead them to stardom in the music industry. Conquer their hearts one idol at the time!
rows.description_html: Have you ever dreamed of being an idol manager? The time has come to embark on that journey! After a car accident, you suddenly find yourself isekai’d in the universe of a popular video game that you were playing. Here, you have to create your very own talent agency and find success in the exciting music industry. This epic isekai idol business simulator features spectacular music and a builder-style gameplay. Build your agency, guide the babes towards celebrity, complete quests and unlock exclusive rewards. Recruit the girls and make sure these sexy aspiring stars get everything they need on the path to popularity. The trainees are super talented and eager to become real idols, but they need you for that! You’ll not only be in charge of leading the company and managing careers but also of seducing the hotties. This industry is filled with spicy fun & juicy h-scenes. The road to fame might get lonely sometimes, so make sure you give them the love they need!

rows.name: Faaast Penguin
rows.short_description: 'Faaast Penguin' is a wild and thrilling knockout action racing game where up to 40 penguins collide in a chaotic race to the finish! It's free with cross-platform support! Unleash attacks! Hop on ULTIMATE RIDES! Use shortcuts! Pass your rivals and reach the finish line first!
rows.description_html: You’ve never been on a vacation like this―― Heading for an extravagant dinner, penguins collide in a knockout race. TAKEOFF! 🐧Faaast Penguin Highlights📷️ ○Strategic attacks are the key to survival! Close the gap using rivals or obstacles… Attack at the right moment! When your attack succeeds, you’ll fly forward and speed up. You can use attacks right after each other after successful hits, so find opportunities to keep chaining combos as much as you can! ○Race at all kinds of resorts from all over the world! From high-speed water slides and desert pyramids to exploring massive waterfalls in the jungle, or even up in the clouds—you are invited to take a 10-minute tour of up to four courses from a variety of options. Penguins are obsessed with these amazing and chaotic races! 🐧 GAME SYSTEM ◯Intuitive and exciting action Become a boost master by attacking opponents! Skid past your rivals via shortcuts! Hunt Sardine Cans and turn the tide with the Ultimate Ride! The race has begun! Get hyped in chaotic races filled with challenging rivals and obstacles! ◯Survive the party in this knockout action race! The four resort activities are elimination-style races to knock others out of the party! The top points earner is our winner—time to grab your win and maybe a mackerel on the way out! ◯You have a bit of time to spare. What will you do? I’ll be on vacation with friends! Play alone? Dive in with friends? Or huddle a big group for a party? In “Faaast Penguin,” you can enjoy any situation. Solo play, up to 4-player party play, and custom matches for up to 40 penguins. With cross-platform compatibility, anyone can splash their way in! 🐧 Abundant penguin customization Customize your outfits, Rides, Ultimate Rides, and emotes to stand out! Some outfits even change based on your gameplay. Since performance isn't affected, why not enjoy your vacation in style. （Oh, yeah. The penguins are actually tobogganing on Rides🐧） Courses and skins are scheduled to be continually added each season! Experience thrilling and chaotic knockout action racing and join the penguin vacation! ---- ◯Notice “Faaaast Penguin” utilizes Epic Online Services to facilitate cross-platform play. Please note that an Epic Games account is required to play.

rows.name: The Windows Are Gone
rows.short_description: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it.
rows.description_html: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it. The Windows Are Gone is a short, psychological horror game made by Scary Cube. It focuses on creating an immersive and disturbing atmosphere through the manipulation of narrative and audiovisual elements. This game should take 40 minutes to 1 hour to complete. FEATURES - Psychological horror: Immerse yourself in an unsettling narrative that blurs the line between reality and the subconscious. - Retro Aesthetic: Nostalgic PS1/PS2 visuals with a mix of old and modern. - Atmospheric Gameplay: Experience an immersive atmosphere created through the manipulation of the audiovisual elements. - Moving in: Bring the boxes inside and decorate the house to your liking: it's your new home, afterall. - Exploration: Explore the scenary, find secrets and piece together the clues left by the previous owner of this mysterious house. - Multiple Endings: Choose the destiny of the protagonist.

rows.name: Explaining every string
rows.short_description: No online, no services, no DLCs, no open-world, no rogulike, no roguelite, no metroidvania, no backtracking. Can't say 'no god' cause god participate in one of boss fights. Not on your side. It's just straight line from start to finish. And skill required to get through it. Party like 1989.
rows.description_html: This is a game I wanted to create when I was eight. This is a game many of you wanted to create when you was eight. No online, no services, no DLCs, no open-world, no rogulike, no roguelite, no depression metaphors, no metroidvania, no backtracking. Can't say 'no god' cause god participate in one of boss fights. Not on your side. It's just straight line from start to finish. And skill required to get through it. And timer if this is not enough. Party like 1989. This is fully functional and completed game created live, during streams. Viewers of youtube channel 'Explaining Every String' seen creation of this game from very first line. You can see it too (in Russian, unfortunately). Or read on github. First is was educational project but at some point it turned into something close to Andy Warhol movies. Alone man creating videogame while time passes. But I did it (almost, soft is never complete). 400+ streams and here we are. We're dealing with twin-stick shooter. These game features 15 levels in 5 'bioms' + 6 boss fights (god I love boss fights). There are 15 mini-bosses in 15 ordinary levels. You have some arsenal with golden classic like shotgun or rocket launcher and dash to correct your mistake or turn around your luck. Unfortunately, I'm not an artist at all so I gone full retro. Recreated vibes of overcoming 1983 crisis. Colors of NES, sounds of some ancient machine, music a-la 'Mozart meets NintendoCore' and simplistic graphic. Also it includes some simple cut-scenes with story. You can even try to figure out what it means. Special entertainment for whose who loves soulsbourne games. If you think you can do better do it. Code licensed under MIT. Assets under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Fork it and perfect it if you dare.

Become Guardian. Become Gaia.

rows.name: ASTRAL TALE-星界神話
rows.short_description: 'ASTRAL TALE'- Myth of the Stars,' a classic Japanese MMORPG, is now officially operating worldwide. A brand-new profession has been introduced, allowing players to embark on a unique journey across the stars together!
rows.description_html: Classic Japanese MMORPG 'ASTRAL TALE' is making its official release!. Embark on cute adventures under the starry sky, heal your soul, become a one-of-a-kind adventurer, journey with familiar companions into a new chapter, explore the beautiful starry world freely, and shape your destiny to create legends! 【Explore the Astral Realm, Forge Adventures】 Embark on a journey of free exploration in a vast fantasy world, uncover hidden treasures, immerse yourself in adventures and legends unknown, and join hands with your fellow adventurers as you head towards the horizons of the sky and the sea! 【Freedom to Change Class, Your Mastery at the Helm】 Switch between multiple Class at will, allowing your mood or tactical needs to change roles whenever necessary. In the Astral Realm, you can always find your unique style, returning to the initial excitement of role-playing! 【With You in Battle, Stellar Companions】 Powerful companions from the stars have descended at this moment. From the first encounter to building deep connections, they grow alongside you. Each stellarian has their unique story and charm, becoming an indispensable part of your adventures! 【Explore Hidden Worlds With your own personal Mobile Cottage】 Wherever the mobile cottage goes, it takes you there! With its unique three-level design and customizable interior, along with a rich array of life systems including greenhouse gardening, alchemy in the basement, cooking, tailoring, and more, you can create a one-of-a-kind space that's truly your own! 【Rich Wardrobe, Unique Appearance】 Obtain a wealth of free outfits appearance, allowing you to create versatile character images without extra money. From classical elegance to cyber-future, become the cutest adventurer with charm that touches the heart!

rows.short_description: A huge open-world old-school 2D top-down MMORPG packed with monsters, quests, puzzles, and challenging bosses. Explore vast lands, train skills, level up, team up, flaunt rare gear, climb leaderboards, and dive into a satisfying long-form grind. Now in Beta Phase 1 with major updates on the way
rows.description_html: Current State & Development Swords & Crystals is currently in Beta Phase 1. This indie game has been in active development for over six years, with more than 7500 hours of work poured into it, entirely unpaid and driven purely by passion. Every dollar the game earns will be fully reinvested into development, including improved PvP , 5-player dungeons , a player-driven economy with trading and  marketplace system , more bosses / quests / items / zones  and full class/race/character customization . For exact details on planned features and expected release timelines, visit the official Swords & Crystals website . In this early beta stage, the game offers a substantial, stable, and fully playable experience : 200+ items & 100+ quests 10 skills to train & 1 major boss encounter Stable servers with a small but steadily growing community More updates, features, and content polls will continue to roll out as the world evolves. Easy & Accessible Gameplay Enjoy straightforward and simple game mechanics that are easy to pick up. There is no overwhelming user interface, complex calculations, or confusing numbers to figure out which items are best. The game provides very clear overviews of what can be achieved, what the goals are, where to find specific items, which enemies you’ll face, and their item drop rates. Quests follow a clear and consistent design. Objectives are short and easy to understand, without long dialogue or story monologues to skip. All quests use the same familiar system, rather than wildly different mechanics like in OSRS. Expect classic, WoW-style tasks such as slaying enemies, capturing towers, collecting items, reaching locations, or hunting rare drops. You always know exactly what to do. Crafting armor or brewing potions is made effortless, without complicated windows or pop-ups. Everything is designed to be clear, understandable, and accessible, making it enjoyable for players of all experience levels. If you’re looking for modern, highly polished gameplay with streamlined systems, this is not that kind of game. Instead, Swords & Crystals features less polished but high-quality old-school controls and mechanics , offering a classic, nostalgic experience with substance over flash Embark on a Grand Adventure Explore a sprawling 2D top-down MMORPG inspired by Old School RuneScape, Classic World of Warcraft, and Zelda. Swords & Crystals blends real-time action combat inspired by Hyper Light Drifter with challenging, skill-based boss battles reminiscent of Titan Souls and Warcraft. Venture through an enchanted medieval world full of secrets, danger, and discovery, where your journey is shaped by your skill, dedication, and achievements. This indie MMO sets itself apart with a seamless open world, unique art style, online multiplayer, deep RPG systems, and a massive interconnected map with no loading screens . Its 2D world uses detailed physics and animation to create the feel and depth of 3D. KEY FEATURES: Stunning Visuals Travel through lush forests, glowing deserts, enchanted lakes, and shadowy ravines. Dynamic lighting, day/night cycles, floating leaves, and reflective waters bring the world to life. Immersive Soundscapes Atmospheric music and ambient sound design elevate every moment, from calm exploration to intense battles. Interactive Multiplayer Team up, trade, compete, or simply explore with players from around the world. Some monsters and events require strategy and cooperation to overcome. Massive Open World A vast, seamless landscape with no loading screens—filled with secrets, hidden paths, puzzles, and mythical creatures waiting to be discovered. Leveling & Questing Grow stronger by defeating enemies and completing quests. Rise from a beginner to a legendary hero through consistent effort and mastery. Skill Mastery Train 10 distinct skills , including melee, mining, smithing, herbalism, and alchemy. Higher skill levels unlock better tools, stronger weapons, more valuable resources, and crucial advantages in dangerous areas. Collect & Upgrade Gear Explore ruins, caves, and dungeons to uncover rare loot. Earn gold, gather resources, defeat bosses for tokens, and upgrade your equipment through shops and rare drops. Epic Boss Battles Take on colossal bosses alone or with allies. Plan, strategize, equip the right gear, and earn rare treasures for your victories. Puzzles & Secrets Solve magical puzzles, reveal hidden chambers, and uncover secret routes woven throughout the world. Badges & Achievements Showcase your dedication through achievements earned by conquering challenges and discovering hidden locations. Also unlock rare items with can be unlocked by having certain amount of achievement points.  Leaderboards & Records Compete with other players for highest level or skills, top times in boss fights, PvP, and skill challenges. Break records, rise through the ranks, and earn prestige rewards. Constant Evolution Expect regular updates, expansions, events, and continuous improvements—delivered carefully and thoughtfully to ensure your progress, achievements, and items are never devalued. Unlike many modern games, updates are designed not to break or ruin existing systems , so your hard-earned accomplishments remain meaningful as the world grows.

Hospital Mode , build your own Hospital, clean it, heal patients in fun minigames, protect him with security guards, talk with sanity inspectors...

rows.name: Wind Ryder
rows.short_description: A comedy, romantic dating sim, masquerading as an adventure RPG.
rows.description_html: Join our dashing hero, Ryder , as he teams up with three fabulous ladies to save the world from the reawakened astral goddess. Enter the fantasy, magical world of Wind Ryder and explore the town of Fallhorn, its nearby forests and destinations, and an academy which trains would-be heroes. Meet the stunning and fearless huntress, Anabelle Wind , whose arrows never miss their mark! With her sharp aim and even sharper wit, she'll keep you entertained while taking down enemies! Next, we have the captivating mage, Arwen Pryor , whose magical prowess is as mesmerizing as her looks! Watch as she unleashes powerful spells and freezes her enemies with a sultry smile! And let's not forget the elegant elven sword master, Prim Moonstar , who dances through battle like a graceful whirlwind! Prepare to be amazed by her lethal swordplay and her unexpected love for cheesy puns! A romantic comedy adventure with a hero and 3 heroines. Funny banters with laugh-out-loud moments. Fast, turn-based battle system. No grinding needed. Custom anime art. Breathtaking soundtrack. Attraction system to build bond with heroines. Quest journal to guide you. Talent system and different talents to unlock for each character. Forging system for upgrading weapons. Immersive side-quests and a character-driven story. Total playtime: 2-5 hours. Together, this dynamic quartet will battle through treacherous dungeons, face hordes of monstrous foes, and unravel the secrets of the astral goddess! But be prepared for more than just saving the world! With hilarious banter, playful rivalries, and unexpected romances , this game is guaranteed to keep you laughing and swooning! Are you prepared to soar through the skies, save the world, and maybe even find love along the way? Wind Ryder. Get ready for an adventure that will blow you away!

rows.name: Zeitghast
rows.short_description: Run, dash, shoot, and slash your way through a mechanized prehistoric world in this fast paced platformer-shooter. Keep your eye on the clock while trying to stop an evil mad scientist from disrupting the timeline!
rows.description_html: Zeitghast is a fast-paced, action-packed sidescrolling Platformer-Shooter in which you navigate a technologically enhanced prehistoric world. Take on the role of a Zeitghast --A magical time spirit tasked with protecting the timeline, and stop the evil Dr. Antag O’Neste as he travels back in time to take credit for every invention that ever existed. Race Through a Variety of Unique Stages! Traverse a multitude of challenging levels by jumping, dashing, shooting, and slashing! Over a Dozen Unique Weapons! An ice cannon, a rocket launcher, and even a fire-breathing lizard?! There are a wide variety of weapons to pick from, so grab your favorite and start shootin’ and slashin’. Time is Money! Time is the common currency and lifeforce for our Zeitghast protagonist. You can earn more time by collecting time tokens in the level, or by defeating enemies! However, be careful not to run out of time. Discover Secrets In Every Stage! Be on the lookout for time-saving secrets, hidden weapons, and of course, collectibles in every stage! Fight Dangerous Enemies! Fight powerful enemies originating both from the rift between space-time and Dr. Antag’s army of cyborg dinosaurs!

rows.name: Tank Mayhem
rows.short_description: Tank Mayhem is an intense local multiplayer tank shooter with many unique power-ups and game modes. With a 3D environment and real-time lighting, this game aims to add a modern twist to classic 2D tank shooters. Have fun blasting your friends and trying out all of the exciting weapons :)
rows.description_html: Tank Mayhem is an intense local multiplayer tank shooter with many unique power-ups and game modes. With a 3D environment and real-time lighting, this game aims to add a modern twist to classic 2D tank shooters. Have fun blasting your friends and trying out all of the exciting weapons :) Key Features: 22 unique and devastating power-ups. Highly destructive enhanced versions of all base power-ups, bringing the total of weapons in your arsenal up to 45. 20+ maps with a variety of hazards and interactable objects. Highly customisable tanks with thousands of colour combinations. A short set of singleplayer levels that you can use to learn the basic mechanics, and later come back to to get an edge over your friends. Multiple game modes that can be played in any combination. Play the way you like, or turn on everything and enjoy the chaos :) Highly customisable gameplay. Don't like certain power-ups or wish they spawned more often? Fine-tune everything to your heart's content. 11 achievements to collect, with special rewards for completing them.

rows.name: Cubyte
rows.short_description: Cubyte is an abstract minimalist top-down shooter game. Journey through levels, purchase upgrades, and defeat your foes!
rows.description_html: Cubyte. A 2D game made of shapes. Beginning as a lab escapee with your friends detained, you must figure the way out. Prepare to face numerous enemies, each wanting to bring you down! Your objective is to get to a portal that will help teleport you to the next area. Green Bois (ICues) will help guide you through your journey. Skills Required Dodging. Otherwise, you'd probably die. Brain. Can't play the game without it! Aim. How else do you expect to defeat your enemies? Features 15 levels 3 different styled environments 3 unique bosses in-game currency player-leveling experience 2 difficulty options FIRE music Green bois Secrets Disclaimer Mac users are unable to unlock achievements. We are sorry for this inconvenience, and are currently working towards fixing it :(

rows.name: Project Chimeira
rows.short_description: We will save humanity by our knowledge. We need to just immerse in this environment.
rows.description_html: Project Chimera is a gamified learning experience inspired by science in VR, which allows players to explore a vast spaceship and learn about various topics. You find your self before a door in a forest in the middle of nowhere. This door is an entrance to a mysterious spaceship. This spaceship has a central elevator which will be used as a level selection portal. In each level, you should solve puzzles to fix the spaceship and help it to be ready for launch again.

rows.name: Football Heroes League
rows.short_description: Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls.
rows.description_html: ⚽️ FREE TO PLAY  ⚽️ MULTIPLAYER FOOTBALL  ⚽️  LEGENDARY HEROES ⚽️   Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls. A real person controls every player on the pitch, creating dynamic matches blending tactics with spectacular special moves. Master the intuitive third-person control system to aim shots, thread perfect passes, and unleash mind-blowing character abilities that defy physics. Team up with friends, show off your skills, and climb the ranks to become a legendary Soccer God! Experience soccer reimagined with astounding heroic abilities blended with strategic gameplay for high-stakes competitive matches.   Master the innovative aiming system to unleash perfect shots and passes   Charge your kicks for devastating power plays   Execute advanced moves like juggling, trapping, and precision dribbling   Dominate with strategic steals and slide tackles Choose from a diverse roster of extraordinary characters, with more to come throughout Early Access:   Team up with friends in dynamic online matches   Unlock new characters and customize your look   Climb from rookie divisions to legendary Soccer God status   Enjoy skill-based matchmaking for perfectly balanced games   Complete daily and weekly quests to earn rewards   Jump into 2v2, 3v3, or 5v5 matches   Train against AI opponents   Master abilities in a dedicated Training Mode   Coming Soon: Instant Replay System to capture your greatest moments Join us in shaping the future of Football Heroes League! As an indie studio passionate about creating something extraordinary, we're excited to build this game alongside our community. Your feedback and support will help us deliver the competitive soccer experience of your dreams. See you on the pitch!   Run Games

Challenge Yourself: Unlock rewards by beating levels with the perfect solution.
